cfc819a066b90a4db20045201dd15c0f.name: Raw Meat and Azure Russula Skewer
cfc819a066b90a4db20045201dd15c0f.desc:
This mushroom skewer will strengthen not only your flesh but also your mind. 

Grilled over a fire, it will raise your maximum health, increase your magic damage, and accelerate your mana regeneration.

3e5a68386d5fd34d88f0e4a3f97f2d6a.name: Proto Matter-Bender
3e5a68386d5fd34d88f0e4a3f97f2d6a.desc:
A traditional Ancient tool used to adjust the subject's physical matter or shell after arrival. It can also be used to unleash the full wonder of blunt force trauma.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

3175f44896690640a44af5daec27b086.name: Rogue Gloves
3175f44896690640a44af5daec27b086.desc: Protects the fingers from traps and cuts. A rogue's best friend!

002a7d6766df3143b01b0e7cb5044fd2.name: Butter Churn
002a7d6766df3143b01b0e7cb5044fd2.desc: With this butter churn, you can make your own fresh butter and buttermilk at home.

5fb5040d0b18ab49a10b6cf71038697e.name: Oscar Godwin
5fb5040d0b18ab49a10b6cf71038697e.desc: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

40db1c41b2f73c4ab586abbfb0ed7aa4.name: Boreal Axe
40db1c41b2f73c4ab586abbfb0ed7aa4.desc: An axe forged from shadowy steel crowned with a single, slim gemstone. The grip is mantled with boreal wood.

113808d386e74b45a28dfb2e5c34c3af.name: Silver Bowl
113808d386e74b45a28dfb2e5c34c3af.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f02d9b67059dbc47a9d53de77b268a0f.name: Yucca Fruit
f02d9b67059dbc47a9d53de77b268a0f.desc: A sweet fruit that grows in dry areas, needing little water. Despite that, it's quite refreshing!

d42b7cd247f2824294d6657b6606baad.name: Fenrig's Axe
d42b7cd247f2824294d6657b6606baad.desc: An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.

908d9bca9dc88b4eba02b858d6b30c1d.name: Eternal Shock Totem
908d9bca9dc88b4eba02b858d6b30c1d.desc:
Summons a totem that launches shock projectiles at enemies that also deal Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. 
Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

57da8fb8513e8949a9ba897cfc13bc64.name: Meat and Tomato Skewer
57da8fb8513e8949a9ba897cfc13bc64.desc: Even in the simplest setting, this skewer comes together easily with meat, a tomato, and a small flame.

548bb6ac48dc75478fdd244318e6c67b.name: Carved Round Door
548bb6ac48dc75478fdd244318e6c67b.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6b638ca444df2e4396e496143e9515d6.name: Hunter Gloves
6b638ca444df2e4396e496143e9515d6.desc: These leather gloves have been adorned with metal to protect the wearer's knuckles.

d6b6d3d26580d44cb59750c7d8cd1e0b.name: Veilwater Basin Boardwalk I
d6b6d3d26580d44cb59750c7d8cd1e0b.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6892d48601a0af46b8801ffafa92b399.name: Baby Hophare
6892d48601a0af46b8801ffafa92b399.desc: An adorable little Hophare. Its eyes frantically scan the environment when you pick it up, but it calms down quickly.

6892065c0ea27c4899d834a38d2da6dd.name: Table Saw
6892065c0ea27c4899d834a38d2da6dd.desc: An important workplace for a Carpenter which will enable many new crafting opportunities.

4bd9dd0379497142adc6be8093967304.name: Bamboo Barricade I
4bd9dd0379497142adc6be8093967304.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

561696e9737b90439f82f7f58a034b46.name: Long Plant Pot
561696e9737b90439f82f7f58a034b46.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

cf8a87c28cff8e439eb9799aee718fef.name: Dreadbane
cf8a87c28cff8e439eb9799aee718fef.desc: A large and powerful hammer that has been corrupted by the Shroud. Good for smashing bugs!

1f2b3c6765b9aa4588610393cee43436.name: Wood Acid
1f2b3c6765b9aa4588610393cee43436.desc: This byproduct of the Charcoal Kiln has many useful properties, which can be used in medicine and alchemy.

1edff9ae2c58b84396e11bdb78ea1cd5.name: Thaumaturge Hat
1edff9ae2c58b84396e11bdb78ea1cd5.desc: An extravagantly exaggerated tricorn hat that shields the caster's head from snowfall. The imposing antlers are a wearable trophy representing the wearer's spirit animal.

c486b348f4601d4cb24fac1c1ba28dde.name: Brazen Bull Helmet
c486b348f4601d4cb24fac1c1ba28dde.desc: A heavy helmet, adorned with the imposing horns of a bull and a tall, far-reaching crest. The faceplate only leaves room for the eyes, letting the wearer's red-hot anger radiate outwards.

73f5ea287f23ba439ca7fbcd03585d5a.name: Golden Bulwark Chestplate
73f5ea287f23ba439ca7fbcd03585d5a.desc: A gold-plated chest plate, heavy and imposing — piercing it would be no easy task.

3efd68bc4e700341b35f4978bbc2689f.name: Hunter Vest
3efd68bc4e700341b35f4978bbc2689f.desc: Taking down prey, and even other predators is far easier with this finely made hunter's armor.

f6b50dab0b923c4086cc72b74ef700e9.name: Jezmina's Apotheosis
f6b50dab0b923c4086cc72b74ef700e9.desc: An axe that carves a path through enemies, no matter what. Swinging it fearlessly makes it feel light as a feather.

1ca2d6fa3c2af8499c2bd0f7573ad97c.name: Bamboo Room Divider I
1ca2d6fa3c2af8499c2bd0f7573ad97c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

85c7b3e0404a3d4285acc6968e7f7ab3.name: Herbalist Headwrap
85c7b3e0404a3d4285acc6968e7f7ab3.desc: Headgear for herbalists. Healing others is surprisingly hard when you can't actually see them.

544d742ee092cb4ba7da2c4b4f594b2a.name: Monstrous Ribs
544d742ee092cb4ba7da2c4b4f594b2a.desc:
Large ribs of the most vile Fell Monster.

Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

d6781b6f054b3a42badefe306344ea9e.name: Hunter's Ring
d6781b6f054b3a42badefe306344ea9e.desc: An ancient ring that gives you stamina.

8e3dc705ea2f0244a554bf402b08d0a7.name: Small Ancient Prayer Beacon
8e3dc705ea2f0244a554bf402b08d0a7.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c6cd3248b602434ea4a1b0364d420376.name: Veilrift Axe
c6cd3248b602434ea4a1b0364d420376.desc:
Every swing of this axe leaves a tear in the veil that separates the living from the beyond.

Hollow Echo:
The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.

55f9859612f56549ac4e6bd5936b4ad1.name: Eternal Light Burst II
55f9859612f56549ac4e6bd5936b4ad1.desc:
Ignites a flash of light, bright enough to push back enemies around the caster.
It also deals Stamina Damage based on your Intelligence attribute to Shroud infested enemies which fills their Stun Bar.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

c2f7f679987a4e44ad4c85b807dd8b67.name: Ancient Temple Floor Brazier I
c2f7f679987a4e44ad4c85b807dd8b67.desc:
A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.

481deb9e5c75334c8d8c994054e2e21e.name: Fire Fly
481deb9e5c75334c8d8c994054e2e21e.desc:
An animal, also blessed by the Flame, that spreads light in the dark.

Can be used as fishing bait, especially liked by common fish.

e6cae89cc716a049b411057414caae32.name: Herbalist Pants
e6cae89cc716a049b411057414caae32.desc: Some plain herbalist pants. They smell like rosemary and thyme.

8bd0dd9fd526814e8a1276b85427fc10.name: Large Mesosiderite
8bd0dd9fd526814e8a1276b85427fc10.desc: The mesosiderite consists of a rough mix of metal and stone. They likely resulted from a crash between two asteroids.

d138b17a2a204c41ad242cd194b9696e.name: Ammonia Gland
d138b17a2a204c41ad242cd194b9696e.desc:
This gland contains a concentrated substance which can be used to tan furs. 

Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

a9a11d1cdef8794dbef1b5ca34441aa7.name: Torn Cloth
a9a11d1cdef8794dbef1b5ca34441aa7.desc: Torn and tattered remains of cloth that were left behind and now serve the Scavengers as clothing.

0d920b41d6b2ab4ea90924ad45b57531.name: Baby Common Goat
0d920b41d6b2ab4ea90924ad45b57531.desc: A cute baby Common Goat. They tend to rub their heads against your leg for attention.

047e41660da39f4dae53b27e250801c5.name: Monstera Plant
047e41660da39f4dae53b27e250801c5.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

a0df78e7e3aaab4b8badc9515f8f1007.name: Ornate Flute
a0df78e7e3aaab4b8badc9515f8f1007.desc: Miles Rapore's old flute, used to decorate the soundscapes of The Honeydews' many musical performances. He's often credited with keeping the band together, but his reclusive attitude towards crowds and stringent focus on marketability earned him a bad reputation.

8bb182511f44454e80cc10d36ddbf1d0.name: Celestial Axe
8bb182511f44454e80cc10d36ddbf1d0.desc: An ice-cold axe with a central, vibrant gem. Its blades are adorned with small spikes to cause maximum damage. When this axe rains down on its enemies, it beautifully reflects the sun's light.

14fb1506c9800244b5ae3a7c861fbf63.name: Alchemist Apprentice Chest
14fb1506c9800244b5ae3a7c861fbf63.desc: A comfortable, traditional garb suiting an upcoming alchemist.

575eadced16d7e4f9f15cce738d8443e.name: Corn Seedling
575eadced16d7e4f9f15cce738d8443e.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

045fce70c29c1f4e80eedaf84c2edd24.name: Pillar Of Flames III
045fce70c29c1f4e80eedaf84c2edd24.desc:
Ignites an area with flames that continuously damage enemies within.
It also applies a burn debuff to them.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

43a60c501d8c8e438f34ba1547847bc9.name: Fire Totem I
43a60c501d8c8e438f34ba1547847bc9.desc:
Summons a totem that launches fiery projectiles at enemies and explodes when it expires. 
Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

67a17d8d37aecd4594bf1dc0c1d82894.name: Standing Target
67a17d8d37aecd4594bf1dc0c1d82894.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

deca0aa0ba4f934f8bdc026ae793e13f.name: Large Throne Room Brazier
deca0aa0ba4f934f8bdc026ae793e13f.desc:
A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.

1c4577f779efb946841fc67dc174a9e1.name: Icy Brook
1c4577f779efb946841fc67dc174a9e1.desc:
An arrangement of cool grays and blues, reminiscent of an icy brook on a cloudy day.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.

15b5f970b314f9439f308901b98e66f1.name: Red Marble Column Base I
15b5f970b314f9439f308901b98e66f1.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

180af616b4d7c843ad98d6f9fc9f3d2c.name: Book I
180af616b4d7c843ad98d6f9fc9f3d2c.desc: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.

824edd5bb5ee0843aaa4d9017c8dcd57.name: Omen Helmet
824edd5bb5ee0843aaa4d9017c8dcd57.desc:
A living shell to encase the wearer's face like an iron maiden.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

eda21a74f5b0a542abab5cd58983b22e.name: Serpent Warrior Pants
eda21a74f5b0a542abab5cd58983b22e.desc: A pair of grey trousers. They layer well under the more elaborate cloth of the upper body armor.

a96303a3f1efd3459d68b30b446c1f8d.name: Wooden Palisade V
a96303a3f1efd3459d68b30b446c1f8d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

0440334096780a4c8fbc4effefa541bd.name: Blowpipe
0440334096780a4c8fbc4effefa541bd.desc: A long, hollow iron tube. To highly skilled craftsmen it offers the possibility to work glass.

30bf46d3eec42c4db339c94893213f7c.name: Ectoplasm Aggregate
30bf46d3eec42c4db339c94893213f7c.desc: A massive formation of ectoplasm crystals, pulsing with energy. An enormous life force is trapped within — and has been for a very long time.

8d657b64e8638445841f81343c6c6666.name: Scholar's Wand
8d657b64e8638445841f81343c6c6666.desc:
Scholars of the North once researched the use of pyromagic against particularly harsh yearfall. It took countless explosive experiments to discover the same benefit most people might achieve with a bonfire. Downsides, such as third-degree burns, were common, so research was quickly stopped.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

8b73fa682ab1b6498d8cebd2549747f5.name: Frostbite Slasher Hood
8b73fa682ab1b6498d8cebd2549747f5.desc: The fearsome metal mask is only partially covered by the hood, leaving most of its sharp edges and lines visible to your prey.

8c3e0df315e4e84ca62a0f0467dd137e.name: Pendant Ceiling Lantern
8c3e0df315e4e84ca62a0f0467dd137e.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

a69d6c7832f3794cbf4cc5487c634723.name: Tidecaller Tunic
a69d6c7832f3794cbf4cc5487c634723.desc: A light tunic, as majestic in appearance as the powers it bestows when you spread your arms wide.

0421225b5e592d47a5399780a5147b9c.name: Fur Trousers
0421225b5e592d47a5399780a5147b9c.desc: A little archaic, but better than cloth.

92ac28e725dd9c44ac936c572bc0878f.name: Foreboding Golden Urn
92ac28e725dd9c44ac936c572bc0878f.desc: A golden urn with intricate ornaments in the shape of an eerie skull. The lateral detailing resembles fangs or claws.

fe16cd0914cc154589d3d40c5f9a4f56.name: Cathedral
fe16cd0914cc154589d3d40c5f9a4f56.desc:
A cool gray reminiscent of cathedral walls, eternal in its grace and silence.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

83b503e511029d4a94f9122cffce89ca.name: Diver’s Endurance Flask
83b503e511029d4a94f9122cffce89ca.desc:
A flask brewed from rare underwater materials, easing the strain of every powerful stroke. 

Reduces stamina drain while sprint swimming or sprint diving.

c0d123f2ea091b488b2a2d73d69f145d.name: Small Windmill Sails
c0d123f2ea091b488b2a2d73d69f145d.desc:
These windmill sails are small, but they still create enough force to power a mill.

Must be placed near the mill.

233a972dc3e9d547a12c41d6a2322ea0.name: Blue Floor Light II
233a972dc3e9d547a12c41d6a2322ea0.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

57017a17f90fad4782f4a0a1bacdcbd9.name: Book I
57017a17f90fad4782f4a0a1bacdcbd9.desc: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.

4d14f3e45d509642afa626ab672f06fc.name: Hailscourge
4d14f3e45d509642afa626ab672f06fc.desc: A blade that's cold to the touch. It weighs heavily on the mind.

444e01efa8eb0c48a3396f2c1a9feccc.name: Alpine Antler Trousers
444e01efa8eb0c48a3396f2c1a9feccc.desc: A simple pair of brown leather pants that connect well to the corresponding undergarments for the torso.

3ddd13753ea6a84687e6ecf37b2e235c.name: Gem of Lycanthropy
3ddd13753ea6a84687e6ecf37b2e235c.desc: Defeating an enemy at night has a %k chance to spawn a Lunar Orb. Collecting a Lunar Orb grants %k Health and %k Mana aswell as a special food buff that grants %k max Health, %k max Mana, %k max Stamina and %k melee damage for %k.

aaf40338bac09944b5bc96cd686f472c.name: Hailcaster Gloves
aaf40338bac09944b5bc96cd686f472c.desc: Simple layered gloves that allow for optimal versatility and swiftness when spellcasting.

cd73ff4f7899774f9cb8e0f3f0e41dfe.name: Forest Longbow
cd73ff4f7899774f9cb8e0f3f0e41dfe.desc: This bow has great tension, making it exhausting to use. It does great damage in exchange.

0df7a503f83c454e8ea0cafc793c0ed2.name: Room Divider III
0df7a503f83c454e8ea0cafc793c0ed2.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

8a813ac8c9040d4693d2c6eb9940f309.name: Vase Of The Ancients VI
8a813ac8c9040d4693d2c6eb9940f309.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

10f5ac9f81d30c4f86cda8143c3fe81d.name: Decorative Skull III
10f5ac9f81d30c4f86cda8143c3fe81d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

051fffd577b5024eb3cb3211f9172637.name: Gem of Soul Reaping
051fffd577b5024eb3cb3211f9172637.desc: Damaging an enemy puts a   mark on them for %k.  Marked enemies spawn a soul phial on death that can be destroyed to heal you and your allies for %k Health points in a 5m radius and also counts as an enemy kill for other effects.

fb331b404cc91d46a73c55331135096b.name: Flame Arcanist Boots
fb331b404cc91d46a73c55331135096b.desc: Pointy-toed shoes that curl upwards ever so slightly near the front. They feel nice and cool on the feet.

442f50389939c247868b094280499d81.name: Large Bloomheart Fruit Plant Pot II
442f50389939c247868b094280499d81.desc: An ancient potted plant. This one can be displayed in the Cultivation Rack.

e5304164e7b1824ca4bb6cd95aaad715.name: The Last Spark
e5304164e7b1824ca4bb6cd95aaad715.desc:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"A flaming soul in a mortal body, nurtured amongst the ashes of a dying world.
Now, your time has come. Awake!"

My final piece: The last spark, the hearth of hope, the beginning of a new era. I wanted to paint the Flameborn directly, but I cannot begin to fathom what they will look like. Maybe I will get to meet them one day... then, I'll paint them a proper portrait! Until then, I hope you keep this painting safe, friends. - J

1cc9aca717fbd04b9503c4aca889cd4c.name: Blackmire Statue III
1cc9aca717fbd04b9503c4aca889cd4c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c3c30ba54fe5aa45b08d8ed8f3c9c618.name: High Elegant Armchair
c3c30ba54fe5aa45b08d8ed8f3c9c618.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

cb624f582b84d34d9f9403b48b64f823.name: Crypt Fence
cb624f582b84d34d9f9403b48b64f823.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

22571064f67fb6459ce3d1394ad73083.name: Empty Farmbed
22571064f67fb6459ce3d1394ad73083.desc: This Farmbed can be filled with dirt, sand, or soil to grow plants.

22570eb0c488b2408e12e1179d45bdfc.name: Gastropods
22570eb0c488b2408e12e1179d45bdfc.desc:
These two petrified gastropod shells have survived eons — together. One can hope that their inhabitants kept each other company, but a solitary fate is more likely.

This collectible is found in the Revelwood.

fb14d0a6f2db344ea22aa76b7572b8ee.name: Chandelier
fb14d0a6f2db344ea22aa76b7572b8ee.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

3548098b9eefcd4e9d37e06ad3600861.name: Warm Padding
3548098b9eefcd4e9d37e06ad3600861.desc: A warmer and better-insulated padding kit. When used to create armor, it will protect you from the bitter cold.

a8c499594655064496e15effd64bfd3a.name: Steel Hanging Lamp
a8c499594655064496e15effd64bfd3a.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

6a6b61f6f6359c40aa89180143e5e6a3.name: Large Castle Table
6a6b61f6f6359c40aa89180143e5e6a3.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

ad5605512609b445bf4803912628346a.name: Meteorite Showcase (5 Small Slots)
ad5605512609b445bf4803912628346a.desc: A showcase to display meteorite collection items.

90578214b9fb0f4ea489b06b35a98a9c.name: Grilled Yucca Fruit
90578214b9fb0f4ea489b06b35a98a9c.desc: When cooked, the Yucca Fruit becomes very sweet. Makes the mouth water and recovers Stamina.

b84160247140c64ea05d76a81853be14.name: Deerstalker Gloves
b84160247140c64ea05d76a81853be14.desc: Firing an arrow with these gloves is effortless, creating a silky smooth stream of movement for the wearer.

74c213b7dab45c46b0403bfde4d01e61.name: Underwater Luminous Growth
74c213b7dab45c46b0403bfde4d01e61.desc: An organic growth that glows brightly in the deep, dark waters.

be9aef81861fc54db140a606b60d259e.name: Mannequin "Let Me Serve You"
be9aef81861fc54db140a606b60d259e.desc: A mannequin that can be dressed in armor or vanity items.

0db955c372a7ae43bf39e3ed6007df93.name: Gilded Depths
0db955c372a7ae43bf39e3ed6007df93.desc:
Dark as the deep end, a green so rich it swallows light. Balanced with a warm gold and bright turquoise.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

a3acf4cde3eca44d8b4aa435872cddb7.name: The Dragons' Map
a3acf4cde3eca44d8b4aa435872cddb7.desc:
A reconstructed map, consisting of 4 former map pieces. It depicts a lake with an island, a river, an obelisk, and parts of a large skeleton. The full writing on the back now reads: 

Mae's Memoir:
The first day of yearwake is unlike the rest
The peaks lay quiet, licking yearfall's wounds
As the sunlight sets in the faraway west
On fields where sleeping buds awoke to blooms 

Ony's' Memoir:
I fly so high, I may never come down
I dance on the sun, whole body ablaze
My cup's always full, I'd drink till I drown
In liquid light and limerence, until I feel dazed

Orpheus' Memoir:
Once born a wanderer, I sought incandescence and bliss
Now I'm frozen in time, my body cast in chains
Accustomed to a sea of shadow, deep in the abyss
My eyes hurt in the brightness, so no light may remain

Polaris' Memoir:
I'm a shining star, drifting high up in the sky
To find your path, you must look to me only
Gazing down at the world, it's hard to deny
Having no one at my side makes my spirit lonely

43ecb57def309b40b5f97ee4bbc014d2.name: Shroud Nexus
43ecb57def309b40b5f97ee4bbc014d2.desc: Highly concentrated Shroud energy, bundled in a pulsating core.

0edf97311179ba42b2f575e276673922.name: Wood Banister II
0edf97311179ba42b2f575e276673922.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

0ad9bfd08f15cd408a3423478531b661.desc: A mix of different biome-specific materials, mainly stone and dirt.

5a7a68f0e9d0ad45a0014870c67e604e.name: Thaumaturge Boots
5a7a68f0e9d0ad45a0014870c67e604e.desc: A well-fitted pair of boots to round off the Thaumaturge armor set. The purple accents create a balanced overall look.

b53a9a3ba937cc4cbbeddaa8049e061a.name: Iron Axe
b53a9a3ba937cc4cbbeddaa8049e061a.desc: An axe with a very sturdy iron head. It's more efficient!

be7b8288f630b2479e31db7a427a9184.name: Vorgoth's Soulbound Crown
be7b8288f630b2479e31db7a427a9184.desc: His crown claws at him like reaching fingers. Much like the Mysterious Traveler, who needed no such grip to dig into his thoughts.

417ad291e581b74aa1af1895a5a58239.name: Wand Weapon Rack
417ad291e581b74aa1af1895a5a58239.desc: A display to showcase weapons or shields.

2f0dc7b5d2cd994abf9245d2fb985842.name: Palm Leaf Roof Block
2f0dc7b5d2cd994abf9245d2fb985842.desc: A breezy roof made from natural materials. It makes you want to take a tropical vacation.

a88661b3d40aad4a9864e346eb31481a.name: Drak Stone Totem III
a88661b3d40aad4a9864e346eb31481a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4cd635454bafe84b9aac42570da00c4b.name: Rough Wood Block
4cd635454bafe84b9aac42570da00c4b.desc:
A basic construction material. Not very pretty, but it gets the job done.

Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

99e9fc7bf237804bb1398e1e5b69e328.name: Greater Golden Twinflame Sword
99e9fc7bf237804bb1398e1e5b69e328.desc: An elaborate sword, decorated in gold filigree. It came from the skies as a shooting star years ago, and fell into the gaping maw of a cave.

28205f9bbc131349abb29a87fc94aad7.name: Poisoned Bronze Arrow
28205f9bbc131349abb29a87fc94aad7.desc:
A poisoned Special Arrow, deadlier than ever before.

Poisoned Arrow: Enemies hit by this arrow are poisoned and additionally receive 12 damage per second for 5 seconds.

648b944909fe1f46bb272278cf636a6e.name: Rustic Bench
648b944909fe1f46bb272278cf636a6e.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

51f15f4106d6134faeca56cf6d24e4f2.name: Small Ancient Plant Pot
51f15f4106d6134faeca56cf6d24e4f2.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

05a35e54da2ebb4b8a5a09b27c43c24f.name: Root Staff
05a35e54da2ebb4b8a5a09b27c43c24f.desc:
This staff was made from the roots of an age-old tree. Wisdom and calm flow through it.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

1daa0174496c4f458eb16cf2b9e84b19.name: Dragon Sword
1daa0174496c4f458eb16cf2b9e84b19.desc: A mythical blade from long gone days. Legends say that it was passed on to Embervale by a wise spirit who descended from the stars in the year of the dragon.

58267ff592a8604b822fc858b23d7ce3.name: Poisoned Golden Steel Arrow
58267ff592a8604b822fc858b23d7ce3.desc:
This golden, steel-tipped Special Arrow has been dipped in poison. A strike with this will be most deadly.

Poisoned Arrow: Enemies hit by this arrow are poisoned and additionally receive 24 damage per second for 5 seconds.

48c8c466ded1a041b40bb68835f9e739.name: Heal Cascade II
48c8c466ded1a041b40bb68835f9e739.desc:
Releases continuous healing projectiles that automatically seek you and your allies.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

bddbd31b2a1a5f489859e25c0b00193d.name: Abysswalker
bddbd31b2a1a5f489859e25c0b00193d.desc:
A heavy weapon, fit for descending any abyss — both literally and figuratively.

Shroud Imbued: 
This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.

35cc7eec4f9fe843bc041c4e68447c34.name: Marksman Hood
35cc7eec4f9fe843bc041c4e68447c34.desc: A hood worn by ruthless people to hide their intentions. The leather trim provides additional protection and camouflages the wearer between the trees.

09ce5c481a53804cac0d6f9ef30c857f.name: Riptide
09ce5c481a53804cac0d6f9ef30c857f.desc: A shield that was washed into a grotto by the river. It must have belonged to a valiant hero.

4c98958ca67e604a920e50c7f85d4005.name: Sky Specter Chest
4c98958ca67e604a920e50c7f85d4005.desc: A royal blue gambeson that hides the wearer's blackened heart and devious intentions underneath. It allows you to blend into the night sky, providing the perfect camouflage for a downward strike.

21c912f9c324df4a9909274f52d2fcb9.name: Medium Hollow's Eve Pumpkin II
21c912f9c324df4a9909274f52d2fcb9.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

7446834dd102064e873bf718b6b465d9.name: Flame Mosaic Piece II
7446834dd102064e873bf718b6b465d9.desc:
A small part of a shattered Flame mosaic. Perhaps you can piece it together if you find all the shards!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. The full collection includes 8 pieces. They can be reassembled into a mosaic inside a Flame Mosaic Frame. The Frame must be placed on the ground.

33de213770604b4fbc6929c6c7b90563.name: Ripped Alchemist's Wall Hanging
33de213770604b4fbc6929c6c7b90563.desc: The second half of a wall hanging, visualizing the complex symbiosis of the natural and magical. When paired with the other half, perhaps this ancient wisdom can be understood.

ef15b44cd0748742b96d8eb69e292120.name: Silver Jug
ef15b44cd0748742b96d8eb69e292120.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

5efbc56ddd7fad4bba087e6e3fb24554.name: Basket III
5efbc56ddd7fad4bba087e6e3fb24554.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4475b5bf75251a4e99f407a2b8ce74c8.name: Waveborne Ritualist Helmet
4475b5bf75251a4e99f407a2b8ce74c8.desc: The mask veils the face, but not the intent. You are here to keep one safe.

f62201ea0a23fd4c9d45b2fc745c2427.name: Grilled Fish with Coconut Rice
f62201ea0a23fd4c9d45b2fc745c2427.desc: The light sweetness of the coconut rice pairs well with the smoky fish filet. A shame you couldn't add a hint of lime or lemon!

18d4e6218179a14090a6ba1b69f4a4fa.name: Eternal Hollow Wretch II
18d4e6218179a14090a6ba1b69f4a4fa.desc:
Summons a Hollow Wretch ally that attacks enemies. 
Maximum amount of summoned Hollow allies is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

8534ed06a9e98b4ba7b800d38ad24795.name: Rough Wood Block
8534ed06a9e98b4ba7b800d38ad24795.desc:
A basic construction material. Not very pretty, but it gets the job done.

Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

6b92237e02a5904c90d1c5490d4f055e.name: Staff Of The Serpent
6b92237e02a5904c90d1c5490d4f055e.desc:
A majestic staff topped with an ouroboros ornament made from green jade. It's perfect for honoring the year of the snake.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

a92dc4dc00947141855f4400a81ed7b7.name: "Braid" Wig Head
a92dc4dc00947141855f4400a81ed7b7.desc: A wig head that unlocks more haircuts once picked up. It can also be placed in your base as decoration.

a311895ed9773447bda08ad81b24be3b.name: Flame Arcanist Gloves
a311895ed9773447bda08ad81b24be3b.desc: Gilded gloves that brandish both royal blue and gold. They're emblazoned with long, metal claws that tip the gloves.

ab7a8b6a1bf9d940b963d8c6d5ffb8ce.name: Sugar Cane Seedling
ab7a8b6a1bf9d940b963d8c6d5ffb8ce.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

ce5bec6cb7637843bdd502e3f9a3dcd0.name: Luminous Wand
ce5bec6cb7637843bdd502e3f9a3dcd0.desc:
This wand grants power over fire to whoever is brave enough to wield it.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

0cc1386c152dea4c8092f5c0d000e474.name: Nettle  Seedling
0cc1386c152dea4c8092f5c0d000e474.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

88d7433a8b61c44794c732065e902d14.name: Mountain's Shadow Chest
88d7433a8b61c44794c732065e902d14.desc: No matter where you turn, the celestial crags of the mountainside always cast a dark shadow over the valleys. With this piece of armor, you can blend into the dark and travel lightly like a freezing gust of wind to find your enemies.

2cf49b2d3f89b743ac7eea5f444d092f.name: Androme's Wand
2cf49b2d3f89b743ac7eea5f444d092f.desc:
"My dear students, I depart once more... but do not fret! I've prepared a task — and a wand to help you solve it — for my absence! Use this tool to trace the constellations in the sky. Can you find the sign of the Pheonix?"

- Professor Androme

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

ed4d14402830eb43b3078c22c2a078f0.name: Golden Vase Of The Ancients III
ed4d14402830eb43b3078c22c2a078f0.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

61d7ee1862464f49b6c5784ebdfdf4e9.name: Crude Wooden Side Table
61d7ee1862464f49b6c5784ebdfdf4e9.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

522b9707ccb50940b260248ed01e795d.name: Celestium Arrow
522b9707ccb50940b260248ed01e795d.desc: The Celestium tip shimmers beautifully in the sun. But don't let that distract you from landing a precise shot.

4be92df4f4c8e546821e85a0efc82278.name: Larger Sea Lily Fossil
4be92df4f4c8e546821e85a0efc82278.desc:
A large and slender sea lily, reaching up towards the surface and sky. If it had any sense of perception, it'd be able to judge the rise and fall of the sea, as well as the looming change in the waters.

This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.

af0731661c2a3f42a3de76343f36497b.name: Fell Striker Greatsword
af0731661c2a3f42a3de76343f36497b.desc: A blade commonly used by the Striker commando of the Fell. It's brutal, jagged, and efficient.

484cac2d0b395941b6a8fa30f23b9e5c.name: Castle Wall Shelf
484cac2d0b395941b6a8fa30f23b9e5c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

51567a3d7e874947b742ed06f3e6b8ce.name: Eternal Ice Bolt III
51567a3d7e874947b742ed06f3e6b8ce.desc:
Conjures an icy projectile that deals damage in an area and applies a slow debuff.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

e31f1f51e008dd4eb0a0d5c9495ff0fd.name: Waveborne Ritualist Gloves
e31f1f51e008dd4eb0a0d5c9495ff0fd.desc: Golden adornments define this set — and naturally, the gloves are no exception.

fdc005d0db534744ae2c82c6b7393eea.name: Yellow Luminescent Block
fdc005d0db534744ae2c82c6b7393eea.desc: A phosphorizing yellow block that draws your eyes in with whispered promises of wealth and secrecy.

eb232011ab8c0a4c99ef877342529f6a.name: Roasted Coffee Beans
eb232011ab8c0a4c99ef877342529f6a.desc: A handful of roasted coffee beans. They smell chocolaty and rich, with a light note of floral sweetness. They must be ground up before brewing.

A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

667b2e67188abd46871546ebb26e62a6.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

7b2e29208b855f4ebdc8e921190eb0f4.desc:
A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. 

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

89d328076eafec49b184826b0b338dea.name: Book I
89d328076eafec49b184826b0b338dea.desc: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.

2240f40c3275fb4dab69ae12fbe91804.name: Dragon Sword
2240f40c3275fb4dab69ae12fbe91804.desc: A mythical blade from long gone days. Legends say that it was passed on to Embervale by a wise spirit who descended from the stars in the year of the dragon.

0dc156bc61b82940af8f40046e14008d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f5e56e07bc020649b161c950785c0d74.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

5e7f6f5a7a7d1a48a1fc66f6a21d8148.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

2dbefe8895dfd448b4bb925808355f4b.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

9238ad2a024b3340b35a7b74e533a51c.name: Shroud Gelatin
9238ad2a024b3340b35a7b74e533a51c.desc:
A translucent, gelatinous substance. It shimmers with an eerie glow and possesses restorative and protective properties.

Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

063ebbc305db3a4ca513cf5c12ce436c.name: Icicle Sword
063ebbc305db3a4ca513cf5c12ce436c.desc: A sleek silvery sword, slim and reflective like a pure icicle.

9e2f8b5a8fb8ac4f99f150c45b09d640.name: Stinging Nettle
9e2f8b5a8fb8ac4f99f150c45b09d640.desc: One has to be careful when harvesting this herb, but the reward is surely worth it.

4cfdcf23b21608479d17c3eab6c5448f.name: Improved Laboratory
4cfdcf23b21608479d17c3eab6c5448f.desc: This laboratory was improved by adding a retort.

e770de9292560a44895b3c81dc8cdf97.name: Alpine Antler Hood
e770de9292560a44895b3c81dc8cdf97.desc: A fur hood that protects the wearer's face from the strong, cutting mountain winds.

b2085a16513f02488fb8fa6791af06c2.name: Fine Sand
b2085a16513f02488fb8fa6791af06c2.desc:
A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. 

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

4aca045542e09a47917a09d4d4b8efc3.name: Aloe
4aca045542e09a47917a09d4d4b8efc3.desc: This desert plant contains a slimy liquid, which is know to have medical applications. Used in alchemy.

8e2ebc6169711a4d829f98b3430ac97a.name: Yellow Flower
8e2ebc6169711a4d829f98b3430ac97a.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

076d8efdaa982849b5116007ed5ab42d.name: Roasted Corncob
076d8efdaa982849b5116007ed5ab42d.desc: Roasted with a smoky aroma, it's a real pleasure for the taste buds, able to set free all of its strengthening attributes.

11cc83a2f783104580a38396a21db728.name: Crypt Standing Torch
11cc83a2f783104580a38396a21db728.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

c6be57c85dc7f24189bf9602f02d2aef.name: Lute
c6be57c85dc7f24189bf9602f02d2aef.desc: Lutes are a classic instrument of choice for bards. They can be used to play beautiful melodies with friends or alone.

ff25952fe9cda843a4605826c19e11a5.name: Ashwind Strider Hood
ff25952fe9cda843a4605826c19e11a5.desc: A hood and mask that shield the face below from smoke.

3f0c36e65210f74d8e3db4e2096b45ee.name: Secret Sandstone Door
3f0c36e65210f74d8e3db4e2096b45ee.desc: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.

300d299d000e7c4e81cc492fc7ac8ebe.name: Light Blue Hair
300d299d000e7c4e81cc492fc7ac8ebe.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

f70b3b5c634ec94ea7b7bf279c409bc2.name: Sunpiercer Shoes
f70b3b5c634ec94ea7b7bf279c409bc2.desc: Thanks to their wrapping technique, these shoes provide good support while still allowing you to remain agile.

a0ef22bd26448b40acda53c9f7254e44.name: Round Wooden Door
a0ef22bd26448b40acda53c9f7254e44.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e4c39817cd896341a2515d2ddd66f548.name: Fish Chowder
e4c39817cd896341a2515d2ddd66f548.desc: A hearty, creamy soup made with tender chunks of fish and fresh vegetables.

3d69b205b468f5448f578cd216083819.name: Green Hair
3d69b205b468f5448f578cd216083819.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

ad2018e6bc88e945b577aa2f049059de.name: Omen Trousers
ad2018e6bc88e945b577aa2f049059de.desc:
Dark chestnut-colored pants. They're less frayed and battered than the remainder of the Omen's armor.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

e8da807c15b77c438b7a413f787947a6.name: Copper Hair
e8da807c15b77c438b7a413f787947a6.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

776b2b0463e8ff44aae4d8f85906848d.name: Gem of Focused Light
776b2b0463e8ff44aae4d8f85906848d.desc: Targeting an enemy for a few seconds while aiming or blocking puts a  mark on the enemy. Attacking the marked enemy deals %k additional fire damage. The mark can stack up to 3 times by continued targeting, increasing the bonus damage by %k at 2 stacks and %k at 3 stacks.

a992eaaa59d154488fd3b7e74316e6f1.name: Hophare Pillow
a992eaaa59d154488fd3b7e74316e6f1.desc: A cosy pillow with a Hophare design on it. The animal looks so lively that you think it may leap from the fabric at any moment!

a1deba46d1918947826c21d6e099ea48.name: Vertical Banner II
a1deba46d1918947826c21d6e099ea48.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

0c2689b1c53c3549a397e223bae01bfa.name: Brazen Bull Trousers
0c2689b1c53c3549a397e223bae01bfa.desc: These leg guards protect the wearer's sides from incoming strikes.

871d3257b80eb74fb26dee7ac62f830a.name: Hophare Food Bait
871d3257b80eb74fb26dee7ac62f830a.desc:
Food for attracting and taming a Hophare.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.

90020ca7cf17a540824f5ec5f342113c.name: Veilwater Basin Boardwalk II
90020ca7cf17a540824f5ec5f342113c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

aa6125b403346d47ad32525c96db6961.name: Iron Bars
aa6125b403346d47ad32525c96db6961.desc: A glistening silver metal that has a wide range of applications.

3991eb29e893234db3302a88a8e7c4db.name: Flare Arrow
3991eb29e893234db3302a88a8e7c4db.desc:
Scouting ahead can be quite challenging, especially in the dark. 
This Special Arrow leaves a flare at the point of impact, spending a little light.

c529139ad05f7f4dbbf855e87ab36fed.name: Small Polished Wooden Cabinet
c529139ad05f7f4dbbf855e87ab36fed.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

2d61313ddd22fd49bf8ccbe2c089ea3f.name: Giant Bone Arrow I
2d61313ddd22fd49bf8ccbe2c089ea3f.desc:
An arrow made from bone.

The force of this arrow allows it to pierce hit targets to harm multiple foes.

4d62b12a3521604d9cb0f7aa2f962e82.name: Cryptic Wand
4d62b12a3521604d9cb0f7aa2f962e82.desc:
A strange wand that was covered by ashes. Its body bends and twists, but never breaks.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

c712d77c25baed47b41ae7e7d0805d77.name: Vat I
c712d77c25baed47b41ae7e7d0805d77.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

71f8aafaef52c24f9a70e8c8e73d89d2.name: Ice Protection Lotion
71f8aafaef52c24f9a70e8c8e73d89d2.desc: A lotion that protects you from the cold seeping in. It grants its user +1 ice armor per character level.

b8cd48ea4b1a3c4a91ac47220d5042ab.name: Bamboo Fence With Ropes I
b8cd48ea4b1a3c4a91ac47220d5042ab.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1e5474a3aedbcb4a9f502813241c53b2.name: Drak Teeth
1e5474a3aedbcb4a9f502813241c53b2.desc: A collection of conical teeth. The Drak lose them aplenty throughout their lives, and fill the more permanent holes with gold implants or rage.

7a74083e7440d242ba1dc8a418d46989.name: Charcoal
7a74083e7440d242ba1dc8a418d46989.desc:
Created in a kiln under high temperatures. 

Burned wood mixed with oxygen creates a flammable material, highly convenient and needed to dive into the world of craftsmanship.

5c80419ea1814f43b03920c61b996dac.name: Ultimate Health Potion
5c80419ea1814f43b03920c61b996dac.desc:
Hard to believe there is an even better concoction.

This one instantly restores a massive amount of health.

9b000b9ec48aa8489c8f445f8bbe9a54.name: Ancient Ring of Stamina
9b000b9ec48aa8489c8f445f8bbe9a54.desc: An ancient ring that gives you stamina.

f06411022e03854bb121586541e5dac1.name: Explorer Pants
f06411022e03854bb121586541e5dac1.desc: Even after many weeks on the road, these pants will still be comfortable and in good shape.

c50a34a835ca954ba5893ff9cb0b909b.name: Dried Banana Chips
c50a34a835ca954ba5893ff9cb0b909b.desc: These conserved banana chips do not regenerate as much health as the raw fruit. However, the duration of their effect lasts longer — and the crunch is nice, too.

80fa648b5c1e99448377a50d44a59c49.name: Mage Boots
80fa648b5c1e99448377a50d44a59c49.desc: Light boots. They're slightly pointed at the toes.

b9d12a03a589da4e97bd6f91e5546064.name: Nomad Highlands Miniature Piece
b9d12a03a589da4e97bd6f91e5546064.desc:
The Nomad Highlands were once filled to the brim with traveling merchants, gold, and greed. It was glorious, bustling, and rotten to the core before the Shroud ever came along.

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.

90c4fd6e95a4924c9c920dda18ebfcb1.name: White Flower
90c4fd6e95a4924c9c920dda18ebfcb1.desc: A small potted plant to beautify your home.

6e806ecb56467f4fbafa94d32b7ceb1c.name: Fireball II
6e806ecb56467f4fbafa94d32b7ceb1c.desc:
Ignites a fireball projectile that erupts upon impact and deals damage in an area. 

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

a4e42ab85e18e94b88118c1e85d613de.name: Cryptic Wand
a4e42ab85e18e94b88118c1e85d613de.desc:
A strange wand that was covered by ashes. Its body bends and twists, but never breaks.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

4c62fcc038838d408b4f68087a79400b.name: Scrap Pot IV
4c62fcc038838d408b4f68087a79400b.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

7dd66727c530254eb336dc7042f1adcb.name: Moonstone
7dd66727c530254eb336dc7042f1adcb.desc: No one has ever cut one from rock — only found where the Ancients have passed. Maybe they've brought it to Embervale from wherever they originated.

61df9f80cb548e409b3e434d1253d386.name: Wolf Daggers
61df9f80cb548e409b3e434d1253d386.desc:
This dagger pair is adorned with a wolf head detail, representing its ferocious strike.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

5c42b1a989dfe840a11882e5af18441e.name: Exclusive Hollow Gloves
5c42b1a989dfe840a11882e5af18441e.desc: The golden adornments on these gloves create an aura of superiority and grace.

a3faecf3782aac4ea7ccf30da72ae841.name: Fell Sicklescythe Trophy
a3faecf3782aac4ea7ccf30da72ae841.desc:
Sometimes, the muscles around the eyes still twitch. It's natural, and not worrying. Mostly.

Collect multiple Fell Sicklescythe Heads to craft the Trophy.

5ec552aaf2e8134fa033c5fc73eb49f2.name: Staff Of The Serpent
5ec552aaf2e8134fa033c5fc73eb49f2.desc:
A majestic staff topped with an ouroboros ornament made from green jade. It's perfect for honoring the year of the snake.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

3203e87a95306b419abaccc43967bb3f.name: Ectoplasm Cluster
3203e87a95306b419abaccc43967bb3f.desc: A cluster of ectoplasm crystals. It holds immense magical powers inside.

c7b57d5b33e5974f9948d2a478ab4026.name: Purple Floor Light I
c7b57d5b33e5974f9948d2a478ab4026.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

7b55c10f9dd8c34dbf5e4a6af6aa200f.name: Spice
7b55c10f9dd8c34dbf5e4a6af6aa200f.desc: Nobody really knows what it is. They just call it the "Spice". It makes food much more delicious though, so it is highly sought after!

930490a0e5a1284797dce63e1ae71a6e.name: Spellbreaker Hat
930490a0e5a1284797dce63e1ae71a6e.desc: This magical spellbreaker's hat has been adorned with an azure gem that attracts and stores scattered fragments of the Flame. Their power is later unleashed during heartpounding, close-quarter combat.

d0358c8367ec0949a980eb32e25a6b09.name: Large Ancient Cupboard
d0358c8367ec0949a980eb32e25a6b09.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4bd25b9b4bdc1349ba35d28e611ff9c1.name: Copper Double Door
4bd25b9b4bdc1349ba35d28e611ff9c1.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f1e21e7a7c8084469d17a1cf5d92f041.name: Lifelock Gloves
f1e21e7a7c8084469d17a1cf5d92f041.desc: Use these gloves to seal away your combatons' life force, binding them to life at your behest. Should they fall, nevertheless, then they will rise from the ashes with a flick of your wrist.

9e56e935b4f01e4d82da0f10b23a4771.name: Foliage
9e56e935b4f01e4d82da0f10b23a4771.desc: A leafy green plant material, naturally occurring in the Blackmire. It can be used for creating hedge mazes or garden artistry.

6d7e315724a4224692a0b50a63503a9d.name: Exotic Fruit Salad
6d7e315724a4224692a0b50a63503a9d.desc: A vibrant mix of Prickle Pearl, Bloomheart Fruit, Strawberries, and Dates. Sweet, exotic, and refreshingly simple.

dc6eaf0b31334a4cb1809852ba2971c3.name: Bronze Fell Thunderbrute Trophy
dc6eaf0b31334a4cb1809852ba2971c3.desc:
Even the most gruesome creatures must bend to the Flame, no matter their size. At least the slushing sounds inside its dome have subsided.

Collect multiple Fell Thunderbrute Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

b064ee383e2af9458e758be8c8bbcf6f.name: Wall Tapestry Piece
b064ee383e2af9458e758be8c8bbcf6f.desc:
A ripped piece of a wall tapestry. Find both missing pieces to reassemble the scenery!

Both pieces can be found in the Albaneve Summits.

b22fcc008a7a304eaa6e98edddb5d295.name: Golden War Hero Axe
b22fcc008a7a304eaa6e98edddb5d295.desc: Many soldiers fall in war. Those who return are heralded and showered in gold and gifts; given weapons befitting a celebrated veteran... but for some, such gifts merely serve as a reminder of their harrowing past.

54655f26406f05409af350b3c4924175.name: Diving Helmet
54655f26406f05409af350b3c4924175.desc:
A silver helmet that increases your maximum oxygen while diving.

Its delicate engraved lines imitate the flow of water, and the viewport is segmented like a clam's shell.

ac0988172f834b4b855f58a4a7d73ae8.name: Noble Diadem
ac0988172f834b4b855f58a4a7d73ae8.desc: An elegantly twisted metal headband, adorned with an eye-catching stone.

eada5354727e8343bea6bc04f762be57.name: Stone Shower
eada5354727e8343bea6bc04f762be57.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

beaab31e77e5c940b31b36c7b38701f8.name: Palm Wood Side Table
beaab31e77e5c940b31b36c7b38701f8.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

a7dffc45718be348820e4efd17a6bc6f.name: Ancient Mana Potion
a7dffc45718be348820e4efd17a6bc6f.desc: A flawlessly formulated mana potion that instantly restores a massive amount of mana upon use.

721369a0d0756c4dbdf315d184918a44.name: Ancient Dungeon Block
721369a0d0756c4dbdf315d184918a44.desc: An Ancient block that creates walls with a subtle yet distinct scallop pattern. It is most frequently used inside Ancient Spires.

1860097026ed9746a13d0f2f201760a3.name: Grappling Hook
1860097026ed9746a13d0f2f201760a3.desc: A sturdy tool that can help to cross many chasms along the way.

32a6d220ad2f8c4db5c940e8e19d9130.name: Crimson Valor
32a6d220ad2f8c4db5c940e8e19d9130.desc:
The rose-red accents on the ivory background add a romantic flair, painting the wearer to be a charming, valiant hero.

This color palette can be made with Springlands materials.

a5fc1c0db6f5634b82d995f5b06b0d47.name: Circus Knives
a5fc1c0db6f5634b82d995f5b06b0d47.desc:
A pair of circus knives that can do a lot of damage if left in untrained hands! Better watch out!

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

72f44798e190d04ebf1ed54b8437e3b7.name: Bronze Direwolf Trophy
72f44798e190d04ebf1ed54b8437e3b7.desc:
Cast entirely in bronze, every savage detail of the Direwolf has been immortalized in cold metal.

Collect multiple Direwolf Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

6645bde541dd1d48a5e2e7a08f0cdaea.name: Exceptional Flute
6645bde541dd1d48a5e2e7a08f0cdaea.desc: A delicate flute, decorated with swift aquamarine brushstrokes that carry the tones forth like silvery winds.

257e2ffb19ea074d90112f56063ebb66.name: Candle
257e2ffb19ea074d90112f56063ebb66.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

0756aeee61636740b60826e93c7cef71.name: Galen Yager
0756aeee61636740b60826e93c7cef71.desc: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

f5af29cf7600d340a57d303f81d8b6e0.name: Skull Stalker Chest
f5af29cf7600d340a57d303f81d8b6e0.desc: You feel calm and guarded in this upper body armor — consider your next move carefully.

1089743f79108e4d812cb15603079d27.name: Two-colored Lily Flower
1089743f79108e4d812cb15603079d27.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

fe6cc8018bdc5541afb76e7ea17c8d01.name: Dog Food Bait
fe6cc8018bdc5541afb76e7ea17c8d01.desc:
Food for attracting and taming a Dog.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.

fbc7ec70d16e6c41a51e0362b2ebdd1a.name: Copper Pickaxe
fbc7ec70d16e6c41a51e0362b2ebdd1a.desc: A decent tool forged out of copper. At least working does not become a hassle because of bad equipment.

35fbe70bdbcc0a4baedecc4cc7d4a71d.name: Spellweaver Throne
35fbe70bdbcc0a4baedecc4cc7d4a71d.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

6a1e84343426fc4a8ec6bca5bc440516.name: Medium Stone Brazier
6a1e84343426fc4a8ec6bca5bc440516.desc:
A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.

750fc6286947d1469cfe166520964aaa.name: Flame Arcanist Hat
750fc6286947d1469cfe166520964aaa.desc: A voluptuous, pointed wizard hat! The crowning glory of clothing for the magically inclined.

edba43f19f41974f8f6be7ab4995d427.name: Gold Fell Sicklescythe Trophy
edba43f19f41974f8f6be7ab4995d427.desc:
The moment before the final curse was spoken is frozen forever in this golden trophy. Thankfully, the incredible power of the flame is ever-present.

Collect multiple Fell Sicklescythe Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

bdebf55772ff5f4ba612aa7d17c90b53.name: Decorative Skull II
bdebf55772ff5f4ba612aa7d17c90b53.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

988137403ac0684f809713c4173d3657.name: Ritual Tempest Wand
988137403ac0684f809713c4173d3657.desc:
This ceremonial wand was often used when praying for downpours when the drought first started. While that didn't work, you can still use it to call lightning down on your enemies!

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. 

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

3268562e6056b5449488647fb2fa452e.name: Ironheart Greatsword
3268562e6056b5449488647fb2fa452e.desc: An iron core lies hidden inside the blade's casing, peeking out from the silver curtains on the blade's flat.

7fbfd6af9b9a3642a063067b635b4479.name: Coconut Plant
7fbfd6af9b9a3642a063067b635b4479.desc: A large potted plant to beautify your home.

2371a955614ce44ca6f3175e7d458b48.name: Darya's Remorse
2371a955614ce44ca6f3175e7d458b48.desc:
A wand that burns as bright as the sun. It's decorated with a flower that wraps around the handle, blooming near the hilt. Despite its radiance, it carries a dark energy — is it remorse, or the curse of the Shroud?

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Ethereal Duplication:
The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

adea4a33e748e6478e8d3a7cd4e0b01b.name: Fae Deer Farmer Overalls
adea4a33e748e6478e8d3a7cd4e0b01b.desc: A farmhand's overalls. The deep pockets are very helpful when gathering herbs or storing animal feed.

af74409f2367b341b24cbd573581b5d6.name: Drak Relief V
af74409f2367b341b24cbd573581b5d6.desc:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

The image encapsulates a moment of change: A shipwreck on faraway shores foretells humanity's demise. They see the Ancient Lands rise above the horizon— a sign of the gods turning away from humanity at last. For the Drak, the time to strike back has come.

203b0ec70e8d594cbaf5fcd56ca79b1b.name: Drak'Dal Chieftain Axe
203b0ec70e8d594cbaf5fcd56ca79b1b.desc: Those who wield the Drak'Dal Chieftain Axe command great awe — one swing is enough to bring a tribe to its knees. It's taken many lives, and lusts for countless more.

9dfaac21e14d69419d8a5c98f4c5b4c9.name: Jagged Obsidian Axe
9dfaac21e14d69419d8a5c98f4c5b4c9.desc: A savage weapon of black glass. The blade seems almost alive, dark as the void and sharp as Drak scales.

33eea341284bc84dbde293b0983ad4ac.name: Golden Curved Palisade
33eea341284bc84dbde293b0983ad4ac.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ee3c5ca14304c442960e1b93784326d7.name: Mercenary Chest
ee3c5ca14304c442960e1b93784326d7.desc: A heavy breastplate that has lost its shine, but not its notoriety.

a59fa51056673c469214479d8b332b26.name: Starlight Block
a59fa51056673c469214479d8b332b26.desc: A building block brandishing fine, luminous constellations on a midnight blue background, framed by golden panels.

66e8c1cdae2e40428bffb3ad64d40328.name: Small Elegant Sofa
66e8c1cdae2e40428bffb3ad64d40328.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

b5ce5746998b2d4083a426a125abe740.name: Turquoise Eyes
b5ce5746998b2d4083a426a125abe740.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

d985eb116f0a754ab2c59b87f434596f.name: Fancy Stone Block
d985eb116f0a754ab2c59b87f434596f.desc: This is no normal stone block. It comes with wooden decorations. Floors or ceilings built with this block are covered with wooden planks, and windows or doors get a wooden frame too.

dbfda6519a13484993e40c5fc57a102f.name: Iron Fell Critter Queen Trophy
dbfda6519a13484993e40c5fc57a102f.desc:
When you now look at the Fell Critter Queen's Head you wouldn't think that she once was powerful enough to command an entire swarm.

Collect multiple Fell Critter Queen Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

d26b10003b9ee04583701c225d4fdca4.name: Alchemist Apprentice Gloves
d26b10003b9ee04583701c225d4fdca4.desc: Starting out on the path of the alchemist apprentice, these gloves will make your life a little more comfortable.

3176e51a6107834f8e984406a95e4aa2.name: Metal Block
3176e51a6107834f8e984406a95e4aa2.desc:
Use Metal Blocks to add decorative elements to your buildings.

Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

adace21aa961f14b95b42a3e601fb90c.name: Vertical Banner IV
adace21aa961f14b95b42a3e601fb90c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

8644dc0a8feed546ab0a4d0bd226de82.name: Frostbite Slasher Chest
8644dc0a8feed546ab0a4d0bd226de82.desc: A breezy vest layered on top of a long shirt. The additional belt buckle strapped across the chest holds some spare blades.

2438bd76630cc243b4bf3d3da44108ff.name: Ring of Frost
2438bd76630cc243b4bf3d3da44108ff.desc: It hugs your finger like an icy embrace and lets you become one with the cold. It imbues the wearer with increased frost resistance.

5c4a20687457e449bb0bd9d403fe4496.name: Thyme
5c4a20687457e449bb0bd9d403fe4496.desc: Small leaves with a strong presence. A little goes a long way, perfect for a fine fresh tea!

07da83b0e1281a49ae6d5f37d4b86974.name: Iron Hollow Wispwyvern Trophy
07da83b0e1281a49ae6d5f37d4b86974.desc:
Some fights leave scars. Others leave a fear of the undead.

Collect multiple Hollow Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

c62b0de6beae0446a0b6dabea953d311.name: Rectangular Coaster
c62b0de6beae0446a0b6dabea953d311.desc: A wooden plate to display foods and drinks on a table.

c96d7989f863e34b8f697d4f31e6dc83.name: Stone Door
c96d7989f863e34b8f697d4f31e6dc83.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ab6b38ab3c72b0409c1b7e8e0cc78cb2.name: Pearlfrost Mentor Pants
ab6b38ab3c72b0409c1b7e8e0cc78cb2.desc: A pair of warm pants, tinged in a deep blue. It provides ample protection from the elements.

982460ac7171fe46832c576bf2833f04.name: Decorative Skull I
982460ac7171fe46832c576bf2833f04.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

73341ebc6fa8c44a831c0cdef77e4f69.name: Small Boreal Wood Sideboard
73341ebc6fa8c44a831c0cdef77e4f69.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

50f62b99511e884091e0d377f1a2773a.name: Decorative Oven I
50f62b99511e884091e0d377f1a2773a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

fa4f1f9fa6458445a2fba003c607111e.name: Gem of Toxic Betrayal
fa4f1f9fa6458445a2fba003c607111e.desc: Landing a backstab on an enemy applies  poison for %k that deals %k poison damage per second.

708e8c3b53a6d14480617cb474c540da.name: Improved Grappling Hook
708e8c3b53a6d14480617cb474c540da.desc: Requires less stamina. Can be activated at larger ranges.

b256a635c731a443914a678fb2895461.name: Elder's Staff
b256a635c731a443914a678fb2895461.desc:
A magical staff, brimming with the power of its former owner. Legend has it that the elder's soul is linked to it, sometimes humming at night.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

71a386d35778e64f812de880f303b8b5.name: Dreadbane
71a386d35778e64f812de880f303b8b5.desc: A large and powerful hammer that has been corrupted by the Shroud. Good for smashing bugs!

65943979c867ff45b727a337f3e82d56.name: Hollow Halls Showcase (2 Small Slots)
65943979c867ff45b727a337f3e82d56.desc: This is a showcase for Hollow Artifact Collection Items usually found in the Hollow Halls.

b45bcdc7a14d024382685ee60a461720.name: Hollow Wretch I
b45bcdc7a14d024382685ee60a461720.desc:
Summons a Hollow Wretch ally that attacks enemies. 
Maximum amount of summoned Hollow allies is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

b6ec451ef193b141b566e64c36361b1b.name: Regular Stone Block
b6ec451ef193b141b566e64c36361b1b.desc: A Regular Stone Block used for everyday construction.

da9f98b75580714cacc6bc3f31182725.name: Brazen Bull Chest
da9f98b75580714cacc6bc3f31182725.desc: If anyone dares to engage you in close combat, they'll get a taste of your wildly thrashing spiked shoulder pads. Your defense will be impenetrable, and the cuts you'll leave will be deep.

a8dc28dc47e5a8439b40e08c8dc23028.name: Cyan Party Hat
a8dc28dc47e5a8439b40e08c8dc23028.desc: A fun little hat for fun little parties!

668b1e5aaa561d479fcae2737ce98134.name: Obsidian Block
668b1e5aaa561d479fcae2737ce98134.desc: A pitch-black block of solid obsidian. Building with this will add a mystical aura to your home!

215d6a4cefc9784f8c6aff56937eaa11.name: Fluffy Pants
215d6a4cefc9784f8c6aff56937eaa11.desc: These pants are nothing special on the outside, but inside, they're lined with a fur layer.

b2373f04efd0ce4e911a48262f177306.name: Wooden Table
b2373f04efd0ce4e911a48262f177306.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

89e3109bfa8dcd44a9ec229a3a669bc2.name: Reaper's Wand
89e3109bfa8dcd44a9ec229a3a669bc2.desc:
A twisted wand emitting a faint, blue light. It demands to be wielded!

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

0306a9781531d14fae7f1e1dc1c4f4a5.name: Sand
0306a9781531d14fae7f1e1dc1c4f4a5.desc: A wonderful material gathered on mass in the Kindlewastes.

8e5d774c4b80464c87de29e6d9a2972e.name: Wooden Ladder
8e5d774c4b80464c87de29e6d9a2972e.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

a3c405ebf299a94a8074de7b304bf4fa.name: Iron Claw Club
a3c405ebf299a94a8074de7b304bf4fa.desc: A mace that easily cleaves through foes like a pack of starving wolves.

38a5d43243ed4c42927593f3585d14e1.name: Ignited Bow
38a5d43243ed4c42927593f3585d14e1.desc: Ignited by the Flame itself, this bow pulses with the power of fire.

a2e93d244010fe43b758588c2db0b422.name: Vorgoth's Eye Trophy
a2e93d244010fe43b758588c2db0b422.desc: When placed, the eye slowly becomes something more than just a core again. Thin layers of skin reform around it, forming a heavy eyelid that never fully closes.

1a7e5182943737449da02abba8c693f1.name: Fang Blade
1a7e5182943737449da02abba8c693f1.desc: This blade is razor-sharp like the fangs of the terrifying creatures that prowl the Nomad Highlands.

5d141b7bd481524487b1d1328e523274.name: Hardwood Ash Tree Seedling
5d141b7bd481524487b1d1328e523274.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.

89c4fb0238fd884baac49203bbf93b35.name: Scrap Bucket
89c4fb0238fd884baac49203bbf93b35.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

8e3ef4ab1eb94b47b4db06ec7a9b94cd.name: Exclusive Hollow Boots
8e3ef4ab1eb94b47b4db06ec7a9b94cd.desc: Sturdy boots that withstand any march for hundreds of miles.

10b08e0fe5d036409afa2247d2baf355.name: Lumberer Hat
10b08e0fe5d036409afa2247d2baf355.desc: A hat that is made both practical and fun with added fluffy fur.

9c38d5d15c5f7e4fb1a743db5711ced9.name: Water Balloon
9c38d5d15c5f7e4fb1a743db5711ced9.desc:
A plump leather container that's been filled with water. Throw it to make others Wet and Soaked!

Wet 
Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30% for 15 minutes. Warmth reduces the remaining duration.

Soaked 
Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30% for 30 seconds. Also reduces Ice and Shock Resistances by 30% but increases Fire Resistance by 30%.
Soaked can be applied to enemies.
Soaked duration can not be reduced by warmth, and transitions into the Wet debuff once it ends.

51285288e10d004c8b24599fa3cc65ba.name: Diamond Wall Emblem II
51285288e10d004c8b24599fa3cc65ba.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

020c4e41decfad46b01f9963e828c48e.name: Ectoplasm Soup
020c4e41decfad46b01f9963e828c48e.desc: Unnerving goo. It bestows great powers on those who eat it.

e159acd8c07ee14ca17d59efb3967e7f.name: Golden Bulwark Pants
e159acd8c07ee14ca17d59efb3967e7f.desc: The pants might not look like much, but they actually do their job of protecting your life in battle.

7f05781901764b40aea885421eabe64d.name: Maritime Shower
7f05781901764b40aea885421eabe64d.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

81dda9d883a95c4abdb1b5b72dc52acd.name: Hunter Boots
81dda9d883a95c4abdb1b5b72dc52acd.desc: These boots are ideal for stalking prey.

e04bb38f97eefe47b81941cebb5536ba.name: Knight Boots
e04bb38f97eefe47b81941cebb5536ba.desc: A knight's boots. They've seen much peril and anguish.

e2b1bf498afaa4459b6625d6d865ae0f.name: Ginger
e2b1bf498afaa4459b6625d6d865ae0f.desc: Fresh ginger, perfect for brewing hot tea to keep any cold at bay.

5df55f1f0125534f87df7115fc7aaf34.name: Cauldron
5df55f1f0125534f87df7115fc7aaf34.desc: A centerpiece for the Alchemy Station.

7b00577cb4011c4383e4e8e5843ca625.name: Raw Meat and Corncob Skewer
7b00577cb4011c4383e4e8e5843ca625.desc:
A hearty feast that fortifies your body. 

Grilled over a fire, this skewer will increase your melee damage, boost your maximum health, and accelerate your health regeneration.

64a3551918156546b3219ac952b44105.name: Reaper's Wand
64a3551918156546b3219ac952b44105.desc:
A twisted wand emitting a faint, blue light. It demands to be wielded!

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

683624da9f57514aa2ac55c411883ee0.name: Basswood Tree Seedling
683624da9f57514aa2ac55c411883ee0.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.

ced0bcb5f82020478a3bfb31b1c289c0.name: Fertile Revelwood Dirt
ced0bcb5f82020478a3bfb31b1c289c0.desc:
A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. 

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

4b7dd3864a63ea4e8f00f58a07b0a267.name: Lesser Golden Twinflame Sword
4b7dd3864a63ea4e8f00f58a07b0a267.desc: A weapon that was rumored to have fallen from the stars. The man who found it could never feel whole, always searching for a missing piece.

cacc33a43c7dd54597675c2a217e1bbc.name: Aquamarine
cacc33a43c7dd54597675c2a217e1bbc.desc: This aquamarine is as clear as a crystalline lake under bright blue skies.

4ea07b3504053f4e9fcbb21aa49ec57c.name: Tidecaller Headpiece
4ea07b3504053f4e9fcbb21aa49ec57c.desc: A striking, extravagant headpiece, just as broad as your magical abilities — but you might get stuck in the doorway.

2ad1638148cc3c48a299e3318012be87.name: Golden Recruit Axe
2ad1638148cc3c48a299e3318012be87.desc: The most successful, newly decorated recruits are sometimes gifted weapons dipped in gold. They aren't any sharper than their less impressive counterparts, but serve as a status symbol among the group.

0c17b28121517c4ca30f052b89d82f60.name: Tiny Backpack
0c17b28121517c4ca30f052b89d82f60.desc: An extension to your backpack that enlarges your inventory by one row.

59ddccee9e6d7c45bca5af94e29d2b31.name: Scales
59ddccee9e6d7c45bca5af94e29d2b31.desc: Hardened scales of wild animals. Some say they are as hard as stone.

cdd1e571bb092a4bafe13fd54c33408c.name: Ectoplasm Crystal
cdd1e571bb092a4bafe13fd54c33408c.desc: A sizeable ectoplasm crystal. Its properties allow it to store life force for eons.

39827ccdad51084ea90d642f8b8616a1.name: Health Potion
39827ccdad51084ea90d642f8b8616a1.desc: Filled with vitalizing ingredients, it instantly restores a good amount of health.

52811051e00ded49aa20aac1baed4206.name: Sunny Loungewear Garb
52811051e00ded49aa20aac1baed4206.desc: A breezy tunic that's perfect for a day by the shore.

ea6610ab94fb5442b2a4601ed7b840b6.name: Drak Relief Showcase
ea6610ab94fb5442b2a4601ed7b840b6.desc:
A showcase that holds pieces of a Drak themed relief.
Collect all pieces to complete this showcase and unlock special trophy recipes.

01eb040eac7692458b46ed5e6c73690f.name: Rustic Window Frame I
01eb040eac7692458b46ed5e6c73690f.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

2fc80cab911092448168d8c9dc04bc7a.name: Drak Temple Vase V
2fc80cab911092448168d8c9dc04bc7a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

eb98f093d116354ca95a4471bd53ef06.name: Mushroom Omelette
eb98f093d116354ca95a4471bd53ef06.desc: A delicious meal with an earthy taste.

c0f11d52ef30b74aa928659f9bc42ec6.name: Medium Crypt Cabinet
c0f11d52ef30b74aa928659f9bc42ec6.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

8d66943f289eb34897e3ff0bb828f759.name: Alchemist Apprentice Chest
8d66943f289eb34897e3ff0bb828f759.desc: A comfortable, traditional garb suiting an upcoming alchemist.

90d46b0a8ff6f542921266a84c85c798.name: Bronze Hydrak'Dal Trophy
90d46b0a8ff6f542921266a84c85c798.desc:
The Hydrak'Dal would surely be outraged that you covered his golden decorations with bronze. Fortunately, he can no longer complain.

Collect multiple Hydrak'Dal Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

aa3389c2fcbb0b429af1bc43152de357.name: Royal Decree
aa3389c2fcbb0b429af1bc43152de357.desc:
None can deny your authority when you're dressed in sacred white and royal lavender.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

8230db64a6d2fd4daefc9d2c9d0ee7f4.name: Firefeather Bow
8230db64a6d2fd4daefc9d2c9d0ee7f4.desc: A formidable bow that ignites foes from afar. It bears crimson fangs that jut from its centre and carries diamond-shaped appendages along its body. It reminds you of a bloodsucking bat or a fiery bird with a fearsome beak.

9de380764623b549ac2c095c6521b71a.name: Knight Trousers
9de380764623b549ac2c095c6521b71a.desc: Knightly pants. The cloth attached brandishes a glorious golden thread.

b753da6d142a7e4aac1fba64dc770cc6.name: Sky Specter Pants
b753da6d142a7e4aac1fba64dc770cc6.desc: A pair of pants that is fit to hide under midnight gloom.

bbee733cfaea2948b89494742b4831dc.name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Pants
bbee733cfaea2948b89494742b4831dc.desc: Simple black pants with delicate golden details. Inconspicuous on its own, but in perfect harmony with the other parts of this set. The hems have been rethreaded many times, worn thin by long journeys through Embervale. A quiet statement to the distance once walked by the "Scholars of the Empyrean".

ec5d5e557e969f43a640cf3673c4a65d.name: Iron Double Door
ec5d5e557e969f43a640cf3673c4a65d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

478504d541d55747bb3167a0ffd62d4c.name: Fried Rice
478504d541d55747bb3167a0ffd62d4c.desc: If pure, cooked rice is a bit too plain for you, then this fried rice might satisfy your needs. The added egg breaks up the granular texture of the rice, and the vegetables create a punch of flavor!

fb726ab4bacfa74187eb4ee933d50f90.name: Shepherd's Lightning
fb726ab4bacfa74187eb4ee933d50f90.desc:
A mighty relic, able to provide solace amidst chaos. The previous owner might have been a retired hero. 

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

c0d27e42f57d22428ccd1a4b959b27b9.name: Exceptional Harp
c0d27e42f57d22428ccd1a4b959b27b9.desc: An outstanding harp with fine, silvery strings. The shape of the body and lightweight wood make this instrument perfect for learning to play the strings. Holding it makes you feel a bit melancholic.

5b871e6fe4cae743b1493eccdc65dd55.name: Shock Totem II
5b871e6fe4cae743b1493eccdc65dd55.desc:
Summons a totem that launches shock projectiles at enemies that also deal Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. 
Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

9dc499c68a521142a40a760cacf5299f.name: Iron Bucket
9dc499c68a521142a40a760cacf5299f.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

9a42bc20c173e948ae272510c4ffed77.name: Athanor
9a42bc20c173e948ae272510c4ffed77.desc: A complex oven used by scholars of the alchemical mysteries.

2d1436d4be7bb9498473f0196fdc79a0.name: Ancient Ring of Health
2d1436d4be7bb9498473f0196fdc79a0.desc: This ring will increase your health and healing rate.

e1be36ed71169643b11979f73a08ab9d.name: Scrap Platter
e1be36ed71169643b11979f73a08ab9d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4c5389c2d9de894eacdf7697143c5663.name: Scavenger Miner Axe
4c5389c2d9de894eacdf7697143c5663.desc: It's unclear if this Scavenger Miner Axe was ever meant to pry ore from stone, or to pierce traitors’ backs.

ff7bd45c9be59b4298e5c6debe897a6a.name: Light
ff7bd45c9be59b4298e5c6debe897a6a.desc: A light that can be used in a Sparkworks system. Any other light source, such as a torch or brazier, can be used in one as well.

bed9fe236c4a4e419457e972db991b2b.name: Marksman Gloves
bed9fe236c4a4e419457e972db991b2b.desc: These gloves prevent the bowstring from digging into the skin while lining up shots.

3063e6574a533e4eb4f791f4e3a75607.name: Drak Temple Vase VII
3063e6574a533e4eb4f791f4e3a75607.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e337bab5c53cdd46939889ecbc6a9bd7.name: Aunt Braelyn
e337bab5c53cdd46939889ecbc6a9bd7.desc: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

a2108c27deaa95429d120dcae9a8fca7.name: Adventurer Boots
a2108c27deaa95429d120dcae9a8fca7.desc: These boots are perfect for any terrain. Easy to clean, robust, and light.

2e98a90d13bedb44bf9e5b09ca49981a.name: Big Decorated Tree
2e98a90d13bedb44bf9e5b09ca49981a.desc: A richly decorated and festive-looking tree.

3b32ceb5973fa447abf4ccb51edc6303.name: Iron Scavenger Matron Trophy
3b32ceb5973fa447abf4ccb51edc6303.desc:
Their queen has fallen. Elixir and blood taint the mud. A soothing silence finally veils the night.

Collect multiple Scavenger Matron Helmets to craft the Iron Trophy.

ff5ce588f5fd06449c3b68ed9f7d0421.name: Exceptional Ring of Mana
ff5ce588f5fd06449c3b68ed9f7d0421.desc: This ring will increase your mana and its replenishment.

c59e459ac3b95d4a8df1b153531a9d55.name: Snow
c59e459ac3b95d4a8df1b153531a9d55.desc:
Powdery, lily-white snow. The way it drowns out the sounds of chaos makes the world seem just a little more peaceful.

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

a4974940aac1434886bbf8967325e731.name: Skull Candle
a4974940aac1434886bbf8967325e731.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

0501bfb68d4dba418a565bf74a16bef6.name: Crown Crusher
0501bfb68d4dba418a565bf74a16bef6.desc:
The four-way cage around the mace's core forms an outward radiating crown when raised above the wielder's head. This serves as a final fanfare to victims before they're crushed at their ruler's feet.

Shroud Imbued: 
This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.

eec8b8d87553d945a2eb97f4febf7204.name: Cryptic Wand
eec8b8d87553d945a2eb97f4febf7204.desc:
A strange wand that was covered by ashes. Its body bends and twists, but never breaks.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

4c15477c2b00094380305959071b6ffa.name: Firefly Standing Lamp
4c15477c2b00094380305959071b6ffa.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

5b2a2b6167ea51408a35f7d58e263792.name: Ancient Temple Door
5b2a2b6167ea51408a35f7d58e263792.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

bd393e650085af478fde350b9736d783.name: Hollow's Eve Hood
bd393e650085af478fde350b9736d783.desc: A shadowy hood that hides a sinister skull mask underneath. Scary!

5e789b400b46c942b8b2962cd160b662.name: Corrosive Blood
5e789b400b46c942b8b2962cd160b662.desc:
A volatile, acidic fluid harvested from weak Fell Foes. Its corrosive properties make it a valuable ingredient in crafting repair kits, where its unique chemistry is harnessed to restore the durability of worn-out items.

Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

d4d7d6fe0d579d4c96ea9c9b8e06ba36.name: Golden Bulwark Boots
d4d7d6fe0d579d4c96ea9c9b8e06ba36.desc: You’ve likely never worn foot armor this light, but give it a shot — the chest plate’s weight needs counterbalancing somewhere.

7f0d77a403726a48a91a6e87b8706e1e.name: Artificer's Helmet
7f0d77a403726a48a91a6e87b8706e1e.desc: A helmet that hides the wearer's face below a sturdy sheet metal mask. The attached headpiece adds some height and heft, resembling the dawning sun — and the beginning of a new era of progress.

5923243d76343947a67bd80c9a3e212b.name: Lorekeeper's Greatsword
5923243d76343947a67bd80c9a3e212b.desc: A large greatsword with a subtle circle pattern. You get the feeling that each curve could resemble a syllable, interlocking where they rhyme to create poetry... however, you could not possibly ascertain meaning from the symbols.

fc732cd6518d6a429c63f0eedb522324.name: Vanguard Boots
fc732cd6518d6a429c63f0eedb522324.desc: Gilded boots adorned with fiery, red gemstones. The pattern above the shins bears a resemblance to rays of sunlight or the glory of the blazing Flame.

79dc7f39a9045a4da91ddeaf2b3d18d7.name: Spectral Ward
79dc7f39a9045a4da91ddeaf2b3d18d7.desc:
This magic shield allows you to block and parry against physical attacks. 

Parry
You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar.
Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

2f0ee82878a32c4aba7ac20b605088f5.name: Crystal Knives
2f0ee82878a32c4aba7ac20b605088f5.desc:
A crystalline frame lines the edges of these short blades. They shift incoming light and reflect it, bathing the daggers in the color of fresh mountain springs.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

350b981f90a0d84cb06c2a763b6a0b07.name: Grasshopper
350b981f90a0d84cb06c2a763b6a0b07.desc: A resilient grasshopper that's adapted to the warm colors of the Nomad Highlands. It can be used as fishing bait, most likely to catch uncommon fish.

371871826c9beb46be9cabccbf787405.name: Copper Arrow
371871826c9beb46be9cabccbf787405.desc: An arrow with a copper tip.

e4bce239716c6d46a5403d7ab11bc204.name: Giant Bones
e4bce239716c6d46a5403d7ab11bc204.desc: These bones are far larger than normal and are exceptionally sturdy.

3d62989822fc3342979bfe048df29ab3.name: Fertile Springlands Dirt
3d62989822fc3342979bfe048df29ab3.desc:
A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. 

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

66360486f265f64dbb7dfb3d78d36dc6.name: Alchemist Apprentice Boots
66360486f265f64dbb7dfb3d78d36dc6.desc: Simple leather boots — a perfect fit.

0abbc3324409be4bba10d9b20e244e2a.name: Algae
0abbc3324409be4bba10d9b20e244e2a.desc: These algae may look inconspicuous, but they are highly versatile.
