8a06df3c05be664a9c2302e18bcd6d52.name: Healer Tunic
8a06df3c05be664a9c2302e18bcd6d52.desc: A breathable tunic with ample space for storing bandages, herbs, and tissues.

c9da9c7b621c1449b8b60ef5275344de.name: Ashwind Strider Pants
c9da9c7b621c1449b8b60ef5275344de.desc: Airy, slightly billowing pants that allow the wearer to feel the heat of the wind.

d3943623565bc04a816b8b7e15cfe0db.name: Big Leather Crate
d3943623565bc04a816b8b7e15cfe0db.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d499703e1bd9e546ae0361a47d9cef3a.name: Sapphire
d499703e1bd9e546ae0361a47d9cef3a.desc: Despite its angelic looks, this sugary sweet cinnamon-colored cat is a gleeful little rascal who likes getting into trouble! You can never be too mad, though. Just look at those beautiful, sapphire blue eyes!

a868656349e77d4e877a7ced63029f2a.name: Iron Grate
a868656349e77d4e877a7ced63029f2a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6a0fddb7adf97e4c8bf750cebd092067.name: Lifelock Boots
6a0fddb7adf97e4c8bf750cebd092067.desc: Gray boots that have been darkened by smoke and ash.

9689b0b66df7e247a20892aab2622b4f.name: Adventurer Helmet
9689b0b66df7e247a20892aab2622b4f.desc: A simple but reliable helmet. You might still get a bump or two if you get hit, but that's part of the fun.

9689c41b30f4ed428ffe670aa57ad10e.name: Lifelock Gloves
9689c41b30f4ed428ffe670aa57ad10e.desc: Use these gloves to seal away your combatons' life force, binding them to life at your behest. Should they fall, nevertheless, then they will rise from the ashes with a flick of your wrist.

3a4097cc10e36c49bc12fc73a8f14266.name: Venomkiss
3a4097cc10e36c49bc12fc73a8f14266.desc:
A deviously poisoned set of daggers that meander like the slithering body of a Kindlewastes Diamondback snake.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

c348b69ba9b3734e87a87bae20d6b9d9.name: Incendiary Ball
c348b69ba9b3734e87a87bae20d6b9d9.desc:
This bomb contains a highly flammable liquid, setting a large area on fire when deployed.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

cdd9cce32d1ed84aaf1ffe436adaaf3c.name: Hophare
cdd9cce32d1ed84aaf1ffe436adaaf3c.desc: A curious, but shy Hophare. Their timid nature and quick reflexes protect them from predators!

8257db5e866c3041afb58fa33a62d21c.name: Venerable Hollow Boots
8257db5e866c3041afb58fa33a62d21c.desc: These boots send tremors through the Hollow Halls wherever they step.

6eb784090d391547868d2a4871fe5644.name: Fine Hardwood Door
6eb784090d391547868d2a4871fe5644.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

b8e529dda054174f8dff44e5fec107e7.name: Diamond Wall Emblem
b8e529dda054174f8dff44e5fec107e7.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

bb154ce867add64ab55152d9a01e1151.name: Ornate Wall Banner
bb154ce867add64ab55152d9a01e1151.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4390eb78605e104eaa00edae49c59e43.name: Crypt Throne
4390eb78605e104eaa00edae49c59e43.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

4d5b039a8e4bfd42a9f21a53db155113.name: Simple Coffin Lid
4d5b039a8e4bfd42a9f21a53db155113.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

13c1bbfaac91ec4fa0a67429315b6506.name: Greater Ring of Mana
13c1bbfaac91ec4fa0a67429315b6506.desc: This ring will increase your mana and its replenishment.

159f56be6b314b4c8e9ea33c8f08646a.name: Yucca Palm Seedling
159f56be6b314b4c8e9ea33c8f08646a.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

b0d918f238effd49b0a43e59d00a19c3.name: Deerstalker Gloves
b0d918f238effd49b0a43e59d00a19c3.desc: Firing an arrow with these gloves is effortless, creating a silky smooth stream of movement for the wearer.

b5de97e73c367d479900ee03a5252bd1.name: High Polished Window Frame
b5de97e73c367d479900ee03a5252bd1.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6bb2cf30ab2c7340a4d0f4afb2045004.name: Summoning Staff
6bb2cf30ab2c7340a4d0f4afb2045004.desc: Summons rescued survivors into your bases around a Flame Altar.

25318246d6c1f243b1e57d892a70e750.name: Boiled Eggs
25318246d6c1f243b1e57d892a70e750.desc: Simple but nourishing. Boosts Health and Stamina Regeneration.

7a6dfe71edf8cb43af59ab25a5304224.name: Wall Tapestry Showcase
7a6dfe71edf8cb43af59ab25a5304224.desc: Reassemble a valuable wall tapestry using this showcase.

ea4fd25a5f766340bca41a466b214a09.name: Hanging Silver Chandelier
ea4fd25a5f766340bca41a466b214a09.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

f2ee514438f83742903a78e75291cc6f.name: Castle Roof Block
f2ee514438f83742903a78e75291cc6f.desc: With this greenish castle roof block, nothing stands in the way of your architectural masterpieces.

17234584ef9084449dd0285fcc1b2847.name: Revelwood Green Leaf Seedling
17234584ef9084449dd0285fcc1b2847.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.

d8d7ab6022ca1a4faab75b868000ccfb.name: Fabric
d8d7ab6022ca1a4faab75b868000ccfb.desc: A sturdy material that was woven out of linen. It revolutionized the clothing industry due to its flexibility and durability. It looks better as well.

8b5d094a053eb4409f3836b2352e38d9.name: Wailing Blade
8b5d094a053eb4409f3836b2352e38d9.desc: An expertly crafted blade, balanced and sharp. Cuts through foes like a wail through the night. It bears the mark of a famous blacksmith from Pikemead's Reach.

c8433634ad068d489b3dc18df48b26e2.name: Starborn Sword
c8433634ad068d489b3dc18df48b26e2.desc: A sword that was forged on a faraway star. Its light is now dormant, but not entirely lost.

4a4738c66ecfe04399133e5f7503d301.name: Ancient Wall Lamp
4a4738c66ecfe04399133e5f7503d301.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

c265d7a40d53874b8fda807ccc1221ba.name: Battering Ram Hammer
c265d7a40d53874b8fda807ccc1221ba.desc: A heavy two-handed hammer that can break through any door thanks to the added front spikes. Bashing, tearing, and slashing are no problem for this weapon!

5eddcbaf1a722d4ca7fe83d43feee785.name: Nocturnal Axe
5eddcbaf1a722d4ca7fe83d43feee785.desc: Forged from a dark metal, mysterious and silent as the night. This axe does not reflect, does not allow light. Still, you believe you catch reflections dancing across the blade from the corner of your eye... surely, your sight betrays you.

8fd3843c2ecd0748861d52e28e7aeb3f.name: Golden Bulwark Pants
8fd3843c2ecd0748861d52e28e7aeb3f.desc: The pants might not look like much, but they actually do their job of protecting your life in battle.

b61bc9ca96864442b45f959e477e4db2.name: Eternal Ice Totem I
b61bc9ca96864442b45f959e477e4db2.desc:
Summons a totem that launches icy projectiles at enemies, applying a slow debuff to them. 
Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

09910f575099c04680bbe15e70bf8bb0.name: Deadeye Trousers
09910f575099c04680bbe15e70bf8bb0.desc: These pants are extremely light and therefore enable quick and flexible movements. Crouch, climb, and run to gain an advantage!

4530f818b3fb7a4fb9a90bc6e164f9df.name: Silverback
4530f818b3fb7a4fb9a90bc6e164f9df.desc:
This sleek, silver-scaled fish is known for the distinctive metallic sheen along its back, which gives it its name.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

6c58e2cf88c60e46bc2b33d1b0570207.name: Flower Wreath
6c58e2cf88c60e46bc2b33d1b0570207.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

12a8e963d8c460449e9b651225421e2e.name: Huge Magic Chest
12a8e963d8c460449e9b651225421e2e.desc:
A big and heavy chest that offers fantastic storage space for countless items.

The items stored here can be used for crafting purposes from anywhere in the base!

5b7000f08d4a2142aeddb4b2c762a91d.name: Sparkling Dark Crystal
5b7000f08d4a2142aeddb4b2c762a91d.desc: When gazing upon the crystal's surface, you feel the mirror image warp and shift into something... unsettling.

227fb7b2d384e744a49c69f518c9534c.name: Skull Stalker Gloves
227fb7b2d384e744a49c69f518c9534c.desc: These gloves lock your hold on the bow — target the head with steady aim.

f8889bc93d05834ba21852f43219245b.name: Fire Bolt VII
f8889bc93d05834ba21852f43219245b.desc:
Ignites a fire bolt projectile that deals damage to a single target.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

fee1a6888118d24f88e6ac9d3af80aa7.name: Sun & Shore
fee1a6888118d24f88e6ac9d3af80aa7.desc:
The sand is pale and warm, the water deep and blue, the sun comes out and shines just for you. 

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

c09cfdaaa278c14597f9ad3b12f9abc9.name: Archaic Essence IV
c09cfdaaa278c14597f9ad3b12f9abc9.desc:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.

812b1a14cf83da4894f03cf0cbed37f3.name: Bronze Fell Critter Queen Trophy
812b1a14cf83da4894f03cf0cbed37f3.desc:
The Fell Critter Queen's Head mounted on a wall and covered in bronze seems more ornamental than threatening.

Collect multiple Fell Critter Queen Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

8b1fed31ca491d45ab99f44559ad2569.name: Mothling Boots
8b1fed31ca491d45ab99f44559ad2569.desc: Comfortable brown boots that make you feel as if you're being carried on a moth's wings.

8b1f0ff4cac6314486efbc967137f5b5.name: Warlock Shirt
8b1f0ff4cac6314486efbc967137f5b5.desc: A traditional garment which was historically worn by esteemed battle mages. Now, their ritualistic nature is a faint memory at best.

0f84c22f4b771f408dee9841341487d8.name: Aquamarine Dust
0f84c22f4b771f408dee9841341487d8.desc: Finely ground Aquamarine crystals that sparkle beautifully.

1cd2f27376fee441b7d0d4d3a7790fc7.name: Scrappy Greatsword
1cd2f27376fee441b7d0d4d3a7790fc7.desc: A broken blade, retrieved from the rubble and ash of the old world. It may still cause significant damage when in the wrong hands.

3401392eaec1b04d8dec5648ea44d2b0.name: Raw Fatty Meat
3401392eaec1b04d8dec5648ea44d2b0.desc: A tender, raw slab of fatty meat. It is uncooked, and therefore not consumable.

69dd1232fa96884c8c83ac24d7cbca8f.name: Scout Chest
69dd1232fa96884c8c83ac24d7cbca8f.desc: A simple, light chest piece to complement the rest of the armor.

7db0b448ca2e754487fb181b6894721c.name: Book II
7db0b448ca2e754487fb181b6894721c.desc: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.

b24797609b813e40ba3b9aa798eddd05.name: Quetzal Hunter Pants
b24797609b813e40ba3b9aa798eddd05.desc: They let you sprint through the thicket with the swiftness of wings.

5c1c0c44922a27409c46a6f5f4edf17d.name: Trailblazer Trousers
5c1c0c44922a27409c46a6f5f4edf17d.desc: Pants made from deep blue cloth and patched leather. The layers on the inside provide good insulation against the bitter cold.

41c19c821a825343ade4d2eb8d391b1e.name: Flame Arcanist Hat
41c19c821a825343ade4d2eb8d391b1e.desc: A voluptuous, pointed wizard hat! The crowning glory of clothing for the magically inclined.

2e810d996b0d544c9d9a2d5040f060da.name: Warden Gloves
2e810d996b0d544c9d9a2d5040f060da.desc: Heavy gloves that can swing any weapon with added might.

ad5f874a59253647bdaab54721bbd2a8.name: Waveborne Ritualist Pants
ad5f874a59253647bdaab54721bbd2a8.desc: With their simplicity, these pants bring balance to the outfit and allow the wearer’s presence to shine.

36adf512e2b8a246874418001538084e.name: Ember Carapace
36adf512e2b8a246874418001538084e.desc: Heat-hardened scales from a carapace creature of Cinder's Cradle. Blades skate off its surface, and flames find nothing to catch.

f72b517c6d823a49b58bbee5411b1b67.name: Ice Bolt IV
f72b517c6d823a49b58bbee5411b1b67.desc:
Conjures an icy projectile that deals damage in an area and applies a slow debuff.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

67f0fc8ad358b5458b3c79494d560c84.name: Carved Secret Bookshelf Door
67f0fc8ad358b5458b3c79494d560c84.desc: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.

a8aef8b8bbd0dc44b3d115358c55d435.name: Hawk Chest
a8aef8b8bbd0dc44b3d115358c55d435.desc: A formidable chest piece, decorated with many elements resembling nature, vines, and petals.

875cbbd2b4aba2439148f0a2d2215b25.name: Iron Direwolf Trophy
875cbbd2b4aba2439148f0a2d2215b25.desc:
The snarling lips and crushing fangs remind you of the countless fights you had with the Direwolf.

Collect multiple Direwolf Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

4cfee619fad01e4bbae6899bdde03567.name: Shadowbloom
4cfee619fad01e4bbae6899bdde03567.desc: The Shadowbloom is one of the few plants resistant to the Kindlewastes heat. Their bright orange glowing petals are only visible at night and are used to make vibrant colors.

840dba425d92604489d7788634f4d58f.name: Tidecaller Pants
840dba425d92604489d7788634f4d58f.desc: Those pants go perfectly with the tunic, creating a fluent transition. They allow enough air circulation to prevent overheating during battle.

63138d8224f852458f0a1303bd369d14.name: Elio Ricci
63138d8224f852458f0a1303bd369d14.desc: The Barber, Elio Ricci, allows you to change your appearance.

7156f35b3f3ced4ab5951d7ba76d0828.name: Pretty In Pink
7156f35b3f3ced4ab5951d7ba76d0828.desc:
These vivid colors — deep cyan, bright magenta, and rich black — make a statement all on their own. With this palette, you won’t go unnoticed.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

89b5f220f8bc1b429b15f69526445920.name: Ethereal Ward
89b5f220f8bc1b429b15f69526445920.desc: This ward creates an otherworldly light that protects the wielder from incoming damage, akin to a divine blessing.

013911ed38abcb45a7b0f53b69ed4c4f.name: Fire Bolt II
013911ed38abcb45a7b0f53b69ed4c4f.desc:
Ignites a fire bolt projectile that deals damage to a single target.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

abff5b6bbbf82e43a3fd57717c90731d.name: Soldier Boots
abff5b6bbbf82e43a3fd57717c90731d.desc: A pair of boots which is covered in silvery scales. Your ankles will be safe and sound with these.

80585761b53de84cb9bc1291402a9fb4.name: Mortar
80585761b53de84cb9bc1291402a9fb4.desc: A fine mortar. This should enable an Alchemist to broaden their crafting spectrum when placed within their reach.

873d587c00f3174da27e9a77fbbfaeba.name: Construction Hammer
873d587c00f3174da27e9a77fbbfaeba.desc:
Hammer of the Ancients: An archaic building tool fueled by the Flame, capable of quickly  erecting various structures around your home.

Can only be used within the range of a Flame Altar.

f4bdfaaa2b6fe24bbe325b2487f1acc2.name: Wooden Bucket
f4bdfaaa2b6fe24bbe325b2487f1acc2.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ad21d7699ba52e4198e3524bdccc46a0.name: Provisional Scythe
ad21d7699ba52e4198e3524bdccc46a0.desc: A provisional tool used to deal fast and ugly cuts.

7e1a8d0dbb35c545aca59171c6cb12f5.name: White Flower
7e1a8d0dbb35c545aca59171c6cb12f5.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

b01f606bbb1e984396441332ee16aede.name: Two-Handed Melee Weapon Wall Mount
b01f606bbb1e984396441332ee16aede.desc: A display to showcase weapons or shields.

acc479ae033cc94b944b2d10b3e097e0.name: Pikemead's Bulwark
acc479ae033cc94b944b2d10b3e097e0.desc:
Even in death, the Queen unites those who seek protection behind her shield. 

Parry
You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar.
Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

6bf830e67ea1294b8f403c17b5bb6c29.name: Executioner's Axe
6bf830e67ea1294b8f403c17b5bb6c29.desc: An axe of gruesome origin. It has seen many heads roll and still fulfills its purpose today.

c6a0bdca4ff75d4383aca17dc6435d0f.name: Torchlight Staff
c6a0bdca4ff75d4383aca17dc6435d0f.desc:
A staff that was used by magical torchbearers of bygone days. They'd illuminate uncharted caves to claim even the furthest corners of the Albaneve Summits as parts of the northern empire. The scouting went well until the Cyclopes learned that the torchbearers were feeble mages whose light could be snuffed out easily with a decisive boulder toss.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

2c5a196cc566de42883e4c8d448f9e51.name: Assassin Hood
2c5a196cc566de42883e4c8d448f9e51.desc: A special piece of cloth was added to this assassin hood to hide the wearer's face and their most likely daunting smile.

8d95bd218aeb6549aaec5709805ecf97.name: Silver Bars
8d95bd218aeb6549aaec5709805ecf97.desc: Citizens of Embervale would sometimes invest in silver in the hope it would hold its value during a crisis. A crisis did come, but the silver offered little help.

0730232532f61940a697a2e543e78876.name: Copper Door
0730232532f61940a697a2e543e78876.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

b78297836423254a8b433461df71bc10.name: Ultimate Ring of Stamina
b78297836423254a8b433461df71bc10.desc: An ancient ring that gives you stamina.

609fb511c7e61c49813b7d9507d3fbb9.name: Ancient Shelf
609fb511c7e61c49813b7d9507d3fbb9.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

5e2335ce431f854e95571e43d152b275.name: Warlock Boots
5e2335ce431f854e95571e43d152b275.desc: Traditional warlock boots, which protect the feet and allow the wearer to stampede over enemy remains.

31ad650be5d37c47926a19041c8c048a.name: Axe
31ad650be5d37c47926a19041c8c048a.desc: A primitive tool used for cutting wood. It can also be used as a weapon in a pinch.

e59ea5d5af760042b219d4da6fcaa8c3.name: Grilled Dune Armadillo
e59ea5d5af760042b219d4da6fcaa8c3.desc: A specialty of the Kindlewastes — customers love it because of its health benefits!

a6ae0ff0701d09429b180f225e06ae45.name: Copper Bars
a6ae0ff0701d09429b180f225e06ae45.desc: A rare and valuable metal thanks to its thermal conductivity. It's often used to create things that require a lot of heat.

4f4c6e0c0557144dac3cd6e4f6f3264f.name: Riptide
4f4c6e0c0557144dac3cd6e4f6f3264f.desc: A shield that was washed into a grotto by the river. It must have belonged to a valiant hero.

7f9939fcad435a41ac9be051d53608f6.name: Farm Soil
7f9939fcad435a41ac9be051d53608f6.desc:
Healthy soil that will increase the growing speed of most plants.

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

8171ab9e6db9684babf4424802fee46c.name: Candied Ginger
8171ab9e6db9684babf4424802fee46c.desc: Peppery, sweet, and packing a punch — this candied ginger is a great snack for anyone not afraid of strong flavours.

4557ea22cd625d4f9f3cfc47513a148a.name: Yellow Flower
4557ea22cd625d4f9f3cfc47513a148a.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

21b34b51a49bdd4f9761b1802b0ce5b6.name: Alchemist Apprentice Gloves
21b34b51a49bdd4f9761b1802b0ce5b6.desc: Starting out on the path of the alchemist apprentice, these gloves will make your life a little more comfortable.

f37c1a1bc7baea43b7cf37c977f5a6bf.name: Mystic Gloves
f37c1a1bc7baea43b7cf37c977f5a6bf.desc: Mystical gloves that have been adorned with glistening aquamarine stones.

cda3d7d447843a47b1f3184022e4bb48.name: Hollow Halls Showcase (3 Small and 2 Medium Slots)
cda3d7d447843a47b1f3184022e4bb48.desc: This is a showcase for Hollow Artifact Collection Items usually found in the Hollow Halls.

1e36bc84c731ea47b800d697f91e8027.name: "Round-Billed Sailer On One Leg"
1e36bc84c731ea47b800d697f91e8027.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

115124e1dce2794fa148c35e97fcc341.name: Waveborne Ritualist Gloves
115124e1dce2794fa148c35e97fcc341.desc: Golden adornments define this set — and naturally, the gloves are no exception.

c26dd8deea1c654fa84d0f2ff351af8a.name: Secret Polished Granite Door
c26dd8deea1c654fa84d0f2ff351af8a.desc: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.

f54b9e0671a1914b9c64c705dfb0c4e1.name: Shroud Beam
f54b9e0671a1914b9c64c705dfb0c4e1.desc:
Releases an aimed ray of disastrous Shroud that continuously deals damage to enemies within. 

Shroud Spell: This spell results in a debuff that reduces your Time in the Shroud.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

ab83134bdb865541ae121eb4cc38649c.name: Silver Platter
ab83134bdb865541ae121eb4cc38649c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

929efc735056ff4d9cb82cc14db04de6.name: Lilac Insomnia
929efc735056ff4d9cb82cc14db04de6.desc:
The cold thrill of the night winds is far too electryfying to sleep. This color palette is bursting with a trance-like energy and tinged with madness.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

b49211ccdfd79d4db8bd30c3c8a40b66.name: Sword of Radiance
b49211ccdfd79d4db8bd30c3c8a40b66.desc: A bright and mighty weapon emanating power.

06a43219a8a4d24f9103da98af744cf9.name: Celestium Platter
06a43219a8a4d24f9103da98af744cf9.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

734ccbbd739ed244abadf3109f1cbc23.name: Riptide
734ccbbd739ed244abadf3109f1cbc23.desc: A shield that was washed into a grotto by the river. It must have belonged to a valiant hero.

d8c0e5e397a0934882fd6fbccbf28d68.name: Fern
d8c0e5e397a0934882fd6fbccbf28d68.desc: A small potted plant to beautify your home.

3aebfea2898651468d16cea80555928d.name: Blackmire Statue V
3aebfea2898651468d16cea80555928d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

b26e0733474a824e83580700592b107e.name: Sword Of The Serpent
b26e0733474a824e83580700592b107e.desc: A glistening green blade, perfectly representing the aesthetics of the year of the serpent.

71bbdfa11351ed41b0f8660a279d073e.name: Black Hair
71bbdfa11351ed41b0f8660a279d073e.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

0d081356b4ba754d9bddc0b77a16c7df.name: Small Crypt Cabinet
0d081356b4ba754d9bddc0b77a16c7df.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d95fdc93ee511145a87a2ab0e3f5b7d8.name: Basket IV
d95fdc93ee511145a87a2ab0e3f5b7d8.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f52c4d9431d4b34db3304ee31fba24f6.name: Bloodfeather Pants
f52c4d9431d4b34db3304ee31fba24f6.desc: Designed for stealth, these neutral pants make sneaking through the thicket effortless.

7f5b0954cdacfc409dc7d8b52ceee51a.name: Staff of the Ram
7f5b0954cdacfc409dc7d8b52ceee51a.desc:
A horned staff that has been embellished with alabaster fur. It is soft to the touch.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

96152bdfbb73244495d5bb1785d18dbf.name: Circus Knives
96152bdfbb73244495d5bb1785d18dbf.desc:
A pair of circus knives that can do a lot of damage if left in untrained hands! Better watch out!

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

c7b6185b65515e4788aca32b1b731584.name: Mothling Pants
c7b6185b65515e4788aca32b1b731584.desc: Furry boots wrapped with cords. The strands can be unwound to fasten makeshift bandages in a pinch. Decorative pom poms hang dangle from the sides.

77d1a81d283ab143b43044b38022d925.name: Advanced Glider
77d1a81d283ab143b43044b38022d925.desc: This Glider is lighter and enables you to travel bigger distances.

7b5634b57f628348bf5f23d99d97049c.name: Large Salon Mirror
7b5634b57f628348bf5f23d99d97049c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ab450f2195d4524193b78934b877998c.name: Tiny Plant Pot
ab450f2195d4524193b78934b877998c.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

41c99385c28e1b4cb4b80c942e3ed218.name: Palm Leaf Basket
41c99385c28e1b4cb4b80c942e3ed218.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d54263a816f25f4ea08fce149555e124.name: Fossilized Bone Dust
d54263a816f25f4ea08fce149555e124.desc: Grinding the Fossilized Bone into dust frees its inherent magical attributes and makes it more handy for further production steps.

29c8b0db705bb04598ef3ec7f4a2d92a.name: Roasted Shiitake Mushroom
29c8b0db705bb04598ef3ec7f4a2d92a.desc: A roasted shiitake mushroom. The new, smoky aftertaste brings out the umami flavor.

2e89fa0516706a419ef92331d7478f58.name: Lonely At The Top
2e89fa0516706a419ef92331d7478f58.desc:
A music sheet that contains a thought-provoking tune. Snow falls ever so slowly when pondering the past.

Music Sheet: 
Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

78076535573f4f4e9c0af654a8ca5114.name: Fur Chest
78076535573f4f4e9c0af654a8ca5114.desc: Reinforced with Metal Scraps for better protection.

d17036be7929004a884eecf9f336347e.name: Simple Tropical Wood Fence with Ropes I
d17036be7929004a884eecf9f336347e.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

86ffcd9ff6c6c44d8c884e5674675678.name: Minor Arcana
86ffcd9ff6c6c44d8c884e5674675678.desc: Archaic power vibrates deep within this sword.

7d99d0ca6de67c4198f6e03f6745611d.name: Deerstalker Trousers
7d99d0ca6de67c4198f6e03f6745611d.desc: Warm and padded hunting pants that will retain your body heat during cold, starless nights.

bd49aca6a8dbc24f9537f5268c855f92.name: Ashwind Strider Gloves
bd49aca6a8dbc24f9537f5268c855f92.desc: A pair of asymmetrical gloves. One leaves the fingertips bare, allowing you to check the direction of the wind.

209950ce092b5f4e8a738a1b9115eca3.name: Empty Cymbidium Pot
209950ce092b5f4e8a738a1b9115eca3.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

0776869ec8db974aa101714f795b9a5f.name: Wet Boot
0776869ec8db974aa101714f795b9a5f.desc: A soaked boot, damaged through years of water exposure. Perhaps the fur on it could be useful.

76457ce62021f64cb3b7dd6986c0b249.name: Nightnebula
76457ce62021f64cb3b7dd6986c0b249.desc:
A mystical pair of blades used for unspeakable divinations held under the full moon.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

d3c34fcde89abb47a7bd092d45d71207.name: Pikemead's Bulwark
d3c34fcde89abb47a7bd092d45d71207.desc:
Even in death, the Queen unites those who seek protection behind her shield. 

Parry
You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar.
Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

2f1ee608bc918842bd47701ead1aea20.name: Smooth Stone Road Block
2f1ee608bc918842bd47701ead1aea20.desc: A road material made from smooth stones. Traveling on it is a delight.

2e4b9aec3ee6a544a08b9c0aa2e4d39d.name: Bell Pepper Seedling
2e4b9aec3ee6a544a08b9c0aa2e4d39d.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

de024e70aab08d46bb26fe29539af1ec.name: Mysterious Flask
de024e70aab08d46bb26fe29539af1ec.desc: A strange flask exuding a feeling of power.

e2aa055a443f6145a6e21bd5e5b1ffbb.name: Fish Bones
e2aa055a443f6145a6e21bd5e5b1ffbb.desc: Small fish bones that can be used in crafting. They feel brittle in your hands, but they'd be a terrible pain if stuck in your throat.

96b809ba8f69ec48a47c8effdcae7900.name: Fresh Shroud Spore
96b809ba8f69ec48a47c8effdcae7900.desc:
Fresh Shroud spores, used to craft medicines that can cure the Shroud curse.

They first appear in the Springlands at night, among groups of Fell enemies above the Shroud.

4eb816cc995b714e85fee6891f87a414.name: Improved Construction Hammer
4eb816cc995b714e85fee6891f87a414.desc:
A magical tool powered by the Flame. It enables you to fly while building various structures for your base.

Requires being within the range of a Flame Altar to work.

cd08e28305de394ea118e2113716f202.name: Sandstone Brazier
cd08e28305de394ea118e2113716f202.desc:
A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.

3677c2f30f08ed49a94ef2946c5711a6.name: Fowler Trousers
3677c2f30f08ed49a94ef2946c5711a6.desc: The pants were made from varied materials and protect all the most important areas adequately.

edda859181cae246b8cd4f9fe4cb4782.name: Big Blue Wall Banner II
edda859181cae246b8cd4f9fe4cb4782.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d4a93ad0463edb45a81cbd6cd57ce554.name: Tomato Fish Soup
d4a93ad0463edb45a81cbd6cd57ce554.desc: A creamy and delectable tomato soup, made more aromatic with a fish filet.

6d2255df2dbde94f9c89ff4115a5a356.name: Fur Boots
6d2255df2dbde94f9c89ff4115a5a356.desc: Warmer and sturdier than simple cloth.

a2a4a9c789f798499918a3ca736a5ded.name: Spider Web III
a2a4a9c789f798499918a3ca736a5ded.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f591c9457394ad40bcd4531559a441c0.name: Skull Stalker Pants
f591c9457394ad40bcd4531559a441c0.desc: These pants move with you through the underbrush, boosting your stamina as you stalk your prey.

d80697a3ebc22c4193d400ff59c966ea.name: High Iron Window Frame I
d80697a3ebc22c4193d400ff59c966ea.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

3196e107f096e94897e08d02e8684683.name: Large Boreal Wood Sideboard
3196e107f096e94897e08d02e8684683.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e8867dda43481d4dace36b3c1cb9b642.name: Assassin Gloves
e8867dda43481d4dace36b3c1cb9b642.desc: Robust gloves that hide the wearer's palms and true intentions.

12d7b26d00d69043b786aca8086a5ba4.name: Infusion Altar
12d7b26d00d69043b786aca8086a5ba4.desc: A flat stone altar used to combine archaic components into a powerful magical infusion.

8c3898afe15d1e4f9f5977e8466fc889.name: Globe
8c3898afe15d1e4f9f5977e8466fc889.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

a697a15bad10164791a76a626497fec7.name: Above The Vermin, The Cowards, The Liars
a697a15bad10164791a76a626497fec7.desc:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"With it came power, mistrust, and a longing for more."

"Levitation", you said. I could not believe my ears, but you were never one to jest, so I took you at your word. What did it feel like? Was it bright and sharp? Weightless and warm? Suffocating and unsteady? Maybe a little bit of everything. - J

f04eac16efa1f04c907d2e257834d68b.name: Large Albaneve Summits Brazier
f04eac16efa1f04c907d2e257834d68b.desc:
A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.

fd0fa9befb0037479d57f87d7da49ca8.name: Rough Stone Block
fd0fa9befb0037479d57f87d7da49ca8.desc:
A Rough Stone Block built in the most basic manner of craftsmanship.

Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

1393dde9edb59b4b99e99209734f7ca8.name: Deadeye Hood
1393dde9edb59b4b99e99209734f7ca8.desc: This archery hood lets you watch over the peaks and valleys like a hawk. Nothing will escape your vigilant gaze!

87c94a65165bdf468c61c23affe9c66b.name: Eternal Arc Lightning I
87c94a65165bdf468c61c23affe9c66b.desc:
Releases continuous lightning strikes that can arc to multiple other close targets.
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

4c6b3a2c98095248bd17aed8d79f9596.name: Dragoncore Staff
4c6b3a2c98095248bd17aed8d79f9596.desc:
A blood-red gem hovers above the staff, exposed and splintered. The era of dragons has long passed. One day, the Dawn Age, the age of mankind, will end, too.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

8d402159c5420249ae26ec301b364d89.name: Indigo Seedling
8d402159c5420249ae26ec301b364d89.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

5998bc817b475e41babed429990f4e2f.name: Book V
5998bc817b475e41babed429990f4e2f.desc: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.

219c0fcd6ff91c429d89b745b2e986da.name: Large Bamboo Basket
219c0fcd6ff91c429d89b745b2e986da.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6e6a65d0f6393f498fbcb5df51ade28a.name: Bronze Hollow Cyclops Trophy
6e6a65d0f6393f498fbcb5df51ade28a.desc:
When encased in solid bronze, the head looks even more menacing than before.

Collect multiple Hollow Cyclops Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

4a38c1678533304c87534974993ecf6b.name: Electric Initialiser
4a38c1678533304c87534974993ecf6b.desc:
An electrifying wand that was previously used to start engines and machinery in an instant. The air crackles around it, and it has an odd shape.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

4f1695ba28a84540b60d8169aeaf3baf.name: Crude Wooden Gate I
4f1695ba28a84540b60d8169aeaf3baf.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

5ecefa202ec5094085f0db1883ded5ce.name: Rustic Bed
5ecefa202ec5094085f0db1883ded5ce.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

dabfceaa54ef3947948f92f89a4867ff.name: Honey Baked Banana
dabfceaa54ef3947948f92f89a4867ff.desc: The banana and honey combine to create a smooth and creamy sweetness. A delicacy for any Flameborn with a sweet tooth!

df383dab3e66ab41b20e544432299a1e.name: Frostwing Axe
df383dab3e66ab41b20e544432299a1e.desc:
Legends say that this weapon was once wielded by a hero who was mangled in battle. He sought a freezing cave to rest and tend to his wounds, leaving a trail of blood in the snow. 
Once he emerged after a hundred-year slumber, a swarm of ice bats soared into the night sky, signaling his return.

ad8e1875d73d064292473a2d200cd735.name: Raw Rice
ad8e1875d73d064292473a2d200cd735.desc: Grains of raw rice. They'll be very filling once cooked!

7e8754738986af42a2d7904a590e2fdc.name: Golden Bulwark Helmet
7e8754738986af42a2d7904a590e2fdc.desc: Just one look into those eyes and your enemies will want to turn the other way. That was your first line of defense, and you didn't have to lift a finger.

5eafdb4ece04c74fbc2c333a76a61502.name: Spiked Club
5eafdb4ece04c74fbc2c333a76a61502.desc: A slightly improved version of the Club, reinforced with spikes.

d7ed3da8dda70e4ab6af9df58c19fc45.name: Shield Wall Emblem I
d7ed3da8dda70e4ab6af9df58c19fc45.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

9c7742a955584044a0a9338dbb768972.name: Seafood Grill
9c7742a955584044a0a9338dbb768972.desc: A sturdy grill, perfect for preparing advanced seafood dishes. With it, your food will come out extra crispy and full of flavor.

d54a3c3649977545a986f3d6b2f67388.name: Exceptional Handpan
d54a3c3649977545a986f3d6b2f67388.desc: This golden handpan was used by the Drak. Did they play it during ceremonies, sacrifices, or duels? You can't say for sure, but you do know that its sound is magical and enticing.

b31332c3fb9fd54eba0525c225e5dfd5.name: Trampoline (High Jump)
b31332c3fb9fd54eba0525c225e5dfd5.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

90704856247b124b8765d92b8ce9ee4a.name: Scrap Cup
90704856247b124b8765d92b8ce9ee4a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

b238123a46cf8c4d89fa58b1432bc997.name: Exclusive Hollow Pants
b238123a46cf8c4d89fa58b1432bc997.desc: Pants fit for a midnight march. The metal plating is polished enough to reflect the moonlight.

8e5e2031abed85468c856209a2643146.name: Bronze Vukah Brawler Trophy
8e5e2031abed85468c856209a2643146.desc:
Battle-hardened and brutish, the beastly Vukah would create their Brawlers through constant clashes. Only the strongest survived.

Collect multiple Vukah Brawler Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

8e5eeceb74701c48b4cb58cefec9b2bc.name: Radiant Paladin Chestplate
8e5eeceb74701c48b4cb58cefec9b2bc.desc: Showcase your beaming soul of flames and cast out all evil once and for all! The light thunders and roars with every heartbeat.

eae347858fe02640acd2cacd1c4680ee.name: Lesser Golden Twinflame Sword
eae347858fe02640acd2cacd1c4680ee.desc: A weapon that was rumored to have fallen from the stars. The man who found it could never feel whole, always searching for a missing piece.

bc2ae1d06b621249972793a3efd44609.name: Gloom Monarch Helmet
bc2ae1d06b621249972793a3efd44609.desc: It's said that the original owner of this helmet wore it to hide his many facial scars. Whether this is true is uncertain.

6c0bef06d18c5245bb1254ddd99162b8.name: Royal Pants
6c0bef06d18c5245bb1254ddd99162b8.desc: Billowy pants that were made from the finest silks. They create an interesting and lavish silhouette.

5d15b27130868e4da4e2e3ef9f6dda0d.name: Big Wooden Crate
5d15b27130868e4da4e2e3ef9f6dda0d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e781bfe3136cae45b800a48beda70ef4.name: Magician Gloves
e781bfe3136cae45b800a48beda70ef4.desc: A magician's gloves, bound by a magic-infused golden thread.

2730be745eb5f14cb8c92d951acd5517.name: Flax
2730be745eb5f14cb8c92d951acd5517.desc: A popular plant due to its strong fibers. It can be used to make linen.

685612d702567144b0ad2871996668f8.name: Morningdew Greatsword
685612d702567144b0ad2871996668f8.desc: No matter how dire the night may be, with the rising sun comes sweet morning dew.

d4d0927e13f35b469bfa017fe544b6ab.name: Luminous Growth
d4d0927e13f35b469bfa017fe544b6ab.desc: It glows in the dark. A moody light source often found in or around caves.

367f6143a0e8d84f8a0f21f743b61e10.name: Wood Wall III
367f6143a0e8d84f8a0f21f743b61e10.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c559ada8f835a04593f0cfd88d3e65b4.name: Sage Headwrap
c559ada8f835a04593f0cfd88d3e65b4.desc: You can't read sacred scrolls if you can't see, but true understanding comes from within, anyway.

8f48d7c074e1ce498f3405dd4ecb94ae.name: Hawk Boots
8f48d7c074e1ce498f3405dd4ecb94ae.desc: Ride as swift as the bluejays with these sturdy leather boots.

bad6d3fb469a7b4d84c2512f02f3cf73.name: Archmage Hat
bad6d3fb469a7b4d84c2512f02f3cf73.desc: This magical hat was decorated with fine metal spines that reach out to the stars. It only graces the brightest minds in Embervale!

3ffeb3028fcb1941bf418c0a466eff93.name: Highly Polished Stone Block
3ffeb3028fcb1941bf418c0a466eff93.desc: A stone block refined with the highest level of craftsmanship, rarely seen even in ancient times.

45a5b4a01b3ee94b955c1caba0499b3b.name: Bamboo Lounger
45a5b4a01b3ee94b955c1caba0499b3b.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

be56ba4b567e9d47b000ad0365423c64.name: Assassin Trousers
be56ba4b567e9d47b000ad0365423c64.desc: A plain pair of pants. Under different circumstances, they would allow the wearer to easily blend into any crowd.

abd121dad27dc244a6efbc7cbc0d1983.name: Pikemead's Bulwark
abd121dad27dc244a6efbc7cbc0d1983.desc:
Even in death, the Queen unites those who seek protection behind her shield. 

Parry
You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar.
Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

dd58bac66a57cb44a70c05fb2089506b.name: Thunderbolt Axe
dd58bac66a57cb44a70c05fb2089506b.desc: This one-handed axe crackles with electrifying energy since it was charged by lightning during a rare desert storm.

1da4b66a9fa9ea4a81a37acd96387fa7.name: Fluffy Tunic
1da4b66a9fa9ea4a81a37acd96387fa7.desc: A warm tunic, lined with white wool. The sleeves are long and wide, so it's fun to swing your arms around gleefully!

3d3ce3621f043544b58fde8c58184cbd.name: Basalt
3d3ce3621f043544b58fde8c58184cbd.desc: Dense, dark volcanic stone, harder than common Cinder Rock. Masons prize it for its durability and even texture.

e8adcffd88b0814a874b837c04d11e14.name: Moonstone Block
e8adcffd88b0814a874b837c04d11e14.desc: A solid block of shimmering moonstone. It's cool to the touch and it catches light beautifully.

5c91aecb25e10947b5ee354eaae79196.name: Ranger Vest
5c91aecb25e10947b5ee354eaae79196.desc: This piece of armor only offers minor protection against incoming arrows, but that hardly matters. The best preventative measure is to aim for the eyes.

ffd964f78293754e87ae82d2f99676ea.name: Bronze Cyclops Trophy
ffd964f78293754e87ae82d2f99676ea.desc:
Their faces are frightening, but they mostly just want to herd goats and yaks. People only make up a small portion of their diet. 

Collect multiple Cyclops Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

f57a2bef6e97d24789e164756afe4f9a.name: Guardian Trousers
f57a2bef6e97d24789e164756afe4f9a.desc: Trousers that were made from a very stiff material.

51cc3f858a94ca469d93dc51f885ce1d.name: Gem of Currents
51cc3f858a94ca469d93dc51f885ce1d.desc:
While Wet or Soaked, damaging enemies will apply Soaked to them for %k sec. Damaging soaked enemies has a chance of %k to deal %k bonus Shock Damage.

Wet 
Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30%% for 15 minutes. Warmth reduces the remaining duration.

Soaked 
Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30%% for 30 seconds. Also reduces Ice and Shock Resistances by 30%% but increases Fire Resistance by 30%%.
Soaked can be applied to enemies.
Soaked duration can not be reduced by warmth, and transitions into the Wet debuff once it ends.

e9b1b9f50da42c40baf6493770a69207.name: Large Round Iron Window Frame
e9b1b9f50da42c40baf6493770a69207.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

503d6c34bf7e6e42afee913ec62c6580.name: Ultimate Bandage
503d6c34bf7e6e42afee913ec62c6580.desc:
A highly effective bandage with thyme extract.

This item heals 80% health over 10 seconds if applied to a wound and clears any poison effect.

Receiving any damage interrupts the healing effect.

08a5c808775f4940913366093f04073b.name: Baby Yak
08a5c808775f4940913366093f04073b.desc: A baby Yak, fluffy and warm.

bdb6ebe56aa0b04dba0af626c60cc12d.name: Roof Tiles Block
bdb6ebe56aa0b04dba0af626c60cc12d.desc: A Roof Tiles Block is needed to build shingle roofs, commonly seen in construction.

94d015ba9eaf3c48a06cd9fe8b04687f.name: Field Stones
94d015ba9eaf3c48a06cd9fe8b04687f.desc: An assortment of differently sized stones commonly found on fields.

19f120bece58b24c9f8877fc20675a8a.name: Ice Bolt II
19f120bece58b24c9f8877fc20675a8a.desc:
Conjures an icy projectile that deals damage in an area and applies a slow debuff.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

dcbd5e16c8c7d04e82f33fd0809f6e85.name: Stone Column Block
dcbd5e16c8c7d04e82f33fd0809f6e85.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e5702be70de18a449d70dc27ef093f14.name: Prison Fence Gate
e5702be70de18a449d70dc27ef093f14.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

36030dbb95a7574b9ee02774dde5b1a6.name: Grilled Shockfin
36030dbb95a7574b9ee02774dde5b1a6.desc: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

b735b2b30a2ab44494b42d1abe909f2b.name: Shroud Sand
b735b2b30a2ab44494b42d1abe909f2b.desc: Fine sand that's been infused with Shroud spores. Commonly found in the Kindlewastes biome.

ec3ff6375ac13a459e24cd60b2a8183c.name: Chamomile
ec3ff6375ac13a459e24cd60b2a8183c.desc: A wondrous flower known for many potential applications, but used mostly for healing purposes.

434bf9c3c71ae74d945ef075384c43d9.name: Darya's Wand
434bf9c3c71ae74d945ef075384c43d9.desc:
A wand that harnesses the power of the eclipse. It functions best when the sun is fully submerged in darkness, and only a faint rim of light shines through.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Ethereal Duplication:
The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

91a17d27a8642948925f208a685487ee.name: Cutthroat Trousers
91a17d27a8642948925f208a685487ee.desc: The added leather grants superior protection from jagged rocks, unruly tree bark, and incoming arrows.

77e1a6dbfc462d42a7639e2772ff44b2.name: Ancient Mana Potion +
77e1a6dbfc462d42a7639e2772ff44b2.desc: Instantly restores a large amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.

5fa0042f7d699b48a32f76bb3439f5bc.name: Workbench
5fa0042f7d699b48a32f76bb3439f5bc.desc:
Craft blocks, new items and repair broken equipment. 

The Workbench can only be placed inside the area of a Flame Altar.

4a219132616c1c4388649eb7bfe667da.name: Granite Stone Lavatory
4a219132616c1c4388649eb7bfe667da.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

2278596a57b94543be1b86662d3eb801.name: Bamboo Room Divider I
2278596a57b94543be1b86662d3eb801.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

9bb426692b78fb4bb545592770f4b7ad.name: Brick-Timbered Block
9bb426692b78fb4bb545592770f4b7ad.desc: A new type of timber block for building. The brick accents warm up any space.

a3ec3e3ae8ad08469fa1b90026434fdb.name: Chitin Powder
a3ec3e3ae8ad08469fa1b90026434fdb.desc: Fine powder made from grinding critter carapaces.

d552e1ed1700524e836ec2088561de15.name: Sky Specter Chest
d552e1ed1700524e836ec2088561de15.desc: A royal blue gambeson that hides the wearer's blackened heart and devious intentions underneath. It allows you to blend into the night sky, providing the perfect camouflage for a downward strike.

e41a0dd3a76b0240889db11fd880769a.name: Warlock Helmet
e41a0dd3a76b0240889db11fd880769a.desc: A helmet which protects your sensitive cranial bone from harm while riding into battle.

12826eba883c2f489c9697a3718fbb85.name: Crypt Candle
12826eba883c2f489c9697a3718fbb85.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

7a09fd06f84eb24784035f0ac0d236f8.name: Bamboo Wood Block
7a09fd06f84eb24784035f0ac0d236f8.desc: This building block is made from sustainable materials, specifically bamboo. It has a beachy feel to it.

337b29aa55e9824e80f2ab2b6aa98a79.name: Crypt Wall Torch
337b29aa55e9824e80f2ab2b6aa98a79.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

4846e1388ff9c34bb73ea39ab13e515b.name: Dark Crystal Cluster
4846e1388ff9c34bb73ea39ab13e515b.desc: A cluster of dark crystals, growing together. They reach into different directions like the finger bones of the undead, clawing themselves out of their graves.

8a6451bbf541264091d4de19d4c7a1c2.name: Drak'Dal Spine
8a6451bbf541264091d4de19d4c7a1c2.desc: Ridges line the base of this sword, adding weight to each swing. The uneven silhouette is reminiscent of protruding vertebrae.

c938c9e60c4f71448d5a1ae4040245a1.name: Shroud Mushroom
c938c9e60c4f71448d5a1ae4040245a1.desc:
A mushroom that is commonly found beneath the Shroud. 
It's inedible but can be processed into different materials in crafting.

808f1beaa8933d41be5e0bc3f77336ad.name: Placeable Gem Forge
808f1beaa8933d41be5e0bc3f77336ad.desc: This Gem Forge can be placed inside your base. Use it to upgrade gems or to insert them into your weapons from the comfort of your own home.

06579152b0d79e45b1ef9bb6cc7a0d5f.name: Scrap Ladle
06579152b0d79e45b1ef9bb6cc7a0d5f.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

2a373d4062c0904fa79b5eae094f54ba.name: Vanguard Wall Banner
2a373d4062c0904fa79b5eae094f54ba.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

2a37e1c9659c76459c2f9e48cdf98f12.name: Artificer's Boots
2a37e1c9659c76459c2f9e48cdf98f12.desc: A pair of heavy-duty, gilded boots. Even sharp machinery pieces or rotating gears could not scrape them.

0c7d6de5b059e04e9ce97b75c2df6c18.name: Ancient Microscope II
0c7d6de5b059e04e9ce97b75c2df6c18.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1994bd3344e20949b92d2295d18996bc.name: Mana Drain II
1994bd3344e20949b92d2295d18996bc.desc:
Releases a continuous magical beam that leeches Mana from enemies without dealing damage to them.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

a2f2a52dc255a549aabe2a759701368b.name: Secret Limestone Door
a2f2a52dc255a549aabe2a759701368b.desc: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.

494a07e891160345a0e5ec6dcf3e21a5.name: Secret Crude Wooden Bookshelf Door
494a07e891160345a0e5ec6dcf3e21a5.desc: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.

538c54ff49d9c046ab953873da0e2520.name: Fine Wooden Fence Pole
538c54ff49d9c046ab953873da0e2520.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ad58c19cca4e964fb19985eb3a263bd0.name: Large Round Carved Window Frame
ad58c19cca4e964fb19985eb3a263bd0.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e812f054e3d7e14fa6f91cdfdc18897f.name: Crestflame Chest
e812f054e3d7e14fa6f91cdfdc18897f.desc: A belted chest armor piece that's marked by thick, linear grooves and ridges that stretch towards the sun. It is adorned with violet trim that elevates the construction and creates a pleasing color palette reminiscent of the hues of the Mother Flame.

20a9f0ede6efdd46b8127b1186cec1a2.name: Spider Web II
20a9f0ede6efdd46b8127b1186cec1a2.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

db8a9892014b934cb15d23a7ae10b9e9.name: Eagle Eye Trousers
db8a9892014b934cb15d23a7ae10b9e9.desc: The faded cool hue of these pants provides stark contrast to the flaming accents on the rest of the armor set.

c8c095c2ed3838418110ac8f1707f2b1.name: Bronze Block
c8c095c2ed3838418110ac8f1707f2b1.desc: A Bronze Block commonly utilized in art and science. It inspires greatness when used as a building material.

2e5bc4d331d2b74faa4c48890b33d763.name: Emberguard Helmet
2e5bc4d331d2b74faa4c48890b33d763.desc: The crest atop this helmet stretches upwards, caressing the skies like the crown of an Ancient Spire and willing to frame within it the light of the sun.

57877756005b8d4b848630fba3b81a80.name: Solstice Daggers
57877756005b8d4b848630fba3b81a80.desc:
They unveil their true power during the solstice, as if they were recharged and invigorated by the sun's rays.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

84065a6fe0e1b7499553bffb93a1ec3d.name: Trilobite Imprint
84065a6fe0e1b7499553bffb93a1ec3d.desc:
A detailed trilobite imprint. The structure of its exoskeleton can still be made out clearly.

This collectible is found in the Revelwood.

b03767f7e8a2da44b35a29247b26959d.name: Heart Pillow
b03767f7e8a2da44b35a29247b26959d.desc: A soft velvet heart-shaped pillow, bringing not only comfort but a luxurious, elegant look to any space.

7acb1428b8ebfc41a1066742e52790ce.name: Fine Hardwood Double Door
7acb1428b8ebfc41a1066742e52790ce.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

8e28e9a9626bfc45b524e82d55331ea3.name: Sacrificial Vukah Dagger
8e28e9a9626bfc45b524e82d55331ea3.desc:
A crude dagger, previously used by a Vukah in a bloody ritual.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

07675f1c52d9e14a85ba70039214d2f6.name: Blacksmith Garb
07675f1c52d9e14a85ba70039214d2f6.desc: Just enough to protect the wearer from sparks.

c561c075fe91cc45bc6e18f082972b52.name: Gem of Battle Mania
c561c075fe91cc45bc6e18f082972b52.desc:
While the Elixir buff is active, dealing damage activates the Satisfied Battle Mania buff, granting %k Health, %k Mana and %k Stamina regeneration for %k. 

Each additional hit refreshes the duration of that buff; however, once it runs out, the Unsatisfied Battle Mania debuff will suspend any Health, Stamina, and Mana regeneration for %k.

ef74b1ff956c9e4e8090bdcca937a448.name: Major Arcana
ef74b1ff956c9e4e8090bdcca937a448.desc: Archaic power sleeps within this blade. It resonates, whispers and sings to those who dare to listen.

b14a4ac5ae1f974eb9d1d0e61a7d909b.name: Bronze Fell Sicklescythe Trophy
b14a4ac5ae1f974eb9d1d0e61a7d909b.desc:
The Sicklescythe's tongue froze once struck down, too powerless to cast the final curse stuck in its throat.

Collect multiple Fell Sicklescythe Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

2d9968a1aec92d4189693b2f9e1de5c9.name: Noble Sword
2d9968a1aec92d4189693b2f9e1de5c9.desc: A dignified blade, used to defend the honor and lives of the weak.

683fcec61189db4397594a0d5d5ea0b9.name: Adventurer Gloves
683fcec61189db4397594a0d5d5ea0b9.desc: Sturdy gloves that protect the hands while exploring. The red markings on them represent bravery.

badef4f82d7b9f49a29035bd31db8d2a.name: Grey Blades
badef4f82d7b9f49a29035bd31db8d2a.desc:
A pair of dark, grey daggers adorned with a bright green gem the color of envy.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

061991ad85f014499f7c79ea59eed59d.name: Smithing Tools
061991ad85f014499f7c79ea59eed59d.desc: A collection of tools — the heart of every smithy.

fe7d4372a53bb8419c9401924d68b57e.name: Standing Crypt Coffin
fe7d4372a53bb8419c9401924d68b57e.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f7056e0c48c86b4396f2ad500c55648a.name: Fern
f7056e0c48c86b4396f2ad500c55648a.desc: A small potted plant to beautify your home.

4b869159d1b6b04a9e29a6a83a64aece.name: Brazen Bull Shield
4b869159d1b6b04a9e29a6a83a64aece.desc: The goat head imprinted on this metal shield is imposing, looking down on its adversaries with a stalwart gaze.

fc550a9f94019f4ea805d373d26587f9.name: Incredible Ward
fc550a9f94019f4ea805d373d26587f9.desc: A strong magic shield with a near-impenetrable barrier. The Ancients may have used this invention long ago, but they most likely discarded it in favor of other research projects.

5ddfa68ed9d6d64986620dda293c8c88.name: Eagle Eye Boots
5ddfa68ed9d6d64986620dda293c8c88.desc: Wrapped in darkened leather and shrouded in mystery, these boots carry the wearer as if on clouds.

b12b53056d74374f96168a9da4cca667.name: Shepherd's Staff
b12b53056d74374f96168a9da4cca667.desc:
A potent staff capable of guiding those who would otherwise be without protection.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

73a2f82fe1d6a2418a967ae0d8177e9e.name: Yellow Wall Banner
73a2f82fe1d6a2418a967ae0d8177e9e.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

a2950cab00e68f4e92f91694b7cb72c5.name: Drakian Boots
a2950cab00e68f4e92f91694b7cb72c5.desc: A pair of boots that has been reinforced with Drak paraphernalia, granting you the upper hand in combat.

3eaa7a9e91b34044a9161244825ff679.name: Cutthroat Chest
3eaa7a9e91b34044a9161244825ff679.desc: A warm, padded vest. Ideal for enduring cold nights while awaiting the time to strike.

bf80fb01fa0a2548b10938b6b0a4297a.name: White Wall Flower
bf80fb01fa0a2548b10938b6b0a4297a.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

c414fe2cc7188f40a15219062aa8e52c.name: Gold Vukah Brawler Trophy
c414fe2cc7188f40a15219062aa8e52c.desc:
Whoever owns this trophy has shown that even the strongest Vukah Brawler is no competition to them.

Collect multiple Vukah Brawler Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

9d0b389c1063ba40bfebba146ca56a4c.name: Archmage Hat
9d0b389c1063ba40bfebba146ca56a4c.desc: This magical hat was decorated with fine metal spines that reach out to the stars. It only graces the brightest minds in Embervale!

7383c5153c8a754eae0f71f21cf61213.name: Vukah Shrine
7383c5153c8a754eae0f71f21cf61213.desc:
Interacting with this shrine will grant you the Vuk'ahrrrrr buff. 
It grants + 20% Damage against Scavenger and 
+ 10% Poison Resistance for 30 minutes.

fe3f03fdf541c8418a96a4223701c26c.name: Drak Stone Totem IV
fe3f03fdf541c8418a96a4223701c26c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

5045f1ac818b72498426b4a615380d4b.name: Small Plant Pot
5045f1ac818b72498426b4a615380d4b.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

0e8484b59aeac1499b6653c21d6f5687.name: Raw Meat and Mushroom Skewer
0e8484b59aeac1499b6653c21d6f5687.desc:
This mushroom skewer will strengthen not only your flesh but also your mind. 

Grilled over a fire, it will raise your maximum health, increase your magic damage, and accelerate your mana regeneration.

7d0ec963fc14c04e96445fee99219424.name: Round Polished Window Frame
7d0ec963fc14c04e96445fee99219424.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e70df091baa75847bd7185ff8655eb19.name: Rune Apprentice's Sword
e70df091baa75847bd7185ff8655eb19.desc: The simplicity of this sword is deceiving! A faint, magical power radiates from the pastel blue stone forged into the blade. This craftsmanship was very popular with young spell slingers and battle mages.

7bacf556480ee84992d45121e506cb80.name: Mercenary Trousers
7bacf556480ee84992d45121e506cb80.desc: A piece of leg armor that already looks like it has seen many years of use.

a6a73167808f8144bd7ad964583d55f8.name: Book I
a6a73167808f8144bd7ad964583d55f8.desc: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.

5c7a201e51e8b349b104fbaed0ef7c87.name: Aureolin Plant
5c7a201e51e8b349b104fbaed0ef7c87.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

a94e2937135c2a49a5a5d88d331eb6bb.name: Drak Scales
a94e2937135c2a49a5a5d88d331eb6bb.desc: Fresh and glistening Drak scales, shimmering and shifting in the golden glow of the sun.

bc9744bb38bde7449dfe608ee7c1aa76.name: Sharpshooter Trousers
bc9744bb38bde7449dfe608ee7c1aa76.desc: Green pants which allow the wearer to glide through tall grass swiftly and silently.

fa7ff3fb2a1fa147bbdb13cceeb67c09.name: Archmage Gloves
fa7ff3fb2a1fa147bbdb13cceeb67c09.desc: Gloves which were worn by the most talented, renowned and successful mages of the kingdom.

1d6e072b67ba224eb7efed53a00c2a82.name: Astronomy Standing Lamp
1d6e072b67ba224eb7efed53a00c2a82.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

f459939e813aa74a9584b814e406281a.name: String
f459939e813aa74a9584b814e406281a.desc: Used to bind things together, String is an extremely important item.

3e6cde4ba88e38478db682b9581f6e46.name: Beef Stew
3e6cde4ba88e38478db682b9581f6e46.desc: A burning hot, meaty stew. Increases your resistance against extreme cold and improves your health and health regeneration.

f6247f2810085c498f5bab8b89fdf18d.name: Whiskerfin
f6247f2810085c498f5bab8b89fdf18d.desc:
This bottom-dwelling fish is known for its long whiskers, which it uses to sense movement and food in the water. Apparently, it sensed your bait, too.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

5b9020025fa2d642a853a72c43077349.name: Wooden Double Door
5b9020025fa2d642a853a72c43077349.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c4d6656608fe804d937de79d7a820e53.name: Grilled Crimsonback
c4d6656608fe804d937de79d7a820e53.desc: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

c266a4b94c1175458cfdc90233d26b04.name: Flame Mosaic Piece VII
c266a4b94c1175458cfdc90233d26b04.desc:
A small part of a shattered Flame mosaic. Perhaps you can piece it together if you find all the shards!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. The full collection includes 8 pieces. They can be reassembled into a mosaic inside a Flame Mosaic Frame. The Frame must be placed on the ground.

dd0386f76666fe48924079d04ac093a6.name: Steel Wall Lamp
dd0386f76666fe48924079d04ac093a6.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

1384f20a7967f74496d1a4885f194119.name: Blackened Staff
1384f20a7967f74496d1a4885f194119.desc:
Every apprentice knows that the Blackened Staff hides dark secrets. Trying to uncover them leads to migraines, nausea, and paranoia.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

c8258ac47aebce44b77be72b98ed1e70.name: Astronomy Desk I
c8258ac47aebce44b77be72b98ed1e70.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

783e2b14ed8e904495e5dcc1a961560f.name: Kiln
783e2b14ed8e904495e5dcc1a961560f.desc: A crude industrial oven for sintering and heating.

6c5995173fd66b4b94797191ee9cf7fc.name: Bloodfeather Gloves
6c5995173fd66b4b94797191ee9cf7fc.desc: Adorned with a crystal and gold trim, these gloves give you a firm grip on your daggers — ideal for strikes from behind.

1cf2ccb22d9b294fa696091e7cf66dc9.name: Guard Of The North Sword
1cf2ccb22d9b294fa696091e7cf66dc9.desc: Lord Vorgoth's once-trusted blade was discarded before the war and replaced by a weapon more befitting vile acts. It still clings to a semblance of sanity and light, shining brightly in the dark like the North Star.

033643cbc5d673439264a56f83eb27c4.name: Dreadbane
033643cbc5d673439264a56f83eb27c4.desc: A large and powerful hammer that has been corrupted by the Shroud. Good for smashing bugs!

d95852104c12304a9429d38e80421020.name: Deceiving Staff
d95852104c12304a9429d38e80421020.desc:
The weapon of choice for the deceitful.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

32fd58291d414f4bbe8212c2e214a6e0.name: Big Fur Rug
32fd58291d414f4bbe8212c2e214a6e0.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f1fb167fe903a342b3b9e739d2fd75c7.name: Fowler Gloves
f1fb167fe903a342b3b9e739d2fd75c7.desc: Wearing these gloves makes the pulse slow down mysteriously before going in for the kill, thus steadying the hands.

eb4447b944e98842b208b997d4ab25bd.name: Herbalist Boots
eb4447b944e98842b208b997d4ab25bd.desc: Quickly dash to the rescue in these comfortable and snug boots!

b98d9b9eb05c81418ead2281e216611a.name: Graveyard Fence Pole
b98d9b9eb05c81418ead2281e216611a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1bced738537cde439eeec29843649178.name: Ring of Stamina
1bced738537cde439eeec29843649178.desc: An ancient ring that gives you stamina.

3e2ebe8a0f519041b58bf7da20f5b741.name: Gloom Monarch Trousers
3e2ebe8a0f519041b58bf7da20f5b741.desc: This forgotten piece of armor is covered in dried blood and shrouded in darkness. Maybe it should have stayed lost.

c17a4c01b04a8542a7f109882e69de97.name: Snowpal Mom
c17a4c01b04a8542a7f109882e69de97.desc: A friendly figure made from snow.

520e5cc6a5a913448dee61d3ed55400b.name: Hunter Hood
520e5cc6a5a913448dee61d3ed55400b.desc: Remain unseen and strike from the shadows with this formidable archer's hood.

a13d1a36911029468ebe3784c86d6e2c.name: Refined Sandstone Block
a13d1a36911029468ebe3784c86d6e2c.desc: A building material made from Sandstone, fitting the colors of the desert. It was created for architectural monuments.

50c9684b097d974e844c6e3ba4107b46.name: Steel Axe
50c9684b097d974e844c6e3ba4107b46.desc: This improved tool will lose durability more slowly thanks to its steel cutting blade. Be careful with your fingers while woodworking!

dc68ae3cc9a274489c57896323b4ae17.name: Daylily Seedling
dc68ae3cc9a274489c57896323b4ae17.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

d21f3cd1cf25dd48b74b2bd9da321770.name: Archmage Chest
d21f3cd1cf25dd48b74b2bd9da321770.desc: A truly spirited garb for magicians and casters. The fabric was laboriously dyed with deep cobalt pigment derived from imported nightblooms.

f318973b9aec524aa823de9b635378fc.name: Temple Stones
f318973b9aec524aa823de9b635378fc.desc: Weathered stones, either built or claimed by the Vukah. The yellow-tinged moss in the furrows hints at its age.

c47956d6e2a4f140b480bfd1f0f3266a.name: Lifelock Helmet
c47956d6e2a4f140b480bfd1f0f3266a.desc: A robust circlet helmet that sits deep on the forehead and covers the eyes, like a descending one-eyed vulture.

a3b6693d13d3714f9eab6ccbbc6fb2ce.name: Efflorescent Hope Gloves
a3b6693d13d3714f9eab6ccbbc6fb2ce.desc: Gold veins flow through these gloves like sun-kissed rivers emerging after an icy slumber. The color of the underlying cloth changes from blue to green, symbolizing an awakening — a reach toward the light above the water's surface.

b42e0aab78a3084cac6f091f99ab28d5.name: Wood Wall II
b42e0aab78a3084cac6f091f99ab28d5.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

db9269f1c529a04e91063b4ceb57f4f6.name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Boots
db9269f1c529a04e91063b4ceb57f4f6.desc: With these boots, the "Scholars of the Empyrean" were able to pass the trapped corridors of the Night Sanctums. Their soles, often worn thin, were replaced countless times. Hopefully, they'll carry you just as far on your own journey.

c13c3c2c812cd7468cddd589d13b5e85.name: Bronze Bathtub
c13c3c2c812cd7468cddd589d13b5e85.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

97efc256f2fea946976f9aadaccaa2e7.name: Sunpiercer Helmet
97efc256f2fea946976f9aadaccaa2e7.desc: Embody golden grandeur with this ornate helm — and a gaze as unyielding as stone itself.

97ef7a0209aeb948b2c6a4fe6a352924.name: Waveleaper
97ef7a0209aeb948b2c6a4fe6a352924.desc:
The Waveleaper dances atop the waves with unmatched agility, a living embodiment of the waters untamed spirit.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

c2eac16a75e6e94d83895bf5d17a1710.name: Mannequin "Strike A Pose"
c2eac16a75e6e94d83895bf5d17a1710.desc: A mannequin that can be dressed in armor or vanity items.

f25445f4bfc2b34996c62405475b4fa8.name: Strawberry Cake
f25445f4bfc2b34996c62405475b4fa8.desc: The sugar rush powers your stamina regeneration for a short amount of time.

d7a0f6dd57469e4badb983bcba7f6b70.name: Castle Throne
d7a0f6dd57469e4badb983bcba7f6b70.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

47f3da1900a9c54ab01f93eaf1eaedb4.name: Waveborne Ritualist Boots
47f3da1900a9c54ab01f93eaf1eaedb4.desc: With this footwear, the healing power of the earth flows straight through you — can you feel it?

02fe99b7e8197e40b11b547e1a811de3.name: Muted Green Hair
02fe99b7e8197e40b11b547e1a811de3.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

67d24ae6603fa2478f388d0146afb175.name: Simple Wood Support
67d24ae6603fa2478f388d0146afb175.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

44dce98b09aea04896ca3c66c231552f.name: Rising Fighter Trousers
44dce98b09aea04896ca3c66c231552f.desc: Polstered trousers to dampen your fall in fighting practice.

a99462d67f9ee44295531b340622d613.name: Scholar of the Young Flame Gloves
a99462d67f9ee44295531b340622d613.desc: Gleaming golden gloves were the mark of a Scholar in motion, swift of thought and radiant of heart.

9ab08e887b083744ab2bf0cdda35cfb3.name: Trap Fireball
9ab08e887b083744ab2bf0cdda35cfb3.desc:
A Trap Fireball which can be used as spell ammunition.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

a378a3d40584104e801b4ccc9d0b85e3.name: Gem of Puncturing
a378a3d40584104e801b4ccc9d0b85e3.desc: Dealing piercing damage applies  puncturing to enemies.  Punctured enemies receive %k bonus pierce damage from ANY pierce damage source for %k.

9ef3c680d2402541972c108ec00b94ec.name: Wall Tapestry IV
9ef3c680d2402541972c108ec00b94ec.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

56ac3134c63d3042ba4a3bf5e0f2d086.name: Cade Hawthorn
56ac3134c63d3042ba4a3bf5e0f2d086.desc: The Carpenter Cade Hawthorn can craft anything with wood.

8ba455b79a89fc42bbfbcf9f5e4ea9b0.name: Pearlfrost Mentor Chest
8ba455b79a89fc42bbfbcf9f5e4ea9b0.desc: It's an expertly layered blue coat with a white fur trim. The quilted cloth and leather provide better protection in close combat. The gold casing near the heart carries a faceted gem and resembles a cornflower blue eye, searching the battlefield for souls in need.

69622fac7e31304db5a9c894b60b7aef.name: Graven Idol Axe
69622fac7e31304db5a9c894b60b7aef.desc: Carved with a stone visage, this axe is as much relic as weapon.

63d65da8815dc940beb6e7fdcfa11c63.name: Spellweaver Pants
63d65da8815dc940beb6e7fdcfa11c63.desc: Lilly-white pants peek through from beneath the crimson coat. It makes you wonder: Can there be innocence in times of war? Despite the bloodshed, the hearts of those who wield magic must always remain pure. Otherwise, their power becomes unbound from both law and morals.

d62d7c938a308a44aca680064002b450.name: Mage Trousers
d62d7c938a308a44aca680064002b450.desc: These comfortable and plain pants are perfect for apprentices who wish to gather some firsthand adventuring experience.

cc2054a0b426914b8dd5f35cc3c26cb0.name: Medium Hollow Halls Banner
cc2054a0b426914b8dd5f35cc3c26cb0.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ef3e14206ce37f42a8c75e5fc556538f.name: Crestflame Helmet
ef3e14206ce37f42a8c75e5fc556538f.desc: Vibrant plumes emerge from the crest of this helmet and meander forth like smoke. They remind one of the Mother Flame's light as it fades against the dusk.

c9c4776cf66473409be42a830bcad2ec.name: Common Fishing Bait
c9c4776cf66473409be42a830bcad2ec.desc: An almost guaranteed catch for common fish!

1064263c62df6748b710bda13927da62.name: Room Divider I
1064263c62df6748b710bda13927da62.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e3a56abbb97f3946ad1fbd266c5ccace.name: Wooden Tavern Counter
e3a56abbb97f3946ad1fbd266c5ccace.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

449ebb1849d54544984a61427c61acd6.name: Sacrificial Vukah Dagger
449ebb1849d54544984a61427c61acd6.desc:
A crude dagger, previously used by a Vukah in a bloody ritual.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy.

fc1f055bbbb4584e82497e057853124d.desc: Tasty and fresh berries, stimulating the bodily regeneration abilities with fresh vitamins for a short duration.

Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

57324bff19bda44b9f3c6cfd08fa9811.name: Ring of Rivulets

71fa4cf650ce844a847e1f0002ca05fb.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

b9d398b7fddaff4ab80594b607678136.name: Leather
b9d398b7fddaff4ab80594b607678136.desc: A versatile and durable material that is smooth to the touch. It also has the advantage of being waterproof.

2ee796b23e98c64e8a7a52e26b0471d4.desc: Decorative bells are especially suitable for the yearfall.

b5c8ec9fd31a494ebbb2f67d0af81c75.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

33c90592c1351a4da68030fb3ff39b2e.name: Sharpshooter Vest
33c90592c1351a4da68030fb3ff39b2e.desc: The shoulder pads on this Sharpshooter Vest are exceptionally sharp and pointed like the tip of an arrow.

64388a9bfe98db489a0e927e5b588512.name: Marksman Vest
64388a9bfe98db489a0e927e5b588512.desc: The leather on this nature-bound armor piece was layered to resemble the leaves of a withering forest.

a31b16438b8dc348a018cf22dd563deb.name: Fae Deer Farmer Shirt
a31b16438b8dc348a018cf22dd563deb.desc: A short-sleeved linen shirt that's topped with an orange fur cape. The cape flows down the wearer's back and ends in pieces that wave in the wind like a tail.

5ee67917ffd4d741af1c2dbd26c0a242.name: Glimmer Gentian
5ee67917ffd4d741af1c2dbd26c0a242.desc:
"Glimmer Gentian" is a variant of the gentian plant that can only be found in the Albaneve Summits at night.

It emits a bright pink glow and can be used to create vibrant color palettes.

ada6dd78438d444281816bdf2ac6f8dc.name: Large Dark Crystal

863e4da62b14e140a67fc3022c8c8368.name: Spellweaver Standing Banner
863e4da62b14e140a67fc3022c8c8368.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

7a3822de5e443d46af344c145e784421.name: Stellar Wand
7a3822de5e443d46af344c145e784421.desc:
A wand with a certain celestial quality. It captures the light of the stars above, similarly to a telescope.

beeaf500ce4e4d49bc6edb1ea1e13552.name: Staff Of The Serpent
beeaf500ce4e4d49bc6edb1ea1e13552.desc:
A majestic staff topped with an ouroboros ornament made from green jade. It's perfect for honoring the year of the snake.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

b1b7e3fdca3f8b4fa911ab796a7b5be2.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

0686323fef51884798d5804f7438ea17.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

451ab9ca30ba684bbcd66f440782739d.name: Regular Sandstone Block
451ab9ca30ba684bbcd66f440782739d.desc: A Regular Sandstone Block. It's very cost-efficient.

58b4132d8a662547acc40285aa1210fc.name: Book III
58b4132d8a662547acc40285aa1210fc.desc: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.

431d216a537cda46b6449b2508cd1f6b.desc: Throw this mystical vessel to temporarily summon a skull companion.

4422a14694722d46904689095a29f68a.desc: A small potted plant to beautify your home.

595302af5bd42348b218ac7c2b8fa335.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

86004385a7bcc944bf9819281863deb4.name: Fell Wispwyvern Trophy
86004385a7bcc944bf9819281863deb4.desc:
The change of tides was not kind to this creature. Perhaps it can finally rest.

Collect multiple Fell Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Trophy.

5aabdb3dc9c00243bcb6e2c33e9cc9ff.name: Paper Lantern II
5aabdb3dc9c00243bcb6e2c33e9cc9ff.desc:

589562ca5d297b4791fe7d86fc555f76.name: Frostbite Slasher Boots
589562ca5d297b4791fe7d86fc555f76.desc: Heavy boots with metal caps, perfect for kicking down doors or crushing skulls under your heel.

da7aec49e568b148a8b1322e289c65bc.name: Red Marble Column Base II
da7aec49e568b148a8b1322e289c65bc.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6666e465a6d1734c815d19fb30d00d72.desc: An improvised bow made out of basic materials. Unfortunately, the bowstring is quite loose.

493b2ca58fbbb54b96aaf0d0ce108130.desc:
Ages ago, they were many — soaring across snowy peaks and through painterly valleys. Now, there is only one. Oh, how far you fall when flying high.

Collect multiple Fell Dragon Youngling Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

5d0e0c93b2bc77478fa9984a28af3279.desc: A mace with a segmented body, reminiscent of a totem pole climbing towards the sky. The head is augmented with a stone crown that radiates outwards.

0629c567a302c843afe58ea80fa5515b.desc: A golden parade armor that shines brighter than the sun. A resilient flame flickers inside the chestplate's cavity, framed by the sigil which the Flameborn have claimed as their own.

a0f99b91f90dd34d86c81564c2f8997c.desc: Full metal armor with flourishing lines, swinging around the leg like ensnaring vines. Their thorns may prick, tear, and break her, but a wounded deer leaps highest, so they say.

cf473522aed56a4ea5b7f6bd84ac9f8f.name: Heal Cascade I
cf473522aed56a4ea5b7f6bd84ac9f8f.desc:
Releases continuous healing projectiles that automatically seek you and your allies.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

b938717cabf3ed46b7308ad1b9903002.name: Crude Wooden Fence IV
b938717cabf3ed46b7308ad1b9903002.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

99fb8a2ab658064b90fcab7b37d0e2ac.name: Exclusive Hollow Gloves
99fb8a2ab658064b90fcab7b37d0e2ac.desc: The golden adornments on these gloves create an aura of superiority and grace.

2832dfacb97416449748be858ee9a5ed.name: Fluffy Mittens
2832dfacb97416449748be858ee9a5ed.desc: These gloves were patched together with two different fabrics. They re-create the look of "hooves".

7abc1fb8995448448395f39081d3cb5a.name: Wolfsbane Plant
7abc1fb8995448448395f39081d3cb5a.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

8042ecd42133c247afa52bfe9b5f703e.desc: Created with mana-potent ingredients, the Mana Potion restores a good amount of mana.

b91978be5dc6ed43aeb7ae39f7af4575.desc: Miscreants, brutes, and evil doers of the past would often wield similar blades. Perhaps this weapon was forged in the shadows of a back alley and changed hands on the black market.

Overcharge:

Rays of steel stretch outward from the sword handle's guard. They resemble the final light of the sun before an eclipse.

This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.

Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

a765f209d3c3f9439ab4afc58515226a.desc:

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

7a5f44597f81364e86828e65db3e3420.name: Reaper's Wand

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

cc6e784270bde7419745ab7c82b1a7bf.name: Drak Relief I
cc6e784270bde7419745ab7c82b1a7bf.desc:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

This piece shows the Drak arriving on Embervale. They spy Ancients buildings on the horizon, and are drawn to explore them.

0db4a95e497ebb4c9a8ed6c3f3398292.name: Fell Crimson Critter Queen Trophy
0db4a95e497ebb4c9a8ed6c3f3398292.desc: Her red glowing head is smaller than your memory suggested and her mandibles less threatening.

64c4bcbcee9d0d4e9a925bf34153f890.name: Bamboo Container II
64c4bcbcee9d0d4e9a925bf34153f890.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

64c400ad70fc7445a25e3802042edb87.name: Crestflame Pants
64c400ad70fc7445a25e3802042edb87.desc: These are trousers that were created using superior ancient forging techniques. They bear the same mystical radial lines favoured by the ancient masters.

48207ee473fece499e934b403d7f61b5.name: Talion's Bow
48207ee473fece499e934b403d7f61b5.desc: A bow used by Commanders of the Northern Guard. A powerful energy flows through the user, increasing their pulse and allowing for faster shots.

a3a7f8017ea56c4b8a0d646fc0c76361.name: Hollow Titan Trophy
a3a7f8017ea56c4b8a0d646fc0c76361.desc: The bare helmet of the Hollow Titan. At its crown rises a stiff plume.

9fde1cffc696734197808cb3623b7639.name: Greater Thunderblast Axe
9fde1cffc696734197808cb3623b7639.desc: An electrically charged two-handed axe, able to release sparks into the overcast sky when striking. It was struck by lightning while inside a cataclysmic typhoon and survived, unlike it's previous owner.

3f1e484381778d43ae6c959eb04718d5.name: Mercenary Helmet
3f1e484381778d43ae6c959eb04718d5.desc: This sturdy Mercenary Helmet protects your eyes and hides your expression, making you appear fearless and intimidating.

caed7cf302443642b4e883d1a5b33d6e.name: Ground Lantern I
caed7cf302443642b4e883d1a5b33d6e.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

cf4f3a0805bd2c4ba61d6957803843da.name: Archmage Trousers
