cf4f3a0805bd2c4ba61d6957803843da.desc: The pants are elegantly held together with cobalt stitching and thread. The color represents sophistication and the superiority of the mind.

1de31b00f32e8142be8566c8db2b5e35.name: Wildheart Standing Banner
1de31b00f32e8142be8566c8db2b5e35.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

46e2cdfce8fe0e428713c25d3dcd8d7d.name: Elder Gloves
46e2cdfce8fe0e428713c25d3dcd8d7d.desc: All the forgotten knowledge of the world will be at your fingertips with these highly sought-after gloves.

cd11484405698d4686dbb26db66e80e1.name: Cyclops Torso
cd11484405698d4686dbb26db66e80e1.desc:
A cozy Cyclops ribcage with enough room for you and your best mate to snuggle up in.

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.

7d646c2368358346aab6704ed1cafe88.name: Conifer Wood Block
7d646c2368358346aab6704ed1cafe88.desc: A cozy, darker wood block made from conifer logs. It makes you want to hunt in the mountains or to drink hot tea by the fire.

abf1fddfad91c141920fd406843225b8.name: Ultimate Mana Potion
abf1fddfad91c141920fd406843225b8.desc: A excellently formulated mana potion that instantly restores a massive amount of mana upon use.

6838b48f5e125b43bf20969c349060eb.name: Freshblood Mace
6838b48f5e125b43bf20969c349060eb.desc: When a drakling hatches from its shell, its lowered, elongated body appears almost snake-like. However, they soon adapt an upright posture and bare their teeth — this process is represented through the design of this mace.

bad7e0a253e49f48a62179fa3cb707f9.name: Fae Deer Food Bait
bad7e0a253e49f48a62179fa3cb707f9.desc:
Food for attracting and taming a Fae Deer.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.

239ab990d2ec484ab0bd6757149d1842.name: Dragon's Wing
239ab990d2ec484ab0bd6757149d1842.desc: Gain the strength of a dragon with this legendary weapon.

827023a5fa38e94c9d652ebbb20d6c25.name: Albaneve Summits Bone Key
827023a5fa38e94c9d652ebbb20d6c25.desc:
Opens doors in the Albaneve Summits Hollow Halls.

Some chests in the Hollow Halls require Ectoplasm to be opened — collect enough on your descent! 
Also make sure to save some Ectoplasm for crafting Bone Keys.

6ed0a037147b4043a7a5928a4917abfa.name: Mannequin "Back Off"
6ed0a037147b4043a7a5928a4917abfa.desc: A mannequin that can be dressed in armor or vanity items.

2569912f19a68f44899ab186c78296b2.name: Metal Wall Drain I
2569912f19a68f44899ab186c78296b2.desc: This drain will remove any water above it. Can be placed on the wall.

bdf52c5e1ad5a444a86c4728edad589d.name: Prickle Pearl Seedling
bdf52c5e1ad5a444a86c4728edad589d.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in Basalt Farm Soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

175b882fa01e1c41b7067f174ceb90ad.name: Brazen Bull Gloves
175b882fa01e1c41b7067f174ceb90ad.desc: Catching a backhand from these spiked gloves will bring even the most vigilant attacker to their knees.

d2b385e65de05c4d9d685358a0ead21d.name: Ancient Microscope III
d2b385e65de05c4d9d685358a0ead21d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f490adc9a3464845bf7e7a237d4c7c1b.name: Sunny Loungewear Pants
f490adc9a3464845bf7e7a237d4c7c1b.desc: A pair of lightweight pants. They're simple and easily replaced, so it's not too bad if they become bleached by the sun or drenched with water.

d80fe9851fe137478e21ce1cd0acaa50.name: Hawk Trousers
d80fe9851fe137478e21ce1cd0acaa50.desc: Pants such as these were originally made fashionable by prominent falconers from ages long past.

70f536b0816d134585de9474c58e7c7a.name: Staff Of The Serpent
70f536b0816d134585de9474c58e7c7a.desc:
A majestic staff topped with an ouroboros ornament made from green jade. It's perfect for honoring the year of the snake.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

8b95c4cb0d270b4aae70ddca3708440f.name: Iron Vukah Brawler Trophy
8b95c4cb0d270b4aae70ddca3708440f.desc:
Every thundering roar is a spectacle, a bloody sight to behold. They've sunk their tusks into now-forgotten lands... time to reclaim the kingdom.

Collect multiple Vukah Brawler Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

7eedb783d67bf540b6c5f8ef09ce8038.name: Prison Room Divider I
7eedb783d67bf540b6c5f8ef09ce8038.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

773f232af81efc46b8cb039618ea2d10.name: Mercenary Gloves
773f232af81efc46b8cb039618ea2d10.desc: Mercenary Gloves. They're worth their weight in gold.

40249f82251f124cb204a1712f3b5502.name: Snowfall
40249f82251f124cb204a1712f3b5502.desc:
White like freshly fallen snow, somewhere on the edge of the world.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

a96672b9119e97469510ac5f00688bd4.name: Superior Health Potion +
a96672b9119e97469510ac5f00688bd4.desc: Instantly restores health massively, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.

ef2f5db5051dea43aa2a7fe0fcd27bc2.name: Chester Loft
ef2f5db5051dea43aa2a7fe0fcd27bc2.desc: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

628795f18c1abc4b9ebb1176dfbb6020.name: Hydrak'Dal Head
628795f18c1abc4b9ebb1176dfbb6020.desc:
The head of a Drak'Dal tribe leader. You've severed it from its neck, but in its place, two new ones will form — figuratively speaking.

Collect multiple Hydrak'Dal Heads to craft the Trophy.

4b415b624528a14090b5d1a708abce70.name: Fine Hardwood Handrail
4b415b624528a14090b5d1a708abce70.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

bcaf0fcc47b56c4ca43ba0fcdb1bcf41.name: Empty Farmbed
bcaf0fcc47b56c4ca43ba0fcdb1bcf41.desc: This Farmbed can be filled with dirt, sand, or soil to grow plants.

fd37381a4c47734da55ef0422d52463a.name: Eternal Shroud Meteor
fd37381a4c47734da55ef0422d52463a.desc:
Calls down a disastrous Shroud Meteor on up to five foes.

Shroud Spell: This spell results in a debuff that reduces your Time in the Shroud.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

b379d9d66e78fa4da9c1f2d6b3c91ad5.name: Rust
b379d9d66e78fa4da9c1f2d6b3c91ad5.desc:
Colored like rusted metal, slate, and copper.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

1a0425980e2bd3459e789229f0a6d44e.name: Sky Specter Boots
1a0425980e2bd3459e789229f0a6d44e.desc: These boots allow you to step as if carried by the clouds, silently prowling between silvery shadows.

9664baff4f3c3b4080ea5088d2fb8d95.name: Big Clay Vat
9664baff4f3c3b4080ea5088d2fb8d95.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c705b668f190c1439797212266bddd87.name: Frostbite Slasher Trousers
c705b668f190c1439797212266bddd87.desc: This pair of pants has ample space for carrying exposed blades and hidden toxins.

22b7d49ec04e3342a134e797d2c83084.name: Small Ancient Temple Shelf
22b7d49ec04e3342a134e797d2c83084.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

0bd6f1a0da05e747b52038c96bf22254.name: Large Crypt Mausoleum
0bd6f1a0da05e747b52038c96bf22254.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

b1e69c834e9d024db6f36e7a5890aaac.name: Lesser Golden Twinflame Sword
b1e69c834e9d024db6f36e7a5890aaac.desc: A weapon that was rumored to have fallen from the stars. The man who found it could never feel whole, always searching for a missing piece.

1036c8067349174a865c75ab59fe5e41.name: Gemini Ring
1036c8067349174a865c75ab59fe5e41.desc: A delicate ring with the symbol of the Gemini — quivering with hatred in the moonlight.

a58ae5d4d061654eb0ac4188ec6d5d91.name: Eternal Bonestorm I
a58ae5d4d061654eb0ac4188ec6d5d91.desc:
Conjures a flurry homing bone projectiles that hunt down enemies with crushing force.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

fa78b7bbdb2d1546bf8251d064a83ba4.name: Resin
fa78b7bbdb2d1546bf8251d064a83ba4.desc: This protective juice of trees has many functions. First and foremost, serving the cause of the trees!

21a5b9739debd043a254d9ddd82c4702.name: Eternal Fire Totem I
21a5b9739debd043a254d9ddd82c4702.desc:
Summons a totem that launches fiery projectiles at enemies and explodes when it expires. 
Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

bf3b8bcec4cf6f48aca8605c593282e1.name: Gem of Destiny
bf3b8bcec4cf6f48aca8605c593282e1.desc: Mark one random enemy within %km as Marked by Destiny for %k. Defeating the marked enemy spawns an orb that grants either %k health, %k mana, or %k stamina depending on which resource is most depleted.

bf3b3d901f46cc4da78ae90cb2a7399e.name: Ectoplasm
bf3b3d901f46cc4da78ae90cb2a7399e.desc: A strange material extracted from ectoplasm fragments. It was filtered through cloth and coal but still smells odd.

691596b8e74e86498037c31fe9699d07.name: Shield Rack
691596b8e74e86498037c31fe9699d07.desc: A display to showcase weapons or shields.

3ca2b2b09771d94193907bf82fd94426.name: Decorative Oven II
3ca2b2b09771d94193907bf82fd94426.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

63898a417cfc2845b0cbb0c92851eb21.name: Black Eyes
63898a417cfc2845b0cbb0c92851eb21.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

ac599a3b3230ae4d852d49c5b7c3343f.name: Meat Chopper
ac599a3b3230ae4d852d49c5b7c3343f.desc: A primitively crafted but brutal weapon, awaiting its next prey.

1143aac1984aa649b3af22287b0ce720.name: Barber's Favorite Wig Head
1143aac1984aa649b3af22287b0ce720.desc: A wig head that unlocks more haircuts once picked up. It can also be placed in your base as decoration.

76b3c0a5fc746c4cbd11701e1e1821f2.name: Eternal Frost Arrow II
76b3c0a5fc746c4cbd11701e1e1821f2.desc:
An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's ice-cold to the touch.

Eternal Arrow: Does not deplete Ammo per use. Equip the Eternal Arrow and use Mana to shoot it with a Bow.

5000716d57bde44b86b359575768fca0.name: Trailblazer Gloves
5000716d57bde44b86b359575768fca0.desc: Sturdy gloves, dark as the midnight sky. They've been adorned with animal horns that were gathered during the hunt.

17fec6fdf682704f965b0030f50381fb.name: Aquamarine Dreams
17fec6fdf682704f965b0030f50381fb.desc:
A luminous blend of crystal blues and soft turquoise hues captures the shimmering depths of clear waters. Calm yet vibrant, this palette radiates the freshness and clarity of aquamarine crystals, exuding a quiet elegance.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

57e5cdbf1af2c443b03fe1f77a1d06dc.name: Switch Button
57e5cdbf1af2c443b03fe1f77a1d06dc.desc: A switch button combined with a light. Pushing the button switches the state between ON and OFF. A glowing light indicates the ON state.

e7c8a53e8cf97c419338ca0a2a720150.name: Purple Eyes
e7c8a53e8cf97c419338ca0a2a720150.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

5c35666128c96944b7a684785a3c8d46.name: Farmer Pants
5c35666128c96944b7a684785a3c8d46.desc: Sunbleached pants, carefully patched and sown with leftover thread. The cloth is wearing thin in some areas...

ccb48f0b1673364d8de02cf3f506aae0.name: Hopeful Glimmer
ccb48f0b1673364d8de02cf3f506aae0.desc:
Unyielding and unbroken, this staff resembles the realm's last bastion of hope.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

9f24e6b497036848b617e69863dc4ba1.name: Sharp Shark Tooth
9f24e6b497036848b617e69863dc4ba1.desc:
A sharp tooth from a large aquatic being, possibly a megalodon variant. It's preserved incredibly well and, surprisingly, might be comparatively recent. The owner must've had quite an appetite to need such gigantic teeth...

This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.

793b09b558423441bfed41a680e095b0.name: Emberguard Helmet
793b09b558423441bfed41a680e095b0.desc: The crest atop this helmet stretches upwards, caressing the skies like the crown of an Ancient Spire and willing to frame within it the light of the sun.

432dbb3be13968459955a5802f01dac3.name: Royal Temper
432dbb3be13968459955a5802f01dac3.desc:
This palette carries itself with quiet authority. It's regal without trying, and bold without apology.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

562156d65f4bec46a08d305bb970a25a.name: Ancient Column
562156d65f4bec46a08d305bb970a25a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

781856d29655294bbfa20ce0da1f65d5.name: Captain Melville Fontane
781856d29655294bbfa20ce0da1f65d5.desc: Captain Melville Fontane is a fisher and entrepreneur who offers fishing gear.

496afd3233cb914383e53d497f381d9a.name: Fae Deer Farmer Gloves
496afd3233cb914383e53d497f381d9a.desc: Two-toned leather gloves with light stitching. Their pattern gives them an almost whimsical feel.

f9bccf6444db6b4394abe046c01540c5.name: Mountain's Shadow Trousers
f9bccf6444db6b4394abe046c01540c5.desc: A pair of charcoal black, loosely fitted pants. The larger silhouette stems from the extensive wool padding inside.

bebc4b58d68e5f4a97dd409f9660214e.name: Limestone
bebc4b58d68e5f4a97dd409f9660214e.desc: Limestone is an abundant resource often used in architecture.

9c6163cb256fbf4aa756b4c49d0650fd.name: Bow and Arrow Wall Mount
9c6163cb256fbf4aa756b4c49d0650fd.desc: A display to showcase weapons or shields.

ce18022e51ecd24fb4508b24992509cf.name: Flour
ce18022e51ecd24fb4508b24992509cf.desc: Flour that can be created by grinding Wheat Grains to dust.

29ba8a893424de4bb9289e7eb5588e0a.name: Huge Ancient Door
29ba8a893424de4bb9289e7eb5588e0a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

23e012a11a1104478949f03ee82dfb69.name: Mana Drain V
23e012a11a1104478949f03ee82dfb69.desc:
Releases a continuous magical beam that leeches Mana from enemies without dealing damage to them.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

2e7bf4a2aff02f439eefc78b47c940ec.name: Training Doll II
2e7bf4a2aff02f439eefc78b47c940ec.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

57a7150c30d8f04c8b9f56bb982906b1.name: Direwolf Trophy
57a7150c30d8f04c8b9f56bb982906b1.desc: The Direwolf's Head dominates the wall, it's sheer scale dwarfing any common wolf beside it.

151d99876550b74d99e9561b7b469340.name: Goat Food
151d99876550b74d99e9561b7b469340.desc:
Nutritious goat food for tame animals on your farm. It can be given to both Common Goats and Frizzy Goats.

It must be placed inside the appropriate feeder.

93d8a5893493b0468bd8dceccf3fd6e4.name: Ring of the Ancients
93d8a5893493b0468bd8dceccf3fd6e4.desc: A broad ring that invokes power through golden glyphs. Spherical discs and tori orbit a central gem, like planetary rings, as the stone in their midst shimmers with unknown colors.

d683492e905c1d41b16044e9d3ab53b1.name: Composite Bow
d683492e905c1d41b16044e9d3ab53b1.desc: This is a very sophisticated bow with high tension.

ff3f704910759d4c9d7b465c003b534a.name: Maid Garb
ff3f704910759d4c9d7b465c003b534a.desc: Soft and comfortable maid attire. It's easily cleaned if dirtied with washing water, milk, or wine.

c58110e105db2042beb6155ea208d171.name: Silver Haze
c58110e105db2042beb6155ea208d171.desc:
A wand with the power to command ice-cold lightning. It coats the air around it in a silvery sheen.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

62ec09e4b976e842b2b2a2bc44223f00.name: Tin Bars
62ec09e4b976e842b2b2a2bc44223f00.desc: A metal used to create bronze. It can be found in the Nomad Highlands.

e917b7230adba044a70a2a6662273595.name: Vase Of The Ancients I
e917b7230adba044a70a2a6662273595.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

0216cf8852f6c3478c7bec103759fc52.name: Fell Confusion Pheromones
0216cf8852f6c3478c7bec103759fc52.desc: Can be thrown to create a Pheromone Cloud that confuses Fell enemies, who run around in panic when affected.

32b882f07d078340b69c323c0f857200.name: Book I
32b882f07d078340b69c323c0f857200.desc: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.

78da8fb49ed7484fae982c7ec66c8022.name: Grilled Game
78da8fb49ed7484fae982c7ec66c8022.desc: A staple in many traditional Revelwood dishes. It has a rejuvenating effect.

03d2b704b1ecfe4abb3f7182048eed51.name: Indigo Plant
03d2b704b1ecfe4abb3f7182048eed51.desc: A large potted plant to beautify your home.

0768a2f150d4b24f89bb6e94aed37b35.name: Hailcaster Hat
0768a2f150d4b24f89bb6e94aed37b35.desc: A sophisticated crown that frames the wearer's head with a golden halo and amethyst sparks. It represents the dawning sun, bathing the mountainsides in a long-awaited morning glow.

8f519d821264ab4c81ee982410a7dd13.name: Maggots
8f519d821264ab4c81ee982410a7dd13.desc: Worms are good for catching all kinds of epic fish. Especially the ones from Cinder's Cradle.

3008e9b3aa46b64291898af101ab4b20.name: Noble Gloves
3008e9b3aa46b64291898af101ab4b20.desc: These lightweight gloves are perfect for holding a quill and signing decrees.

ebe0e1c9b92c13418e1fc08509fdec2d.name: Linen
ebe0e1c9b92c13418e1fc08509fdec2d.desc: The natural fiber won from the processing of Flax. The first step of cloth creation.

1dcc33c591e377458affb967c52ee0d8.name: Boreal Wood Bedside Table
1dcc33c591e377458affb967c52ee0d8.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

15df96f60f06f94bb1cd75cddc9ceb55.name: Wailing Blade
15df96f60f06f94bb1cd75cddc9ceb55.desc: An expertly crafted blade, balanced and sharp. Cuts through foes like a wail through the night. It bears the mark of a famous blacksmith from Pikemead's Reach.

b806ed347a056944a7f7dfa47c6b70de.name: Toxic Sack
b806ed347a056944a7f7dfa47c6b70de.desc: A large gland filled with a lethal substance. Handle it with care!

2823b6a7b01dba46a127949395fbf97d.name: Date
2823b6a7b01dba46a127949395fbf97d.desc: Sweet, sticky fruits of the date palm. Travelers swear by them for a quick recovery on the road.

ea8f688b80422744abdadace93c8a751.name: Reaper's Wand
ea8f688b80422744abdadace93c8a751.desc:
A twisted wand emitting a faint, blue light. It demands to be wielded!

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

7cf01eb748a8044da57d77e2de25f0c2.name: Hailcaster Pants
7cf01eb748a8044da57d77e2de25f0c2.desc: Dark padded pants with golden seams. They're warm and comfortable.

e3bdcbe4dfb52f4cac974459cd53d625.name: Wall Banner of the Ancients II
e3bdcbe4dfb52f4cac974459cd53d625.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

8b9dab4faebd6949898fff8b3c2ae2ce.name: Blackmire Dirt
8b9dab4faebd6949898fff8b3c2ae2ce.desc:
A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. 

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

18151cdd9a164b47844e164e6ea2456e.name: Iron Meteorite
18151cdd9a164b47844e164e6ea2456e.desc: A dense chunk of nickel and iron. The slow cooling over millions of years formed its crystal bands — the Widmanstätten structure.

9d0cd934cb199a4280876c63feb5b01f.name: Small Coaster
9d0cd934cb199a4280876c63feb5b01f.desc: A wooden plate to display foods and drinks on a table.

413f5507f7d5fe46bb2ec7e5a7e01d97.name: Rough Wood Block
413f5507f7d5fe46bb2ec7e5a7e01d97.desc:
A basic construction material. Not very pretty, but it gets the job done.

Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

6df53974b8b6a149a9d80262310bec16.name: Fire Wisp Summon
6df53974b8b6a149a9d80262310bec16.desc: The scroll summons a Fire Wisp that follows, assists you in battle and provides light.

6df58362992d1d40b04fbd37080e64a1.name: Exclusive Hollow Chestplate
6df58362992d1d40b04fbd37080e64a1.desc: This plate armor stands out with its golden glow, metal trim, and vibrant underlying colorway. The royal purple was achieved by harvesting and heating sea snail mucus in the past, and the extinction of aquatic wildlife only heightens its exclusivity.

468db9a4c1b411488848e2291e0e9664.name: Amber Bow
468db9a4c1b411488848e2291e0e9664.desc: A bow with the color of sunny amber or dunes. Its shots can pierce anything.

b5e019bb68a4b74fb7d8f17bafb1332b.name: Tropical Wood
b5e019bb68a4b74fb7d8f17bafb1332b.desc: This tropical wood can be harvested from ancient trees. It is very sturdy!

116a64a65abc39419037eacbf4a56196.name: Crestflame Shield
116a64a65abc39419037eacbf4a56196.desc: A bulky, circular shield that almost appears to possess a glowing energy core. With this, your defense will be powered up greatly!

74496c11ab21eb45b8963f59c3741e25.name: Wolf's Fang Gloves
74496c11ab21eb45b8963f59c3741e25.desc: Silver-framed metal gloves with elaborate finger plates. The fingertip covers sharpen at the end into claw-like points.

a94f3c4b26a2d343a1a6df3cbefe545e.name: Flightless Redtail Pillow
a94f3c4b26a2d343a1a6df3cbefe545e.desc: A comfortable pillow with a bird on it. The bird may not be able to fly, but it still looks stylish!

a94ff210fcc9374d99ad738a3ddaaa58.name: Yellow Cymbidum Flower
a94ff210fcc9374d99ad738a3ddaaa58.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

9f6a09109fbde247ae89312ffb8e61c4.name: Veilwater Basin Boardwalk I
9f6a09109fbde247ae89312ffb8e61c4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4b2a67a580ce7f479409c37f5b710753.name: Spider Gland
4b2a67a580ce7f479409c37f5b710753.desc:
A gland that's seemingly dripping with poison. Don't think about it too much, or the visual will haunt your dreams.

Found on poison-spitting spiders and can be used in crafting to produce an antidote to Hemotoxin.

1b0dedffe859a9479aa2f1d51ac1a3b8.name: Child Of The Lyre
1b0dedffe859a9479aa2f1d51ac1a3b8.desc:
Somewhere in the kingdom of Orindell, naked feet dance upon hot marble floors. The pain is temporary, but the memory will last.

Music Sheet: 
Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

0a60da8bcedb7448b048ed0a2059061c.name: Queen Pikemead Statue Piece
0a60da8bcedb7448b048ed0a2059061c.desc:
A broken piece of the Queen Pikemead sculpture.
Find every piece to reassemble a statue.

e23f1053d7e3744ea7528d4e2f459f95.name: Skull Trophy VI
e23f1053d7e3744ea7528d4e2f459f95.desc: The Drak decorate their settlements with such trophies. It's impressive that they even washed off the blood — they surely reuse it for other purposes...

c5e6868a4aa27a4dae9e1e96a2d5a2e6.name: Left Cyclops Leg
c5e6868a4aa27a4dae9e1e96a2d5a2e6.desc:
This left Cyclops leg is much taller than you. You barely reach the kneecaps.

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.

e63a955b8990704fb8a0ecc4b60fa40a.name: Dimweald Hammer
e63a955b8990704fb8a0ecc4b60fa40a.desc: A mighty hammer, family heirloom of the Dimwealds. This weapon belonged to Berhtolf, the firstborn son. Bravery was his downfall.

8fd56c9fb8863a48a3dc616655eb4b40.name: Ice Totem I
8fd56c9fb8863a48a3dc616655eb4b40.desc:
Summons a totem that launches icy projectiles at enemies, applying a slow debuff to them. 
Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

e36034a840eeee46bf940002026f712f.name: Ruffles
e36034a840eeee46bf940002026f712f.desc: A loud, energetic dog with sunny fur that yearns for connection. Its tail hasn't stopped wagging ever since you freed it from its cage. The Scavengers that owned this dog previously called it "Ruffles".

d57a585b638b41408a6f90f72eb7ae5a.name: Palm Leaves
d57a585b638b41408a6f90f72eb7ae5a.desc: Vibrant palm leaves that offer ample shade in the blazing sun. They can be used as a crafting ingredient.

b34344c2cc72204d81d86558a0508592.name: Evergreen Tree Seedling
b34344c2cc72204d81d86558a0508592.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.

70a040c07a3b4a42847452c86f091f2f.name: Guardian Gloves
70a040c07a3b4a42847452c86f091f2f.desc: Big and bulky gloves, usually worn when wielding large weaponry and shields.

3b5bead22d35c6478d2a0ffd92b8d8bf.name: Decorative Oven III
3b5bead22d35c6478d2a0ffd92b8d8bf.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

36ed11f51df84d43ac986550cf8ac491.name: Blue Floor Light I
36ed11f51df84d43ac986550cf8ac491.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

549e234860921442bc0cdc855055d5cc.name: Boreal Wood Garden Fence I
549e234860921442bc0cdc855055d5cc.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d04f430c9c89a84c8f936eae6ffaa621.name: Soldier Chestplate
d04f430c9c89a84c8f936eae6ffaa621.desc: This regal soldier's armor symbolizes chivalry, glory, and valor.

603cb9f7d480bf41ad12d1017eacfe95.name: Convergence
603cb9f7d480bf41ad12d1017eacfe95.desc:
One born from the depths below, one fallen from the stars above — two otherworldly forces that should never meet, yet here they are. Combined into something entirely their own. Beautiful in their contradiction.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

b1b0bd0297f24848bedd5abfc985ac14.name: Grilled Crab Meat
b1b0bd0297f24848bedd5abfc985ac14.desc: A generous portion of grilled meat. It must've come from a giant crab. Enjoy!

949b7b5147635f448bbfb5ee3a67db93.name: Lesser Ring of Stamina
949b7b5147635f448bbfb5ee3a67db93.desc: An ancient ring that gives you stamina.

f88a3d58bf5e8f4a93daa208700dd383.name: Large Crypt Table
f88a3d58bf5e8f4a93daa208700dd383.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

4d00702c9b725943bb508e7dec3be397.name: Circus Knives
4d00702c9b725943bb508e7dec3be397.desc:
A pair of circus knives that can do a lot of damage if left in untrained hands! Better watch out!

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

50e968d398388142bbabfbbbac901eec.name: Kindlewastes Rubble
50e968d398388142bbabfbbbac901eec.desc: A mix of different biome-specific materials, mainly stone and dirt.

8382bf9235e4f3499b8e4bc129680774.name: Magician Gloves
8382bf9235e4f3499b8e4bc129680774.desc: A magician's gloves, bound by a magic-infused golden thread.

4c3ee19997ca494fb6f17d7759cfcd42.name: Mycelium Overgrown Block
4c3ee19997ca494fb6f17d7759cfcd42.desc:
A block of stone infested by Shroud spores.

Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

2bf4307719fd154482bd7e1e8eaf5f31.name: Pinewood Fence Gate I
2bf4307719fd154482bd7e1e8eaf5f31.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

3403473f4e4e484e9b66853c002a31f8.name: Wooden Cup
3403473f4e4e484e9b66853c002a31f8.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

85f9ef23546fa04c968c5b7b11c844bd.name: Critter Parts
85f9ef23546fa04c968c5b7b11c844bd.desc:
Remains of the pests that dwell below the Shroud.

Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

bec4f24d1c9b7848b91712157eb6d14e.name: Circlet Of Lightning
bec4f24d1c9b7848b91712157eb6d14e.desc: A metal crown, coursing with electrifying energy. Wearing it makes the hair on your body stand up.

925a59782bfb3c48bdf7bf6a7c826398.name: Ornate Harp
925a59782bfb3c48bdf7bf6a7c826398.desc: A heavenly instrument, previously owned by Harper Langley of The Honeydews. Its body has a beautiful carved pattern reminiscent of a mermaid's fishtail, befitting Harper's image as a siren.

a535550d6a4cd840881a7e22fd5893e8.name: Wooden Palisade VII
a535550d6a4cd840881a7e22fd5893e8.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

cf7ea1790b391c4cbaec5f5ac48a95f1.name: Fenrig Mills, Jr.
cf7ea1790b391c4cbaec5f5ac48a95f1.desc: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

fc9c24825bd1d44bbc4734f0ac01e4b3.name: Giant Telescope Base
fc9c24825bd1d44bbc4734f0ac01e4b3.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

85da7436705eee42a4bb5c61c4918158.name: Polished Wooden Double Door
85da7436705eee42a4bb5c61c4918158.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

3c4df86251dc7544971565c0a237a2c4.name: Magician Hat
3c4df86251dc7544971565c0a237a2c4.desc: This magician's headgear frames the wearer's face with a luscious golden trim.

b84c020cde5708428c22f8327e3db81a.name: Ancient Cooling Unit
b84c020cde5708428c22f8327e3db81a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

970f9fcfd371f84f8a80abd0cfa9c909.name: Moonstone Arrow
970f9fcfd371f84f8a80abd0cfa9c909.desc: An arrow with a precisely polished moonstone tip.

4fcae89028195345a6ca32f28e866987.name: Sweet Mokka
4fcae89028195345a6ca32f28e866987.desc: A traditionally brewed cup of coffee with a hint of sugar. The sweetness pairs well with the depth of flavor.

b7e11698c9a68d4bb31a11183a768b24.name: Serpent Warrior Chest
b7e11698c9a68d4bb31a11183a768b24.desc: The ruby-red cloth, emerald-colored scales, and golden trim create a warm and regal cosmetic armor piece when combined.

b1723d846d199c409a51b82ec4fb7744.name: Iron Vorgoth's Eye Trophy
b1723d846d199c409a51b82ec4fb7744.desc:
The internal glow is dim and struggling against confinement.

Collect multiple Vorgoth Eyes to craft the Iron Trophy.

923b5a8749abfc458a0d12373f1da8cc.name: Bembel Pitcher
923b5a8749abfc458a0d12373f1da8cc.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

0c670cd9645acc4e8bc96c1bf1c3e05b.name: Banebringer
0c670cd9645acc4e8bc96c1bf1c3e05b.desc: An infested Shroud bow, able to teach the true meaning of pain.

96d1e1d19aeae84fabb12911c5a74d81.name: Fell Thunderbrute Greatsword
96d1e1d19aeae84fabb12911c5a74d81.desc: The great Fell Thunderbrute Greatsword — shrunken for your convenience.

1c96a62b42f8bd499551654c82cb6de0.name: Emily Fray
1c96a62b42f8bd499551654c82cb6de0.desc: The Farmer Emily Fray crafts food and helps you grow your plants.

5d0752aaa299814c92ab0b9b53a1749d.name: Skull Trophy V
5d0752aaa299814c92ab0b9b53a1749d.desc: The Drak decorate their settlements with such trophies. It's impressive that they even washed off the blood — they surely reuse it for other purposes...

be86c0aa10e3ef4ca84e912f0104b69b.name: Blood Rose Gloves
be86c0aa10e3ef4ca84e912f0104b69b.desc: Sharp claws and a sharper tongue that refuses to be silenced — such is both sword and shield of the Blood Rose.

8a2fe1b2ac94b140b5fb6eb723db4c0b.name: Deerstalker Chest
8a2fe1b2ac94b140b5fb6eb723db4c0b.desc: Every movement is softened and muted whilst clad in this upper body armor.

10a3b11c3e5059499c688e9b980b77a2.name: Tarred Straw Block
10a3b11c3e5059499c688e9b980b77a2.desc: Made from straw and enhanced with tar. This is an enhanced version of the Plant Fiber Roof Block, especially well-suited to protecting against the elements.

1e9593c87665f540a1905e170f54aca7.name: Rising Fighter Chest
1e9593c87665f540a1905e170f54aca7.desc: Light, polstered and ready to take a few hits — the perfect chest armor for a beginner.

f5aafb0215f440448a509c1fd4563ccc.name: Stone Water Dispenser
f5aafb0215f440448a509c1fd4563ccc.desc: This item will dispense water endlessly until it is submerged.

b682e706553a184f8fa1b331c58ba93f.name: Sushi
b682e706553a184f8fa1b331c58ba93f.desc: Fresh, healthy, fun to eat, and good for the soul. What more could you want from a meal?

a872c8a531ab3e419e24ded17ca76cc6.name: Explorer Helmet
a872c8a531ab3e419e24ded17ca76cc6.desc: Dashing headgear with a set of goggles. They protect the wearer's eyes from vapors and water but were also used while gliding on wind currents back in the day.

1db5e52132e9b04cad3dfa6727871c81.name: Fae Deer Farmer Hood
1db5e52132e9b04cad3dfa6727871c81.desc: A fanciful hood with expressive animal ears and a draping cape. It's made from layers of faintly dotted fur and is well-suited for walking among the Fae Deer as a trusted friend and companion.

45977e5068e0b341be43336383174dff.name: Fur Gloves
45977e5068e0b341be43336383174dff.desc: Simple but reliable protection for hands.

a79cde195e88674d949417e218d0591b.name: Silver Dust
a79cde195e88674d949417e218d0591b.desc: Fine, shimmery silver powder. Don't drop it, or you'll find specs of silver in your floorboards for weeks to come.

774f83d8f5ac0c43bbf78ebc333be943.name: Shroud Weaver
774f83d8f5ac0c43bbf78ebc333be943.desc:
A malicious staff that effortlessly intertwines the strings of fate with the Shroud.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

365274be896d954fa0bf9e60935fc7d8.name: Aloe Plant
365274be896d954fa0bf9e60935fc7d8.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

8ef3866f73866547b289c372cc817bbd.name: Pine Shortbow
8ef3866f73866547b289c372cc817bbd.desc: A practical and quick bow made from humble pine wood.

aea7043c72b44a458f88298f06e2543a.name: Enflamed Sword
aea7043c72b44a458f88298f06e2543a.desc: A burning sword, glowing with power. It burns hot enough to reduce the mana of its prey with every hit.

680aeabbe892234d947afc7268f56dbf.name: Royal Boots
680aeabbe892234d947afc7268f56dbf.desc: Stomp out anti-feudalist uprisings in style with these fashionable and finely crafted shoes!

83e70fe4ffcf4846bbcfb036e13196ff.name: Pinewood Fence Gate II
83e70fe4ffcf4846bbcfb036e13196ff.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

5733902bcd5dcd4f8fb239632e28de51.name: Large Backpack
5733902bcd5dcd4f8fb239632e28de51.desc:
An extension to your backpack that enlarges your inventory by three rows. 

Outdated
This item is of an old design. Visit your craftsmen to find an improved version of the backpack with an additional row.

e89fd7e7db209441ae168fba0a507847.name: Gloom Monarch Gloves
e89fd7e7db209441ae168fba0a507847.desc: Legends say that these gloves once belonged to a dark ruler whose name has been wiped from the history books.

1e57afdd6f1d3b4bbf6c933811607f01.name: Scholar of the Young Flame Pants
1e57afdd6f1d3b4bbf6c933811607f01.desc: Delicate fabric with intricate details, ever-shifting with the angle of the sun. Worn by the Scholars who chased knowledge across these lands.

037ddf2a9a68dd47bf51d738ec08e6b9.name: Shroudbinder Wand
037ddf2a9a68dd47bf51d738ec08e6b9.desc:
This magical wand fires projectiles that deal Shroud damage.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Ethereal Duplication:
The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

8ed4e30be5690b4484e150f3c9e4e4fb.name: Small Hollow's Eve Pumpkin I
8ed4e30be5690b4484e150f3c9e4e4fb.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

58121e892cba9c42a922e445789983d6.name: Irrigation Gate Large
58121e892cba9c42a922e445789983d6.desc: This gate can be lowered or raised to control the water flow around it. It's perfect for gardeners who want an efficient way to water their plants!

a406d340cc6d7c4892ea5a410495e5b5.name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Cloak
a406d340cc6d7c4892ea5a410495e5b5.desc: This ceremonial robe belonged to an honorable "Scholar of the Empyrean", worn during sacred offerings in the Night Sanctums. Wear this piece with the same pride the previous owner did.

88012376a0a38d47ac2210a1249bd2c4.name: Copper Jug
88012376a0a38d47ac2210a1249bd2c4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

9eb6a1700025d44889475acedbe80c8c.name: Large Golden Window Frame
9eb6a1700025d44889475acedbe80c8c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

234d48f0383bfd41bd66b91542d1addc.name: "Afro" Wig Head
234d48f0383bfd41bd66b91542d1addc.desc: A wig head that unlocks more haircuts once picked up. It can also be placed in your base as decoration.

3b8290865305cb4eb3d31af14b875a3e.name: Bamboo Boardwalk II
3b8290865305cb4eb3d31af14b875a3e.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

49b88bfe001fae4ab70edd309f1f91d9.name: Sky Specter Boots
49b88bfe001fae4ab70edd309f1f91d9.desc: These boots allow you to step as if carried by the clouds, silently prowling between silvery shadows.

c1c13cee89f6f249895f552de20709c5.name: Iron Fell Thunderbrute Trophy
c1c13cee89f6f249895f552de20709c5.desc:
Cauterize the wound. Cleanse the spreading stain, and erase the festering blight. The light of the Flame cannot be denied.

Collect multiple Fell Thunderbrute Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

c26faa27b8724b488a3857afdd5481f9.name: Stone Stair I
c26faa27b8724b488a3857afdd5481f9.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

06a654243e575f4385b9465b1873b22b.name: Daggers Weapon Rack
06a654243e575f4385b9465b1873b22b.desc: A display to showcase weapons or shields.

1d58b80ab07d0a45b70e5ad2db6a268b.name: Electric Nerve
1d58b80ab07d0a45b70e5ad2db6a268b.desc: An electrified strand of nerves. It's a sought-after magical ingredient needed in some spell recipes.

d58279e7068bb04f96c20bf2fba1368d.name: Vesztah's Mace
d58279e7068bb04f96c20bf2fba1368d.desc: Two mirrored Drak are represented on this mace. Despite being outwardly similar, they may not share the same fate — for the Broodmother's duality demands the weak become a feast for the strong.

f60e2c9a0df13c478c04025e36186720.name: Dragon Sword
f60e2c9a0df13c478c04025e36186720.desc: A mythical blade from long gone days. Legends say that it was passed on to Embervale by a wise spirit who descended from the stars in the year of the dragon.

1f65550065712c4d848a4ec93f9c6ef7.name: Quetzal Hunter Gloves
1f65550065712c4d848a4ec93f9c6ef7.desc: These gauntlets shield your arms as you chase through the undergrowth, striking foes from afar.

963642a6c459074b83681c0671930ee9.name: Saffron Seedling
963642a6c459074b83681c0671930ee9.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

4e36a1b76b3bf643b3af6a5dc71d3d1b.name: Red Party Hat
4e36a1b76b3bf643b3af6a5dc71d3d1b.desc: A fun little hat for fun little parties!

7dd94cb257b0a545868168f6d4677363.name: Blacksmith Boots
7dd94cb257b0a545868168f6d4677363.desc: These boots will still keep their shape even if you drop a hammer on them. Or tongs. Or an entire anvil. How handy!

a919f93408b0444bb17f79fa6312062d.name: Aurora Beans
a919f93408b0444bb17f79fa6312062d.desc: Colored like the first light of morning, these bean-like structures grow straight from the blossom. The color alone is hard to explain — the taste even more so. They need to be cooked before eating.

a720f817e0c94f42a5d6f892f7bd9d34.name: Serpent Warrior Helmet
a720f817e0c94f42a5d6f892f7bd9d34.desc: This helmet lets you portray a particularly patient and calculating gaze.

6e45d33c6acfbf4d955b4b36a6c23cb9.name: Bamboo Ladder III
6e45d33c6acfbf4d955b4b36a6c23cb9.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

621b4f1ef056d7479d02ee4dd94f23d0.name: Salon Sink
621b4f1ef056d7479d02ee4dd94f23d0.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

473a932cad7c0947b4d8f07ea3800377.name: Drak Temple Vase IV
473a932cad7c0947b4d8f07ea3800377.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

2f5ef4a0c9c7d348bc9d4ce89ac8ca12.name: Coconut Palm Seedling
2f5ef4a0c9c7d348bc9d4ce89ac8ca12.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested repeatedly.

d54425a3b5c7e740959605f1178fe5fa.name: Sage Pants
d54425a3b5c7e740959605f1178fe5fa.desc: Remarkable pants. What makes them remarkable? The wearer, mostly.

1a980486775546488fd553a30ebcd48c.name: Archaic Lockpick
1a980486775546488fd553a30ebcd48c.desc: Lockpicks exclusively used by the Ancients in their structures and dungeons.

7d9ba0df47804b4f921f65245a334979.name: Yak
7d9ba0df47804b4f921f65245a334979.desc: This woolly fellow grows a thick coat to weather the harsh climate of Albaneve Summits. It can be shaved for wool.

c59130bf521cb442a30b2e80bd8353c4.name: Round Iron Window Frame
c59130bf521cb442a30b2e80bd8353c4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

7c3e91b3feaabe4ca8bf874b80dc5eb2.name: Rising Fighter Shield
7c3e91b3feaabe4ca8bf874b80dc5eb2.desc:
Even a simple shield such as this can save your life when you get surrounded or surprised. Use it to block or parry incoming attacks!

Parry
You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar.
Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

bd4b2e92d2e22c429ab17ddef57fe170.name: Trailblazer Hood
bd4b2e92d2e22c429ab17ddef57fe170.desc: The metal rim around this hood forms an elegant crown, jagging out from the wearer's skull. The shape of the tips is reminiscent of wings.

2a292f998be28a44b5d9412aa25244c7.name: Raw Game
2a292f998be28a44b5d9412aa25244c7.desc: Uncooked game. Must be roasted over a fire.

d4e91ebb7e1f174c88059409ec0dac8a.name: Archmage Chest
d4e91ebb7e1f174c88059409ec0dac8a.desc: A truly spirited garb for magicians and casters. The fabric was laboriously dyed with deep cobalt pigment derived from imported nightblooms.

9155036a3d4f0d47bd948ac320079af7.name: Stun Arrow
9155036a3d4f0d47bd948ac320079af7.desc:
This Special Arrow deals little damage but hits the target with massive force to increase the enemies' Stun Bar until they eventually become overpowered.

Stun Bar increase scales with Dexterity.
Stun duration depends on the enemy's size.

Overpower 
Attacking blocking enemies or parrying their attacks fills their Stun Bar until they become overpowered.
Overpowered enemies are open for Merciless Attacks.

7f1f3d9316262a47adce034a630a0db3.name: Sunpiercer Chestplate
7f1f3d9316262a47adce034a630a0db3.desc: The gleaming gold and vibrant green crystals adorning the chestplate make it a shield and a statement of enduring strength. Watch out for the spiked shoulder pads!

f98e6d77337ec149a3bb5b474fbf2793.name: Vat III
f98e6d77337ec149a3bb5b474fbf2793.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

34cdfb875c03d44e92c22c8b7bb4e151.name: Dark Brown Hair
34cdfb875c03d44e92c22c8b7bb4e151.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

cd295d351d60fb4da5213cd1933b6faa.name: Gem of Overpowering
cd295d351d60fb4da5213cd1933b6faa.desc: Attacking a blocking enemy deals %k additional stamina damage and increased pushback.

c6c9454f5bd58f49a564a36de4500443.name: Sword Of The Serpent
c6c9454f5bd58f49a564a36de4500443.desc: A glistening green blade, perfectly representing the aesthetics of the year of the serpent.

50942427acefe14b949694e5d7253fff.name: Simple Fishing Rod
50942427acefe14b949694e5d7253fff.desc: A basic fishing rod made out of the simplest ingredients. Don't pull too hard, or it might break. It also doesn't lay particularly well in the hand, so long fights are not possible with it.

3a71889ec10076489a4fc03587bfb4aa.name: Extinguished Sword
3a71889ec10076489a4fc03587bfb4aa.desc: Although no longer enflamed this formerly magical sword still has a sharp edge.

1c7f821833ebf04b8bb4733392ac8e94.name: Mystic Pants
1c7f821833ebf04b8bb4733392ac8e94.desc: A pair of proper trousers. The metal delicate accents around the waist resemble the moon and the tide.

aa8bc27d063dd946b0059f5067fa7290.name: Noble Boots
aa8bc27d063dd946b0059f5067fa7290.desc: These boots must've previously been worn by a solemn noble quietly roaming through the church gardens.

416e9c83b5f66a4099e03b82337229d9.name: Boreal Wood Side Table
416e9c83b5f66a4099e03b82337229d9.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

cf29eb7990ebd449b426ba4515fab213.name: Flame Arcanist Gloves
cf29eb7990ebd449b426ba4515fab213.desc: Gilded gloves that brandish both royal blue and gold. They're emblazoned with long, metal claws that tip the gloves.

d5e729b91ba7024b909dee5b7de0f089.name: Eagle Eye Helmet
d5e729b91ba7024b909dee5b7de0f089.desc: This hood further enhances your sight and lets your gaze burn hotter than a thousand suns.

cbf9b77af4759741b7ca20ff4f65f8f7.name: Ashwind Strider Hood
cbf9b77af4759741b7ca20ff4f65f8f7.desc: A hood and mask that shield the face below from smoke.

1e7efb45dc965c43b40ecdfe274a72d8.name: Supply Sacks III
1e7efb45dc965c43b40ecdfe274a72d8.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d636d8a48c63be4e9cc9f2b3c32d4b00.name: Eternal Pillar Of Flames I
d636d8a48c63be4e9cc9f2b3c32d4b00.desc:
Ignites an area with flames that continuously damage enemies within.
It also applies a burn debuff to them.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

b66bbd2a2bc3424dad458cfa5d28229b.name: Iron Prison Double Door
b66bbd2a2bc3424dad458cfa5d28229b.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d2ac890f56b54c41888115a4f2e77e3d.name: Palm Wood Shelf
d2ac890f56b54c41888115a4f2e77e3d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4cab3e5c31b234469cafb30c81242a91.name: Wooden Chair
4cab3e5c31b234469cafb30c81242a91.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

59d824a96238a04096befed8ae84dd2d.name: Small Mortar
59d824a96238a04096befed8ae84dd2d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

0a8fff358f3fb64485a44807621b7893.name: Fell Black Knight Shield
0a8fff358f3fb64485a44807621b7893.desc: A shield that unites the entire brute force of the North behind it. It opposes the Ancients and any fools who dare not to make way.

85663345d394bd498f7b031b1ed760df.name: Mana Drain III
85663345d394bd498f7b031b1ed760df.desc:
Releases a continuous magical beam that leeches Mana from enemies without dealing damage to them.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

5ff70a2ae61c02488d4653614996dc09.name: Light And Shadow
5ff70a2ae61c02488d4653614996dc09.desc:
Bold as midday sun, tempered by white and grounded in black.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

68f3e353c4314440b10e392ef9bb0757.name: Crystal Ball
68f3e353c4314440b10e392ef9bb0757.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4130e0d4a2a55b4db6267b9fb821111b.name: Basket II
4130e0d4a2a55b4db6267b9fb821111b.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6de636649332da4e9911abcc488fb3e0.name: Hot Plates
6de636649332da4e9911abcc488fb3e0.desc: Hot Plates that can be used to upgrade the oven.

dcd63076268a1f43a74b9f64ab4df1c5.name: Healer Gloves
dcd63076268a1f43a74b9f64ab4df1c5.desc: These gloves allow nimble fingers to patch up wounds when in a pinch.

e47181e0d0d8c84f82db996333fab536.name: Crystal Bowl
e47181e0d0d8c84f82db996333fab536.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

b0cc4b4443fc9b4b9a283687f500dd3e.name: Tall Stone Brazier
b0cc4b4443fc9b4b9a283687f500dd3e.desc:
A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.

cbbb77018a8804428445cc842d2ebc1b.name: Cutthroat Chest
cbbb77018a8804428445cc842d2ebc1b.desc: A warm, padded vest. Ideal for enduring cold nights while awaiting the time to strike.

0366bb1f9b0ef9469770655e55665b58.name: Fine Stone Handrail
0366bb1f9b0ef9469770655e55665b58.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6c6a5e79761dfe4485b858a7e7d34c13.name: Rocky Stone Road Block
6c6a5e79761dfe4485b858a7e7d34c13.desc: A rugged-looking stone road material made from jagged rocks. Be careful where you step!

6382d418d3b57748b85039be32f2f025.name: Drak Relief VI
6382d418d3b57748b85039be32f2f025.desc:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

Flames swallow a town, and the sky is set alight. Chaos reigns as the Drak reappear in the Veilwater Basin. No defenders are visible.

8fc61f84f150db42a1c50a58e5c55740.name: Conifer Crate
8fc61f84f150db42a1c50a58e5c55740.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

053a9927cab4c149998732e99113b4a0.name: Hair Splitter
053a9927cab4c149998732e99113b4a0.desc: This axe is eerily precise. The hair on your arms stands up as you wield it.

053a1ff42b880045abae7210ed0d9a17.name: Lavender Dream
053a1ff42b880045abae7210ed0d9a17.desc:
Pitch-black like the night that swallows even the calmest of dreamers. The light lilac accents embody the color of lavender tea.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

217fea8a828ece45b18c0652a191b7cd.name: Signpost Pole
217fea8a828ece45b18c0652a191b7cd.desc: A signpost that can be used to attach direction signs.

e84af1dd94983747bbf823cedaf9dd15.name: Fae Deer Feeder
e84af1dd94983747bbf823cedaf9dd15.desc:
A feeding device that holds Fae Deer food.

It will feed your animals when filled with the corresponding food.

22726a943d1a024fa6d8a532d011f4f0.name: Adventurer Chest
22726a943d1a024fa6d8a532d011f4f0.desc: Warm, light, and agile. This piece of armor is a great fit for adventurers! The red scarf is especially daring.

2898b0368937444491fba1cdac77bb00.name: Gold In The Water
2898b0368937444491fba1cdac77bb00.desc:
Want to look like a gold nugget resting on the bottom of a lake? With this color palette, you embody just that — rich, vibrant blues with a hint of sparkling gold.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

07be1f54acdf0c4f8f155e9253c522c4.name: Critter Glands
07be1f54acdf0c4f8f155e9253c522c4.desc:
A pair of slippery Glands. 

Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

74fca8ebd35fba46bfbf85c19f6406fb.name: From Dusk Till Dawn
74fca8ebd35fba46bfbf85c19f6406fb.desc:
Through the dark night until dawn drapes the sky in golden-yellow and red hues. This color combination would look stunning on a flag too!

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

2df050e351125747a287d097594f3562.name: Exceptional Lute
2df050e351125747a287d097594f3562.desc: A wonderful lute with carefully placed, playful decorative lines. They spring forth like joyful melodies on a sunny midyear day.

cb5e9ac27a1cd54d84fc2fff8cdf0ada.name: Copper Ore
cb5e9ac27a1cd54d84fc2fff8cdf0ada.desc: A common ore needed to create Copper Bars.

0b725aba4112bc4894efcc9907877f49.name: Death Gazer Axe
0b725aba4112bc4894efcc9907877f49.desc: Its crystal eye watches the battlefield, and those it fixes upon rarely see another dawn.

924bfec1f6d2f446938dd8e5be27fcba.name: Siren Seeker Chest
924bfec1f6d2f446938dd8e5be27fcba.desc: Old fishing nets span across fabric, still carrying their spoils: Starfish, seashells, and strings of pearls are displayed proudly as accessories. Were they gifts from the mermaids and their folk, or simply lucky finds? It's hard to tell.

6702d794c6e1be43989362766797e717.name: Ancient Health Potion
6702d794c6e1be43989362766797e717.desc: A flawlessly formulated health potion that instantly restores a massive amount of health upon use.

cf6f32ded2022c41a025c6998d68fb36.name: Sediment
cf6f32ded2022c41a025c6998d68fb36.desc:
The color of arid roads and sandy tombs.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

57a0a547ed03b94196069f86bdae2367.name: Shroud Survival Flask
57a0a547ed03b94196069f86bdae2367.desc:
Contains cleansed Shroud Liquid, enhancing the resistance of the user.

Must be taken before entering the Shroud. Extends the Time in the Shroud by 2 minutes. This effect will last for 45 minutes.

7e4bb402d920044ca44505c9dca3e5cd.name: Iron Hollow Titan Trophy
7e4bb402d920044ca44505c9dca3e5cd.desc:
The plume becomes rigid and jagged, like frozen spikes. You don't have to worry; they won't attack you anymore.

Collect multiple Hollow Titan Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

5f5c1938f94a1c44bfc9893a25a288ad.name: Clay Pot I
5f5c1938f94a1c44bfc9893a25a288ad.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4add29655165154490c0136e8c825cd5.name: Alchemist Apprentice Hat
4add29655165154490c0136e8c825cd5.desc: Providing general protection and shade, the alchemist's apprentice hat is perfect for wandering around the world.

3f1f5b4b8d970c4daf417fdcbd95f207.name: Water Pouch
3f1f5b4b8d970c4daf417fdcbd95f207.desc: This pouch can be filled at a well or lake. A sip of water helps to recharge your power!

840065767b33ad44966c29d8617ac746.name: Overgrowth Tool
840065767b33ad44966c29d8617ac746.desc:
A magical tool capable of adding and removing various types of overgrowth to walls in your base. 

It can only be used within Flame Altar range and requires overgrowth material.

c7633a812a43b140bc007a38fb37a2e5.name: Darya's Staff
c7633a812a43b140bc007a38fb37a2e5.desc:
A staff that harnesses the power of the eclipsed sun. It functions best when only a crescent of light is left.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

d13cd9dcb419fa46a00451f820c3d706.name: Room Divider II
d13cd9dcb419fa46a00451f820c3d706.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f3ebb9a40076dc49bffc3d1d6e8548fd.name: Shroud Slime
f3ebb9a40076dc49bffc3d1d6e8548fd.desc: Vibrant and deeply disturbing if you allow it to invade your mind.

b03112babf5f3541a10d31c62fefd726.name: Mana Drain VIII
b03112babf5f3541a10d31c62fefd726.desc:
Releases a continuous magical beam that leeches Mana from enemies without dealing damage to them.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

85acd660ea0fae4ea7d6c0e0741c1a44.name: Antiseptic
85acd660ea0fae4ea7d6c0e0741c1a44.desc: A medical solution to prevent wound infections. Among other things, it can be used to disinfect bandages.

40632233062bbf44a52cab57f1ed1e77.name: Flat ramp 4m
40632233062bbf44a52cab57f1ed1e77.desc: This tool can only be used inside the building area around a Flame Altar. It can help you to quickly build your desired base with pre-defined structures.

43c97dcc042556439f2078c3827d398a.name: Cloudy Brook
43c97dcc042556439f2078c3827d398a.desc:
An arrangement of warm grays and browns, reminiscent of a muddy brook lined by hazelnut bushes.

This color palette can be made with Springlands materials.

66312ea8abc6f04ba47143e2924af3aa.name: Book I
66312ea8abc6f04ba47143e2924af3aa.desc: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.

d11d623b764dc446913e39e224c85da4.name: Magnificent Granite Stone Table
d11d623b764dc446913e39e224c85da4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

cb012be3dbded14dadcb5f768931cc0e.name: Massive Hammer
cb012be3dbded14dadcb5f768931cc0e.desc: A large hammer, made from a combination of rock and steel. The mix of materials makes it especially heavy.

47c68bb2b2c615449bef82acfbf97353.name: Mae's Map Piece
47c68bb2b2c615449bef82acfbf97353.desc:
The fragment of a torn treasure map, found on a dragon skeleton in the Albaneve Summits. Perhaps you could reconstruct the map if you found all pieces?

There's writing on the back:

Mae's Memoir:
The first day of yearwake is unlike the rest
The peaks lay quiet, licking yearfall's wounds
As the sunlight sets in the faraway west
On fields where sleeping buds awoke to blooms

da2603ff7c23024a975e0eedd10b7785.name: Rustic Window Frame II
da2603ff7c23024a975e0eedd10b7785.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

fd5706164afc144eb0e4450798ed4375.name: Stone Bench
fd5706164afc144eb0e4450798ed4375.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

6cb0453ce6f5fd4f906b9719a57a0b35.name: Shadowbane
6cb0453ce6f5fd4f906b9719a57a0b35.desc: An accurate bow imbued with the mysterious powers of the Shroud.

c725166028670543aa036685727c1ece.name: Hollow's Eve Chest
c725166028670543aa036685727c1ece.desc: A dark tunic held together by "fake" bones. They rattle like real ones do. How suspicious!

c7252872b1dd6e409e790d3d57ed0238.name: Cinderscale
c7252872b1dd6e409e790d3d57ed0238.desc:
Its scales glow faintly with residual heat. Better to handle with thick gloves, unless you want to get burned.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

b5f8ca51f6cb05458a25f10a0af2277f.name: Eternal Ice Totem II
b5f8ca51f6cb05458a25f10a0af2277f.desc:
Summons a totem that launches icy projectiles at enemies, applying a slow debuff to them. 
Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

61303716753085429f5a9e10d673a18c.name: Low Large Plant Pot
61303716753085429f5a9e10d673a18c.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

c51d99c755569e419c5c6069f9349e7d.name: Sacrilegious Steelsword
c51d99c755569e419c5c6069f9349e7d.desc:
A blade forged from the stolen steel of fallen soldiers. It spreads regret and misery.

Hollow Echo:
The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.

9a83893e9838a6419d85373cf9320c27.name: Scout Boots
9a83893e9838a6419d85373cf9320c27.desc: The path of the scout is a little easier on quiet soles.

5e16904a7422c5409947503d823af109.name: Gem of Swiftness
5e16904a7422c5409947503d823af109.desc: After sprinting for a short time, attacks deal %k bonus cutting damage for %k. The duration refreshes every time damage is dealt.

438b3d1613d72d4a97fdb2b57a1f5c7a.name: Wall Banner
438b3d1613d72d4a97fdb2b57a1f5c7a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d5b1ee1af030db49a468388211a70dd9.name: Chain Heal II
d5b1ee1af030db49a468388211a70dd9.desc:
Releases a mending ray that automatically seeks nearby allies.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

7442221e6baa0343b7d73b534becb99a.name: Crestflame Gloves
7442221e6baa0343b7d73b534becb99a.desc: Heavy gloves, held together by pairs of belts and buckles. With these, you can grab whoever dares to threaten the Mother Flame straight by their wretched throat.

c27f38068ddead4586c24429c1510571.name: Dusk Amethyst
c27f38068ddead4586c24429c1510571.desc:
A deep, royal purple dominates this color palette. The color seems to draw you in like the glimmering inside of an amethyst geode.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

f2e997b2997e3b40a5b86e37d3240bc7.name: Cinder's Cradle Miniature Piece
f2e997b2997e3b40a5b86e37d3240bc7.desc:
A tabletop map piece that shows Cinder's Cradle, the home of the Ancients. Years ago, they would have filled the quiet air between the daring basalt spikes with theories, deliberations, and heated debates... but now, everything is still.

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.

2c0f3c3f969b7445bc08fa3bfd136165.name: Staff of Guidance
2c0f3c3f969b7445bc08fa3bfd136165.desc:
Use this staff to burn a path for your herd through the frozen wastes and help them conquer the iciest rivulets and rockiest cliffs.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

4c750bbef23e1d4d8364bb44785d6741.name: Medium Ancient Temple Shelf
4c750bbef23e1d4d8364bb44785d6741.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

37b655a5208b2b40adc991114e437764.name: Secret Granite Door
37b655a5208b2b40adc991114e437764.desc: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.

e45abf574fcf6b44a6cdb90e88e6a32b.name: Left Cyclops Arm
e45abf574fcf6b44a6cdb90e88e6a32b.desc:
It's the left arm of a fearsome Cyclops. These skeletal fists could still crush you.

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.

f61e9e61a6ed4242829f1374db602e4c.name: Golden Steel Arrow
f61e9e61a6ed4242829f1374db602e4c.desc: A refined steel-tipped arrow embellished with gold. With this, you can fight in style.

7283f7f9846cf44693b0eaf5eab7850e.name: Sky Specter Gloves
7283f7f9846cf44693b0eaf5eab7850e.desc: Gloves with added metal rims that glisten like daggers in the dead of night.

5d7c64f1cfefd446bf7d6dd46892ae18.name: Gold Fell Wispwyvern Trophy
5d7c64f1cfefd446bf7d6dd46892ae18.desc:
Once thought to be a path to redemption turned into a path to damnation. Fortunately, the Flame was strong enough to avert greater disasters several times.

Collect multiple Fell Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

f8a26218d6e15a41beca4eb37dbbb550.name: Sage Boots
f8a26218d6e15a41beca4eb37dbbb550.desc: Comfortable and modest shoes for lounging in a library.

65beb2dc4f5b3640af4bd8cad14d3e8b.name: Mothling Gloves
65beb2dc4f5b3640af4bd8cad14d3e8b.desc: Thick wooly gloves. They vaguely smell of bonfires and animal fur. Perhaps someone was wearing these while petting their furry companions by a fire?

30857cc7014ab14fa544176bf7582fff.name: Greater Ectoplasm
30857cc7014ab14fa544176bf7582fff.desc: This liquid was created by crushing ectoplasm shards and gathering the resulting goo. It's been filtered and is technically sterile.

8d2b0f8dfd22354bb3b10fd4944cfd1f.name: Wheat Grains
8d2b0f8dfd22354bb3b10fd4944cfd1f.desc: Both a cooking ingredient and a seed for the fields.

341b88e26e078149bf75bc65cb6cf4ed.name: Astronomy Desk
341b88e26e078149bf75bc65cb6cf4ed.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

7b68f89ac9d5854493becb285328cc99.name: Wood Foundation
7b68f89ac9d5854493becb285328cc99.desc: This tool can only be used inside the building area around a Flame Altar. It can help you to quickly build your desired base with pre-defined structures.

b59b2d2a453886408550f3efa1795fe9.name: Guard of the North Helmet
b59b2d2a453886408550f3efa1795fe9.desc: Very few people witnessed the sharp, crystalline breath escaping Vorgoth from under the helmet firsthand. They saw his howl dance in the haze and felt it shiver down their skin, creep into their mind, and twist around their bones. Many did not live to tell the tale.

890d8e5a75bcef4583bf56b23095a065.name: Elder Chest
890d8e5a75bcef4583bf56b23095a065.desc: This armor was conceived to restrain and control the wearer's smoldering magical energy within. If worn by a mere apprentice rather than an elder, it could make their heart stop!

93171949802b834aae65c6d307e1f7f4.name: Flame Pact Pants
93171949802b834aae65c6d307e1f7f4.desc: Light brown pants. Comfortable and distinguished in their simplicity.

0dfb59d85c79914ab6949c48ec11582a.name: Mountain's Shadow Chest
0dfb59d85c79914ab6949c48ec11582a.desc: No matter where you turn, the celestial crags of the mountainside always cast a dark shadow over the valleys. With this piece of armor, you can blend into the dark and travel lightly like a freezing gust of wind to find your enemies.

2778db519d0f60459f88a02cc29a6409.name: Citywall Block
2778db519d0f60459f88a02cc29a6409.desc: A neglected building material which is often used to building high and sturdy walls. This block protected the denizens of many cities before the fall.

0523bd716c36d84899c2f265c94e2376.name: Large Drak'Dal Door
0523bd716c36d84899c2f265c94e2376.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

38cf4b573236bc4e8b55ca7f1b8e7f09.name: Lever With Indicator
38cf4b573236bc4e8b55ca7f1b8e7f09.desc: A lever combined with a light. Flipping the lever switches the state between ON and OFF. A glowing light indicates the ON state.

1d2a86b5041cd0449f488fcdf3f31fba.name: Mysterious Tome
1d2a86b5041cd0449f488fcdf3f31fba.desc: A mysterious old book that cannot be opened. No matter how hard you pull at the petrified covers, the tome doesn't seem willing to spill its secrets.

3b3533a8ab03d04d83e8449663200d02.name: Basket VI
3b3533a8ab03d04d83e8449663200d02.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1ccd52ef008483418e68c1a34f0ba8a2.name: Ancient Ceiling Lamp
1ccd52ef008483418e68c1a34f0ba8a2.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

af03d87e84644343ae4615c87bcb7019.name: Hunter Trousers
af03d87e84644343ae4615c87bcb7019.desc: Nothing is more suitable for a long prowl than this set of pants.

4fe225c611316a40b837712909eed6f7.name: Hardened Leather
4fe225c611316a40b837712909eed6f7.desc: This patch of leather has been made more sturdy and enduring.

9a077bb7cb898647a6d1beec03225b2f.name: Warrior Boots
9a077bb7cb898647a6d1beec03225b2f.desc: These boots were designed to allow for reckless charges and dashes. The metal tips at the front prevent you from stubbing your toes.

ba1e232f83696440991800556d422a4b.name: Satin Strings
ba1e232f83696440991800556d422a4b.desc:
A music sheet for a soft song with heavenly tones.

Music Sheet: 
Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

41bc408e9614b84fb8b5a3fcc7a8eb33.name: Molten Axe
41bc408e9614b84fb8b5a3fcc7a8eb33.desc: It feels as though this metal, still carrying a small flame as its eye, like a candle's light, never truly solidified. The axe's body still bends and morphs under your touch, eager to be molded by your grip.

8895922b95d7cf45ba2c46181e0b3bd0.name: Scavenger Scattershot Head
8895922b95d7cf45ba2c46181e0b3bd0.desc: You hold it in your hand — the Elixir still dripping from its fanged mouth. It's finally over.

ca159620251e8642a56ea3ef8235274f.name: Shovel Garden Gnome
ca159620251e8642a56ea3ef8235274f.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

8ded12f0ad69824ea5d5ebb928928c17.name: Fluffy Hood
8ded12f0ad69824ea5d5ebb928928c17.desc: A nice, cream-colored hood to keep you warm and snug. The droopy little ears are purely fashionable, but aren't they cute?

c8e158a85a32004f8b14924154194006.name: Ectoplasm Press
c8e158a85a32004f8b14924154194006.desc: A special crafting station that allows its devious users to create otherworldly ingredients.

de337d6a37c38e4da466d00a90fbdd18.name: Throne Room Wall Brazier
de337d6a37c38e4da466d00a90fbdd18.desc:
A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.

11e7b56ef75848489818f0abf3899b95.name: Book I
11e7b56ef75848489818f0abf3899b95.desc: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.

c6d9e7755e7e9045bfdb8c7c341e9bf8.name: Sword and Shield Rack
c6d9e7755e7e9045bfdb8c7c341e9bf8.desc: A display to showcase weapons or shields.

5133f03a0dfadc438e76069e82af4cd1.name: Alpine Antler Hood
5133f03a0dfadc438e76069e82af4cd1.desc: A fur hood that protects the wearer's face from the strong, cutting mountain winds.

5133783307c7d843a7bf2f37d205257d.name: Small Aurora Beans Plant Pot
5133783307c7d843a7bf2f37d205257d.desc: An ancient potted plant. This one can be displayed in the Cultivation Rack.

b428af10daf0b344a275d38a2da438ff.name: Improved Millstone
b428af10daf0b344a275d38a2da438ff.desc: This stone serves as the centerpiece of a mill.

1977769c06f2f14295a994d31fc55c10.name: Epic Fishing Bait I
1977769c06f2f14295a994d31fc55c10.desc: Catch regular epic fish with ease thanks to this special bait.

b3dffc3a5d3eb845ab66f914926ed6f8.name: Acid Bite
b3dffc3a5d3eb845ab66f914926ed6f8.desc:
Sprays a lingering, poisonous acid in a cone in front of the caster. 
It also breaks the armor of enemies, applying a debuff which lets them take 25% increased physical damage for a short duration. 

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

212aec9ecada3a43ba0462ccfb45abac.name: Light Burst
212aec9ecada3a43ba0462ccfb45abac.desc:
Ignites a flash of light, bright enough to push back enemies around the caster.
It also deals Stamina Damage based on your Intelligence attribute to Shroud infested enemies which fills their Stun Bar.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

3689362075888246a416514bc30079b0.name: Of Daggers And Wine
3689362075888246a416514bc30079b0.desc:
A music sheet for a dramatic song fit for nights of devilry.

Music Sheet: 
Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

480a8f6a4356884cb699d15e17e85bb9.name: Blackguard Gloves
480a8f6a4356884cb699d15e17e85bb9.desc: Reinforced gloves with makeshift chitin plating.

94374aa93b770e499fbaa8c31d63e47a.name: Iron Fell Striker Trophy
94374aa93b770e499fbaa8c31d63e47a.desc:
By now you know that running to the back isn't a winning strategy; it's just an invitation for him to get the better of you.

Collect multiple Fell Striker Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

350e51974d62804ca45f625ca4def133.name: Mill
350e51974d62804ca45f625ca4def133.desc:
A mill that can be used to grind materials to a fine powder.

This mill only works when there is a force generator nearby. Either windmill sails or a partially submerged water wheel counts as a generator. 

The force generator doesn't have to be connected to the mill; it can be placed freely nearby.

d2db4626fc6c1a49a9d1ac2a98218279.name: Valiant Shield
d2db4626fc6c1a49a9d1ac2a98218279.desc: A formidable shield that can keep you and your allies safe.

4cda972c9ffa024884bc8289970a0fea.name: Siren Seeker Sandals
4cda972c9ffa024884bc8289970a0fea.desc: A pair of strappy sandals that make it easy to feel the sand and the sea.

31e637354faeae49a3ec414ef9b52c6f.name: Eagle Eye Chest
31e637354faeae49a3ec414ef9b52c6f.desc: The bright adornment on this armor piece shines brightly and aims to honor the glorious Flame.

1227c97adfcac04fa3206d8fed64b82c.name: Antique
1227c97adfcac04fa3206d8fed64b82c.desc:
Softspoken, sandy browns, and bright ash colors give this palette a dusty, but distinguished look.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.

c117182c2048cb44985e665bfedb5697.name: Muted Red Hair
c117182c2048cb44985e665bfedb5697.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

edcd68045e961a4ea518a70b88766888.name: Spellweaver Boots
edcd68045e961a4ea518a70b88766888.desc: Tightly fitted boots, made from gold metal and cured leather. With these, you will be able to dance between the rain of bolts and blades, casting doom upon your foes with swift movements.

2adc71b40bca98428447e7fd2bf36e42.name: Half-Light Halos
2adc71b40bca98428447e7fd2bf36e42.desc:
Step only where you remain unseen, strike those whose eyes are blinded by your glint in the half-light.

Shroud Imbued: 
This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

e4a0a6313e483a43a8f98ad9e2374ebf.name: Blue Wall Light II
e4a0a6313e483a43a8f98ad9e2374ebf.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

e5b82688aa19154f9a1e914c0eb4a4de.name: Mirage
e5b82688aa19154f9a1e914c0eb4a4de.desc:
Music that evokes flaming rays of sunlight, and the burning soles of a 1000-mile walk.

Music Sheet: 
Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

e8b776d5bdb42d47bd1aea91dd39cd1b.name: Cutthroat Helmet
e8b776d5bdb42d47bd1aea91dd39cd1b.desc: A darkened hood which lets you blend into the woodland scenery more easily. A piece of red cloth covers the mouth, making you feel like a bandit.

f3b54c4f0a55b049bddb11200092c639.name: Ranger Trousers
f3b54c4f0a55b049bddb11200092c639.desc: Pants which shield the legs from brambles and thorns while hunting down prey.

204e61cdd19397498f14736dbf600fa0.name: Trapdoor Metal 2m
204e61cdd19397498f14736dbf600fa0.desc: This trap door might open unexpectedly beneath your feet. Watch your step!

54fc217bed8df142a948d006f6fc18ff.name: Cyclops Pelvis
54fc217bed8df142a948d006f6fc18ff.desc:
A bony Cyclops pelvis. It's eerie.

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.

2553a668e9cc2c47a0695f212401ca40.name: Brittle Shroud Flakes
2553a668e9cc2c47a0695f212401ca40.desc:
If these brittle flakes are not handled carefully, they can fall apart and stick to everything, especially clothes.

It's unusable by itself, but can be processed into different materials in crafting.

5c9b6990efc0434da983094d4f78047c.name: Round Wooden Window Frame
5c9b6990efc0434da983094d4f78047c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

cc1a1733be9a3445b8b3a6f3735b6a53.name: Mothling Robe
cc1a1733be9a3445b8b3a6f3735b6a53.desc: This robe was fashioned to look like Emperor Moth wings. The double fur collar is especially soft. Below it lies a macrame shirt, expertly woven by nimble hands.

9a8b98bb1ea70b4d82329d6b755339a2.name: Crestflame Pants
9a8b98bb1ea70b4d82329d6b755339a2.desc: These are trousers that were created using superior ancient forging techniques. They bear the same mystical radial lines favoured by the ancient masters.

c9be589a97ed3047a7e6a6cd5eec0af0.name: Iron Ore
c9be589a97ed3047a7e6a6cd5eec0af0.desc: The natural resource needed to create Iron Bars, an important material for every adventurer on the way to the top.

0c032987fbd1604eb9efad805b998c33.name: Waveborne Ritualist Tunic
0c032987fbd1604eb9efad805b998c33.desc: A magnificent aquamarine gleams upon this garment, said to amplify the wearer’s healing abilities

faa0e4ae2f8bac4cadfe9a57ebd62c6e.name: Shroud Liquid
faa0e4ae2f8bac4cadfe9a57ebd62c6e.desc:
The liquified essence of the Shroud, harvested from enshrouded growths of the Springlands biome.

The brown fluid emits a violet vapor and is used for many powerful alchemical purposes.

72aad79145b6a34bb1fd05ce7563edc2.name: Small Backpack
72aad79145b6a34bb1fd05ce7563edc2.desc: An extension to your backpack that enlarges your inventory by two rows.

c1d9255ada03d1448c6acbaa16701e9c.name: Butterfly Bloom Seedling
c1d9255ada03d1448c6acbaa16701e9c.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

d08e68df5c99ff42b6d1a48873645c93.name: Pearlfrost Mentor Pants
d08e68df5c99ff42b6d1a48873645c93.desc: A pair of warm pants, tinged in a deep blue. It provides ample protection from the elements.

9deed4adf9f7f541b6480f14eca3fd8f.name: Raw Bird Meat
9deed4adf9f7f541b6480f14eca3fd8f.desc: It's not properly cooked. Eating this raw would cause nausea.

be229311c1b6504ba5ef6b6aeadfa431.name: Bronze Fell Wispwyvern Trophy
be229311c1b6504ba5ef6b6aeadfa431.desc:
The scales are heavy with muck and grime, dulling its glow. Hard to believe such a being once illuminated the water lilies under Pikemead's glorious rule.

Collect multiple Fell Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

01d733a18b83dc4ba6ff4ec8e9269b6b.name: Blunt Knives
01d733a18b83dc4ba6ff4ec8e9269b6b.desc:
A dull set of daggers. Simple, but still efficient in a pinch.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

d35919ea5c92fa40a94b9072c30d7e5d.name: Gloomberry Flower
d35919ea5c92fa40a94b9072c30d7e5d.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

92b80be8bd4b014196d05934f5518796.name: Assassin Gloves
92b80be8bd4b014196d05934f5518796.desc: Robust gloves that hide the wearer's palms and true intentions.

d45eb16a2a09de4c9241a5b5b563e718.name: Lupa's Scalper
d45eb16a2a09de4c9241a5b5b563e718.desc: "Shadow Over Umber Hollow — Lupa" is etched on the side.

4c7dce6666ced44a800aab37f7e604a2.name: Animal Fur
4c7dce6666ced44a800aab37f7e604a2.desc: Warm and comfortable during yearfall. A versatile resource that is very common and can be used for many things.

1aeee31524d8a44aa5c339536d89d23b.name: Wizard Hat
1aeee31524d8a44aa5c339536d89d23b.desc: Some farmers believe that wizards store their magical energy in their brimmed hats. These rumors were widespread but false. Mostly.

de9823db12905248ad7eed28c66f9865.name: Fake Stone Floor Passage
de9823db12905248ad7eed28c66f9865.desc: Fool others looking for hidden passages in your base with this fake secret door.

c1ba4e85540f4f4588d64f3adc8fa79a.name: Irrigation Gate Small
c1ba4e85540f4f4588d64f3adc8fa79a.desc: This gate can be lowered or raised to control the water flow around it. It's perfect for gardeners who want an efficient way to water their plants!

ffa5bf3b4a9b4e4a9c538a47329d992b.name: Dragonsbane
ffa5bf3b4a9b4e4a9c538a47329d992b.desc:
An axe found atop the skull of a giant dragon skeleton. Legends say it was used to slay the mother dragon, but it wasn't lodged inside her cranium when you found it. 

That's probably for the best. Mothers have enough headaches already.

b73f3397d79f334c9495a0c674ee835a.name: Graveyard Fence Broken I
b73f3397d79f334c9495a0c674ee835a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

488e160e4d1e514a999f36acca73b9ea.name: Dreadbane
488e160e4d1e514a999f36acca73b9ea.desc: A large and powerful hammer that has been corrupted by the Shroud. Good for smashing bugs!

7963ba146c19304aa45baed25054d7a2.name: Aloe Seedling
7963ba146c19304aa45baed25054d7a2.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

321e029748eb864ba0bd05cc5f636b95.name: Cooking Station
321e029748eb864ba0bd05cc5f636b95.desc: A basic setup for preparing meals.

dca8b06d1f338943a50cbfc3016a207a.name: Spiral Iron Stairs
dca8b06d1f338943a50cbfc3016a207a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

de796883aa080947a875e2b9e88a2e34.name: Ancient Colum Base II
de796883aa080947a875e2b9e88a2e34.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

3c8cd748073ef2498a536b3aef7aff57.name: Rogue Chestplate
3c8cd748073ef2498a536b3aef7aff57.desc: A well-balanced chest piece that lets the wearer regenerate their energy faster.

04ef30079aab1847bc13f10f9bc60408.name: Kindlewastes Flower
04ef30079aab1847bc13f10f9bc60408.desc: An ingredient used in crafting recipes.

95abbeee12eb5e48a31950bdb151e5e1.name: Magician Trousers
95abbeee12eb5e48a31950bdb151e5e1.desc: These pants were made from silky smooth cloth, gracing only the most esteemed magicians.

95ab4829ce7a92469d187d5ee1a8c121.name: Bamboo Container I
95ab4829ce7a92469d187d5ee1a8c121.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

73282c03c11b2440a101c7fe95ecaa24.name: Talion's Bow
73282c03c11b2440a101c7fe95ecaa24.desc: A bow used by Commanders of the Northern Guard. A powerful energy flows through the user, increasing their pulse and allowing for faster shots.

ca3c44f38fad364ebe73e1eef7ffd004.name: Shockfin
ca3c44f38fad364ebe73e1eef7ffd004.desc:
Said to be born from lightning striking open water, the Shockfin is charged with electric energy. Be careful when trying to pull it out of the water.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

c09f8e7299b7bc4ba35c395d4c49076a.name: Flame Mosaic Showcase
c09f8e7299b7bc4ba35c395d4c49076a.desc: A useful frame that can hold the pieces of a Flame mosaic. It must be placed on the ground.

6a963720cbd27649950e08639f1bbcc9.name: Drak Temple Roof Block
6a963720cbd27649950e08639f1bbcc9.desc: A building block that makes it easier to create harsh and visually enticing edges.

c17c4adcc381054aac419e01724418ed.name: Crude Wooden Stool
