c17c4adcc381054aac419e01724418ed.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

b5843dca83e5af4da91fe03fb0e9737a.name: Oath Breaker
b5843dca83e5af4da91fe03fb0e9737a.desc:
There are only a few ways to flee a promise you don't intend to keep. At least one of them involves murder.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

4fea56142da2034ab89ac97f4ac58a0f.name: Hunter Garb
4fea56142da2034ab89ac97f4ac58a0f.desc: This armor provides perfect protection when venturing out into the forest.

cc9e960a3d8f324c81b03b829363a963.name: Crude Wooden Fence II
cc9e960a3d8f324c81b03b829363a963.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

9f0e21e21f67cb449db8b685e88b2ae1.name: Gem of Greater Necromancy
9f0e21e21f67cb449db8b685e88b2ae1.desc: Killing an enemy has a %k chance to spawn an allied Hollow Reaper at level %k. You can only have 1 active Reaper from this gem at a time. Spawning more will delete the existing one. Reapers decay when out of combat for too long.

dbb37a171f5701428a066cc2c135c07c.name: Dark Staff
dbb37a171f5701428a066cc2c135c07c.desc:
A magical staff, utilizing the power of darkness to cast stronger magic spells. A mighty tool feared by every sorcerer.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

1348fcb3da5d2745afb02d03756ee713.name: Vanguard Standing Banner
1348fcb3da5d2745afb02d03756ee713.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d2211cfba47bab4694b00f423cc89113.name: Secret Basement Door
d2211cfba47bab4694b00f423cc89113.desc: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.

b30625c3d2f7484bbb8e495039fa2266.name: Crude Wooden Closet
b30625c3d2f7484bbb8e495039fa2266.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

842fda3c3233774da816fe409a8636f1.name: Brazen Bull Chest
842fda3c3233774da816fe409a8636f1.desc: If anyone dares to engage you in close combat, they'll get a taste of your wildly thrashing spiked shoulder pads. Your defense will be impenetrable, and the cuts you'll leave will be deep.

5d27b24bf5e62f46bc7bb228f25221ba.name: Mountain's Shadow Trousers
5d27b24bf5e62f46bc7bb228f25221ba.desc: A pair of charcoal black, loosely fitted pants. The larger silhouette stems from the extensive wool padding inside.

588f936b4a83ec4db85c2e845a115e08.name: Low Paling Fence II
588f936b4a83ec4db85c2e845a115e08.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

cc7fb59af456594e9504d4a586618ddb.name: Pinewood Room Divider IV
cc7fb59af456594e9504d4a586618ddb.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f0e477461aa11048aa364d7ec64b8cbe.name: Superior Health Potion
f0e477461aa11048aa364d7ec64b8cbe.desc:
It's a truly inspired concoction, and vastly superior to all other currently known Health Potions.

Instantly restores a supreme amount of health.

64d5bd4f6b09564cbe917b684196d425.name: Bamboo Logs
64d5bd4f6b09564cbe917b684196d425.desc: Sturdy, bendy, and regenerative: Bamboo is an ideal material for any Flameborn looking to build a tropical home.

a12075f8e9b4fd4a93c092587bed4b55.name: Heart Pillow
a12075f8e9b4fd4a93c092587bed4b55.desc: A soft velvet heart-shaped pillow, bringing not only comfort but a luxurious, elegant look to any space.

923c0dd69f5450448febf3f7662bbaed.name: Farmer Hat
923c0dd69f5450448febf3f7662bbaed.desc: It keeps the sun out of your tired eyes. That's all it has to do!

fea683abc6190543a2fff11a4c209b89.name: Raw Wolf Meat
fea683abc6190543a2fff11a4c209b89.desc: Raw Wolf meat. Must be cooked for proper consumption.

b6c1ae15547eba4cb3835bd10844920a.name: Mana Drain IV
b6c1ae15547eba4cb3835bd10844920a.desc:
Releases a continuous magical beam that leeches Mana from enemies without dealing damage to them.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

0eeb3aee79b72e44a5eb828c99cfb7c4.name: Experience Scroll
0eeb3aee79b72e44a5eb828c99cfb7c4.desc:
The most different experiences gathered and described on a scroll.

Gain a small amount of experience upon absorption of the content.

f4df1e92785bb74a9b2140ea2e0680f6.name: Moon Over The Well
f4df1e92785bb74a9b2140ea2e0680f6.desc:
A music sheet for a somber song to play in the moonlight.

Music Sheet: 
Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

6a584bbc726573418b6e36eb7a6629bb.name: Grappling Hook Swing Anchor
6a584bbc726573418b6e36eb7a6629bb.desc: Add this swing anchor to your buildings to swing across chasms. Requires a Grappling Hook to activate.

0f49e5ae6f1a06429a752e9b908e7056.name: Kettle
0f49e5ae6f1a06429a752e9b908e7056.desc: A metal Kettle which can be suspended over a Cooking Station.

08145210b19f0b4d88c845b8cc28cb5f.name: Large Coaster
08145210b19f0b4d88c845b8cc28cb5f.desc: A wooden plate to display foods and drinks on a table.

60e0263a15666a4bacc93bed9378fb3f.name: Holly and Berry
60e0263a15666a4bacc93bed9378fb3f.desc:
This color palette is energetic and festive, evoking lush foliage and joyful celebrations.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

ab02cf7bb8446d4c8305b3312b98c0bb.name: Cutthroat Trousers
ab02cf7bb8446d4c8305b3312b98c0bb.desc: The added leather grants superior protection from jagged rocks, unruly tree bark, and incoming arrows.

954e45b52b84c54dbbfcf2ec2c887d1a.name: Archmage Boots
954e45b52b84c54dbbfcf2ec2c887d1a.desc: These boots were made by the most talented cobblers and are as expensive as they come.

fe875ec3576ef34bbf95ed9070067cc8.name: Seafoam
fe875ec3576ef34bbf95ed9070067cc8.desc:
Refreshing like a salty gust of wind from the ocean.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.

8db7b56510ae6241bfb27d2dd8eb88b6.name: Bright Hope Sword
8db7b56510ae6241bfb27d2dd8eb88b6.desc: An iron blade erupts from the golden handle, splitting it like a growing sprig leaping through gilded leaves. Hope always finds a way to grow, even in the darkest of times.

72f0bcb1f269ae4fad8ef4c0c07463e6.name: Shock Wisp II
72f0bcb1f269ae4fad8ef4c0c07463e6.desc:
Conjures a charged wisp that trails you for a short duration. 
It hurls shock projectiles at enemies that also deal Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. 

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

31ee345d4585e744975335a481079596.name: Adventurer Gloves
31ee345d4585e744975335a481079596.desc: Sturdy gloves that protect the hands while exploring. The red markings on them represent bravery.

4eb3f8a9933afa4a8d9cd90a0a18fdf3.name: Red Marble Column
4eb3f8a9933afa4a8d9cd90a0a18fdf3.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

00a3c983d27ed74180fbed92b1367ff4.name: Coconana Smoothie
00a3c983d27ed74180fbed92b1367ff4.desc: A cold smoothie made from coconuts and bananas. Best served with a little decorative umbrella, a cozy spot on the beach, and two swirly straws.

54239c9d1498b44bbe9256d019344ab0.name: Talion's Bow
54239c9d1498b44bbe9256d019344ab0.desc: A bow used by Commanders of the Northern Guard. A powerful energy flows through the user, increasing their pulse and allowing for faster shots.

03bc267a33fc5248a932c14a48164af8.name: Hailcaster Pants
03bc267a33fc5248a932c14a48164af8.desc: Dark padded pants with golden seams. They're warm and comfortable.

3ff1dcbc4e024e4e9ab03da78fa4ebd5.name: Mangrove Seedling
3ff1dcbc4e024e4e9ab03da78fa4ebd5.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.

cf22952e58dfe54d98281f7aff46c93d.name: High Paling Fence II
cf22952e58dfe54d98281f7aff46c93d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

b50849d9ca2c6845a9149edf1e1fa492.name: Eternal Giant Bone Arrow I
b50849d9ca2c6845a9149edf1e1fa492.desc:
An eternal bone arrow that's overgrown with green crystals.

Eternal Arrow: Does not deplete Ammo per use. Equip the Eternal Arrow and use Mana to shoot it with a Bow.

6478d0da67f0d7498cac36e81a2294bb.name: Small Bamboo Window I
6478d0da67f0d7498cac36e81a2294bb.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

fba4ecd4004b7b44af609b3909a08fbf.name: Thaumaturge Pants
fba4ecd4004b7b44af609b3909a08fbf.desc: This pair of pants has significant padding on the inside, allowing you to travel for longer periods in frost-ridden lands. Traditionally, hides from the wearer's spirit animal are used to create the padding, but wool will do in a pinch.

6fc21e25b1aaa54998a8a0d4976f4690.name: Darkwood Axe
6fc21e25b1aaa54998a8a0d4976f4690.desc: This is an elevated version of the Boreal Axe. Its head boasts an intricate design, typical for northern craftsmanship.

e717c3de73088b4795154ae3a5336e26.name: Wisp of Light
e717c3de73088b4795154ae3a5336e26.desc: An imprisoned Wisp of Light. Opening the flask releases a glowing wisp that lights the darkness.

455a15b88f29734c9565700c983f963e.name: Bamboo Window I
455a15b88f29734c9565700c983f963e.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1af64a07b87b12468df43ef1006cab74.name: Water Reptile Leather
1af64a07b87b12468df43ef1006cab74.desc: A shiny material with an interesting texture. Any garment made with this will appear very fashionable.

af51f0b2f3482441a4dd956ed0f0bcc6.name: Lamp
af51f0b2f3482441a4dd956ed0f0bcc6.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

525623d152a0a24daaf06b6e05436f4d.name: Basalt Dust
525623d152a0a24daaf06b6e05436f4d.desc: Ground from dense volcanic rock and very rich in minerals.

cce41bc3523c5844ba7e4df722aff74c.name: Basalt Farm Soil
cce41bc3523c5844ba7e4df722aff74c.desc: Enriched with basalt dust, this soil holds the particular nutrients that plants from Cinder's Cradle demand. Common ground won't do for them — this will.

ee19ea693eabc7488d368cefe8f84aa4.name: Wolf's Fang Chest
ee19ea693eabc7488d368cefe8f84aa4.desc: A robust chest piece, adorned with the fur of a white wolf. The colors blend in well with snowed-in, grey mountains.

f124d7906a12d04e9bfa488e443d2e53.name: Hailscourge
f124d7906a12d04e9bfa488e443d2e53.desc: A blade that's cold to the touch. It weighs heavily on the mind.

d8c384d1dba4964e83f946d028c9b280.name: Bow Weapon Rack
d8c384d1dba4964e83f946d028c9b280.desc: A display to showcase weapons or shields.

499a3ffb67d9fa4188659dae3876b53a.name: Measuring Device I
499a3ffb67d9fa4188659dae3876b53a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e7d97a125eaf8d42992fd140f35dc8e0.name: Superior Mana Potion
e7d97a125eaf8d42992fd140f35dc8e0.desc: A precisely formulated mana potion that instantly restores a massive amount of mana upon use.

623b0341bd65f4409a16907f0e03094c.name: Blacksmith Hat
623b0341bd65f4409a16907f0e03094c.desc: A simple head-covering to soak up some of that pesky sweat. Keeps your precious ears away from hot swinging irons!

50f260f195d5424383a7c1498d0e4cf6.name: Fired Bricks Block
50f260f195d5424383a7c1498d0e4cf6.desc: A block made of Fired Bricks. It has a dull red color.

a55d34add3ac8a44b89725e74a7f8f9b.name: Lesser Ring of Mana
a55d34add3ac8a44b89725e74a7f8f9b.desc: This ring will increase your mana and its replenishment.

91949621635e7748ab0d371b316f9dfb.name: Herbalist Headwrap
91949621635e7748ab0d371b316f9dfb.desc: Headgear for herbalists. Healing others is surprisingly hard when you can't actually see them.

8621e6191b694c41a44194aebe8a65b0.name: Ashwind Strider Gloves
8621e6191b694c41a44194aebe8a65b0.desc: A pair of asymmetrical gloves. One leaves the fingertips bare, allowing you to check the direction of the wind.

5acc4c580ebe4749b03c56b950a5d597.name: Ghostly Ward
5acc4c580ebe4749b03c56b950a5d597.desc: A ward that projects a shimmering, translucent magic shield. It has a ghostly aura.

52185319d87c274f821f4a1dbb39f863.name: Maritime Toilet
52185319d87c274f821f4a1dbb39f863.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

7c5ebd287039cc4a9651f4e62829d5a9.name: Trap Fireball
7c5ebd287039cc4a9651f4e62829d5a9.desc:
A Trap Fireball which can be used as spell ammunition.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

80a179140942dc4c86a064904afe8997.name: Summer Games Headband
80a179140942dc4c86a064904afe8997.desc: A sporty headband with gold accents. It matches the set's belt and makes you feel like the ruler of the Summer Games!

4bd671fc845d4547a1b82e4294af847f.name: Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Eye
4bd671fc845d4547a1b82e4294af847f.desc: The grand eye that mounted the Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct just moments before now lays in your hands. The fused metal plates and ancient machinery are fascinating.

706b1a74b5afa94e8db94ed761ddaa8d.name: Empty Lily Pot
706b1a74b5afa94e8db94ed761ddaa8d.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

fca5d6a583c78447be91b94f293b8ee5.name: Fell Cyclops Head
fca5d6a583c78447be91b94f293b8ee5.desc:
The head of a Shroud infested Cyclops. It has pretty bad breath, even now.

Collect multiple Fell Cyclops Heads to craft the Trophy.

1edcb1986a777c45872b97c53f89ae8c.name: Soldier Shield
1edcb1986a777c45872b97c53f89ae8c.desc: Thrust yourself into battle and glory with the protection of this shield!

28725122b73c2c4d86437f0b713188d4.name: Bamboo Room Divider II
28725122b73c2c4d86437f0b713188d4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

a3c086bb12660648a73919ddd6817bd3.name: Gentian Plant
a3c086bb12660648a73919ddd6817bd3.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

c92b78d784711440b353d1df06330081.name: Thaumaturge Gloves
c92b78d784711440b353d1df06330081.desc: Elaborate armguards that shield the wearer from snow, rime, and grime. An amethyst has been inserted into the gem slot, enabling a better mana flow when spellcasting.

b6c98f6d463e2547bece93e5d5762b22.name: Lupa's Scalper
b6c98f6d463e2547bece93e5d5762b22.desc: "Shadow Over Umber Hollow — Lupa" is etched on the side.

59361b162cf34c48a3051cf24f388c41.name: Skull Stalker Shoes
59361b162cf34c48a3051cf24f388c41.desc: Seamlessly matching the rest of your outfit, these shoes let nothing stand between you and your goal.

3b074d13c252ec4f932a20f80e66ece7.name: Pikemead Statue Showcase
3b074d13c252ec4f932a20f80e66ece7.desc: Use this showcase to reassemble the Queen Pikemead statue.

0aed7bdf403e3c42b344fd1f833f9146.name: Tombstone "Until We Meet Again"
0aed7bdf403e3c42b344fd1f833f9146.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

2bbfbc141b5c4446a343ed1a7f6e44f7.name: Spearfisher Bow
2bbfbc141b5c4446a343ed1a7f6e44f7.desc: Whether used to shoot birds from the sky or fish in the water, this bow is precise and vicious. It's definitely more stylish than a fishing rod, though it's less effective for the same purpose... perhaps its venom would be better used on other wildlife instead.

e506657258d60a4686368af250047c3f.name: Salon Stool
e506657258d60a4686368af250047c3f.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

bfd0bf4db94fa744810bddbdc9cc3c8f.name: Prowl
bfd0bf4db94fa744810bddbdc9cc3c8f.desc:
The array of reds, oranges, and grays creates the ideal camouflage against the sundried mountains.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

afd5e93c68acb242b7f9cafef27f1afa.name: Assassin Trousers
afd5e93c68acb242b7f9cafef27f1afa.desc: A plain pair of pants. Under different circumstances, they would allow the wearer to easily blend into any crowd.

b419ac7f81959f4bb201c26a7c17d739.name: Fowler Trousers
b419ac7f81959f4bb201c26a7c17d739.desc: The pants were made from varied materials and protect all the most important areas adequately.

8748fe61824d4b4f8f0578f6ea93f51d.name: Sunpiercer Gloves
8748fe61824d4b4f8f0578f6ea93f51d.desc: These gloves offer you sufficient protection when you engage in melee combat.

8dbff03c6bb3ac4397eaf71ebcbd5ffe.name: Medium Albaneve Summits Brazier
8dbff03c6bb3ac4397eaf71ebcbd5ffe.desc:
A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.

8dbf0e08f09db942ba42653853a107dc.name: Large Elevated Crypt Coffin I
8dbf0e08f09db942ba42653853a107dc.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

5917ecec4acb754e8a6f62feb64f688f.name: Fleeting Memory
5917ecec4acb754e8a6f62feb64f688f.desc:
A music sheet for a bright song fit for any lively tavern. 

Music Sheet: 
Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

207dcceeca3ba140b5ac303937499ac8.name: Raw Taro
207dcceeca3ba140b5ac303937499ac8.desc: A delicious root vegetable that must be cooked before its sweet and mild flavor can be enjoyed.

a1ea29e9a65813419abf3912f5f1b571.name: Orange Wall Light I
a1ea29e9a65813419abf3912f5f1b571.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

2c6521f08fdca544bd68c62563bf677a.name: High Ancient Window Frame
2c6521f08fdca544bd68c62563bf677a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

facf77ca1b3556499bbb9dc56450e745.name: Red Wall Flower
facf77ca1b3556499bbb9dc56450e745.desc: A small potted plant to beautify your home.

7fe2ff87c88c054da0d3008bcc4b1e08.name: Brazen Bull Shield
7fe2ff87c88c054da0d3008bcc4b1e08.desc: The goat head imprinted on this metal shield is imposing, looking down on its adversaries with a stalwart gaze.

81bad1e9bf2be949a11022f0da5ff6fa.name: Big Yellow Wall Banner
81bad1e9bf2be949a11022f0da5ff6fa.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

78ad6a2de8323241bc887f57bfb9e391.name: Buttermilk
78ad6a2de8323241bc887f57bfb9e391.desc: A refreshing jug of buttermilk. With its lightly sour flavor and silky texture, it's very refreshing.

3cf9a082be5b5b4c847239188c1f70fc.name: Totem Wand
3cf9a082be5b5b4c847239188c1f70fc.desc:
A totem's grimace decorates this wand, watching your every move... sometimes, it empowers your magic. Sometimes, you feel it waiting for your downfall.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

938c23fba4861645a6494aa93dd33d04.name: Deadeye Hood
938c23fba4861645a6494aa93dd33d04.desc: This archery hood lets you watch over the peaks and valleys like a hawk. Nothing will escape your vigilant gaze!

62a08f7a573d434a963e1caef5416812.name: Bronze Fell Crimson Critter Queen Trophy
62a08f7a573d434a963e1caef5416812.desc:
Even molten bronze poured on top of her head couldn't dull her features. Her body remains a deep crimson, and her eyes glow with the same unsettling red as before.

Collect multiple Fell Crimson Critter Queen Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

bab29c4a43009e4e902ef28471c9742a.name: Revitalizing Health Potion +
bab29c4a43009e4e902ef28471c9742a.desc: Instantly restores a lot of health, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.

f7d95fc5d6720f43b575297b192838e2.name: Spine Splinter
f7d95fc5d6720f43b575297b192838e2.desc: No armor piece forged today can endure the sheer brutality of this mace.

fbac471ff126434fbc6ed79475152630.name: Trailblazer Chest
fbac471ff126434fbc6ed79475152630.desc: This armor piece was made from a combination of soft materials and hard, scale-like plating to ensure the ultimate flow of movement and protection. It has small hunting trophies attached to various spaces.

469eaac973ff7a48837e53721b3bd835.name: Eternal Shock Wisp II
469eaac973ff7a48837e53721b3bd835.desc:
Conjures a charged wisp that trails you for a short duration. 
It hurls shock projectiles at enemies that also deal Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. 

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

22d0fc8153c2c44597e2c89c6e1b5323.name: Crypt Bookrest
22d0fc8153c2c44597e2c89c6e1b5323.desc: A foregone history tome presented on an iron stand.

9dfe4aa8c4bb6e49b8c3d377dbce41f2.name: Eternal Bonestorm II
9dfe4aa8c4bb6e49b8c3d377dbce41f2.desc:
Conjures a flurry homing bone projectiles that hunt down enemies with crushing force.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

be3207e6a28be84fb9e29a4e20c45ff4.name: Healer Pants
be3207e6a28be84fb9e29a4e20c45ff4.desc: Woven pants which keep the wearer from scraping their knees.

e9ac551f764ffd4e8ed8ed8204a5b554.name: Steel Floor Torch
e9ac551f764ffd4e8ed8ed8204a5b554.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

0579b6f2bf87f245a5668a4ca1831c3a.name: Blue Globe
0579b6f2bf87f245a5668a4ca1831c3a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

df79e66c12186f4c94186fbe4404067f.name: Small Chest
df79e66c12186f4c94186fbe4404067f.desc: This small chest offers increased storage space for items.

7fa4cf2901d5a94a88952bff58d3eee9.name: Silver Ore
7fa4cf2901d5a94a88952bff58d3eee9.desc: Silver is a precious metal often found in combination with other minerals. This raw silver ore will need to be processed to become useful.

729ba474c3d7d54b8cd8911d486bfda8.name: Frozen Gauntlets
729ba474c3d7d54b8cd8911d486bfda8.desc: A pair of gauntlets that are as cold as snow on a sunless eve. Use them to freeze the hearts of your enemies!

004e57382e7bcd46b8d06e3ed05c617b.name: Granite Stone Sink
004e57382e7bcd46b8d06e3ed05c617b.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

c7ff08f2fbdde449b317b6734dd49082.name: Silver Chalice
c7ff08f2fbdde449b317b6734dd49082.desc:
The bright silver tone of this color palette decorated many of the realm's opulent chalices. It's known to pair well with the sanguine red of wine or the treacherous green glow of deceit and poison.

This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.

a69ac07b441b934697a90ea0ff9c514c.name: Valor Heart Daggers
a69ac07b441b934697a90ea0ff9c514c.desc:
A dagger that can easily be hidden underneath lavish sleeves or dressy skirts. It's quick and easy to unsheath in times of need!

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

8ebe4eea31db2b418ed734ba5c8cc865.name: Excellent Ectoplasm
8ebe4eea31db2b418ed734ba5c8cc865.desc: A slimy broth made from crushed ectoplasm crystals. It's "safe to consume".

8ebe8c23dd0bd041bf1f20b83456902b.name: Orange Eyes
8ebe8c23dd0bd041bf1f20b83456902b.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

27afc737a1affc4b8a1ad5139c9c3669.name: Exclusive Hollow Chestplate
27afc737a1affc4b8a1ad5139c9c3669.desc: This plate armor stands out with its golden glow, metal trim, and vibrant underlying colorway. The royal purple was achieved by harvesting and heating sea snail mucus in the past, and the extinction of aquatic wildlife only heightens its exclusivity.

ec599da1c6256841aaddc283841fe402.name: Thaumaturge Chest
ec599da1c6256841aaddc283841fe402.desc: This chest piece includes a silky white undergarment for warmth and a flowy cerulean cape for further insulation, and dramatic effect.

041efa33ac7e0d4ea171d68e432bf3da.name: Fenrig's Axe
041efa33ac7e0d4ea171d68e432bf3da.desc: An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.

9cb8ad1ecaf9f748be8071a7ea522daf.name: Key to The Pike
9cb8ad1ecaf9f748be8071a7ea522daf.desc: Opens all doors in the "The Pike", the castle within Pikemead's Reach.

a07f3b1d7398de41b7680e67203a7eb5.name: Rustic Door
a07f3b1d7398de41b7680e67203a7eb5.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

2c0834ade98f6c40a3a9b7178e72c129.name: Shield of Light
2c0834ade98f6c40a3a9b7178e72c129.desc: This sacred shield consecrated by the Flame allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.

599b0da7f858344baa5092da50f3a378.name: Springlands Rubble
599b0da7f858344baa5092da50f3a378.desc: A mix of different biome-specific materials, mainly stone and dirt.

85292aed81cfcd46bad3a83caacc0b65.name: Golden Fence
85292aed81cfcd46bad3a83caacc0b65.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ed614a82592d894e880aeb89107b1b60.name: Prawn Fossil
ed614a82592d894e880aeb89107b1b60.desc:
The fossilized remains of a stranded prawn. Most of its tiny legs are not visible anymore, which is mournful for researchers — but enjoyable for squeamish Flameborn.

This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.

19cd239ff8c8fd40b239fbb07404e329.name: Bronze Scavenger Tyrant Trophy
19cd239ff8c8fd40b239fbb07404e329.desc:
Each of her glowing eyes feels like a remnant of one of her whips — echoes of a violence that is no longer there.

Collect multiple Scavenger Tyrant Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

a8ff93db4315ea48aceadec9568d48d9.name: Vase Of The Ancients II
a8ff93db4315ea48aceadec9568d48d9.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

2318347035ac334e83d4f13b93d34eb3.name: Blood Rose Mail Coif
2318347035ac334e83d4f13b93d34eb3.desc: A chainmail coif, crowned with a wreath of roses and thorns. Beauty and pain, pleasure and despair — they all coalesce in her halo.

e212b133f07d454aa47151c01fd1d307.name: Handpan
e212b133f07d454aa47151c01fd1d307.desc: A hang drum is a hand-played steel instrument whose gentle tones spread like ripples across still water.

36dfa5e8f015914693bada14515e1eca.name: Ashwind Strider Chest
36dfa5e8f015914693bada14515e1eca.desc: A layered gambeson that's wrapped in chains and free-flowing silk. Its dark color scheme makes it easy to walk the path of ash and dust unseen.

74fde956c2be7447a9aca5735c4ca432.name: Horned Greatsword
74fde956c2be7447a9aca5735c4ca432.desc: Sharp extensions jut out from the blade's periphery: an assortment of stingers, sharpened flint, and horns. A strike from this jagged edge will rip and tear almost anything.

c23ae2328d046f4dbc90310c84c658ad.name: Bamboo Bedside Table
c23ae2328d046f4dbc90310c84c658ad.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

b98004d9c072be4f956e585fcaa2c279.name: Dried Purple Berry
b98004d9c072be4f956e585fcaa2c279.desc: When conserved, the Dried Purple Berry do not regenerate as much Health as the Purple Berries. However, the duration lasts longer.

917dba68bd2cb04c885865f19ac90ebf.name: Snowpal Dad
917dba68bd2cb04c885865f19ac90ebf.desc: A friendly figure made from snow.

595d73139dff9b4e9a4af1989a215546.name: Maid Hat
595d73139dff9b4e9a4af1989a215546.desc: A headwrap that's white as snow.

e08d7de6b8ac5743a0fb34a0d3f1d21b.name: Poisoned Steel Arrow
e08d7de6b8ac5743a0fb34a0d3f1d21b.desc:
A Special Arrow made from steel, laced with poison, perfect for hunting.

Poisoned Arrow: Enemies hit by this arrow are poisoned and additionally receive 20 damage per second for 5 seconds.

127d8cd419e1ca4ba5358a6ed726d83c.name: Big Straw Mat
127d8cd419e1ca4ba5358a6ed726d83c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

93f147031af474408e5429fbb095a390.name: Cracklewood Wand
93f147031af474408e5429fbb095a390.desc:
A wand that crackles with energy as it nurtures spark and flame. While wielding it, you feel as though it may burst into flame at any moment.
Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

d92c447de1c6924c9647f1b0535c5295.name: Adventurer Boots
d92c447de1c6924c9647f1b0535c5295.desc: These boots are perfect for any terrain. Easy to clean, robust, and light.

4308ad85327f264095d296c8e54e2899.name: Flame Altar
4308ad85327f264095d296c8e54e2899.desc: Place this Flame Altar above the Shroud to mark your home. Build inside the marked area around the Flame Altar.

514b6123d1e1a741badd88218bd90b65.name: Meat and Hazelnut Skewer
514b6123d1e1a741badd88218bd90b65.desc: With just some meat, a hazelnut, and a small fire, you can make this nutritious skewer anywhere and at any time.

98ea718ffab7bd4ba10fb048b286d579.name: Crypt Wall Skull Torch
98ea718ffab7bd4ba10fb048b286d579.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

bc2dac81fd95fa4081553c58b686dbaf.name: Blessed Club
bc2dac81fd95fa4081553c58b686dbaf.desc: A club that was bathed in divine waters, thus acquiring a blessing of protection. Turns out blessings are less effective than cold, hard steel when caught in an ambush.

17bac58e0672ac4f8e20f15ae455175e.name: Pressure Plate
17bac58e0672ac4f8e20f15ae455175e.desc: Activates when stepped on and stays active while pressure is applied.

a527ff7499bca143b25d9de519c1c9f5.name: Mycelium
a527ff7499bca143b25d9de519c1c9f5.desc: Use the Overgrowth Tool to apply this to structures in your base.

a527dfff8362404e916b38ba99646dd6.name: Fireball I
a527dfff8362404e916b38ba99646dd6.desc:
Ignites a fireball projectile that erupts upon impact and deals damage in an area. 

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

8de6681a28d3e64faab555a67150d34e.name: Sacrificial Vukah Dagger
8de6681a28d3e64faab555a67150d34e.desc:
A crude dagger, previously used by a Vukah in a bloody ritual.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

3b0f08637100ae4e9c4bbf293de538ec.name: Waveborne Ritualist Helmet
3b0f08637100ae4e9c4bbf293de538ec.desc: The mask veils the face, but not the intent. You are here to keep one safe.

6c0e02c35bbf894d974a2678b23d8739.name: Ancient Workbench
6c0e02c35bbf894d974a2678b23d8739.desc:
Craft blocks, new items and repair broken equipment. 

The Workbench can only be placed inside the area of a Flame Altar.

This Ancient Workbench is only a visual variation of the normal workbench.

d67dfc32f217eb4c82c8aabceb27fe21.name: Big Hollow's Eve Pumpkin II
d67dfc32f217eb4c82c8aabceb27fe21.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

be97fd523e42bb45a934e7425b6dbea6.name: High Bamboo Window
be97fd523e42bb45a934e7425b6dbea6.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

9c3ca506d322624e90082ce8f0ec94c4.name: Supply Sacks IV
9c3ca506d322624e90082ce8f0ec94c4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

cef35351cdc2584ab164febe16bf4cd4.name: Stone Bed
cef35351cdc2584ab164febe16bf4cd4.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

509d42334a1fa4499e6f015064934a36.name: Fine Hardwood Fence
509d42334a1fa4499e6f015064934a36.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ebf9c741555cf9448912ab294d3957a3.name: Taro Root Curry
ebf9c741555cf9448912ab294d3957a3.desc: A scrumptious curry with lots of heat and depth of flavor. It will make you feel warm and cozy!

b81f8d70e25b594fbdae3fff8eb53d03.name: Hunter Pants
b81f8d70e25b594fbdae3fff8eb53d03.desc: These belted pants will create a perfect fit no matter if you've had venison or porridge for dinner.

97e24969e67133419dde4c4bc20137c4.name: Servant Of Chaos
97e24969e67133419dde4c4bc20137c4.desc:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"The Elixir. It was a cure, a blessing, a weapon."

His frame nearly subsumes the Elixir. They bleed into each other; one dark shape against the sky... He was both peddler and prophet — but what for? - J

920eb9fc36ca79489c589d374ea16f20.name: Blacksmith Pants
920eb9fc36ca79489c589d374ea16f20.desc: These pants are smeared with soot.

510dc3d65ddd8c4fbb9ab6a47fb36ef7.name: Yellow Flower
510dc3d65ddd8c4fbb9ab6a47fb36ef7.desc: A small potted plant to beautify your home.

73bc9d0b53b8134cac0732db9f2dffbb.name: Hophare Feeder
73bc9d0b53b8134cac0732db9f2dffbb.desc:
A feeding device that holds Hophare food.

It will feed your animals when filled with the corresponding food.

dc1d0daea6f02e44aee1180623e4842b.name: Masonry Tools
dc1d0daea6f02e44aee1180623e4842b.desc: A set of tools for a Mason. Enables more advanced crafting options when placed.

5f1ff00cd7f3294ea8baf9e6559e1f4e.name: Water Barrier Ground
5f1ff00cd7f3294ea8baf9e6559e1f4e.desc: A magical water barrier to keep water out.

5f1fca6239dd4e47b21c176ca8b5607f.name: Crystalwater Staff
5f1fca6239dd4e47b21c176ca8b5607f.desc:
A staff that imbues the wielder with the ability to melt ice caps and frozen streams. The resulting fresh water is considered exceptionally pure and healing.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

cc32e8c122e2934cb1f16f4688aea5c9.name: Exceptional Ring of Stamina
cc32e8c122e2934cb1f16f4688aea5c9.desc: An ancient ring that gives you stamina.

27f5881084870741a22f9f2caae56a42.name: Clearwater Staff
27f5881084870741a22f9f2caae56a42.desc:
A ceremonial staff, used in part to melt frozen lakes into clear, drinkable water. 

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

db478ec3a5e0694cb44cdaf965d7e884.name: Bloodfeather Helmet
db478ec3a5e0694cb44cdaf965d7e884.desc: This head armor combines a mask, cloth, and horns. For most foes, it will be the last thing they see when you catch them by surprise.

8831f569c77a9149ac059d820847bcde.name: Secret Wooden Door
8831f569c77a9149ac059d820847bcde.desc: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.

3ea55417e24f58469b4728b882b34154.name: Bamboo Barricade II
3ea55417e24f58469b4728b882b34154.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

37f5ca9fe8951144b9c19ef1acebac46.name: Shell Limestone Road Block
37f5ca9fe8951144b9c19ef1acebac46.desc: This is a road material made from shell limestone, which is commonly found in Veilwater Basin.

1a2500924a1e81459c399d8f6c8639cc.name: Gold Scavenger Matron Trophy
1a2500924a1e81459c399d8f6c8639cc.desc:
Completely gilded, you no longer notice the dirt and stench, so you can hang it in your living room without hesitation.

Collect multiple Scavenger Matron Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

a78ef61351132d4da7bfae5e6c923cb2.name: Fae Deer Farmer Boots
a78ef61351132d4da7bfae5e6c923cb2.desc: At first glance, these brown leather boots appear ordinary. A closer inspection reveals the cloven segment towards the front, which leaves "hoov"-like prints in the mud.

a78e84d005c4dc46ad3cbdfda4f2809d.name: Quetzal Hunter Pants
a78e84d005c4dc46ad3cbdfda4f2809d.desc: They let you sprint through the thicket with the swiftness of wings.

72c256e7d595e149a0fce8c7012d5f93.name: Crab Meat
72c256e7d595e149a0fce8c7012d5f93.desc: You should only eat crab meat when it is grilled, as this is the best way to prepare it.

bf7b29b481ac6c41aaac84be56452576.name: Quetzal Hunter Gloves
bf7b29b481ac6c41aaac84be56452576.desc: These gauntlets shield your arms as you chase through the undergrowth, striking foes from afar.

cdd53fdfbbad9d4f944d424ce093d951.name: Protective Barrier
cdd53fdfbbad9d4f944d424ce093d951.desc:
Conjures a magical shield that blocks and absorbs incoming projectiles until its health is depleted.
You and your allies also gain 25% increased Physical Resistance within the barrier. 

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

7ccb5e1d94220845ada1c03caffa4671.name: Bamboo Ladder II
7ccb5e1d94220845ada1c03caffa4671.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

fe3ab340557abd4fb308d7131dcb469f.name: Palm Wood Banquet Table
fe3ab340557abd4fb308d7131dcb469f.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

d5b283c771ca9345aaa3cec861161997.name: Basket V
d5b283c771ca9345aaa3cec861161997.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

8d6a0eec91e3c54187fa24e57bb56bd2.name: Secret Bookshelf Door
8d6a0eec91e3c54187fa24e57bb56bd2.desc: Fool others looking for hidden passages in your base with this fake secret door.

75dd9c817352534099cc7fd9830a8143.name: Saturated Green Hair
75dd9c817352534099cc7fd9830a8143.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

add7389e3afc30499f0fbdde190a94f9.name: Artificer's Pants
add7389e3afc30499f0fbdde190a94f9.desc: Comfortable cloth pants that protect one from scratches and burns. They feel well-insulated.

b0d525a7cc642a48b0e3749bacf92d5d.name: Scholar of the Young Flame Helmet
b0d525a7cc642a48b0e3749bacf92d5d.desc: A radiant headpiece that can be spotted from afar. Not only when the burning sun reflects off of it.

b757b4245215ed45a1e24ae2564ac92c.name: Lesser Ring of Health
b757b4245215ed45a1e24ae2564ac92c.desc: This ring will increase your health and healing rate.

bbf221f2e1b7fc47b56978cd8ff38bfc.name: Hailcaster Boots
bbf221f2e1b7fc47b56978cd8ff38bfc.desc: These boots provide resistance and grip when stuck in a fierce snowstorm.

8ac465900f575848b7c7dda59de0c717.name: Frost Smasher
8ac465900f575848b7c7dda59de0c717.desc: Every aspect of this hammer's head is designed meticulously. The front and back boast a colorful yet distinguished design, while the sides share a row of spikes. Appealing, and functional.

a1954b9f09e0fd41a8a5133e1e9998b0.name: Light Brown Hair
a1954b9f09e0fd41a8a5133e1e9998b0.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

d4574b0669705241a6284568c83689a6.name: Mercenary Trousers
d4574b0669705241a6284568c83689a6.desc: A piece of leg armor that already looks like it has seen many years of use.

09ac35bd7a6b3a42aae42572f1e65d28.name: Crude Bench
09ac35bd7a6b3a42aae42572f1e65d28.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

a750ac0564650b408121332072a6fa49.name: Ring of the Mother Flame
a750ac0564650b408121332072a6fa49.desc: A golden band that contains a blood-red gem; filigree lapping up around it like flames. The design was inspired by the great altar of the Mother Flame.

2a78447342eb34439112c5643472d558.name: Crystal Cup
2a78447342eb34439112c5643472d558.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f784b52171bc674ea060c9752958702d.name: Artificer's Chest
f784b52171bc674ea060c9752958702d.desc: A dusty overcoat that reveals a metal exoskeleton beneath. A perfectly spherical cavity lies at the very centre of the chest plate, waiting to be adorned with an energy core.

0275d05323d0404797daad8f7f60900d.name: Cactus Plant
0275d05323d0404797daad8f7f60900d.desc: A large potted plant to beautify your home.

d438cec9cc78f44fb3de7f134fcb8d0d.name: Grilled Lean Meat
d438cec9cc78f44fb3de7f134fcb8d0d.desc:
Rich in protein and delicious, but only a small snack.

Increases health of the user by a small margin.

0e41260dbc9a9143bd4aa3218d952020.name: Golden Bulwark Shield
0e41260dbc9a9143bd4aa3218d952020.desc: A massive golden shield engraved with the snarling face of an ancient creature. Its fanged visage is said to ward off evil and strike fear into enemies on the battlefield.

7b69e5053f98994aa1c977a39bead07a.name: Mei-Yin Chen
7b69e5053f98994aa1c977a39bead07a.desc: Mei-Yin Chen is a Lunar New Year trader offering seasonal wares. She also sells copies of cosmetic clothing items.

93187ed662e44544a8009387b9d05a71.name: Liquid Light
93187ed662e44544a8009387b9d05a71.desc:
Like the morning sun, reflected in the still water of an ivory bowl.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

c4b20ece5c102b45b7ee6505b44d2c00.name: Vertical Banner III
c4b20ece5c102b45b7ee6505b44d2c00.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

a90b4956e0f9de498e29c775f6c1a757.name: Wolf's Fang Boots
a90b4956e0f9de498e29c775f6c1a757.desc: These spiked boots can cause a lot of damage when used to pierce arteries in one, swift swinging kick.

27798068ec269147b6d56d09198159be.name: Gold Ore
27798068ec269147b6d56d09198159be.desc: The most tantalizing gold ore is often hidden beneath the water's surface, but be careful when spotting a glint of golden light at the bottom of a stream. The gold rush may swallow you if the waves don't.

e33b465a61f4cf4aae098a59e392a204.name: Flightless Redtail Pillow
e33b465a61f4cf4aae098a59e392a204.desc: A comfortable pillow with a bird on it. The bird may not be able to fly, but it still looks stylish!

669781dde4629541a9e78e27f4821211.name: Golden Vase Of The Ancients I
669781dde4629541a9e78e27f4821211.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

b57d29bd46b7c947bbb0cb24c5894871.name: Azure Russula Seedling
b57d29bd46b7c947bbb0cb24c5894871.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

b8657c818d29fc4086ace4039bedd188.name: Grappling Hook Pull Anchor
b8657c818d29fc4086ace4039bedd188.desc: Add this pull anchor to your buildings to pull yourself forward and onto other platforms. Requires a Grappling Hook to activate.

93f9f881b73bf24c9f5ea5d4b8b564b2.name: Siren Seeker Sandals
93f9f881b73bf24c9f5ea5d4b8b564b2.desc: A pair of strappy sandals that make it easy to feel the sand and the sea.

f865ef8282224f44b834b39e5c8a521d.name: Weathered Ancient Stone Block
f865ef8282224f44b834b39e5c8a521d.desc: This block has an aesthetic that is exclusive to the Blackmire. Only this biome's unique flora and humidity can make Ancient stones weather like this.

7e54749c3aaaaa46a8a9b34a0219a5ec.name: Skull Trophy IV
7e54749c3aaaaa46a8a9b34a0219a5ec.desc: The Drak decorate their settlements with such trophies. It's impressive that they even washed off the blood — they surely reuse it for other purposes...

082ca70455ebdc419b0036b3932abdec.name: Crystal Platter
082ca70455ebdc419b0036b3932abdec.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

11e840a5e4fe324582f17448de4c3d94.name: Elite Hollow Gloves
11e840a5e4fe324582f17448de4c3d94.desc: Heavy gloves, usually carried by bony or rotting ice-cold fingers.

1b8bb1420e3a9d4b9b67b4e9a8c4d47e.name: Smaller Sea Lily Fossil
1b8bb1420e3a9d4b9b67b4e9a8c4d47e.desc:
A robust, small sea lily fossil. No matter how you turn it, you're always greeted by a tendril or imprint.

This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.

d8575eea82cb4e48b79ebbb9ee6266d9.name: Hugo Vanderhall
d8575eea82cb4e48b79ebbb9ee6266d9.desc: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

7f1141e6788d074d90bf4ec96d8c261d.name: Ring of Health
7f1141e6788d074d90bf4ec96d8c261d.desc: This ring will increase your health and healing rate.

d6669c61c625c04b9e382f29c7a10cfd.name: Hailcaster Boots
d6669c61c625c04b9e382f29c7a10cfd.desc: These boots provide resistance and grip when stuck in a fierce snowstorm.

be80e9ef0fd9784ebd0d9e6c23c24ac4.name: Boreal Wood Double Door
be80e9ef0fd9784ebd0d9e6c23c24ac4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ecc624c43df1414dbed4a40ab146c2a0.name: Lupa's Scalper
ecc624c43df1414dbed4a40ab146c2a0.desc: "Shadow Over Umber Hollow — Lupa" is etched on the side.

3f0974d9146b0e42b05d9d3f1b505ecc.name: Flame Pact Gloves
3f0974d9146b0e42b05d9d3f1b505ecc.desc: Gloves adorned with glowing, green gems. No matter what you're rebuilding or tearing down — you'll always look fashionable with these!

3a63ce8eb2d2534d80ab6226c3142cc1.name: Fish Scales
3a63ce8eb2d2534d80ab6226c3142cc1.desc: The scales are still warm when removed from the fish. They never fully cool and are popular under fire mages for obvious reasons.

d1267e164b08e54aa80700c9594196a0.name: Crab Fossil
d1267e164b08e54aa80700c9594196a0.desc:
Nowadays it's rare to find crustaceans, petrified or alive. When crabs were still plentiful, they were caught for meat and later thrown back into the ocean as empty shells to appease the tides. This tradition didn't protect the waters from being corrupted by the Shroud, so it soon lost cultural relevance.

This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.

584a97591f3b3d47a6e820df5823ea7d.name: Spinechill Axe
584a97591f3b3d47a6e820df5823ea7d.desc:
A menacing axe that sends shivering chills down its victim's back with every heavy two-handed swing.

Hollow Echo:
The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.

c9ded0afa54f5540a48faa53acdc668d.name: Shroud Radiance
c9ded0afa54f5540a48faa53acdc668d.desc: The highest concentration of shroud energy, even higher than shroud nexus.

6823dcae99debe44a7a71986da16a96f.name: Flame Pact Pants
6823dcae99debe44a7a71986da16a96f.desc: Light brown pants. Comfortable and distinguished in their simplicity.

47cfb38bcf7cc045b05cd0ae88b88ac9.name: Rising Fighter Gloves
47cfb38bcf7cc045b05cd0ae88b88ac9.desc: Gloves made for beginner fighters. Robust, but agile. They will mainly protect you from blisters when swinging your sword.

14e9e0a9974d5349954abddc87114259.name: Cursed Shroud Sack
14e9e0a9974d5349954abddc87114259.desc: A dangerous, rotting substance, made half-liquid by its state of decay.

e27f642bad0a7a41b025d9c67e187d0c.name: Bamboo Door
e27f642bad0a7a41b025d9c67e187d0c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

97ac8af0079f0c43a57d7253dd79a648.name: Gorestriker
97ac8af0079f0c43a57d7253dd79a648.desc: A deadly club that will decimate any enemy.

2d5ea5a61d60ea4dabe84d3982892e5a.name: Sage Gloves
2d5ea5a61d60ea4dabe84d3982892e5a.desc: In old times these gloves were worn by the wisest scholars of the kingdom, often hiding wrinkled and gray flesh underneath.

b65dd7a5f7a9ad429210a531823787a1.name: Round-Billed Sailer
b65dd7a5f7a9ad429210a531823787a1.desc: A fully grown Round-Billed Sailer, willing to donate fresh feathers for your cause.

2fd4352223263f48840981b329de2f2c.name: Blackmire Statue VI
2fd4352223263f48840981b329de2f2c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

fb9d4476b6bcb3489eca35b53dced99e.name: Golden Leaf
fb9d4476b6bcb3489eca35b53dced99e.desc:
Green and brown with a hint of gold, like raining leaves on a slow day in fall.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

56889ab59d9990409e04866d9d861b3d.name: Throne Room Floor Lamp
56889ab59d9990409e04866d9d861b3d.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

b9ed57c500325a44adb3a4f563a4fc52.name: Quetzal Hunter Helmet
b9ed57c500325a44adb3a4f563a4fc52.desc: Inspired by the Quetzal, a magnificent bird that once graced the skies of Embervale, this beautiful armor set lets you feel the freedom and precision of flight when you wear it.

d29ebfb5a425fa4bb355bb31170314cd.name: Oracle's Everblue
d29ebfb5a425fa4bb355bb31170314cd.desc:
"Gaze into the orb," the Oracle said, eyes fixated on her staff. "It shows the past, the present, and the future — and they're all veiled in blue rot".

Shroud Imbued: 
This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

005e97c478d00747830e8f6907d3a63f.name: Vukah Brawler Trophy
005e97c478d00747830e8f6907d3a63f.desc:
The fur is still speckled with bloody flecks.

Collect multiple Vukah Brawler Heads to craft the Trophy.

0377f209b864c444b7afb0f112f0b0cd.name: Room Divider "Flower"
0377f209b864c444b7afb0f112f0b0cd.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d35a920552c07b4c9a6279f2c6536b00.name: Simple Tropical Wood Fence with Ropes II
d35a920552c07b4c9a6279f2c6536b00.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6272dfe3b60ceb488c1c47617195b6e7.name: Trap Fireball
6272dfe3b60ceb488c1c47617195b6e7.desc:
A Trap Fireball which can be used as spell ammunition.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

47915599f458e24eb9aa40066ff96263.name: Bronze Fell Monstrosity Trophy
47915599f458e24eb9aa40066ff96263.desc:
Even when dead, the swirling chaos inside the gaping maw leaves people spellbound. Don't get too close.

Collect multiple Fell Monstrosity Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

51b8e2da3e404749912f810a50454c48.name: Sage Tunic
51b8e2da3e404749912f810a50454c48.desc: An illustrious garb that almost shines brighter than the wearer's spirit.

95eaffc5325311409920630ef40eb352.name: Limestone Fence
95eaffc5325311409920630ef40eb352.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4d40541aa9153e4b81cb7e9675340f08.name: Thieves Guild
4d40541aa9153e4b81cb7e9675340f08.desc:
For a thief, the only light visible from within the shadows is that which is reflected on a glistening gold coin. 

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

df6a6591bd7fc145a38075ab94836fef.name: Fae Deer Pillow
df6a6591bd7fc145a38075ab94836fef.desc: A decorative pillow that's been adorned with a Fae Deer motif. It seems to be running wild through the wind and bushes.

9eb044de0001fe4fbb5a07bf5fab1cef.name: Stormshield
9eb044de0001fe4fbb5a07bf5fab1cef.desc: A metal plate shield that was twisted and shaped in a Shroudstorm. It seems to be almost indestructible.

4c7e6192b0561545b9a279150b447d96.name: Shroud Weaver
4c7e6192b0561545b9a279150b447d96.desc:
A malicious staff that effortlessly intertwines the strings of fate with the Shroud.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

b3646b10738b0f47b5e1cd2a61071da8.name: Ancestral Star
b3646b10738b0f47b5e1cd2a61071da8.desc: An ancestral weapon from the proud family line of the Galeforths, last held by Virgil Galeforth. He famously said: "If you want this weapon, you'll have to pry it from my cold, dead hands".

848d14ff0225fb4f9a1d7282ba0bcdbc.name: Prayer of the Flame Scroll
848d14ff0225fb4f9a1d7282ba0bcdbc.desc: Offers a small prayer to the Flame, that increases your magic damage and the maximum time in the Shroud for a short duration.

488ffb9e601cac48bc788b4bd0103531.name: Saffron
488ffb9e601cac48bc788b4bd0103531.desc: A rare herbal plant that can be found in hot climates. It's used to create vibrant golden-yellow dyes.

d44047a3f763494c825cf78a720fa777.name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Boots
d44047a3f763494c825cf78a720fa777.desc: With these boots, the "Scholars of the Empyrean" were able to pass the trapped corridors of the Night Sanctums. Their soles, often worn thin, were replaced countless times. Hopefully, they'll carry you just as far on your own journey.

b9afad789f8c5f44ad2fa433936dd6cf.name: Gem of Hyperspecialization
b9afad789f8c5f44ad2fa433936dd6cf.desc: After triggering the weapons Special Ability, any kill within %k will return %k Focus.

1368f656ca415840b0f33189070e06be.name: Soldier's Broadsword
1368f656ca415840b0f33189070e06be.desc: A sharpened broadsword. Swinging it comfortably requires strong arms.

9e729ad8dd93c14694f3e27b821f8ce0.name: Gem of Bloodlust
9e729ad8dd93c14694f3e27b821f8ce0.desc: Grants a %k base chance to spawn a health orb when defeating an enemy. Collecting a health orb grants %k additional cutting damage to attacks and increases the chance for health orbs by %k for %k.

e09d2f2a8a6d7c4cbd27af8eb6a98009.name: Warden Trousers
e09d2f2a8a6d7c4cbd27af8eb6a98009.desc: Gray pants which have been refined with expertly crafted metal parts.

a2fde1d8728ba24a8e4d04bd3187ce9c.name: Empty Cymbidium Pot
a2fde1d8728ba24a8e4d04bd3187ce9c.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

eb288d91ad32aa479a453522f1a26ea7.name: Riptide
eb288d91ad32aa479a453522f1a26ea7.desc: A shield that was washed into a grotto by the river. It must have belonged to a valiant hero.

23ea116578b2f5489cbc1ea7cb26d9cf.name: Talion's Bow
23ea116578b2f5489cbc1ea7cb26d9cf.desc: A bow used by Commanders of the Northern Guard. A powerful energy flows through the user, increasing their pulse and allowing for faster shots.

de3ce924cd50664796a5afc5f1993e88.name: Simple Wood Support
de3ce924cd50664796a5afc5f1993e88.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

b061a60d91fec245a961227bd6df7cba.name: Giant Telescope
b061a60d91fec245a961227bd6df7cba.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

619ee9526e596f46adc03e041d655627.name: Crab Cakes
619ee9526e596f46adc03e041d655627.desc: A delicacy of the marine world, it is crispy on the outside and soft and full of flavor on the inside. It is the perfect meal for weary adventurers.

9af18b5e83479045b70f38c795f21516.name: Rooibos Tea
9af18b5e83479045b70f38c795f21516.desc: An aromatic ingredient that calms the body, providing an instant boost of Stamina for the user.

790738ca18bf9844904fa5a3d875272f.name: High Carved Wooden Window Frame I
790738ca18bf9844904fa5a3d875272f.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

19805050d9768c4090d9b96fc352680f.name: Sage Boots
19805050d9768c4090d9b96fc352680f.desc: Comfortable and modest shoes for lounging in a library.

eb09cca2850dfa429fd9253a094d0f2f.name: Yellow Eyes
eb09cca2850dfa429fd9253a094d0f2f.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

24d0069921532d4b89e818add34f03ae.name: Cutthroat Gloves
24d0069921532d4b89e818add34f03ae.desc: These Cutthroat Gloves have been refined to be snug and effective.

259a0458acd2ce47add60871a6ea1eda.name: Fowler Boots
259a0458acd2ce47add60871a6ea1eda.desc: With these weighted soles, even shaky or uneven ground will not disturb your aim.

47f659605e154143906eab9dfcb17675.name: Coloring Station
47f659605e154143906eab9dfcb17675.desc: A factory that enables the production of color palettes and colorizes your clothes.

fbe3a7c0debd814ea9539f159ac76fe6.name: Vase Of The Ancients III
fbe3a7c0debd814ea9539f159ac76fe6.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e5e01baae6666d4cbae4079da16f047a.name: White Flower
e5e01baae6666d4cbae4079da16f047a.desc: A tiny potted plant to beautify your home.

2ae5d1d84a548a4198b94e196e4ac0ec.name: Mercenary Chest
2ae5d1d84a548a4198b94e196e4ac0ec.desc: A heavy breastplate that has lost its shine, but not its notoriety.

4d86fdb53f111d43a8e9fe7c73d93c18.name: Purple Wall Light I
4d86fdb53f111d43a8e9fe7c73d93c18.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

8308492c2c40b348b58f091b9de734e3.name: Simple Coffin
8308492c2c40b348b58f091b9de734e3.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f66dabcf1f2b5c4b893c8dbef1a30ee3.name: Straw
f66dabcf1f2b5c4b893c8dbef1a30ee3.desc: A natural plant, remains of the agriculture left behind, that grows in the world. It offers protection from the elements when used as building material.

6fe20273a832e84d81e63c8a49425594.name: Chimerical Greatsword
6fe20273a832e84d81e63c8a49425594.desc: A weapon born from the amalgamation of bones, earth, and liquid fire. As your eyes travel across it, the mess of cartilage and moss at the hilt gives way to a light-swallowing obsidian blade.

238d04a1da802a48bfda9b8028908d89.name: Lesser Golden Twinflame Sword
238d04a1da802a48bfda9b8028908d89.desc: A weapon that was rumored to have fallen from the stars. The man who found it could never feel whole, always searching for a missing piece.

78a6da8ff165b641911f29e599182faa.name: Cabbage Mushroom Rice
78a6da8ff165b641911f29e599182faa.desc: A simple pan-fried dish of chopped cabbage, mushrooms, and tomatoes served over rice.

dedf3302bdf26542bc08dadade4368ac.name: Warlock Helmet
dedf3302bdf26542bc08dadade4368ac.desc: A helmet which protects your sensitive cranial bone from harm while riding into battle.

5bd99668fe60d440a48f227b581e97d2.name: Bronze Bowl
5bd99668fe60d440a48f227b581e97d2.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

15ca86d9cbfcc044bf0998d33e6cca3a.name: Golden Room Divider
15ca86d9cbfcc044bf0998d33e6cca3a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

63d9504a2286dc46b34f65fd6c4b60be.name: Fowler Helmet
63d9504a2286dc46b34f65fd6c4b60be.desc: The metal adornment on this hood faintly resembles the beak of a hawk.

aca9ec9d0790d548a6aeb1533972b656.name: Tarpaulin Corner
aca9ec9d0790d548a6aeb1533972b656.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4036c1a6e3ba614497593e77aff45abe.name: Ammonite Imprint
4036c1a6e3ba614497593e77aff45abe.desc:
A stone with multiple large ammonite imprints. There's a bewitching spiral shape on every side of it.

This collectible is found in the Springlands.

ffec4bfc905bcc40b34842f0702189db.name: Low Paling Fence I
ffec4bfc905bcc40b34842f0702189db.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

cc238715dadb63429d71ad1154fdb71e.name: Sacrificial Vukah Dagger
cc238715dadb63429d71ad1154fdb71e.desc:
A crude dagger, previously used by a Vukah in a bloody ritual.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

48d5f88feb917241bcb3ba447f5dda17.name: Big Hollow's Eve Pumpkin I
48d5f88feb917241bcb3ba447f5dda17.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

650da4c2307346408d8c9fbabefdd416.name: Horned Beast Bow
650da4c2307346408d8c9fbabefdd416.desc: A bow crafted to resemble the horned beasts of the Albaneve Summits. It makes for a fearsome silhouette.

680c9ec4a2bba744b6afa8a0672316d0.name: Orrery Display Pillar
680c9ec4a2bba744b6afa8a0672316d0.desc: A pillar that can be used to display planetary models and orbital rings.

4d6794ef11e1d54fb6d4c223981b67e8.name: Dark Blonde Hair
4d6794ef11e1d54fb6d4c223981b67e8.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

c00540569060a6428ef7157f137eda64.name: Gold Scavenger Tyrant Trophy
c00540569060a6428ef7157f137eda64.desc:
For a moment, you're back on the battlefield. Her presence brings the same tension into the room, as if the fight never quite ended.

Collect multiple Scavenger Tyrant Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

75ed841822337a479cc31bca87247d30.name: Green Luminescent Block
75ed841822337a479cc31bca87247d30.desc:
A building block crafted from purified slime. It illuminates the room with a ghostly green glow. 

Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

e5a2c5e18c5000479239741e99b1735c.name: Flame Pact Hat
e5a2c5e18c5000479239741e99b1735c.desc: A floppy hat with red feathers.

d1f024ff946b2945bd2e9855db4e4b22.name: Silvershot Bow
d1f024ff946b2945bd2e9855db4e4b22.desc: A bow that aims to strike the heart of the dark with silver-tipped arrows and no hesitation.

b5ea60c2f395334ea87714e4f9d90ef4.name: Fake Temple Door
b5ea60c2f395334ea87714e4f9d90ef4.desc: Fool others looking for hidden passages in your base with this fake secret door.

d3620f4a407cdc419f169fd042f30064.name: Circus Knives
d3620f4a407cdc419f169fd042f30064.desc:
A pair of circus knives that can do a lot of damage if left in untrained hands! Better watch out!

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

f7b39c0cc94a6540b719cb83c1b57d6f.name: Large Polished Wooden Cabinet
f7b39c0cc94a6540b719cb83c1b57d6f.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4e57009a428a1047885a4d83996c4ac3.name: Brazen Bull Boots
4e57009a428a1047885a4d83996c4ac3.desc: No one will get through you whilst you stand your ground in these regal boots.

18e18296b561a640a7c9c6952a73e563.name: Archmage Gloves
18e18296b561a640a7c9c6952a73e563.desc: Gloves which were worn by the most talented, renowned and successful mages of the kingdom.

08995870f65380448470042641a879c4.name: Pearlfrost Mentor Boots
08995870f65380448470042641a879c4.desc: Tied dark leather boots with quilted fabric sections. They reach up to the wearer's knees, protecting the shins from deep snow.

19e50ed135ce8e489ec69373dba541bb.name: Iron Prison Window Frame
19e50ed135ce8e489ec69373dba541bb.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

099d7e937b5ec5488b720455a77abef0.name: Trap Fireball
099d7e937b5ec5488b720455a77abef0.desc:
A Trap Fireball which can be used as spell ammunition.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

e1d25093064ab8428051c746fb8c55e8.name: Shock Totem I
e1d25093064ab8428051c746fb8c55e8.desc:
Summons a totem that launches shock projectiles at enemies that also deal Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. 
Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

5652f7bed5bbce45b8d8eede3d82fbfd.name: Rubble
5652f7bed5bbce45b8d8eede3d82fbfd.desc: The dusty remains of building materials.

91b4988cf91a0b4fb7b339582d5bb269.name: Mage Chest
91b4988cf91a0b4fb7b339582d5bb269.desc: This garment is held together by oakwood buttons, a woven belt, and magic itself! The buttons are doing most of the work, though.

c83018eb64d246429538052f2f42d1f4.name: Bamboo Room Divider I
c83018eb64d246429538052f2f42d1f4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f36173c9eea9374aaa5e95851f979e18.name: Small Stone Brazier
f36173c9eea9374aaa5e95851f979e18.desc:
A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.

7b79f308a1c10c49a5cc14f87ba6d535.name: Thaumaturge Chest
7b79f308a1c10c49a5cc14f87ba6d535.desc: This chest piece includes a silky white undergarment for warmth and a flowy cerulean cape for further insulation, and dramatic effect.

f02b80b4407c8d4881674bc265d9591e.name: Ghostly Ward
f02b80b4407c8d4881674bc265d9591e.desc: A ward that projects a shimmering, translucent magic shield. It has a ghostly aura.

ec33be88c295cb4db9f5ac310617da74.name: Skull Trophy II
ec33be88c295cb4db9f5ac310617da74.desc: The Drak decorate their settlements with such trophies. It's impressive that they even washed off the blood — they surely reuse it for other purposes...

68afcc661603ec498da0c4676cb8ab83.name: Cutthroat Gloves
68afcc661603ec498da0c4676cb8ab83.desc: These Cutthroat Gloves have been refined to be snug and effective.

ce4983746a6b234b93dd913fa54cb59d.name: Fine Stone Fence Pole
ce4983746a6b234b93dd913fa54cb59d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f426691615bf2a4bb73ff9ac1f651872.name: Thyme Seedling
f426691615bf2a4bb73ff9ac1f651872.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in Basalt Farm Soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

0a2c85decc47464d8cd0087decb00121.name: Golden Dome
0a2c85decc47464d8cd0087decb00121.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4e19c0fadf69784cb11794d32ada56f8.name: Silver Chest
4e19c0fadf69784cb11794d32ada56f8.desc: This small chest offers increased storage space for items.

bf0fb9d6d622bb44ad5f1e9a4c996714.name: Rice Seedling
bf0fb9d6d622bb44ad5f1e9a4c996714.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. This plant needs to be placed in water, so that the roots are always covered.

55352be9ede370479e53d3d4d38128f0.name: Iron Scavenger Tyrant Trophy
55352be9ede370479e53d3d4d38128f0.desc:
Her eyes don't move, yet they seem to follow you all the same. It feels less like being watched, more like being measured.

Collect multiple Scavenger Tyrant Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

0183e4b51d50b5468e9e8a4d96750b2e.name: Kaori Conway
0183e4b51d50b5468e9e8a4d96750b2e.desc: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

76878609d1adad418e2009f1f9989885.name: Big Steel Barrel
76878609d1adad418e2009f1f9989885.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

efc50a6b32261749b956482ebb55097e.name: Darya's Staff
efc50a6b32261749b956482ebb55097e.desc:
A staff that harnesses the power of the eclipsed sun. It functions best when only a crescent of light is left.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

80a2e6555f89ec4c803c23fa626ecd91.name: Hollow Wispwyvern Trophy
80a2e6555f89ec4c803c23fa626ecd91.desc: You stare at the skull and swear the floor trembles. It doesn't. Yet.

7312339899a43248a1e7b0b33300314c.name: Omen Boots
7312339899a43248a1e7b0b33300314c.desc:
Unknown footprints in the mud are always a bad omen, wether one is superstitious or not.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

0a0d72cb09057944a1a78cc6b6ebdda4.name: Bronze Jug
0a0d72cb09057944a1a78cc6b6ebdda4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4af64f382096004f90055a151b97e7ca.name: Pink Flower
4af64f382096004f90055a151b97e7ca.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

ac0ea749ea254848a1774181067f2060.name: Fenrig's Axe
ac0ea749ea254848a1774181067f2060.desc: An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.

39fbc63a18843f499b0dc2286aa5033e.name: Drak Relief IV
39fbc63a18843f499b0dc2286aa5033e.desc:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

Humanity is shown as victorious! They drive the attackers back, and the Drak are forced to retreat overseas to an archipelago.

b7eba38a4f920848b17dd2d15cc63359.name: Ginger Seedling
b7eba38a4f920848b17dd2d15cc63359.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

d3e682250a808845bead36177e32c665.name: Wailing Blade
d3e682250a808845bead36177e32c665.desc: An expertly crafted blade, balanced and sharp. Cuts through foes like a wail through the night. It bears the mark of a famous blacksmith from Pikemead's Reach.

6d64fb371a022c41a9a157d6dfede18e.name: Soldier Boots
6d64fb371a022c41a9a157d6dfede18e.desc: A pair of boots which is covered in silvery scales. Your ankles will be safe and sound with these.

d52726d93382524eaedec6f5d380f0d6.name: Vorgoth's War Banner I
d52726d93382524eaedec6f5d380f0d6.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

82a9779d08e3194b85823c76dec9bfcd.name: Hunter Headband
82a9779d08e3194b85823c76dec9bfcd.desc: A yellow headband that keeps your hair out of your face when hunting or lumbering.

97fa36e27025b8468b80579bf458d8fd.name: Royal Gloves
97fa36e27025b8468b80579bf458d8fd.desc: These gloves are a bit stiff and barely functional. The most important thing is that they look impressive to peasants. You won't need to do manual labor, anyway.

6b239104ca37c349b996b6a91c51eb3c.name: Bronze Scavenger Artificer Trophy
6b239104ca37c349b996b6a91c51eb3c.desc:
The Scavenger Artificer builds, and you suffer the consequences. Now you build with his head. How the tables have turned!

Collect multiple Scavenger Artificer Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

d676800460ee6948a219dcc76448d806.name: Bursting Fell Heart
d676800460ee6948a219dcc76448d806.desc: It's oozing, unaturally enlarged, and still beating whenever you dare to look away. This heart's potent essence is a key ingredient in crafting resilient armor.

baf1f1452710dc49931761dbe9d863aa.name: Blooming Anyway
baf1f1452710dc49931761dbe9d863aa.desc:
Earthy, muddy, and rooted. But even in the most bleak areas, some flowers bloom and bring back color.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

0c5274496a57ab4b9e2c4987b2273f69.name: Water Barrier Wall
0c5274496a57ab4b9e2c4987b2273f69.desc: A magical water barrier to keep water out.

73d420fc3d3dfd4189feec3c53310aec.name: Tank Chestplate
73d420fc3d3dfd4189feec3c53310aec.desc: The improved copper coating of this Tank Chestplate can withstand many more blows at the frontlines of battle.

02096ced7622514faf217a1f81f497a6.name: Brick Fireplace
02096ced7622514faf217a1f81f497a6.desc: A wonderfully inviting fireplace made from red bricks.

81da1b0458964044a272417e233f72b0.name: Ascendant Daggers
81da1b0458964044a272417e233f72b0.desc:
A prideful set of daggers. They foretell a path through the galaxy, enabling the wielder to rise and slash their mark into a star-dotted sky. 3 golden rings mark the handle's beginning and end.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

e4d02e9b0d17464fb65d6fdcbc0abcde.name: Iron Crypt Chandelier
e4d02e9b0d17464fb65d6fdcbc0abcde.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

c75d99f39cf2434ca52a2b2a328099a0.name: Dimweald Axe
c75d99f39cf2434ca52a2b2a328099a0.desc: A one-handed axe, family heirloom of the Dimwealds. This weapon belonged to Lando, the secondborn. He was loyal to the end.

d136740a38955449a0bb05b23c023a0f.name: Diamond Dust
d136740a38955449a0bb05b23c023a0f.desc: Ground down but not less sturdy. Every fragment catches light and splits it into cold blues and flickers of gold.

63000b7acfa0f149a076837432adbdc4.name: Prickle Pearl
63000b7acfa0f149a076837432adbdc4.desc: An ancient crossbreed that reminds you of a pomegranate or a fig that started to sprout — but the whiskers tickle conspicuously in the throat.

11ba86063a0cf0498e3e2a178bb7f6aa.name: Improved Overgrowth Tool
11ba86063a0cf0498e3e2a178bb7f6aa.desc:
A magical tool that allows you to fly while adding and removing various types of overgrowth to walls in your base. 

Requires being within the range of a Flame Altar to work.

0d90740a50fff04680743f689da4e673.name: Stone Column Base
0d90740a50fff04680743f689da4e673.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

bad258a430d2bf47a04b09cd92b8ba10.name: Boreal Wood Bench
bad258a430d2bf47a04b09cd92b8ba10.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

060d3d39253de845895e7415652cf1c7.name: Wildheart Pants
060d3d39253de845895e7415652cf1c7.desc: A pair of pants that fills you with a deep sense of duty despite their simplicity.

4ccc1fd35ced3f46ab933ba2c833c90e.name: Celestium Pickaxe
4ccc1fd35ced3f46ab933ba2c833c90e.desc: A pickaxe forged from basalt stone and celestium. The most durable of its kind.

900f32bdf73b5c4a8aec3214892bca33.name: Awning I
900f32bdf73b5c4a8aec3214892bca33.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

2b82bd434d733048b2e037c5b28872c3.name: Alchemist Apprentice Hat
2b82bd434d733048b2e037c5b28872c3.desc: Providing general protection and shade, the alchemist's apprentice hat is perfect for wandering around the world.

5f18b85db3b07442b6b17b8a17384c19.name: Enshrouded Axe
5f18b85db3b07442b6b17b8a17384c19.desc: A mighty axe which lusts for blood.

f0905ec206034545a3e4cdd22abd6403.name: Small Crypt Cupboard
f0905ec206034545a3e4cdd22abd6403.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

3a35146b186fb8439dd0ea907c89f76b.name: Ignited Hammer
3a35146b186fb8439dd0ea907c89f76b.desc: Inheriting the power of the Flame, this hammer can break through lines of enemies easily.

1c432a0e3091724190696f76b1553bf9.name: Fell Thunderbrute Head
1c432a0e3091724190696f76b1553bf9.desc: Its brain has been replaced by fungi and slush, but it's still tremendously heavy. The face is permanently petrified with a bitter expression.

0cf5ce7d0c6bc340a7a8a3657539f2f2.name: Marksman Boots
0cf5ce7d0c6bc340a7a8a3657539f2f2.desc: Woodland boots made of carefully layered leather straps.

f14c9c7583ce434981a5100f404942bd.name: Bound Tome
f14c9c7583ce434981a5100f404942bd.desc: Two leather straps, locked in place with enchanted ectoplasm crystals, seal away this tome's whispers. Despite being ancient, the fine aquamarine binding shows no signs of age or decay.

e1f90ef53adc0e4bb0e9b075d18ef508.name: Cutthroat Boots
e1f90ef53adc0e4bb0e9b075d18ef508.desc: The reinforced soles allow the wearer to skulk through the overgrowth undisturbed, and to reach vantage points quickly. Perfect for an ambush!

e1f99494f53cfc45ba2a735358b65654.name: Siren Seeker Pants
e1f99494f53cfc45ba2a735358b65654.desc: The cloth of these billowy pants falls in ripples like waves in the cerulean sea.

a83e177071e37149a675af3d0ad189fd.name: Fern
a83e177071e37149a675af3d0ad189fd.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

59bb893b78b479439b2397ab0a820331.name: Staff Of The Moor
59bb893b78b479439b2397ab0a820331.desc:
A sublime staff that carries an eerie visage and blank stare. Its face seems as if it were looking up at you from beneath the motionless surface of a black moor.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

c31e126b9697034081bfb1d4030a564d.name: Golden Ball
c31e126b9697034081bfb1d4030a564d.desc:
This palette presents a multitude of yellow tones, vibrant as a polished golden ball or crown carried by a princess.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

0d338f789865a0419f8d4b1eafd084e2.name: Iron Fence
0d338f789865a0419f8d4b1eafd084e2.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c279331d5bd1be438677c53615d14bde.name: Pinewood Room Divider I
c279331d5bd1be438677c53615d14bde.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6443387e84360242bb1317d4acb4981b.name: Shadowbloom Plant
6443387e84360242bb1317d4acb4981b.desc: A large potted plant to beautify your home.

b62f094127041540a4166ea1df6f0a5b.name: Wolf's Fang Boots
b62f094127041540a4166ea1df6f0a5b.desc: These spiked boots can cause a lot of damage when used to pierce arteries in one, swift swinging kick.

83b39a7d884edf4d8c4e47eb059c621b.name: Bronze Hollow Wispwyvern Trophy
83b39a7d884edf4d8c4e47eb059c621b.desc:
You checked twice for a pulse, just to make sure it's dead. Skeletons normally don't have one, and this one is covered in bronze... You're probably in the clear.

Collect multiple Hollow Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

6e6e771b4ad206469a4b4d4b4d2217c4.name: Fire Bowl
6e6e771b4ad206469a4b4d4b4d2217c4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c4caa7f0e7aeed43a1dfca06ea9a9958.name: Steel Wall Torch
c4caa7f0e7aeed43a1dfca06ea9a9958.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

9dc17f3752e8b641a0ab19eeb52a6634.name: Notice Board
9dc17f3752e8b641a0ab19eeb52a6634.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ba56d29590f90841903520c38d404380.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

928b9225be4a3d43bfc44c271c232e5c.name: Brittle Shroud Petals
928b9225be4a3d43bfc44c271c232e5c.desc:
Delicate petals tainted by the Shroud. Their surface is coated in a faint, toxic residue. Though fragile on their own, they are surprisingly resilient when woven into armor.

Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

06918ad07e0b424e902dee842224635e.name: Staff Wall Mount
06918ad07e0b424e902dee842224635e.desc: A display to showcase weapons or shields.

0cb7d43f6c299d40bb385f6795c8d753.name: Deerstalker Boots
0cb7d43f6c299d40bb385f6795c8d753.desc: Stalking prey in these boots makes barely any sound. None will hear you coming.

2cea1b0c7d083645bc45e7b8ec26c697.name: Straw Pile
2cea1b0c7d083645bc45e7b8ec26c697.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

b9a0ea93e5eed84094290a498d04d8eb.name: Crude Wooden Platter
b9a0ea93e5eed84094290a498d04d8eb.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

29f3383a9079a2499c2d0e1654092e10.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

8d256c315204754196c10718a6221558.name: Rising Fighter Helmet
8d256c315204754196c10718a6221558.desc: A head piece to keep your skull safe when diving into battle.

f34a0be37559fe418cd108b2dbd929ec.name: Temple Keeper's Bow
f34a0be37559fe418cd108b2dbd929ec.desc: Instead of exploiting the ruins of forgotten times, you vow to protect them — to uphold their sanctity for reverence not only today, but tomorrow.

6b69501822c0fd4a8778847cb16fb961.name: Shiitake Mushroom
6b69501822c0fd4a8778847cb16fb961.desc: Shiitake mushrooms work wonders for deepening the flavor of any dish.

289a1a35b0a32e4f90f453b71eea7010.name: Entangle II
289a1a35b0a32e4f90f453b71eea7010.desc:
Grows entangling roots in an area that apply a debuff to enemies which prevents them from moving for a short duration.
Rooted enemies are still able to perform attacks and bigger ones are slowed instead of rooted. 

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

7a24499a4a47cf4aa175be547303011e.name: Constantio's Constructeer, V1.0
7a24499a4a47cf4aa175be547303011e.desc: A construction hammer used by the Ancients to create their multi-purpose constructs. It was created to be incredibly lightweight to reduce the breaks workers would initiate from tired arms.

c5ba20ef64612b49b312fa6091ed1377.name: Mace-like Club
c5ba20ef64612b49b312fa6091ed1377.desc: Don't let the image deceive you. It might look like a mace, but it's a primitive club after all.

f2a5ce5feba4d1499c5ecaef7261eb80.name: Critter Carapace
f2a5ce5feba4d1499c5ecaef7261eb80.desc:
A carapace that protects the soft critter's flesh underneath.

Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

980a6ab846fb5240ac282a9b90d58f71.name: Bonestorm II
980a6ab846fb5240ac282a9b90d58f71.desc:
Conjures a flurry homing bone projectiles that hunt down enemies with crushing force.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

09673d2f7bd7404cb340aa6fd20cfa66.name: Proud Daggers
09673d2f7bd7404cb340aa6fd20cfa66.desc:
Daggers with many edges and sharp hooks. They can be whipped out in the blink of an eye to parry incoming attacks, thus defending your honor.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

424de563ad341342bbff5eba33f9b44e.name: Scavenger Artificer Head
424de563ad341342bbff5eba33f9b44e.desc: The severed head of the Scavenger Artificer. Without its harpoon or turret you have nothing to worry about.

595e4c6bbfe5f6458b4d7b0849781404.name: Bright Resolve
595e4c6bbfe5f6458b4d7b0849781404.desc:
The brightness of the yellow tinge makes it appear almost fluorescent. While shining brighter than the sun, the thought of defeat becomes lost in the radiance.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

3dbca7a268c9c34f9aa2a5d839bf63c5.name: Archaic Infusion
3dbca7a268c9c34f9aa2a5d839bf63c5.desc: Refined from materials that predate recorded history, this infusion carries properties that resist easy explanation. The Ancient Researcher knows what to do with it.

1f316e67697aca428c276d79816dd224.name: Steel Bucket
1f316e67697aca428c276d79816dd224.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4965c31af4bec54b92851faeede07537.name: Steel Moon Axe
4965c31af4bec54b92851faeede07537.desc: An axe with two perfectly rounded, balanced steel blades. They nearly form the shape of the full moon.

5d38c1f1ec4edd439461d1b844c009de.name: Pink Flower
5d38c1f1ec4edd439461d1b844c009de.desc: A small potted plant to beautify your home.

69d2f5dcf1827040965949bfce7392e6.name: Guard of the North Boots
69d2f5dcf1827040965949bfce7392e6.desc: Sodden boots that strode through the knee-high snow of Albaneve Summits under foreboding northern lights. After marching through countless midnight hours, Lord Vorgoth finally reached the gates of Pikemead's Reach, weapon raised high.

c16e7e94b696e147a78f7d67c1054e45.name: Gormander's War Banner II
c16e7e94b696e147a78f7d67c1054e45.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6e3059e61f82c7469bff905c7041b7ad.name: Rising Fighter Chest
6e3059e61f82c7469bff905c7041b7ad.desc: Light, polstered and ready to take a few hits — the perfect chest armor for a beginner.

52028692aa0bf64dba6079cf3e0b46c1.name: Nomad Highlands Rubble
52028692aa0bf64dba6079cf3e0b46c1.desc: A mix of different biome-specific materials, mainly stone and dirt.

6010591682646341a51dab7582775027.name: Wood Banister VI
6010591682646341a51dab7582775027.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f85e7b3bb7a61143b96a12455818f709.name: Tank Trousers
