f85e7b3bb7a61143b96a12455818f709.desc: These padded trousers have been hastily stitched at the seams. Despite that, they hold up well.

3f40a80989242548a7127a31db59d123.name: Ancient Ceiling Mobile I
3f40a80989242548a7127a31db59d123.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

dc5ca897905ef84aa54b74d246265ca4.name: Training Doll III
dc5ca897905ef84aa54b74d246265ca4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1d05e227ce6bf34dadccfd02f19644a8.name: Measuring Device II
1d05e227ce6bf34dadccfd02f19644a8.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

96e3476f17d64a4ab3954ff033826ba1.name: Grapple Plant Seedling
96e3476f17d64a4ab3954ff033826ba1.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

0f5ac00fb193514ab0705ba1c7294ac0.name: Pocket Heater
0f5ac00fb193514ab0705ba1c7294ac0.desc: After Ignition the leather limits the amount of air around the coal, causing it to burn slower. This will keep you warm for a bit.

ef8f357ecd29c14baeca7b7658daca66.name: Guardian Boots
ef8f357ecd29c14baeca7b7658daca66.desc: Hefty boots. They will leave considerable footprints in the ground when you defend those in need.

35276f992a9019468879822fd7df0490.name: Bronze-engraved Greatsword
35276f992a9019468879822fd7df0490.desc: A formidable greatsword, forged with a copper and tin alloy. Its maker took the time to carefully etch harmoniously flowing lines into it, which spill from the ricasso towards the centre of the blade.

1b845fd0a4f46c4382363f011fdb6f4e.name: Balefire Brazier
1b845fd0a4f46c4382363f011fdb6f4e.desc:
A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.

8dc8028b48645649abcf9b82f691b6a9.name: Improved Fishing Rod
8dc8028b48645649abcf9b82f691b6a9.desc: A stronger rod, which makes it easier to reel in a fish and you can also endure the fight longer.

86cdb42b5087434d88511f49bead51e6.name: Bamboo Bench
86cdb42b5087434d88511f49bead51e6.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

ecbfcc48ac601c46a5417eb225739b4c.name: Fluffy Pants
ecbfcc48ac601c46a5417eb225739b4c.desc: These pants are nothing special on the outside, but inside, they're lined with a fur layer.

a1f33b4d8bd58b4fa1819bb152149ab5.name: Rustic Chair
a1f33b4d8bd58b4fa1819bb152149ab5.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

d2d533d0ce7ffb4098dc10f193aadc92.name: Eternal Chain Lightning II
d2d533d0ce7ffb4098dc10f193aadc92.desc:
Releases a lightning strike at an enemy that can arc to multiple other nearby targets.
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. 

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

2e3870410201bd408e5f0f21ef6e33d3.name: Large Ancient Temple Window Frame
2e3870410201bd408e5f0f21ef6e33d3.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

78b6aa90925e9c47b24d9760098419a7.name: Darya's Staff
78b6aa90925e9c47b24d9760098419a7.desc:
A staff that harnesses the power of the eclipsed sun. It functions best when only a crescent of light is left.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

5be94ac304b15c47a69c31d32fcd64ad.name: Sky Specter Gloves
5be94ac304b15c47a69c31d32fcd64ad.desc: Gloves with added metal rims that glisten like daggers in the dead of night.

aa7658d81af68d43b54415f29247b040.name: Wall Tapestry Piece
aa7658d81af68d43b54415f29247b040.desc:
A ripped piece of a wall tapestry. Find both missing pieces to reassemble the scenery!

Both pieces can be found in the Albaneve Summits.

3c0253c12903304d82778e8f56b3b06a.name: Algae Salad
3c0253c12903304d82778e8f56b3b06a.desc: An algae salad that tastes fresh and vaguely salty, like the sea. Something so green and natural must be healthy.

93959307b2a2614daec970b088496874.name: Helix
93959307b2a2614daec970b088496874.desc:
A perplexing wand, corrupted by the Shroud. It bends the mind of its bearer.

Ethereal Duplication:
The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

9b345b85efe72243b870182409313e2f.name: Chieftain's Hammer
9b345b85efe72243b870182409313e2f.desc: An elaborate weapon adorned with prized horns, probably trophies from past hunts. At times, the Drak would make sacrifices to their gods in Ark Morgo to channel their elemental affinities. Therefore, this axe of a tribal chief was imbued with the power of lightning to aid in their pursuits.

c2bfbe3534bab94bbb2dc098238121d0.name: Exceptional Ectoplasm Soup
c2bfbe3534bab94bbb2dc098238121d0.desc: It contains ice and gentian — a failed attempt at herbal iced tea? Its strengths certainly do not lie in its taste.

739e476f4dd41c4eb6b83cbebb76f3f9.name: Small Telescope
739e476f4dd41c4eb6b83cbebb76f3f9.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

35e9f035b0373947972ec07c4fabfe13.name: Scrap Standing Torch
35e9f035b0373947972ec07c4fabfe13.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

c1f2efb89bfcca4f963904e17d795e70.name: Hollow Halls Showcase (2 Medium Slots)
c1f2efb89bfcca4f963904e17d795e70.desc: This is a showcase for Hollow Artifact Collection Items usually found in the Hollow Halls.

c1f255ff434d3843b3f17b6733eac79f.name: Blink Daggers
c1f255ff434d3843b3f17b6733eac79f.desc:
Striking in the blink of an eye, these daggers can slash any throat quickly and quietly.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

63cacdadf410c743896101e434210f68.name: Milk
63cacdadf410c743896101e434210f68.desc: A delicious jug of milk. Drinking it will grant you stamina and recharge your stamina faster!

7d298906accb3644a253da93d0afb410.name: Valor Heart Daggers
7d298906accb3644a253da93d0afb410.desc:
A dagger that can easily be hidden underneath lavish sleeves or dressy skirts. It's quick and easy to unsheath in times of need!

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

11842b4f2c4b0d46a0a4e671978e6599.name: Graveyard Fence Pole
11842b4f2c4b0d46a0a4e671978e6599.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

06d7d34f60f0574e88c18c9948884784.name: Hollow Halls Showcase (1 Large Slot)
06d7d34f60f0574e88c18c9948884784.desc: This is a showcase for Hollow Artifact Collection Items usually found in the Hollow Halls.

a2726aa8bcb974449a3f28c2758c74fa.name: Gentian
a2726aa8bcb974449a3f28c2758c74fa.desc: A star-shaped blossom that blooms in the high-up mountains. It grants more mana when consumed.

ffbe9f2453c70446ac786cf1a4d9994e.name: Quetzal Hunter Shoes
ffbe9f2453c70446ac786cf1a4d9994e.desc: In these shoes, you glide through the thicket effortlessly, barely breaking a sweat.

94d4d1768a43ad46a264ecda22994417.name: Bamboo Room Divider I
94d4d1768a43ad46a264ecda22994417.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

dd1ede0920dac745a05f24b3d0a9e0c2.name: Nitrate
dd1ede0920dac745a05f24b3d0a9e0c2.desc: An alchemical acid used to create explosive substances.

75bfd22743127843b1f48c744e694ce9.name: Red Wall Banner
75bfd22743127843b1f48c744e694ce9.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

90ba650b45d5f44bb274d6a30451b5e2.name: Grass
90ba650b45d5f44bb274d6a30451b5e2.desc: A small potted plant to beautify your home.

aa19a3d2f28ac64198f0adf578ab0f99.name: Metal Bound Wooden Door
aa19a3d2f28ac64198f0adf578ab0f99.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

bbd49d4b9376df4d81e1f199ce5475b6.name: Hailscourge
bbd49d4b9376df4d81e1f199ce5475b6.desc: A blade that's cold to the touch. It weighs heavily on the mind.

df449209cf60234d8a954d9b97ef2aa6.name: Magician Hat
df449209cf60234d8a954d9b97ef2aa6.desc: This magician's headgear frames the wearer's face with a luscious golden trim.

e1c3e91e6eb3c24782a5c0b363cd7750.name: Archmage Trousers
e1c3e91e6eb3c24782a5c0b363cd7750.desc: The pants are elegantly held together with cobalt stitching and thread. The color represents sophistication and the superiority of the mind.

53ceb03aa8c64f4b9ab9213fb937d1a2.name: Scout Gloves
53ceb03aa8c64f4b9ab9213fb937d1a2.desc: Excellent tools to scout with — especially due to their grip and padding.

cb8766eef519ee4a905156791da4d40f.name: Wooden Bathtub
cb8766eef519ee4a905156791da4d40f.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

7dcc87b65d61cc4da2a4ae8098276baa.name: Large Bamboo Crate
7dcc87b65d61cc4da2a4ae8098276baa.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

52290e166759d94d9ea4f3e4d63b9cad.name: Eternal Frost Arrow I
52290e166759d94d9ea4f3e4d63b9cad.desc:
An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's ice-cold to the touch.

Eternal Arrow: Does not deplete Ammo per use. Equip the Eternal Arrow and use Mana to shoot it with a Bow.

f01cb1c195ab6844abfe1a4c0996f4f4.name: Red Flower
f01cb1c195ab6844abfe1a4c0996f4f4.desc: A small potted plant to beautify your home.

8a8738c1b364f04abe141fee59d24fbc.name: Turquoise Hair
8a8738c1b364f04abe141fee59d24fbc.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

fddd7707eacfba4795d7c7e5d8b95722.name: Shield Wall Mount
fddd7707eacfba4795d7c7e5d8b95722.desc: A display to showcase weapons or shields.

356d5adc79816a4faab3ea9b73d909bd.name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Cloak
356d5adc79816a4faab3ea9b73d909bd.desc: This ceremonial robe belonged to an honorable "Scholar of the Empyrean", worn during sacred offerings in the Night Sanctums. Wear this piece with the same pride the previous owner did.

377a87787f531e419aabbbea261f58bb.name: Giant Bone Arrow III
377a87787f531e419aabbbea261f58bb.desc:
An arrow made from bone.

The force of this arrow allows it to pierce hit targets to harm multiple foes.

5966b13b8230b243a6d23c70e96c4ae0.name: The Needles
5966b13b8230b243a6d23c70e96c4ae0.desc:
A fine pair of twin daggers meant to pierce arteries with precision and grace.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

216a3ee5ad30374dbb62c121ff50f471.name: Lightning Shaman Staff
216a3ee5ad30374dbb62c121ff50f471.desc:
This staff is powered by an orb that attracts lightning during thunderstorms. It stores the captured electricity and can unleash it again at a later point.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

bf0036cc1725e244b3be81211a89acff.name: Exclusive Hollow Pants
bf0036cc1725e244b3be81211a89acff.desc: Pants fit for a midnight march. The metal plating is polished enough to reflect the moonlight.

77c637715b41da49bd8d2f1cb5614712.name: Carved Limestone Vase I
77c637715b41da49bd8d2f1cb5614712.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

82d8aa98bab0064494d7cb8da8325609.name: Wooden Grate I
82d8aa98bab0064494d7cb8da8325609.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

3c674d8fb33feb49b0b582980bc9705d.name: Grass
3c674d8fb33feb49b0b582980bc9705d.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

64eeb3e6aa877a48ba9234626df7cad1.name: Lifelock Boots
64eeb3e6aa877a48ba9234626df7cad1.desc: Gray boots that have been darkened by smoke and ash.

082df242d96b634ab9a17070b0f65b05.name: Sparkworks Switchbox
082df242d96b634ab9a17070b0f65b05.desc: Used to add and edit Sparkworks graphs.

20ad4e8a306d4749afac8940d4fa389d.name: Flame Pact Vest
20ad4e8a306d4749afac8940d4fa389d.desc: The best way to elevate your outfit is by extensively adding belts and straps to an inflationary degree, or so they say. A golden sigil on the chest signals your dedication to the Flame.

8e4b5ccd7f3d7d4e8a1491d72735c5c8.name: Scavenger Gong
8e4b5ccd7f3d7d4e8a1491d72735c5c8.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

2c9585089de3f64390a2e8428ae2a060.name: Spellbreaker Chest
2c9585089de3f64390a2e8428ae2a060.desc: The fabric of this coat is thick enough to protect against incoming blows. Additionally, the inner lining follows the direction of the body's veins, allowing the wearer to unleash short-range magic more easily.

a8abf8de8340604b885fc9ae74594963.name: Alpine Rose
a8abf8de8340604b885fc9ae74594963.desc: A large potted plant to beautify your home.

833f9d362c513245bd74c8f157bd7e20.name: Winterly Chest
833f9d362c513245bd74c8f157bd7e20.desc: A long furry coat, often worn by the citizens of the Albaneve Summits. It's very cozy.

f6a469e438e74145885d6f46a52e801b.name: Parade Daggers
f6a469e438e74145885d6f46a52e801b.desc:
These spiky daggers were often worn by soldiers around their belts during parades as a show of force. Sometimes, children are gifted a simpler version as their first weapon.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

492ff4fbb35a0648b5504eed4caf6ac3.name: Gleam Root Diving Light
492ff4fbb35a0648b5504eed4caf6ac3.desc: A throwable light that activates upon landing, even underwater. Not as strong as other light sources.

3a836e12df2fc24fb9687964ab781f87.name: Frizzy Goat Milk
3a836e12df2fc24fb9687964ab781f87.desc: A delicious jug of Frizzy Goat milk. Drinking it will grant you stamina and stamina regeneration.

221fecc702768640b6473d2e70fcb176.name: Explorer Gloves
221fecc702768640b6473d2e70fcb176.desc: Fantastic gloves for digging up secrets, uncovering treasures, or cartographing never-before-seen lands!

11ca9c842132bc428dc1fbc4b5d5b147.name: Chain Heal I
11ca9c842132bc428dc1fbc4b5d5b147.desc:
Releases a mending ray that automatically seeks nearby allies.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

9fcadd1dd57eb54c9cf5175282a572df.name: Frostbite Slasher Chest
9fcadd1dd57eb54c9cf5175282a572df.desc: A breezy vest layered on top of a long shirt. The additional belt buckle strapped across the chest holds some spare blades.

8f54001bfcea5d4b9574f744887b87d1.name: Crude Wooden Bed
8f54001bfcea5d4b9574f744887b87d1.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

fe81ffff04341f468bfc0e1640060e80.name: Elite Hollow Pants
fe81ffff04341f468bfc0e1640060e80.desc: Cloth pants that are ripped and torn. A keen eye can spot sprinkles of dried blood on them.

bcf85367c084fe4b8ac2654ad98e08fc.name: Sunny Loungewear Boots
bcf85367c084fe4b8ac2654ad98e08fc.desc: These simple, comfortable boots are perfect for taking a stroll on a warm summer's day.

d4bd0edd811aa740b38fbe5dc5b98b03.name: Extraordinary Ectoplasm
d4bd0edd811aa740b38fbe5dc5b98b03.desc: A curious blend. Ground, mixed and left to settle. The important thing is that it works. Probably.

0f24252a05f0f144add8c4c59b84b45b.name: Small Decorated Tree
0f24252a05f0f144add8c4c59b84b45b.desc: A richly decorated and festive-looking tree.

4ead25d5c4f53d4694e98205f75dc00a.name: Drakling Daggers
4ead25d5c4f53d4694e98205f75dc00a.desc:
These daggers mark the next stage for young Drak after training with bamboo sticks. Their compact size makes them easy to wield even from an early age.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

541d393dc0972144a935ec9137ce20d2.name: Diamond Wall Emblem I
541d393dc0972144a935ec9137ce20d2.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f0a0385d0c9c3f43abca148dfea9bf1e.name: Plantain Salad with Aurora Beans
f0a0385d0c9c3f43abca148dfea9bf1e.desc: A hearty salad of cooked and roasted plantains, chopped vegetables, and aurora beans. Simple ingredients, satisfying results.

79c28b54d00f144a8f937e652ee5cd89.name: Flag Pole V
79c28b54d00f144a8f937e652ee5cd89.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d49e3de2ea6c9b41805c84dd86c4633e.name: Sunset Mace
d49e3de2ea6c9b41805c84dd86c4633e.desc: Its top is nearly entirely flat, its horizontal line only broken by the protruding rays of a setting sun. Pieces of cloth drape to either side, swaying in the wind like banners of an old reign.

70006d3247f5a44bbf3bca329a22e8e4.name: Talion's Bow
70006d3247f5a44bbf3bca329a22e8e4.desc: A bow used by Commanders of the Northern Guard. A powerful energy flows through the user, increasing their pulse and allowing for faster shots.

2e21b867b80c4a46b72f69c4db021490.name: Breaching Bow
2e21b867b80c4a46b72f69c4db021490.desc: A bow that breaches all — flesh, scales, borders. Nothing can withstand its might.

e8b9b2e590a2ed4fb0ad8709a4eb3c63.name: Iron Wall Torch
e8b9b2e590a2ed4fb0ad8709a4eb3c63.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

1c538c42fcaaaf4a9332b04b711d3b62.name: Carved Tropical Wood Fence with Ropes I
1c538c42fcaaaf4a9332b04b711d3b62.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4e8ecee85f468042b00c13798e4e0436.name: Middle Orrery Rings
4e8ecee85f468042b00c13798e4e0436.desc:
A set of orbital rings. When the inner, middle, and outer rings come together, they can display an entire planetary system.

Find all pieces and combine them on a display pillar!

aca228e4654e124a992a6d8ac3da428d.name: Vegetable Puree
aca228e4654e124a992a6d8ac3da428d.desc: Cooking is a delicate art form. This basic puree will aid any person on their way to becoming an exquisite chef.

27dfff4e856ec942b946b5669bb3c816.name: Gold Bars
27dfff4e856ec942b946b5669bb3c816.desc: Solid gold bars that serve as both a crafting material and a status symbol.

fb9e3b46a311ba449ab69eb80d47c62b.name: Bamboo Window II
fb9e3b46a311ba449ab69eb80d47c62b.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4690a04a59564b4b87d379fb7da53776.name: Market On A Yearfall's Day
4690a04a59564b4b87d379fb7da53776.desc:
This song uses a colorful soundscape to paint a lively market on a cold day. The bright tones illuminate the scenery like fairy lights. It makes you want to warm up with some mead!

Music Sheet: 
Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

4e6f95db88d1d54bb2dd193ef4822e5b.name: Thaumaturge Gloves
4e6f95db88d1d54bb2dd193ef4822e5b.desc: Elaborate armguards that shield the wearer from snow, rime, and grime. An amethyst has been inserted into the gem slot, enabling a better mana flow when spellcasting.

246c9ffa16c0aa4687c82e60a8e811b5.name: Exceptional Hand Drum
246c9ffa16c0aa4687c82e60a8e811b5.desc: An epic drum with finely painted blue lines on it. The pattern on top resembles a symmetrical star.

b760cae47764ce4a9215293ad5c7a3a0.name: Vorgoth's War Banner II
b760cae47764ce4a9215293ad5c7a3a0.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c9a199c06123244e891c5b67b5f331f3.name: Scavenger Scattershot Trophy
c9a199c06123244e891c5b67b5f331f3.desc: The Scavenger Scattershot used to spin toward you like a storm. Now he just hangs there, still.

db129c74613f3f488ba02dd1a037bdf9.name: Forest Beet
db129c74613f3f488ba02dd1a037bdf9.desc: A root brimming with energy, but not very effective in its raw form. Improves the Dexterity of the consumer.

4e5014e8f72caf4ba859f55ce6c8dd73.name: Small Crypt Sideboard
4e5014e8f72caf4ba859f55ce6c8dd73.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

aa21b6df5855cb4ab8b86d3889925504.name: Weathered Stone Block
aa21b6df5855cb4ab8b86d3889925504.desc: In ancient times, these blocks were used to build dungeons and catacombs. Nowadays, they are in bad condition, but still serve their purpose.

68c78315c9c50f419568db5fcedccc7f.name: Mace of Denial
68c78315c9c50f419568db5fcedccc7f.desc: It was customary in the far North to carry the dead to their graves while brandishing a steel mace. This presentation of stalwart strength in the face of death and terror would ward off evil spirits and guide the dead safely to the Northwinds of the afterlife.

68c79d2f81201c48a700945c864eb6b0.name: Sandstone
68c79d2f81201c48a700945c864eb6b0.desc: Sandstone mainly consists of big sand particles - a beautiful natural material and another wonder of nature to admire.

8fd8eb42eb704044ad1a4c704a4eba6d.name: Emberguard Chestplate
8fd8eb42eb704044ad1a4c704a4eba6d.desc: A venerated chestplate that reflects the light of the Mother Flame on its polished, angular surface. Anyone who brandishes this armor vows to be the sword of the Flame and the guard of the light.

0cc7ccb2cdc1f04cabc271904abea529.name: Red Wall Flower
0cc7ccb2cdc1f04cabc271904abea529.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

dad3c8ae22431640896116ce3f3e22c4.name: Flame Pact Hat
dad3c8ae22431640896116ce3f3e22c4.desc: A floppy hat with red feathers.

ee138f5acc1a9647a7232896a7079b99.name: Soldier Gloves
ee138f5acc1a9647a7232896a7079b99.desc: Few enemies can withstand even an unarmed blow dealt with these gloves.

1d53da4d2ff5034aae6e58f5a8099082.name: Wooden Sink
1d53da4d2ff5034aae6e58f5a8099082.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

148d26a844b68f4ea5ff5d0100330553.name: Eternal Frost Arrow III
148d26a844b68f4ea5ff5d0100330553.desc:
An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's ice-cold to the touch.

Eternal Arrow: Does not deplete Ammo per use. Equip the Eternal Arrow and use Mana to shoot it with a Bow.

de7b1ee2810802409a01b6c6dbed515b.name: Copper Platter
de7b1ee2810802409a01b6c6dbed515b.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

40d2c97d9eaf1347a517eeea1abb9c54.name: Bronze Wall Torch
40d2c97d9eaf1347a517eeea1abb9c54.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

9bc04dd5381ac647b936ee786a2a94e0.name: Tank Boots
9bc04dd5381ac647b936ee786a2a94e0.desc: A shiny pair of boots. They're so heavy that you'll practically be immovable when wearing them.

c5cacef31ee6ee41a321e21cd36ba0d9.name: Wolf's Maw
c5cacef31ee6ee41a321e21cd36ba0d9.desc: A blade that devours foes easily. It carved its name into countless bodies in battle.

95ade0f2fdd43941849b719dbac42b07.name: Scrap Vat II
95ade0f2fdd43941849b719dbac42b07.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

3f6f2b22ead97d45a445f3c56287363a.name: Gem of Retaliation
3f6f2b22ead97d45a445f3c56287363a.desc: Blocking damage has a %k chance to add %k bonus blunt damage to the next attack within the next few seconds and increases the pushback.

4633ff633555124aa0022054fc46959e.name: Trap Fireball
4633ff633555124aa0022054fc46959e.desc:
A Trap Fireball which can be used as spell ammunition.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

3ac955cc477cd44ab0fcd7e120fd1ac8.name: Hanging Lantern
3ac955cc477cd44ab0fcd7e120fd1ac8.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

1cd76dff3e5bef4b9350a342b1a1c9e4.name: Pink Flower
1cd76dff3e5bef4b9350a342b1a1c9e4.desc: A tiny potted plant to beautify your home.

3c6f4e939b0bcc41ad927631ad6a7cac.name: Limestone Road Block
3c6f4e939b0bcc41ad927631ad6a7cac.desc: A road material made from limestone. It is much lighter and warmer-toned than similar road materials.

2f59aa6e1674f643b5017bb6a6cdc270.name: Archaic Core
2f59aa6e1674f643b5017bb6a6cdc270.desc: Pulled from the chest of a fallen construct, it still hums faintly. It's heavier than it looks. Whatever made them move lives inside that.

312e8fcb7f546143aba04b79646c74e8.name: Ancient Chair
312e8fcb7f546143aba04b79646c74e8.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

215378f6962fb84899e1f499f04fd6cb.name: Veilwater Basin Boardwalk I
215378f6962fb84899e1f499f04fd6cb.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4ef328f5cbdec54aaa6ad9ab15d04e3a.name: Carpet
4ef328f5cbdec54aaa6ad9ab15d04e3a.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

77afc368d672f24e92c679a90e258089.name: Fae Deer Farmer Boots
77afc368d672f24e92c679a90e258089.desc: A short-sleeved linen shirt that's topped with an orange fur cape. The cape flows down the wearer's back and ends in pieces that wave in the wind like a tail.

b5676021efc5364a9e0ac2f064f7d3b8.name: Rising Fighter Helmet
b5676021efc5364a9e0ac2f064f7d3b8.desc: A head piece to keep your skull safe when diving into battle.

25bad80b43d75c429947147004b3cb9a.name: Club
25bad80b43d75c429947147004b3cb9a.desc: A club carved out of wood. Not much, but better than nothing.

8e53a9e978e8bc4aa49237c7f6271edf.name: Tomato Seedling
8e53a9e978e8bc4aa49237c7f6271edf.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

74d0b608691df247bb70c8cee9f881a3.name: Darya's Remorse
74d0b608691df247bb70c8cee9f881a3.desc:
A wand that burns as bright as the sun. It's decorated with a flower that wraps around the handle, blooming near the hilt. Despite its radiance, it carries a dark energy — is it remorse, or the curse of the Shroud?

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Ethereal Duplication:
The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

550fcec5f8817247962e5e72411d9b4e.name: Lakehopper
550fcec5f8817247962e5e72411d9b4e.desc:
The Lakehopper is an agile fish that you might see "hopping" across the surface of a shallow lake — if you're lucky.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

ddaa34a3c8573f4997f1ab9cc6d5a366.name: Sunpiercer Shoes
ddaa34a3c8573f4997f1ab9cc6d5a366.desc: Thanks to their wrapping technique, these shoes provide good support while still allowing you to remain agile.

e16edd7b70f5e249be17318252434710.name: Spider Web IV
e16edd7b70f5e249be17318252434710.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

3ef4b5883614dc499b1ac58a5a6a2159.name: Aureolin Flower
3ef4b5883614dc499b1ac58a5a6a2159.desc: A beautiful yellow flower with magical properties that increases the user's mana.

de1e5d82a385d34491431d4e51d9fdcb.name: Broodmother’s Eye
de1e5d82a385d34491431d4e51d9fdcb.desc:
These Daggers are adorned with crystal inlays shaped like eyes, a constant reminder to their wielders that the Broodmother Vesztah watches them at all times. It is believed that she guides their hand — ensuring that only the strongest may hatch, while the weak are struck down by the blade's edge.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

3a8bc1e9dd6cdf4da0a2707e9c9e0b01.name: Ancient Ring of Mana
3a8bc1e9dd6cdf4da0a2707e9c9e0b01.desc: This ring will increase your mana and its replenishment.

00c430a860c5de4384bf22a82375eb8f.name: Cyclone Axe
00c430a860c5de4384bf22a82375eb8f.desc: A two-handed weapon with an unceasing swing. It holds the power to perpetually renew itself and the wielder, like the self-nourishing winds of a cyclone.

34c8df192ac26e41aaeb7e839fba6381.name: Staff Of The Serpent
34c8df192ac26e41aaeb7e839fba6381.desc:
A majestic staff topped with an ouroboros ornament made from green jade. It's perfect for honoring the year of the snake.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

edf630c3fc5cc543a87ba0187a35f7a2.name: Medium Plant Pot
edf630c3fc5cc543a87ba0187a35f7a2.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

2227d757b73a274cb738aabfb9c56d48.name: Healer Boots
2227d757b73a274cb738aabfb9c56d48.desc: No need to keep these boots clean and neat. They will get bloody. Your teammates will make sure of that.

0773d6b85322bc4ba09035cdd1758a16.name: Cube 2m
0773d6b85322bc4ba09035cdd1758a16.desc: This tool can only be used inside the building area around a Flame Altar. It can help you to quickly build your desired base with pre-defined structures.

eab96f903ff2eb4e8700c029a1d82f83.name: Large Crypt Coffin I
eab96f903ff2eb4e8700c029a1d82f83.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

84f3edb69dedfb47953f3d477ae79e1c.name: Drak Whistle Bow
84f3edb69dedfb47953f3d477ae79e1c.desc: This bow was fashioned after the likeness of the Drak'Dal, even though they don't use such weapons themselves. An arrow shot from this bow will split the air like the sharp whistle of the drakian tongue.

1c7a5c6a06c98a4c834f09c0cc36f479.name: Flask of the Fell
1c7a5c6a06c98a4c834f09c0cc36f479.desc:
The Shroud grants power to not only the Fell, but to whoever drinks from this flask.

Increases stamina by 20.

220818930fe3a34f98f35dfed32edc73.name: Shroud Particles
220818930fe3a34f98f35dfed32edc73.desc: Contains a higher Shroud concentration compared to spores.

9531eae8d8028e4abbd54a578f2d67db.name: Wanderer's Boots
9531eae8d8028e4abbd54a578f2d67db.desc: A wanderer's boots, worn but still sturdy enough to carry your burdens on your journey.

6fe357714d410145880bfbfc03f7a02a.name: Flame Mosaic Piece V
6fe357714d410145880bfbfc03f7a02a.desc:
A small part of a shattered Flame mosaic. Perhaps you can piece it together if you find all the shards!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. The full collection includes 8 pieces. They can be reassembled into a mosaic inside a Flame Mosaic Frame. The Frame must be placed on the ground.

1a363fb4f69a014eb5814e1eb5357980.name: Ancient Stone Block
1a363fb4f69a014eb5814e1eb5357980.desc: The standard and favored building block among the Ancients.

7d39a1a0c411e2408fb17d7c3cad99ff.name: Bamboo Chair
7d39a1a0c411e2408fb17d7c3cad99ff.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

5f1184938dc52046b8035cb8013bd116.name: Strawberry Milkshake
5f1184938dc52046b8035cb8013bd116.desc: A delightful milkshake. Be careful with the sugar rush! It will regenerate your health and stamina.

74735dadbe9005428156bdcc6fa68a34.name: Grilled Algae Buds
74735dadbe9005428156bdcc6fa68a34.desc: These grilled algae buds can be sprinkled on your food to maximize flavor. They have added health benefits, too!

a979fbd6c803ea448ef08e07587e6d3f.name: Pearlfrost Mentor Hat
a979fbd6c803ea448ef08e07587e6d3f.desc: When wounded warriors see this hat peak up from the horizon, they know salvation is near. Then they notice that the hat is a little bit cone-shaped. They usually don't say anything about it, though.

801fe0b61c31a94e855158aec6dfbc49.name: Grilled Stripetail
801fe0b61c31a94e855158aec6dfbc49.desc: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

92e1a74fde486f41896171efaad87d9c.name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Gloves
92e1a74fde486f41896171efaad87d9c.desc: These black and gold gloves once carried the knowledge and secrets of the humans. Don't be intimidated by the power they literally once held.

bcc2b003e816924c8cd9a4536647bddc.name: Pink Wall Flower
bcc2b003e816924c8cd9a4536647bddc.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

44a2cf59000b1c4ca094eaadd23d9f49.name: Desert Temple Block
44a2cf59000b1c4ca094eaadd23d9f49.desc: A block of an ancient style, representing the architectural elements of the desert temples.

b38c3a3579fbe746be6b9005a1b41533.name: Crestflame Helmet
b38c3a3579fbe746be6b9005a1b41533.desc: Vibrant plumes emerge from the crest of this helmet and meander forth like smoke. They remind one of the Mother Flame's light as it fades against the dusk.

4e77781af86a58488e2057c07c6ac4ea.name: Violet Party Hat
4e77781af86a58488e2057c07c6ac4ea.desc: A fun little hat for fun little parties!

be2c9af288c8e94597dcd592482f5789.name: Spark
be2c9af288c8e94597dcd592482f5789.desc: A small amount of essence from the Flame! By feeding it back to the Flame Altar maybe it could become stronger and burn even brighter.

645bf16566216a4cb2a826e19aeed158.name: Dreadbane
645bf16566216a4cb2a826e19aeed158.desc: A large and powerful hammer that has been corrupted by the Shroud. Good for smashing bugs!

ef2335791ed11e40960863a7ff0353bd.name: Half Wooden Barrel
ef2335791ed11e40960863a7ff0353bd.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d3637a06144d554a8a2df6e87f0d5d65.name: Lumberer Gloves
d3637a06144d554a8a2df6e87f0d5d65.desc: Worn-out gloves with sun spots and a fur trim.

db1afbc02cbd56498093a80478b533b0.name: Skull Summoning Vessel IV
db1afbc02cbd56498093a80478b533b0.desc: Throw this mystical vessel to temporarily summon a skull companion.

db1a5d7f0c41b546b89acbb0d9bb60ef.name: Gem of Corruption
db1a5d7f0c41b546b89acbb0d9bb60ef.desc: Hitting an enemy applies a  mark that can stack up to 5 times.  Marked enemies will emit an explosion when no new stack of  mark has been added for %k or if the enemy dies. The explosion deals %k Shroud damage in a 1m radius. Each stack adds 0,5m and %k of the base damage to the explosion.

95f38d0913f71d46b63d365d6436e6cf.name: Shroud Arrow III
95f38d0913f71d46b63d365d6436e6cf.desc:
If you can't beat them, join them. 
This Special Arrow uses the power of the Shroud and disperses a cloud of it upon impact.

fb872fe61de91e48bd4d0aa96c6b5157.name: Axe Of Phobos
fb872fe61de91e48bd4d0aa96c6b5157.desc: You feel as though the axe creates a rift, a tear in the air with each swing. You peer through to see the nothingness, the vast expanse, the blackness far above. Who reigns in the sea of stars? Perhaps loneliness. Or fear.

9eb9e02d7b956d47bc60a7fc4fc307db.name: First Flameborn Reward Items
9eb9e02d7b956d47bc60a7fc4fc307db.desc: Find all Reward Items for the First Flameborn here.

5032b766562d884c977ebaa9105d147c.name: Blue Wall Banner II
5032b766562d884c977ebaa9105d147c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4e5835b8c67d4d44921227bd4ba9498e.name: Golden Bulwark Helmet
4e5835b8c67d4d44921227bd4ba9498e.desc: Just one look into those eyes and your enemies will want to turn the other way. That was your first line of defense, and you didn't have to lift a finger.

7ec238d0fee5094eb9807f80c07ad24d.name: Explosive Crawler
7ec238d0fee5094eb9807f80c07ad24d.desc:
A mindless, throwable drone made from critter carapaces. Once deployed, the crawler will seek the nearest enemy and combust.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

4a5462f283adcd4f9a5976a97693f777.name: Ornamented Vase I
4a5462f283adcd4f9a5976a97693f777.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ac6cf79be0cd0f4a9a9bacbabb92d244.name: Gold Hollow Cyclops Trophy
ac6cf79be0cd0f4a9a9bacbabb92d244.desc:
The Hollow Cyclops would certainly be delighted with his gilded teeth, with which he would grin menacingly at you.

Collect multiple Hollow Cyclops Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

61047ba86b4c2349805565aed55953f1.name: Tiny Chest
61047ba86b4c2349805565aed55953f1.desc: Crude, but easily crafted storage. It holds space for a few items.

5c674a59a6d6cb40a56d25b0857b2ac6.name: Marianne Reed
5c674a59a6d6cb40a56d25b0857b2ac6.desc: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

b497f0a7a8e4db40a06f701bf8796250.name: Yellow Hair
b497f0a7a8e4db40a06f701bf8796250.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

3f9667dffba03a4980ee26292d7ebdaa.name: Cat Food
3f9667dffba03a4980ee26292d7ebdaa.desc:
Nutritious Cat food for tame pets.

It must be placed inside the appropriate feeder.

fd0cbbd7ba82914a96d4e48b9392eb6d.name: Dog Pillow
fd0cbbd7ba82914a96d4e48b9392eb6d.desc: A soft pillow for your dog.

1711e6e99a223946ad76329a8ab53068.name: Puke Potion
1711e6e99a223946ad76329a8ab53068.desc:
Empties your stomach immediately and clears all active food buffs.
Sadly not effective against food poisoning.

d585768c1d6e8c41afc51fd9b40e723e.name: Grilled Bird Meat
d585768c1d6e8c41afc51fd9b40e723e.desc: A healthy protein rich snack. The color looks just perfect...

8c16c14eebae374aa4ad0a4f45d21c35.name: Blackmire Statue II
8c16c14eebae374aa4ad0a4f45d21c35.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d964278ca43f5544939848494439751b.name: Dragon's Wing
d964278ca43f5544939848494439751b.desc: Gain the strength of a dragon with this legendary weapon.

d24ab2c61c9461469459025b76cfa103.name: Wailing Blade
d24ab2c61c9461469459025b76cfa103.desc: An expertly crafted blade, balanced and sharp. Cuts through foes like a wail through the night. It bears the mark of a famous blacksmith from Pikemead's Reach.

29ecfeb260e393418367d4ae42a7798a.name: Jezmina's Apotheosis
29ecfeb260e393418367d4ae42a7798a.desc: An axe that carves a path through enemies, no matter what. Swinging it fearlessly makes it feel light as a feather.

3ad14c17192f1640ae13bd592a25c5d3.name: Ornate Wood Bow
3ad14c17192f1640ae13bd592a25c5d3.desc: A top-quality bow inspired by antlers. One might call it art.

d194583c354d63479e6d4e2f4f8fc7de.name: Guardian Boots
d194583c354d63479e6d4e2f4f8fc7de.desc: Hefty boots. They will leave considerable footprints in the ground when you defend those in need.

36d924b52cc5cc4eaf15eadea36a3de7.name: Pearlfrost Mentor Gloves
36d924b52cc5cc4eaf15eadea36a3de7.desc: With these padded gloves, you can easily scale any cliff to reach snowed-in souls in need.

085c19408a13e547b795b958a61e9472.name: Black Powder Ball
085c19408a13e547b795b958a61e9472.desc:
An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

74f764a5d5426948b5c8e5f09fe414fc.name: Wall Torch
74f764a5d5426948b5c8e5f09fe414fc.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

cca82dd0410163498f6fd5d8c0e50d9a.name: Glow Soup
cca82dd0410163498f6fd5d8c0e50d9a.desc: A weird brew emitting a blue glow... Nobody quite knows why.

d94580665c51fe459248baabc3803402.name: Plant Fiber Roof Block
d94580665c51fe459248baabc3803402.desc:
Used to build thatched roofs. A basic and reliable solution to keep your head from getting wet.

Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

6d84cfcd082ab44b9a0d9ad9ba458eff.name: Wooden Palisade IV
6d84cfcd082ab44b9a0d9ad9ba458eff.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d22b4986a10db14b9800d40d8c26f6ef.name: Beehive Smoker
d22b4986a10db14b9800d40d8c26f6ef.desc: Unlocks the ability to craft a Honey Beehive that provides honey and wax regularly.

1a9bb54b7e8b5b409354e888d85ca82b.name: Small Ancient Arc
1a9bb54b7e8b5b409354e888d85ca82b.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f0eec07ac0f80c4982c9d310f7047716.name: Flame Mosaic Piece I
f0eec07ac0f80c4982c9d310f7047716.desc:
A small part of a shattered Flame mosaic. Perhaps you can piece it together if you find all the shards!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. The full collection includes 8 pieces. They can be reassembled into a mosaic inside a Flame Mosaic Frame. The Frame must be placed on the ground.

9afa27241bc6e34f929d40cf06ebb62a.name: Instrument Holder
9afa27241bc6e34f929d40cf06ebb62a.desc: An object that allows you to display your instruments.

e92a60918f7b0b4eb4bd8aeb8e45a3aa.name: Blizzard Wand
e92a60918f7b0b4eb4bd8aeb8e45a3aa.desc:
The frozen root wrapped around the icy core of this wand spirals like the howling winds of a blizzard.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

e92a0a1fb90f37449e543c0ad4b41693.name: Clay Jug
e92a0a1fb90f37449e543c0ad4b41693.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4bb906036d31fc4d86e9732d112b85e4.name: Ruffian's Axe
4bb906036d31fc4d86e9732d112b85e4.desc: A broad and imposing axe. If you want to leave a fearsome impression, this weapon will do the trick.

2ca56f922321854fa3ae707b0bd75be2.name: Large Ancient Window Frame
2ca56f922321854fa3ae707b0bd75be2.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6c089bd6750b664d8c50160e031cc126.name: Flame Pact Boots
6c089bd6750b664d8c50160e031cc126.desc: Brown boots equipped with belt buckles and shoe laces. Perfect for a stroll through your wonderful village, castle, or underground bunker.

de26962c2abc8348b27e5d95f590d954.name: Scrap Daggers
de26962c2abc8348b27e5d95f590d954.desc:
A pair of rudimentary and jagged Scavenger daggers. These are commonly wielded by the weakest of the pack, also called Scabs.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

97fbaf73e371d84a8dc718e79575b00f.name: Large Ancient Temple Bench
97fbaf73e371d84a8dc718e79575b00f.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

7c22e713b006b54685fa02817fbbc2ef.name: Fireball IV
7c22e713b006b54685fa02817fbbc2ef.desc:
Ignites a fireball projectile that erupts upon impact and deals damage in an area. 

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

a10b1fb77871b14f8988fc1b922c3cb7.name: Shroud Weaver
a10b1fb77871b14f8988fc1b922c3cb7.desc:
A malicious staff that effortlessly intertwines the strings of fate with the Shroud.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

dd932a9a70591f418080d2427e3c902e.name: Bamboo Barricade IV
dd932a9a70591f418080d2427e3c902e.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

062ddbd0250a584b998850817e74afa9.name: Light Blue Eyes
062ddbd0250a584b998850817e74afa9.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

ee9fa9221a86dd4cb1f7bbee633a2d93.name: Wide Carved Wooden Window Frame
ee9fa9221a86dd4cb1f7bbee633a2d93.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

b3d22beee46c5d4581568af3fb0157b8.name: Open Sandwich
b3d22beee46c5d4581568af3fb0157b8.desc: A relatively simple, but fortifying meal. Fast and ready to go!

3edd6d70c3cb824594312c92c380865d.name: Jezmina's Journey Begins
3edd6d70c3cb824594312c92c380865d.desc:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"Facing their downfall, Ancients and humans united to forge the Flameborn."

It was difficult to capture the likeness of my Ancient companions... and my own, too, no less! My hair has gotten so long. I did not even realize until I brought it on canvas! - J

31f81f2b043ffc43ad9646758f002bfd.name: Frostbite Slasher Gloves
31f81f2b043ffc43ad9646758f002bfd.desc: Padded gloves made from thick white cloth and deep blue leather arm guards. A small buckle and cyan string hold them together. The fingertips are left bare, so you can still feel the pulse of the hunt.

6ce97789d40e51409bd74d21055193a6.name: Shield Wall Emblem II
6ce97789d40e51409bd74d21055193a6.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6301f4c9e3bbbe41bf42febd0122a108.name: Cryptic Wand
6301f4c9e3bbbe41bf42febd0122a108.desc:
A strange wand that was covered by ashes. Its body bends and twists, but never breaks.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

075c3424b5eb46498ef9e22c16490cc5.name: Small Castle Sideboard
075c3424b5eb46498ef9e22c16490cc5.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c2d7057bb5f1a147a1d8700485a4dacc.name: Hydrak'Dal Trophy
c2d7057bb5f1a147a1d8700485a4dacc.desc:
A severed Hydrak'Dal Head with a regal headdress. Even now, it still exudes authority and a will to dominate.

Collect multiple Hydrak'Dal Heads to craft the Trophy.

48fd59e62234bb4c867756c4a39896d6.name: Metal Bound Wooden Double Door
48fd59e62234bb4c867756c4a39896d6.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

9abcc7855c4aee4095e105e8d03a2380.name: Golden Bulwark Boots
9abcc7855c4aee4095e105e8d03a2380.desc: You’ve likely never worn foot armor this light, but give it a shot — the chest plate’s weight needs counterbalancing somewhere.

270ec501cf80214391c64f947423509d.name: Pumpkin
270ec501cf80214391c64f947423509d.desc: Pumpkins are beloved for their sweet, earthy flavor in cooking and their sturdy, hollow shells for festive crafts.

db608a7fbc592442b63ad4173be485d3.name: Alpine Antler Boots
db608a7fbc592442b63ad4173be485d3.desc: A light pair of boots that allow for swift movements when wading through snow and blizzards. You can scout the frozen fringes of the mountains for miles when wearing these shoes!

2aee27af1bb9824ead9acb4f86869486.name: Farm Animal Pillow
2aee27af1bb9824ead9acb4f86869486.desc: A cozy bed for farm animals.

cacada14d1285f428801022951bcedbc.name: Knight Gloves
cacada14d1285f428801022951bcedbc.desc: Royal gloves, befitting a true knight of honor.

44c9952e20bdfa45832d211889041da8.name: Repair Kit
44c9952e20bdfa45832d211889041da8.desc: Repair your equipment on the go. Gradually restores a small amount of durability over time.

d5eafaaaa358eb418c8b64a9869ef041.name: Pearlfrost Mentor Gloves
d5eafaaaa358eb418c8b64a9869ef041.desc: With these padded gloves, you can easily scale any cliff to reach snowed-in souls in need.

2e314c9d53fa9547b1ce54d7ade49fdb.name: Emberguard Gloves
2e314c9d53fa9547b1ce54d7ade49fdb.desc: Proud gloves forged from the finest celestium. Two metal ridges protrude from each spine, enabling the warrior wearing them to push their way through hordes of enemies if needed.

7e08b61fc630f847a9ad02344a3e73a9.name: Flaming Heartbeat
7e08b61fc630f847a9ad02344a3e73a9.desc:
Feel the rhythm of life and the heat of battle with this energizing melody.

Music Sheet: 
Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

06efb03c8685a34086f58c34eaf0a18b.name: Eternal Chain Lightning I
06efb03c8685a34086f58c34eaf0a18b.desc:
Releases a lightning strike at an enemy that can arc to multiple other nearby targets.
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. 

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

326e8acd3cd4f94586d0d5de30c4309f.name: Bronze Fell Cyclops Trophy
326e8acd3cd4f94586d0d5de30c4309f.desc:
A mesmerizing display of overwhelming power, and little intelligence.

Collect multiple Fell Cyclops Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

50590788f0de4f439a4066e7a6206866.name: Hollow Titan Head
50590788f0de4f439a4066e7a6206866.desc: The Hollow Titan wears no face, only a featureless mask, with his plume swaying slightly with each step.

e119a334b52e594e94039b064b4adff7.name: Carved Tropical Wood Fence Pole
e119a334b52e594e94039b064b4adff7.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4cae8f0eb04c414ca2aa8a0f813ca11a.name: Small Polished Wooden Cupboard
4cae8f0eb04c414ca2aa8a0f813ca11a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

86888449f9ecc948966c85b86af3885d.name: Golden Bulwark Gloves
86888449f9ecc948966c85b86af3885d.desc: Blocking feels effortless in these gloves, and the crystals catch the sun with every move.

f072247844cd85428d112300b6463c54.name: Rustic Table
f072247844cd85428d112300b6463c54.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

0cf6cb4a48c6e348bef4c5f4fbe5ed8d.name: Hazelnut
0cf6cb4a48c6e348bef4c5f4fbe5ed8d.desc: A nice snack for the way. The strength it takes to crack its shell, it gives back upon consumption.

4133891f8774ee42bc31644147ee9180.name: Mountain's Shadow Helmet
4133891f8774ee42bc31644147ee9180.desc: A gloomy helmet, hiding an even darker gaze. The crest around the brow casts a shadow over the wearer's eyes, hiding their intention.

fd337fdd83635b49b3651138918a9e4c.name: Rusty Sword
fd337fdd83635b49b3651138918a9e4c.desc: A rusted Simple Copper Sword, damaged by time itself. Its best days are far gone.

1738e45903961241924eaae2abf211c9.name: Siren Seeker Gloves
1738e45903961241924eaae2abf211c9.desc: Small wonders hide amidst the seagrass of the shores, begging to be freed by nimble hands. What will you find betwixt the reeds today? A sharp edge made dull, a fallen star in the sand, a bottled siren's wish? The waves have a way of changing everything they claim, so be careful on your search!

0e79f73445a5794ca75966c5ad28e478.name: Ashwind Strider Chest
0e79f73445a5794ca75966c5ad28e478.desc: A layered gambeson that's wrapped in chains and free-flowing silk. Its dark color scheme makes it easy to walk the path of ash and dust unseen.

7fa6f3a7154e8a48bd13d8f78bf37330.name: Twilight Bloom
7fa6f3a7154e8a48bd13d8f78bf37330.desc:
When darkness falls, the passionflowers begin to bloom. In the night, their petals can shift to a muted pink, almost purple, while their cores continue to glow brightly.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

6ae6574a3968824c9c644bb73bd37c28.name: Serpent Warrior Boots
6ae6574a3968824c9c644bb73bd37c28.desc: These boots have an intricate scale pattern on their green plating.

c1ccb8094c419c4cba27c23a99c0257c.name: Crude Wooden Jug
c1ccb8094c419c4cba27c23a99c0257c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6ba82792ed8f764a9c8820b301b3dd74.name: Crude Wooden Door
6ba82792ed8f764a9c8820b301b3dd74.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

40018b43c605b4479e039bca4f76d8ff.name: Serpent Warrior Gloves
40018b43c605b4479e039bca4f76d8ff.desc: The sharp edges of these gloves that stretch towards the wearer's fingertips jot out like viper fangs.

526066a6bcb8b241a11224c9547756e7.name: Pink Flower
526066a6bcb8b241a11224c9547756e7.desc: A small potted plant to beautify your home.

f8bc575c242a824089a93a3b1ee2275a.name: Bronze Scavenger Matron Trophy
f8bc575c242a824089a93a3b1ee2275a.desc:
The inside of the helmet is strangely damp. There's sticky residue everywhere.

Collect multiple Scavenger Matron Helmets to craft the Bronze Trophy.

dd17824526eefd48a7b004ecee978bc5.name: Capybara Food
dd17824526eefd48a7b004ecee978bc5.desc:
Nutritious Capybara food for tame animals on your farm.

It must be placed inside the appropriate feeder.

e98f2e7a1b2e864abed5a9f556d46b89.name: Fell Broad Sword
e98f2e7a1b2e864abed5a9f556d46b89.desc: A heavy sword wielded by armored Fell soldiers and commanders.

1d6306437cfd1542b20e9747dd2e441d.name: Wailing Blade
1d6306437cfd1542b20e9747dd2e441d.desc: An expertly crafted blade, balanced and sharp. Cuts through foes like a wail through the night. It bears the mark of a famous blacksmith from Pikemead's Reach.

87ce41f53e80d447974dc78a859b83f0.name: Firefly Wall Lamp
87ce41f53e80d447974dc78a859b83f0.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

1b01f3bf3fbbae47b52ce142df4442fe.name: Bow Of The Serpent
1b01f3bf3fbbae47b52ce142df4442fe.desc: A strong bow that frames each shot between two serpents' maws. Let your arrows strike with the calculated savagery of a viper in waiting!

37b1c5e34321f146a8e091dc46d3854d.name: Ikko
37b1c5e34321f146a8e091dc46d3854d.desc:
A happy and carefree dog that likes to sleep in. It loves belly rubs and madly dashing in your general direction every time it sees you. 

You found this dog in a tower ruled by Hollow hounds, and a Hollow Warlock. The Warlock seemingly tried to create a vessel for a companion named "Ikko". You interrupted their ritual — but the name stuck.

317cbb838b82f74db9074ca6ed6522fe.name: Improved Water Well
317cbb838b82f74db9074ca6ed6522fe.desc:
This well is deep enough to tap into even the most hidden water reservoirs. 

It was improved and can reach the groundwater quicker.

3af8aec83aa3184e99ee662eb9e9dd74.name: Ragged Pants
3af8aec83aa3184e99ee662eb9e9dd74.desc: Enough to brace the worst of it, until better armor crosses your path.

7de478dde1acc64bb9cc9ca186b68fef.name: Flint
7de478dde1acc64bb9cc9ca186b68fef.desc:
A mix of flint and basalt, with a hint of faded lavender.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.

e7e381e287226b4ba3d81344adb9dcc2.name: Support Strut
e7e381e287226b4ba3d81344adb9dcc2.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

9bd0bff10514304c85633014b6a0c3e8.name: Jezmina's Apotheosis
9bd0bff10514304c85633014b6a0c3e8.desc: An axe that carves a path through enemies, no matter what. Swinging it fearlessly makes it feel light as a feather.

d8ae92b4461d9d42b9c886dc771f2679.name: Crude Wooden Cabinet
d8ae92b4461d9d42b9c886dc771f2679.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

a72b1efd29a3f140ac2ab5e1830af797.name: Gem of Storm's Eye
a72b1efd29a3f140ac2ab5e1830af797.desc:
Hitting an enemy puts a  mark on them for %k. Hitting a  marked enemy sends a lightning bolt to another  marked enemy, dealing %k damage. The attack can chain to more marked enemies. 

After lightning triggers, the effect has a %k cooldown before it can retrigger from the same enemy. After the cooldown, the  mark is refreshed.

57e18e8cf00cb143bfc78be07ff94f67.name: Ancient Column Block
57e18e8cf00cb143bfc78be07ff94f67.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f9d7c18a4a6c5041a9bd9ca9e239325f.name: Enshrouded Cyclops Eye
f9d7c18a4a6c5041a9bd9ca9e239325f.desc:
A massive, unblinking eye brimming with Shroud power. Its overwhelming energy is a critical element in crafting exotic high-level armor.

Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

c23c7c7f02270547b6dedcc26b5d709c.name: Simple Wooden Pole
c23c7c7f02270547b6dedcc26b5d709c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6a89a6a1bf64fc4b9038e078da037d76.name: Coffee Drum Roaster
6a89a6a1bf64fc4b9038e078da037d76.desc: A machine that's used to roast coffee beans. Necessary to make coffee.

23fbd25f11b7dd44b60cf87c00016eeb.name: Big Bronze Statue "Snake"
23fbd25f11b7dd44b60cf87c00016eeb.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

960364b893561a4a866ff1e3f180264e.name: Cyclops Showcase
960364b893561a4a866ff1e3f180264e.desc: A trophy stand, used to prop up the skeleton of a Cyclops.

b072d99a862e194ebc6801931aa4aa24.name: Desert City Wall
b072d99a862e194ebc6801931aa4aa24.desc: Modeled after Kindlewastes city walls. This block is an accurate replica.

0c7a13d9a4abfc4283d5c5e8d5f8da1a.name: Bonestorm III
0c7a13d9a4abfc4283d5c5e8d5f8da1a.desc:
Conjures a flurry homing bone projectiles that hunt down enemies with crushing force.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

2cad5ebb94dd7841b1bccfbbe6e53605.name: Fertile Blackmire Dirt
2cad5ebb94dd7841b1bccfbbe6e53605.desc:
A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. 

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

422fb7a105076d47a9796340871f065f.name: Bloomheart Fruit
422fb7a105076d47a9796340871f065f.desc: The Bloomheart Fruit takes it's time to ripen, but when it's ready something so juicy and sweet awaits you. It's worth the patience.

c785dca1ff494b4f8f6fa63d9967a61c.name: Book I
c785dca1ff494b4f8f6fa63d9967a61c.desc: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.

bfda5cf4d038264d8f75a2744e445ca4.name: Cat Bowl
bfda5cf4d038264d8f75a2744e445ca4.desc:
A little feeding bowl for your Cat.

It will feed your animals when filled with the corresponding food.

acf87140586e0944beb7734fd7d69e02.name: Entangle I
acf87140586e0944beb7734fd7d69e02.desc:
Grows entangling roots in an area that apply a debuff to enemies which prevents them from moving for a short duration.
Rooted enemies are still able to perform attacks and bigger ones are slowed instead of rooted. 

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

76526048adf4b94ebf789f360262473c.name: Grilled Cinderscale
76526048adf4b94ebf789f360262473c.desc: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

05e08860c19d304785d0fe6bd94fbc2e.name: Light Red Hair
05e08860c19d304785d0fe6bd94fbc2e.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

421088557340fa49b8e48e784ec657fe.name: Ring of Endless Life
421088557340fa49b8e48e784ec657fe.desc: Created in the pursuit of immortality, it cost countless lives and promises more to follow.

fc71592b0435e04f8597ba9e20332861.name: Tidecaller Shoes
fc71592b0435e04f8597ba9e20332861.desc: Stride forth in these shoes, as swiftly as your mana regenerates.

2baa2cc75da3a744ad141a6063995c1d.name: Orpheus' Map Piece
2baa2cc75da3a744ad141a6063995c1d.desc:
The fragment of a torn treasure map, found on a dragon skeleton in the Albaneve Summits. Perhaps you could reconstruct the map if you found all pieces?

There's writing on the back:

Orpheus' Memoir:
Once born a wanderer, I sought incandescence and bliss
Now I'm frozen in time, my body cast in chains
Accustomed to a sea of shadow, deep in the abyss
My eyes hurt in the brightness, so no light may remain

93b5d19d8207cc4fa524214d65ad4684.name: Fine Stone Fence
93b5d19d8207cc4fa524214d65ad4684.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6b0da6fd18bbf44fb6ca9d7ec10d4cdf.name: Meat and Azure Russula Skewer
6b0da6fd18bbf44fb6ca9d7ec10d4cdf.desc: It’s a simple combination — a mushroom and some meat on a skewer — but the flavor and the effects go a long way.

6634878b82c3f148baf79e979d625fa3.name: Hollow's Eve Gloves
6634878b82c3f148baf79e979d625fa3.desc: These dark gloves are ideal for going trick or treating!

2106a1195e3d664aa80cd07199ca4469.name: Grilled Thornridge
2106a1195e3d664aa80cd07199ca4469.desc: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

93968e8ba260c54c952a4cd92e2e3f06.name: Conifer Crate
93968e8ba260c54c952a4cd92e2e3f06.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1e8969ebe65bcb4a87ab0c00311a3d01.name: Skill Point
1e8969ebe65bcb4a87ab0c00311a3d01.desc: An item of power. Feed it to the Flame to gain its strength.

47c908e7f1a86546a964204211ffbbe2.name: Coffee Seedling
47c908e7f1a86546a964204211ffbbe2.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested repeatedly.

ee699aaf66b6904f824253a17d8f210d.name: Secret Castle Door
ee699aaf66b6904f824253a17d8f210d.desc: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.

35eafd098334514dbd284ebd990ab8fc.name: Wand Of Bloodflow
35eafd098334514dbd284ebd990ab8fc.desc:
Winding grooves carve through the body of the wand, creating a canal for extracting the lifeblood of your enemies. Their energy will fuel you long after they've passed.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

83fa7088e6045a4bac2aea13205ce469.name: Stone
83fa7088e6045a4bac2aea13205ce469.desc: The best stories start small. For example with a stone.

14e361f57d113a468dfe491c3b263570.name: Bonestorm I
14e361f57d113a468dfe491c3b263570.desc:
Conjures a flurry homing bone projectiles that hunt down enemies with crushing force.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

2d58b24d7eaafc4f97217f362c7bed9d.name: Sacrificial Vukah Dagger
2d58b24d7eaafc4f97217f362c7bed9d.desc:
A crude dagger, previously used by a Vukah in a bloody ritual.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

30c6797373940a488ada8bcd11c7d808.name: Deerstalker Hood
30c6797373940a488ada8bcd11c7d808.desc: The cloth straps attached to this mask glide softly in the breeze, helping to discern wind direction and speed.

13bf90df1e0fe3479adfba294f7c72ac.name: Drak Soulward Flask
13bf90df1e0fe3479adfba294f7c72ac.desc:
A dark concoction distilled from enemy remains. It unveils the writings of their kin and sharpens your blade against them.

Enables you to read Drakian writings and grants you additional damage against them.

dce152a5f9a1404d8aaace59fa20686d.name: Wolf's Claw
dce152a5f9a1404d8aaace59fa20686d.desc: Strikes with force and leaves devastating wounds. A weapon truly fitting its name.

a77167a5a16a4c4eb8e2275b72299597.name: Pikemead's Bulwark
a77167a5a16a4c4eb8e2275b72299597.desc:
Even in death, the Queen unites those who seek protection behind her shield. 

Parry
You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar.
Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

2b4d3b49d5566043be652205cb80f8b0.name: Fake Ancient Door
2b4d3b49d5566043be652205cb80f8b0.desc: Fool others looking for hidden passages in your base with this fake secret door.

611457df7bdca54ea4d4d305106505bc.name: Palm Wood Logs
611457df7bdca54ea4d4d305106505bc.desc: Logs of a freshly cut palm, ready to be processed to an item of choosing.

6bb054e982207442a8434b75ecbbb77b.name: Wolf's Fang Hood
6bb054e982207442a8434b75ecbbb77b.desc: A hood fashioned from the scalp of a white wolf. The fangs at the front are still attached.

f2ecc44fafdbe74fa0ff14b456acf384.name: Brazier
f2ecc44fafdbe74fa0ff14b456acf384.desc:
A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.

a8289aaabbfb3246bc571015732b60bf.name: Large Ancient Table
a8289aaabbfb3246bc571015732b60bf.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

1d6b679fd1adb649a17ee5d5e8a09642.name: Bow Of The Twin Moons
1d6b679fd1adb649a17ee5d5e8a09642.desc: The decorative orbs attached to the bow's body light up and darken in sync. Always together, chained to an otherworldly rhythm, an ebb and flow from beyond.

291b0edbee91c3489850454350b838f1.name: Medium Magic Chest
291b0edbee91c3489850454350b838f1.desc:
An improved storage option with enhanced capacity.

The items stored here can be used for crafting purposes from anywhere in the base!

12c5b540a08ac84d9a76f4af3f653181.name: Supply Sacks II
12c5b540a08ac84d9a76f4af3f653181.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

b5bdd90e799ab143aef94e064b08d3af.name: Magician Trousers
b5bdd90e799ab143aef94e064b08d3af.desc: These pants were made from silky smooth cloth, gracing only the most esteemed magicians.

f03cdd57fd0330408f706c3771a57f83.name: Sky Specter Helmet
f03cdd57fd0330408f706c3771a57f83.desc: A mask that conceals the face, framing it with faintly printed cloth ribbons that fly in the wind. It may cover the eyes, but the devilish horns betray the wearer's aching for chaos nonetheless.

c26310c8bfbd4c46bdfb371dca0df05c.name: Assassin Chest
c26310c8bfbd4c46bdfb371dca0df05c.desc: A refined chest piece that lets you fade into the dark and strike from the shadows.

80d2c480d9fc0d4b8d6ff1e36ed9f645.name: Steel Portcullis
80d2c480d9fc0d4b8d6ff1e36ed9f645.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

95c5dd12cd7450499c7dd41e947aa241.name: Yak Food Bait
95c5dd12cd7450499c7dd41e947aa241.desc:
Food for attracting and taming a Yak.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.

3f877c5db43467498e9d4c0bad25c9b0.name: Golden Recruit Axe
3f877c5db43467498e9d4c0bad25c9b0.desc: The most successful, newly decorated recruits are sometimes gifted weapons dipped in gold. They aren't any sharper than their less impressive counterparts, but serve as a status symbol among the group.

4b0705bead75d44c988e3702db93a483.name: Shroud Flayer Seedling
4b0705bead75d44c988e3702db93a483.desc: Once placed into Shroud-infused farm soil, this seedling can grow into a Shroud Flayer.

38f11f4c0ca77c478e0afa1e536f147d.name: Lunar New Year Door
38f11f4c0ca77c478e0afa1e536f147d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1beab27999f3bd408605f9439a94f938.name: Large Iron Crypt Brazier
1beab27999f3bd408605f9439a94f938.desc:
A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.

8d2e36526ae86a48b15f3a477da0060d.name: Princely Greatsword
8d2e36526ae86a48b15f3a477da0060d.desc: A noble sabre that impresses with its golden glow and broad blade. Perhaps the former owner was compensating for something.

57e9e57013f1d14dbfe439375347b4a2.name: Gilded Axe
57e9e57013f1d14dbfe439375347b4a2.desc: A steel axe, decorated with gold accents. It makes you feel much stronger, although the blade itself is most likely not improved by much.

7e94d08649247e4e9575e146e8465824.name: Harp
7e94d08649247e4e9575e146e8465824.desc: A heavenly harp with silver strings, beloved by common folk and kings alike.

c4b4c8267997454facb6fa6e2b84d28e.name: Ice Totem II
c4b4c8267997454facb6fa6e2b84d28e.desc:
Summons a totem that launches icy projectiles at enemies, applying a slow debuff to them. 
Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

4f0468d25c556c4daa1950f4450b1f6b.name: Stone Chair
4f0468d25c556c4daa1950f4450b1f6b.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

7c708b3d3e850a42a164ff9c6cf53b1d.name: Greater Mana Potion +
7c708b3d3e850a42a164ff9c6cf53b1d.desc: Instantly restores a medium amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.

daadf31b28c41c47a61409de0f8a3a14.name: Vorgoth's Bound Essence
daadf31b28c41c47a61409de0f8a3a14.desc: Certain protection demands something personal. Use this bound essence to craft Vorgoth's Armor.

50e5d7e7f11b0e4d953937a841143dcf.name: Polished Wooden Door
50e5d7e7f11b0e4d953937a841143dcf.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1cd02b5a5fe90d4b8a5ba06cb090fceb.name: Small Water Wheel
1cd02b5a5fe90d4b8a5ba06cb090fceb.desc:
A small variant of the water wheel. It can be placed in water to generate force for a mill.

Must be placed near the mill.

8f9347b7cda2784f85f29f8bf0a47956.name: Ashwood Wand
8f9347b7cda2784f85f29f8bf0a47956.desc:
A wand that burns with the same destructive force that has razed villages, libraries, and museums. Artefacts and tomes, burnt to a crisp and falling to dust... can you wield this power responsibly?

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

3b1933c0d733814db3b65939aadf2eb3.name: Spellbreaker Boots
3b1933c0d733814db3b65939aadf2eb3.desc: Ground yourself, and feel the earth beneath your feet. Connect to the magical core of the world with these graceful boots and stand firm against your adversaries.

03f59a5fd76c354998a9290d2399bb67.name: Midnight Tomb Block
03f59a5fd76c354998a9290d2399bb67.desc: A building block made from polished marble. It's as dark as the night sky.

9c463c324b00494a89a4f204d2100b04.name: Albaneve Summits Dirt
9c463c324b00494a89a4f204d2100b04.desc:
A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. 

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

67ee7dd3e4a24445868c28ed738cdc97.name: Mage Trousers
67ee7dd3e4a24445868c28ed738cdc97.desc: These comfortable and plain pants are perfect for apprentices who wish to gather some firsthand adventuring experience.

e8f8e7d47aa99647a316da76f1e7fefb.name: Shroud Core
e8f8e7d47aa99647a316da76f1e7fefb.desc: A stable form of energy. Burning it at the Flame Altar may protect against the Shroud.

5f48bcef3ab0a84eaa0c6d61bcdabea1.name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Helmet
5f48bcef3ab0a84eaa0c6d61bcdabea1.desc: The radiant golden glow of this helmet recalls the bright spirit of the previous owner. In Embervale, this helmet was reserved for only the brightest thinkers, whose intellect lit the way.

c4570986e353d14f9c82d5548074ee1f.name: Prized Skull Trophy
c4570986e353d14f9c82d5548074ee1f.desc: A highly prized trophy of a Drak, recognizable by the large number of feathers with which it was adorned. Probably a reminiscence of a legendary battle, or a treacherous slaughter.

f829e9ac3159424788b3c70dbb7d22ee.name: Grilled Penny Bun
f829e9ac3159424788b3c70dbb7d22ee.desc: A smoky grilled mushroom that temporarily amplifies your magical power when eaten.

a0ee66ceac7f3a4aaa288ac772a8a4e0.name: Bamboo Crate II
a0ee66ceac7f3a4aaa288ac772a8a4e0.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

26555d8f6c93e445afc7674a057805b7.name: Soldier Shield
26555d8f6c93e445afc7674a057805b7.desc: Thrust yourself into battle and glory with the protection of this shield!

576db57ae213124693d0548a001915d6.name: Yellow Lily Flower
576db57ae213124693d0548a001915d6.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

8994480a2689d04f9232d58d7e87031a.name: Healer Headwrap
8994480a2689d04f9232d58d7e87031a.desc: A headwrap that protects your sensitive skull from traumatic injury. Enough to postpone the inevitable for a while.

761c3b61724a41499fb591145eeb5b89.name: Venerable Hollow Helmet
761c3b61724a41499fb591145eeb5b89.desc: A fan-like attachment juts from the helmet's vertex. From there, a red crown of straightened bristles radiates forth — forever imprisoning the wearer under its vermillion crescent.

e9dd1e4c69724f4bb17dbb9170b4292a.name: Vorgoth's Eye
e9dd1e4c69724f4bb17dbb9170b4292a.desc: A massive ocular core, torn from Vorgoth, or what was left of him. Inside, faint arcs of energy still flicker.

a5d4507bdd8a4544acf346bebf6138c9.name: Fine Hardwood Fence Pole
a5d4507bdd8a4544acf346bebf6138c9.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1db1ac1de8a8394e82a1c93b12988bb5.name: "Tower In The Night"
1db1ac1de8a8394e82a1c93b12988bb5.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1c54cd3b07653e46830e1edd9d2d6e15.name: Embervale Miniature Showcase
1c54cd3b07653e46830e1edd9d2d6e15.desc: A showcase for displaying the Embervale miniature.

76fd0b605ca538429f65534e20b0802c.name: Royal Gloves
76fd0b605ca538429f65534e20b0802c.desc: These gloves are a bit stiff and barely functional. The most important thing is that they look impressive to peasants. You won't need to do manual labor, anyway.

94fc5ad2e786064e81c0ad8b9aba6ee9.name: Guard Of The North Sword
94fc5ad2e786064e81c0ad8b9aba6ee9.desc: Lord Vorgoth's once-trusted blade was discarded before the war and replaced by a weapon more befitting vile acts. It still clings to a semblance of sanity and light, shining brightly in the dark like the North Star.

baa5071e083e6c48931909e1a0df24b1.name: Solar Mace
baa5071e083e6c48931909e1a0df24b1.desc: A mace with a spiked head shaped like a blazing sun. When raised high, following the curvature of your swing, the sun reaches its zenith — willing and able to blare down at its opponents with full power.

59cc12fcdeff354e91e28e2d914f8d37.name: The Henchman
59cc12fcdeff354e91e28e2d914f8d37.desc: Those who wield this hammer do whatever it takes to be on the right side of history — that being the winning side.

59ccd0adb3d2844195c963b0e6f2c4b2.name: Riptide
59ccd0adb3d2844195c963b0e6f2c4b2.desc: A shield that was washed into a grotto by the river. It must have belonged to a valiant hero.

72ad32bb68e7c245a4579503725de495.name: Lunar Tides Bow
72ad32bb68e7c245a4579503725de495.desc: The upper and lower limbs of the bow curve inwards gracefully, creating the shape of symmetrical waves coming to a crash as the shot is fired. May the crescent illuminate your arrows and steady your breath.

c1dc3c874948934dbea55f53664a5358.name: Primitive Stone Shelf
c1dc3c874948934dbea55f53664a5358.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

7985ac6589debb47b70d4bb57e0f99d2.name: Shades Of Red
7985ac6589debb47b70d4bb57e0f99d2.desc:
Shadowy reds make this palette ideal for a moody night-time journey.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

2aa12846b747de46b403f4191c219933.name: Revitalizing Health Potion
2aa12846b747de46b403f4191c219933.desc:
The pinnacle of potioncraft. It gained its name after rescuing users from countless near-death situations.

Instantly restores an unbelievable amount of health.

2fb73858a53a51498a1a46d79b9e4895.name: Ginger In A Jungle
2fb73858a53a51498a1a46d79b9e4895.desc:
Rich, deep hues of green evoke the jungle and thickets you must navigate. A touch of red is added, like the red ginger flowers that appear here and there, breaking up the sea of green.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

3d0beb4598f3fc48bbc2ac023bf641c4.name: Shock Wisp I
3d0beb4598f3fc48bbc2ac023bf641c4.desc:
Conjures a charged wisp that trails you for a short duration. 
It hurls shock projectiles at enemies that also deal Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. 

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

69217b6a51ae464bb3defa6f7c11c23d.name: Meat and Forest Beet Skewer
69217b6a51ae464bb3defa6f7c11c23d.desc: With just some meat, a forest beet, and a small fire, you can make this nutritious skewer anywhere and at any time.

d07232f4587a1545abed4798c8941478.name: Uncooked Fae Deer Milk
d07232f4587a1545abed4798c8941478.desc: Raw Fae Deer milk. It has to be cooked to be consumed safely.

bbddbbafc163f74189767e6c2d119cff.name: Crimson Ground
bbddbbafc163f74189767e6c2d119cff.desc:
Blood and mud — only weak humans bleed this much. Victory is ours! RAH!

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

054d129c1fbd2c48a6539e0677c6603c.name: Blue Pendant Light I
054d129c1fbd2c48a6539e0677c6603c.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

26d9eee20b31d446a8e5e4e253c91edf.name: Knight Chestplate
26d9eee20b31d446a8e5e4e253c91edf.desc: A knight's chestplate. It has a fading heroic aura.

d57e4ce5a14e6f46a720bc99f8864e8b.name: Sage Seedling
d57e4ce5a14e6f46a720bc99f8864e8b.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

c82a991fc00eeb4cb007deaa8694f8cd.name: Handrail
c82a991fc00eeb4cb007deaa8694f8cd.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

fcde36af0a0cb848a146ac45d1be94eb.name: Fire Bolt IV
fcde36af0a0cb848a146ac45d1be94eb.desc:
Ignites a fire bolt projectile that deals damage to a single target.

Spell Charges:

5b76ba372dfbae4581a6a2496bdcd37e.desc:

Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

36f13180b970344c92746f818ab03d12.name: Popcorn
36f13180b970344c92746f818ab03d12.desc: Greatly regenerates Stamina upon consumption. Delightful and sweet.

7b73bad1787d1647ab4991dc61b3c8b7.name: Dune Armadillo Food Bait
7b73bad1787d1647ab4991dc61b3c8b7.desc:
Food for attracting and taming a Dune Armadillo.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.

4a2ea11235a60642b5dd9138b34a46c9.name: Hunter Trousers
4a2ea11235a60642b5dd9138b34a46c9.desc: Nothing is more suitable for a long prowl than this set of pants.

d05399f26722434c9913f3ea31d3d3db.name: Pompom Jr.
d05399f26722434c9913f3ea31d3d3db.desc:
A timid little fellow with spotted fur. It was found in an empty Kindlewastes home. 

The woman that lived in the house before had many dogs, and her favorite was called "Pompom". Maybe this dog is one of its descendants!

b723654e42d47c46a0ce5dae704bb24e.name: Purple Wall Light II
b723654e42d47c46a0ce5dae704bb24e.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

04f23bdd35f14042903354a37a69909f.name: Sunbeam
04f23bdd35f14042903354a37a69909f.desc: A scorching hot blade infused with the desert heart. It can melt both snow and skin.

fb42af06f7b0834b9092fb13b205e35c.name: Fake Ancient Door
fb42af06f7b0834b9092fb13b205e35c.desc: Fool others looking for hidden passages in your base with this fake secret door.

146f26ada124ba4e9dca944f775aaf48.name: Ball Lightning I
146f26ada124ba4e9dca944f775aaf48.desc:
Conjures a slow-moving ball of lightning that travels unhindered through enemies and some obstacles.
It continuously releases lightning strikes to nearby enemies that also deal Stamina Damage, which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. 

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

2173d4de864691409924ecec51f2fe1e.name: Stone Wall Drain
2173d4de864691409924ecec51f2fe1e.desc: This drain will remove any water above it. Can be placed on the wall.

1548dd3c71985f4f96525f695c8ca91d.name: Ony's Map Piece
1548dd3c71985f4f96525f695c8ca91d.desc:
The fragment of a torn treasure map, found on a dragon skeleton in the Albaneve Summits. Perhaps you could reconstruct the map if you found all pieces?

There's writing on the back:

Ony's' Memoir:
I fly so high, I may never come down
I dance on the sun, whole body ablaze
My cup's always full, I'd drink till I drown
In liquid light and limerence, until I feel dazed

82e1aaf50b53a24884c9f26c9747dc91.name: High Crude Wooden Shelf
82e1aaf50b53a24884c9f26c9747dc91.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

bb9f91dbbe72b047ae8ac94b8f20b6d4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ddca26352fb20144b884ab7525b9b72c.name: Cactus Plant
ddca26352fb20144b884ab7525b9b72c.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

fec85dedb6d92e4385de4e056844e3c6.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

f1e12a9378828d4c8067df71cf9e2632.name: New Moon
f1e12a9378828d4c8067df71cf9e2632.desc:
When the silence of the night begins to envelop the mountains, you best not step outside into the dark. Terror hides where the light does not reach.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

f40101167e63b34f9763e1a94f71eb13.name: Granite Stone Bathtub
f40101167e63b34f9763e1a94f71eb13.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
