fca07e1f5f7329499d67ad1ef3a2b596.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

77b0ec0933e1d645b898454d553e2a01.name: Staff of the Taurus
77b0ec0933e1d645b898454d553e2a01.desc:
A staff that awakes slumbering anger inside the wielder. The protruding amethyst spikes help to channel the emotion towards enemies.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

c160b44fb96ee54e9378b2f2e9fdb1e5.name: Ancient Gold Block
c160b44fb96ee54e9378b2f2e9fdb1e5.desc: A solid gold block from the Ancients, frequently used to adorn structures with decorative trim.

0836527e0e47f149bec322cf06f5291e.name: Sinister Crescent Staff
0836527e0e47f149bec322cf06f5291e.desc:
A ritualistic staff that was cleansed in a still rivulet under a crescent moon. It serves the wielder to guide the undead back to the beyond.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

efa0c4afc860fe44aea140026465c3f6.name: Mauveine
efa0c4afc860fe44aea140026465c3f6.desc: A violet dye, often used in the creation of opulent garments for royals.

9ff2de2356ff0843b914d1c529af814b.name: Artificer's Pants
9ff2de2356ff0843b914d1c529af814b.desc: Comfortable cloth pants that protect one from scratches and burns. They feel well-insulated.

ce053cc0c04cfd40b20158d05c730767.name: Bronze Pickaxe
ce053cc0c04cfd40b20158d05c730767.desc: A pickaxe made out of bronze. Only struggling with the hardest of stones, it can be considered very efficient.

73ed442cc1e50a4690506f95be262ca4.name: Sketches
73ed442cc1e50a4690506f95be262ca4.desc: Tools for making sketches. This should be placed in arms reach of a Carpenter.

2e680a7935f4c64d9a1f5119b3e46f38.name: Devilish Bow
2e680a7935f4c64d9a1f5119b3e46f38.desc: This draconic-looking bow was often feared for its crooked horns of unknown origin. Villagers believed that horns so twisted would always bring bad luck.

86decb199e4a154d84d6fda419f81bce.name: Elite Hollow Chestplate
86decb199e4a154d84d6fda419f81bce.desc: A combination of rust-red fabric, metal plates, and gold accents. The latter usually matches the Hollow's gold teeth!

f712c83c3b139f42bc88d1ae06d3dfe1.name: Maritime Bathtub
f712c83c3b139f42bc88d1ae06d3dfe1.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

a2c19feb880cb440a7192a5bf3817850.name: Empty Farmbed
a2c19feb880cb440a7192a5bf3817850.desc: This Farmbed can be filled with dirt, sand, or soil to grow plants.

e4cae3357f61cd4f9504dc053a8678d0.name: Emberguard Pants
e4cae3357f61cd4f9504dc053a8678d0.desc: A pattern ripples across the fabric, creating subtle peaks and valleys as fingers draw across it.

591266c38c9e4f4895a2d0bef4ba2f41.name: Explorer Coat
591266c38c9e4f4895a2d0bef4ba2f41.desc: The backpack provides ample space for storing unknown flora or newly discovered artifacts while adventuring!

c122e67a8b44d841808633d6c00bcb24.name: Healer Tunic
c122e67a8b44d841808633d6c00bcb24.desc: A breathable tunic with ample space for storing bandages, herbs, and tissues.

cc446a3f8c8fbf4e8db015acb293d1a9.name: Iron Dust
cc446a3f8c8fbf4e8db015acb293d1a9.desc: Fine iron dust, used for different crafting purposes.

803f22303d74f745b89c5e7e9d0c55d0.name: Shroud Wood
803f22303d74f745b89c5e7e9d0c55d0.desc: The wood of Shroud infested trees. Its structure and properties are changed forever.

e3c9a61c181c8441b063230c6c758fc8.name: Assassin Hood
e3c9a61c181c8441b063230c6c758fc8.desc: A special piece of cloth was added to this assassin hood to hide the wearer's face and their most likely daunting smile.

a2a2b83c2a53864596f54b2d998f4a88.name: "Still Life"
a2a2b83c2a53864596f54b2d998f4a88.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

0f0e5ebf4b03b24d8f09a0515811a33c.name: Shadowtail
0f0e5ebf4b03b24d8f09a0515811a33c.desc:
This is a rare, midnight-black variant of the Stripetail. Its dark scales absorb light, making it nearly invisible underwater. This patient predator strikes from the depths when you least expect it.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

b50b2049df2edd4f9fbf99dab867bbff.name: Extraordinary Ectoplasm Soup
b50b2049df2edd4f9fbf99dab867bbff.desc: A thick, viscous soup made from volatile extoplasm. It tastes vaguely minty.

c421f2ec8b9ffb4a8234bfd0f8bd7984.name: Valor Heart Daggers
c421f2ec8b9ffb4a8234bfd0f8bd7984.desc:
A dagger that can easily be hidden underneath lavish sleeves or dressy skirts. It's quick and easy to unsheath in times of need!

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

255ee86693d11e4cad891468c4c690f1.name: Pearlfrost Mentor Chest
255ee86693d11e4cad891468c4c690f1.desc: It's an expertly layered blue coat with a white fur trim. The quilted cloth and leather provide better protection in close combat. The gold casing near the heart carries a faceted gem and resembles a cornflower blue eye, searching the battlefield for souls in need.

403873c266e5a04fad63a530c0247166.name: Taro Seedling
403873c266e5a04fad63a530c0247166.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

f7d4e33c1c6a074e87c1472bf19243cb.name: Goat Feeder
f7d4e33c1c6a074e87c1472bf19243cb.desc:
A feeding device that holds goat food. It can be used for both Common Goats and Frizzy Goats.

It will feed your animals when filled with the corresponding food.

44a374d90299124ebd8f7175b4d2bf1d.name: Sharpshooter Hood
44a374d90299124ebd8f7175b4d2bf1d.desc: Remain keen-eyed as a hawk with this eerie hood.

294a339b354cc54dae78472e5b07b2b5.name: Prison Fence Corner
294a339b354cc54dae78472e5b07b2b5.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

856276371bcd764a916fc10df036b97d.name: Boreal Wood Shelf
856276371bcd764a916fc10df036b97d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

5ff3419b32190d4981500aadf25f7be8.name: Hawk Helmet
5ff3419b32190d4981500aadf25f7be8.desc: This hood includes an iron facemask which was greatly inspired by owls.

1e5b47757ce19c448aef28df15ae5e76.name: Coal
1e5b47757ce19c448aef28df15ae5e76.desc: A hard lump of coal. It makes for great fuel!

ec7322620daccd40ab450942a23efb02.name: Fire Bolt III
ec7322620daccd40ab450942a23efb02.desc:
Ignites a fire bolt projectile that deals damage to a single target.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

49bc672f966f03448b704542b696cf43.name: Pikemead's Bulwark
49bc672f966f03448b704542b696cf43.desc:
Even in death, the Queen unites those who seek protection behind her shield. 

Parry
You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar.
Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

4e5992ac2007e841b9e7b297af68807f.name: Deluxe Edition Items
4e5992ac2007e841b9e7b297af68807f.desc: Find all Deluxe Edition items in this chest.

28d2511e8ac6ad40b9d4226d76c36b25.name: Bow Of The Serpent
28d2511e8ac6ad40b9d4226d76c36b25.desc: A strong bow that frames each shot between two serpents' maws. Let your arrows strike with the calculated savagery of a viper in waiting!

9dda5173617ac441a112cc03dc2d8e33.name: Tank Boots
9dda5173617ac441a112cc03dc2d8e33.desc: A shiny pair of boots. They're so heavy that you'll practically be immovable when wearing them.

4360ce9ee9c58c47a4a5975e8fbe89f8.name: Stapelia Starflower Plant
4360ce9ee9c58c47a4a5975e8fbe89f8.desc: A large potted plant to beautify your home.

dbfcbcf47819a84eb18beb0386edae2b.name: Large Crypt Coffin II
dbfcbcf47819a84eb18beb0386edae2b.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1bfab43e43345d499ef960be8d24561f.name: Fire Bolt I
1bfab43e43345d499ef960be8d24561f.desc:
Ignites a fire bolt projectile that deals damage to a single target.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

c62ad787355847418e4177e92acdd26e.name: Stone Fireplace
c62ad787355847418e4177e92acdd26e.desc: A warm fireplace which you can put in your home. It can be used to cook simple dishes and is vital for receiving the Rested Buff.

d9654820c3aebc4f82320d650c65c550.name: Fire Bolt VI
d9654820c3aebc4f82320d650c65c550.desc:
Ignites a fire bolt projectile that deals damage to a single target.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

bbc65fd1f12f7b4594f718349e7b3bef.name: Antler Bow
bbc65fd1f12f7b4594f718349e7b3bef.desc: Designed in admiration of antlers, this bow has an imperial and awe-inspiring image.

794f47015a6bcd4b999d7e9339fda91c.name: Wooden Bed
794f47015a6bcd4b999d7e9339fda91c.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

fdee408fa12dfb41945d826e6a828fce.name: Blue Eyes
fdee408fa12dfb41945d826e6a828fce.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

1f4ae01a701ee44cbebb091a1da35358.name: Wolf's Fang Chest
1f4ae01a701ee44cbebb091a1da35358.desc: A robust chest piece, adorned with the fur of a white wolf. The colors blend in well with snowed-in, grey mountains.

1550a4b5cb96dd4f82d23233cc73a0d0.name: Training Doll I
1550a4b5cb96dd4f82d23233cc73a0d0.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ff72575dc2f4b845ba244b14d13a1274.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

10edb2f97bd0e6419c6c7f30e10d68c5.name: Mountain's Shadow Shield
10edb2f97bd0e6419c6c7f30e10d68c5.desc: A shield with a central amethyst. The metal frame around the sides makes it more durable.

516576d989d4b443827630f7ca990f8e.name: Bare Fists
516576d989d4b443827630f7ca990f8e.desc: Your bare fists can only do little damage. For survival, a weapon or shield would be preferable.

024954019d78e348a2d9012b06a1fb7f.name: Sword Of The Serpent
024954019d78e348a2d9012b06a1fb7f.desc: A glistening green blade, perfectly representing the aesthetics of the year of the serpent.

e32ef75428bfa246a912c38eeae4e8fd.name: Gold Fell Monstrosity Trophy
e32ef75428bfa246a912c38eeae4e8fd.desc:
Although you have been exposed to this sight countless times, it still exudes a sense of menace and excitement at the same time.

Collect multiple Fell Monstrosity Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

b97b54f372536f448619d285b7019965.name: Iron Prison Door
b97b54f372536f448619d285b7019965.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c08b71c111836f4aa762095f2ed49c11.name: Warden Helmet
c08b71c111836f4aa762095f2ed49c11.desc: Command respect with this Warden Helmet.

3e1cf3dd98b3724da526af6fc05f7ffd.name: "Hanfu Ponytail" Wig Head
3e1cf3dd98b3724da526af6fc05f7ffd.desc: A wig head that unlocks more haircuts once picked up. It can also be placed in your base as decoration.

53a19f4158cffd409821a81f026cc1a7.name: Bandage
53a19f4158cffd409821a81f026cc1a7.desc:
A simple bandage.

This item provides healing if applied to a wound.

e827453609867148a109041dc87f2103.name: Small Steel Brazier
e827453609867148a109041dc87f2103.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

f9b1381847d32b4f8434b02dcb942917.name: Empty Lily Pot
f9b1381847d32b4f8434b02dcb942917.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

d01d2cccbf9dc845bf68f82284b3b959.name: Push Button
d01d2cccbf9dc845bf68f82284b3b959.desc: A push button that sends a short ON signal, then switches OFF again.

971bccf1a0be3647bbf07a4217a5ac96.name: Exclusive Hollow Boots
971bccf1a0be3647bbf07a4217a5ac96.desc: Sturdy boots that withstand any march for hundreds of miles.

fdb03caa795c974493dd8bb6a4edc2b8.name: Gem of Necromancy
fdb03caa795c974493dd8bb6a4edc2b8.desc: Killing an enemy has a %k chance to spawn an allied Hollow Damned at level %k. You can only have 2 active Damned from this gem at a time. Spawning more will delete the oldest one. Hollow Damned decay when out of combat for too long.

dff8a7de3c4d774597442a22e34d1ced.name: Cinder Rock
dff8a7de3c4d774597442a22e34d1ced.desc: Rough, ashen stone found in abundance across Cinder's Cradle.

e509007993ce4442bfe46d371aa2eeaa.name: Spellbreaker Pants
e509007993ce4442bfe46d371aa2eeaa.desc: A pair of pants. They're breezier than they look, allowing you to feel the wind.

93cd4cb6c6491f4aa33079d378ba5a38.name: Alpine Antler Boots
93cd4cb6c6491f4aa33079d378ba5a38.desc: A light pair of boots that allow for swift movements when wading through snow and blizzards. You can scout the frozen fringes of the mountains for miles when wearing these shoes!

8e3d86b64224f744acce015304baccb9.name: Bamboo Plant
8e3d86b64224f744acce015304baccb9.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

bb695ce1ca864645945f80aa9369163f.name: Tank Gloves
bb695ce1ca864645945f80aa9369163f.desc: Copper-plated gloves that protect the wearer's tender hands during a brawl.

dd94ebf4578e3c4b9ab68fd0b3a49681.name: Raw Meat and Forest Beet Skewer
dd94ebf4578e3c4b9ab68fd0b3a49681.desc:
A hunter's favorite ration, crafted for precision. 

After you've grilled it over a fire, it will grant you more maximum health, increase your ranged and dagger damage, and expand your maximum stamina.

ad2f8a4de0ebc64b8e9ab2af39b91dae.name: Iron Window Frame I
ad2f8a4de0ebc64b8e9ab2af39b91dae.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

84fcc90a7e60e440b54f85b58e4cb06f.name: Greater Ring of Stamina
84fcc90a7e60e440b54f85b58e4cb06f.desc: An ancient ring that gives you stamina.

0f3514368e1bd6438d82480995adf578.name: Vorgoth's Soulbound Pants
0f3514368e1bd6438d82480995adf578.desc: Metal-clad from hip to heel, scales shifting with each step — unyielding to everything else.

15f352a6b389ed429b01d08cb28669c7.name: Steel Arrow
15f352a6b389ed429b01d08cb28669c7.desc: An arrow with a steel tip.

7d61a871ab426742aeb4638c625a3bd6.name: Bloodfeather Chest
7d61a871ab426742aeb4638c625a3bd6.desc: With this chest piece, you can cut through the woods with ease, remaining undetected as you prepare your next strike.

b5322cdd1cb0824a887e4ae9bdda7778.name: Glow Dust
b5322cdd1cb0824a887e4ae9bdda7778.desc: A magical dust that can glow in the dark, consisting of the crushed remains of a Fire Fly.

c5575c5f79c6f241a06cac3900af468b.name: Hunter Boots
c5575c5f79c6f241a06cac3900af468b.desc: Makes your step silent and swift.

8f46de7d081ba24c98effb64adb62aec.name: Hollow's Eve Banner
8f46de7d081ba24c98effb64adb62aec.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4cce795e68ae0e458b9285926e87938f.name: Book I
4cce795e68ae0e458b9285926e87938f.desc: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.

42eabce316f1f443b1c7983c880f8076.name: Castle Bench
42eabce316f1f443b1c7983c880f8076.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

969f3e1e4986e04cbed278164021a1de.name: Secret Ancient Door
969f3e1e4986e04cbed278164021a1de.desc: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.

cbfdfdda02597947ac2279291fc3f45f.name: Scavenger Matron Trophy
cbfdfdda02597947ac2279291fc3f45f.desc:
It reeks of foulness and rot, so best ventilate your halls properly.

Collect multiple Scavenger Matron Helmets to craft the Trophy.

4a9bc01a3b9bbb4180b4316c1484a423.name: Totemhead Mace
4a9bc01a3b9bbb4180b4316c1484a423.desc: A ghastly visage is carved into the mace, looking down on your foes as you smash them into the ground.

256607a829055a41bf32a9e0619e8ce5.name: Big Farm Animal Pillow
256607a829055a41bf32a9e0619e8ce5.desc: A cozy bed for large tamed farm animals, such as Yaks or Dune Armadillos.

9888de2ea976774892474109018c2ff8.name: Crestflame Gloves
9888de2ea976774892474109018c2ff8.desc: Heavy gloves, held together by pairs of belts and buckles. With these, you can grab whoever dares to threaten the Mother Flame straight by their wretched throat.

cf0ef6fc336c3943a8db80caf141cde6.name: Eternal Chain Lightning III
cf0ef6fc336c3943a8db80caf141cde6.desc:
Releases a lightning strike at an enemy that can arc to multiple other nearby targets.
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. 

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

fab3dd8f626414448864de10209cb36d.name: Waveborne Ritualist Boots
fab3dd8f626414448864de10209cb36d.desc: With this footwear, the healing power of the earth flows straight through you — can you feel it?

7fc619c306bc7e4fb64f8365d72876f7.name: Incendiary Ball
7fc619c306bc7e4fb64f8365d72876f7.desc:
This bomb contains a highly flammable liquid, setting a large area on fire when deployed.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

4caf56a8d2fb50418f92f9e02967c492.name: Straw Mat
4caf56a8d2fb50418f92f9e02967c492.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

8b9234257bc5644b8847bdfec8c7db4e.name: Fell Crusader Shield
8b9234257bc5644b8847bdfec8c7db4e.desc: A sturdy shield carried by the Fell. It has held up through many crusades.

c878d5908f4f1047a2e79f1afdd06e1b.name: Mountain's Shadow Helmet
c878d5908f4f1047a2e79f1afdd06e1b.desc: A gloomy helmet, hiding an even darker gaze. The crest around the brow casts a shadow over the wearer's eyes, hiding their intention.

3a37663afb88f741a241b22cea124f67.name: Veilwater Basin Boardwalk II
3a37663afb88f741a241b22cea124f67.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f9357ef6ef41b54b8da0f18a530059d5.name: Vat Of The Ancients I
f9357ef6ef41b54b8da0f18a530059d5.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

8689bbdc0058d44daf4c7bf749d016eb.name: Fired Bricks
8689bbdc0058d44daf4c7bf749d016eb.desc: Shiny red bricks that are crafted by hardening Lump of Clay under a heat even a Flameborn has issues with.

08c27ca5eb0a3340a5350ed2f77dc82d.name: Celestium Bars
08c27ca5eb0a3340a5350ed2f77dc82d.desc: A bar of refined Celestium. Its surface shifts between deep violet and pale blue.

2042abc38899b24eac72f7d145fbd625.name: Nomad Highlands Slender Tree Seedling
2042abc38899b24eac72f7d145fbd625.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.

4f5ab74c2e5f0d46bef9bab4cd379de8.name: Wall Banner of the Ancients I
4f5ab74c2e5f0d46bef9bab4cd379de8.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

745d480866782e4686972027d310f889.name: Disc 3m
745d480866782e4686972027d310f889.desc: This tool can only be used inside the building area around a Flame Altar. It can help you to quickly build your desired base with pre-defined structures.

01ea00b53f9dc340a3b114127f313755.name: Balthazar
01ea00b53f9dc340a3b114127f313755.desc: The Alchemist Balthazar brews potions and other concoctions.

ae944e1637a9fa45bd52372e11bcc183.name: Vaporous Staff
ae944e1637a9fa45bd52372e11bcc183.desc:
A wild and withered staff, able to unleash the power of the earth.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

ec7bef2e6008414bbb59b52e1ae3c10b.name: Hammer Of The Piercing Gaze
ec7bef2e6008414bbb59b52e1ae3c10b.desc: A set of crystal eyes adorns this weapon, seeking the weak points of your foes. The handle has been decorated with overlapping leather straps.

65f80ff50fdc7f42b4a27ba45c210cbc.name: Crude Wooden Nightstand
65f80ff50fdc7f42b4a27ba45c210cbc.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

49c4e8ea3610b7438f3638253efd5543.name: Monstera Plant
49c4e8ea3610b7438f3638253efd5543.desc: A small potted plant to beautify your home.

76cfdde10f5a1f40b877084a98c516a5.name: New Moon Greatsword
76cfdde10f5a1f40b877084a98c516a5.desc: A hollow shape, empty as the night sky on a new moon, adorns this weapon's hand guard. The blade has been dirtied, but refuses to shed its silvery sheen.

a4f3f6acce6c9f46a905c9c8f949d566.name: Boreal Wood Garden Fence Pole
a4f3f6acce6c9f46a905c9c8f949d566.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ee24b01ab4794f4ba55b8728455883ec.name: Passionflower Plant
ee24b01ab4794f4ba55b8728455883ec.desc: A large potted plant to beautify your home.

7f88c923968eb447a2d8627cc91dae2c.name: Padding
7f88c923968eb447a2d8627cc91dae2c.desc:
A basic ingredient for all advanced armor. The padding added below the hard shell can create comfort and soften impacts.

A Loom is needed to craft both padding and advanced armor.

4546a24eaa2bea49b07c4b97c1b6aa14.name: Fearsome Club
4546a24eaa2bea49b07c4b97c1b6aa14.desc: This club strikes fear into the hearts of your foes with every swing.

c83aaf29bbc0c44892a535cf6a5b1429.name: Skull Stalker Shoes
c83aaf29bbc0c44892a535cf6a5b1429.desc: Seamlessly matching the rest of your outfit, these shoes let nothing stand between you and your goal.

57016bb12196a64ebfa5e90bedb6e762.name: Gloomberry
57016bb12196a64ebfa5e90bedb6e762.desc: A special berry that can only be harvested at night in the Revelwood. It can be used to enhance various dishes and to create deep blue color pigments.

1c079044ffdfe4479b2276027c3f104a.name: Flame Pact Vest
1c079044ffdfe4479b2276027c3f104a.desc: The best way to elevate your outfit is by extensively adding belts and straps to an inflationary degree, or so they say. A golden sigil on the chest signals your dedication to the Flame.

cba01ab59d16144e983ce61127ed8e45.name: Fish Filet
cba01ab59d16144e983ce61127ed8e45.desc: The Filet from an epic fish, don't worry about any fish bones, they have been thoroughly removed.

71c9caa037c0a24db93adef4c1979704.name: Thaumaturge Hat
71c9caa037c0a24db93adef4c1979704.desc: An extravagantly exaggerated tricorn hat that shields the caster's head from snowfall. The imposing antlers are a wearable trophy representing the wearer's spirit animal.

efeec0e69db3f24ea78c1baa24bc115d.name: Azure Russula
efeec0e69db3f24ea78c1baa24bc115d.desc: The Azure Russula — an ancient mushroom, existing and consuming magic since the beginning of time. Unfortunately inedible if not cooked.

b48151923895df41bf99b19ddd241968.name: Fake Wooden Door
b48151923895df41bf99b19ddd241968.desc: Fool others looking for hidden passages in your base with this fake secret door.

95bee3b81118ba438e25a6f1b6b1ca04.name: Lady Leclair
95bee3b81118ba438e25a6f1b6b1ca04.desc: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

95be4981b565dc4ab03966e227ef560a.name: Round Ancient Door
95be4981b565dc4ab03966e227ef560a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e1bd8caf2617724697130ce6101eb176.name: Wolfsbane Seedling
e1bd8caf2617724697130ce6101eb176.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

2eb6aebcefd79c47bca66e0ed27cd967.name: Embervale Miniature Model
2eb6aebcefd79c47bca66e0ed27cd967.desc: A miniature model of Embervale. Can you pinpoint your own position in it?

66b1ce4b5858d443b7674f7e4148ed11.name: Underwater Overgrowth
66b1ce4b5858d443b7674f7e4148ed11.desc: Use the Overgrowth Tool to apply this to structures in your base.

78342d48d6ad164883f8385707deedf1.name: Alchemist Showcase
78342d48d6ad164883f8385707deedf1.desc: Use this showcase to reassemble an alchemist's notes. Completing the collection will unlock new recipes.

90953d8d4247b9409363e2ee2881c346.name: Artificer's Chest
90953d8d4247b9409363e2ee2881c346.desc: A dusty overcoat that reveals a metal exoskeleton beneath. A perfectly spherical cavity lies at the very centre of the chest plate, waiting to be adorned with an energy core.

a65fb3b83272db449477a5e2c3ac7c05.name: Siren Seeker Chest
a65fb3b83272db449477a5e2c3ac7c05.desc: Old fishing nets span across fabric, still carrying their spoils: Starfish, seashells, and strings of pearls are displayed proudly as accessories. Were they gifts from the mermaids and their folk, or simply lucky finds? It's hard to tell.

11215962b2f849489707e1bb1ac6a83f.name: Fossil Showcase (3 Small Slots)
11215962b2f849489707e1bb1ac6a83f.desc: This is a showcase for Fossil Collection Items usually found in quarries, material veins, or dig sites.

f87f48834abb0e49a3fda3c672d91718.name: Blood Rose Mail Coif
f87f48834abb0e49a3fda3c672d91718.desc: A chainmail coif, crowned with a wreath of roses and thorns. Beauty and pain, pleasure and despair — they all coalesce in her halo.

dddac6022e25594a8f058b6fd96041bd.name: Secret Red Marble Door
dddac6022e25594a8f058b6fd96041bd.desc: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.

88b00e9a3beaa8448a2172cdaad32f1e.name: Wailing Blade
88b00e9a3beaa8448a2172cdaad32f1e.desc: An expertly crafted blade, balanced and sharp. Cuts through foes like a wail through the night. It bears the mark of a famous blacksmith from Pikemead's Reach.

8791eaa9d4caaa42bb66a28a66a00cd3.name: Rocky Shore
8791eaa9d4caaa42bb66a28a66a00cd3.desc:
The deep blue hue that takes center stage in this palette can be found beyond rocky beaches, or on rainy days by the cliff.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.

23fc01612d7a7f4aacdbfbdc7fa6fbd4.name: Reptile Leather
23fc01612d7a7f4aacdbfbdc7fa6fbd4.desc: A sturdy material used in extravagant tailoring.

2257419b6c9df34ebcd823df5c9d3f53.name: Deeproot Axe
2257419b6c9df34ebcd823df5c9d3f53.desc: Carved from foraged dead wood and dusty roots, this axe was hardened in the sun to tear flesh and split bones.

808d982ac21fbe44b0390aee6df648df.name: Lying Wooden Barrel
808d982ac21fbe44b0390aee6df648df.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4bc246c0af4baf4b88099ecc6c89e969.name: Bamboo Seedling
4bc246c0af4baf4b88099ecc6c89e969.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

da87a64a1cec3a4a99643fa8c1c6dabb.name: Skull Trophy III
da87a64a1cec3a4a99643fa8c1c6dabb.desc: The Drak decorate their settlements with such trophies. It's impressive that they even washed off the blood — they surely reuse it for other purposes...

b964fec28def894587efd893f8bfc6f2.name: Sunpiercer Pants
b964fec28def894587efd893f8bfc6f2.desc: These pants are just as short as a foe’s lifespan in your presence.

2e7842722e2dd641abc326b164c6d2d2.name: Guard of the North Chestplate
2e7842722e2dd641abc326b164c6d2d2.desc: Untouched by the Flame, and veiled in a lingering cold. This armor used to belong to Lord Vorgoth, who was rumored to have a frozen heart that splinters and breaks with every tired beat.

14413cf3e0d0e347b0919e87f56cc418.name: Revelwood Rubble
14413cf3e0d0e347b0919e87f56cc418.desc: A mix of different biome-specific materials, mainly stone and dirt.

ad56c00a1ff2fc48b84745be689f6f9b.name: Drak Temple Vase II
ad56c00a1ff2fc48b84745be689f6f9b.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

0f5ce0c6634ab742904c47af6a44da1b.name: Grilled Fatty Meat
0f5ce0c6634ab742904c47af6a44da1b.desc: Beautifully tender, juicy meat. It fills the belly and warms the soul by providing better frost resistance!

c151a71a51352648982bf0d7c78ddd19.name: Bamboo Crate I
c151a71a51352648982bf0d7c78ddd19.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

3c42812318729e468ac992dee0913c57.name: Trailblazer Boots
3c42812318729e468ac992dee0913c57.desc: These heavy boots provide excellent resistance and enable a stronger stance when facing various behemoths.

970488d7cbd4f945a2de32bb01fc24e5.name: Eternal Entangle
970488d7cbd4f945a2de32bb01fc24e5.desc:
Grows entangling roots in an area that apply a debuff to enemies which prevents them from moving for a short duration.
Rooted enemies are still able to perform attacks and bigger ones are slowed instead of rooted. 

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

32b5763e12e1d645b655518ec4c9eef9.name: Luminary Staff
32b5763e12e1d645b655518ec4c9eef9.desc:
A staff that reigns with superior intellectual prowess, ingenuity, and near-boundless energy. It can only be wielded by the brightest minds of our time — or those who deem themselves such.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

6f13ead4ae1cd64bb42dd84a21ba5bf4.name: Elevated Sea Urchin
6f13ead4ae1cd64bb42dd84a21ba5bf4.desc:
This sea urchin sits atop a small platform and is too delicate to attempt removal. 

This collectible is found in the Springlands.

21260764284d4042b340013f21d9ba22.name: Purple Rocket
21260764284d4042b340013f21d9ba22.desc: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

0f3dd30c6b89b7479412dd04a8c1941f.name: Gift Of Violence
0f3dd30c6b89b7479412dd04a8c1941f.desc:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"Humanity dug the Elixir Wells, ripping apart the land and each other to quench their thirst."

When you told me of your family's pain, it reminded me of that of my own people. We're so quick to tear each other to shreds, aren't we? Some will fight for scraps and die with nothing. I wish you the best. -J

f3ef5300f1989c4c92273db7c336659d.name: Desert Shingle Roof Block
f3ef5300f1989c4c92273db7c336659d.desc: A shingle block in blue hues, used in the angled rooftops of the Kindlewastes.

829459e4aa025c4ead3a77e7b1ea0216.name: High Paling Fence I
829459e4aa025c4ead3a77e7b1ea0216.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

7d69b14ddee4a24ebcc089c53e202381.name: Scrap Pan II
7d69b14ddee4a24ebcc089c53e202381.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

acdaffa7406ffb45a0f583e175b17e46.name: Batwing Axe
acdaffa7406ffb45a0f583e175b17e46.desc: The blades of this axe have sharp edges that flow into an upper peak. They were crafted like that to break through frozen lake surfaces or walls and resemble bat wings.

1ea9b9b89cf68444854cf83b61499be8.name: Staff Of The Serpent
1ea9b9b89cf68444854cf83b61499be8.desc:
A majestic staff topped with an ouroboros ornament made from green jade. It's perfect for honoring the year of the snake.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

2717b7c810a0f04bbe02de5f3907e38b.name: Vanguard Gloves
2717b7c810a0f04bbe02de5f3907e38b.desc: Scarlet gloves that remind you of all the blood you've shed. Will the battle ever end? You do not know for sure, but today, we shall not dwell on it — for today is for the living.

8f4ecb5ea50e7c499193ad0c25f366cd.name: Collection Of Books III
8f4ecb5ea50e7c499193ad0c25f366cd.desc: What is better than one book?

47e9b01164c5e94bb97326825c352a32.name: Enormous Magic Chest
47e9b01164c5e94bb97326825c352a32.desc:
A big and heavy chest that offers fantastic storage space for countless items.

The items stored here can be used for crafting purposes from anywhere in the base!

c89f071f54105a409fe873f03c97d58a.name: Eternal Acid Bite II
c89f071f54105a409fe873f03c97d58a.desc:
Sprays a lingering, poisonous acid in a cone in front of the caster. 
It also breaks the armor of enemies, applying a debuff which lets them take 25% increased physical damage for a short duration. 

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

72e44aaf5601a44b9505616c5a24b601.name: Explorer Boots
72e44aaf5601a44b9505616c5a24b601.desc: The wilderness will bend to your will in no time when you face it wearing these sturdy, bite-proof boots.

366642d58fa66a4abb4b9994f1bec73f.name: Large Polished Wooden Cupboard
366642d58fa66a4abb4b9994f1bec73f.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

5cb639196138ea45931746d4f5254c84.name: Scout Hood
5cb639196138ea45931746d4f5254c84.desc: The perfect disguise — even in broad daylight.

7ced864d575c994d995621ad7f8db0aa.name: Acid Cleaver
7ced864d575c994d995621ad7f8db0aa.desc: A cleaver coated with acid and bile, swung by Scavenger Butchers. Its victims can mend the bleeding — but rarely stop the toxins from spreading.

60b561d263429244ac6cb5da33ba2fad.name: Eagle Eye Gloves
60b561d263429244ac6cb5da33ba2fad.desc: Blessed by the Flame and bathed in glorious light, these gloves will ensure that your every strike is guided by the Ancients themselves.

7fce0224cda49c40bfafef740511d8f5.name: Empty Farmbed
7fce0224cda49c40bfafef740511d8f5.desc: This Farmbed can be filled with dirt, sand, or soil to grow plants.

8b9abbb53bd9b34d8308888945c9e74a.name: Mountain's Shadow Gloves
8b9abbb53bd9b34d8308888945c9e74a.desc: Dark leather patterned arm guards wrapped in ashen grey strings. Wool padding peeks out from beneath them when wielding your weapon fiercely.

968868addbf1104082bf205112ef4e38.name: Iron Fell Dragon Youngling Trophy
968868addbf1104082bf205112ef4e38.desc:
The last dragon's head. The final nail in the coffin. The end of an era, and the start of something new.

Collect multiple Fell Dragon Youngling Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

01f25f3da4c4c9419b42bc9d99a6df3b.name: Mana Drain VI
01f25f3da4c4c9419b42bc9d99a6df3b.desc:
Releases a continuous magical beam that leeches Mana from enemies without dealing damage to them.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

48c82d7a3536ba4a8ed0fddafa9c8ebf.name: Gray Eyes
48c82d7a3536ba4a8ed0fddafa9c8ebf.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

9f861caddb16ad4aace72054a90545ae.name: Efflorescent Hope Chest
9f861caddb16ad4aace72054a90545ae.desc: This royal chest piece frames a gleaming gem as its heart, reminding the wearer that hope will prevail. Taupe colored sleeves drape at the sides like a chrysalis being shed. The shoulders are accentuated by wing- or petal-like shapes, blossoming outwards.

c9ba0d9517b56e42804039f122d6cc9d.name: Secret Temple Door
c9ba0d9517b56e42804039f122d6cc9d.desc: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.

a1b781208ae1a848a6279214ac19053e.name: Clay Pot III
a1b781208ae1a848a6279214ac19053e.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1d8b814bdd22d04d9ba5cd8d5397dd58.name: Greater Ring of Health
1d8b814bdd22d04d9ba5cd8d5397dd58.desc: This ring will increase your health and healing rate.

59c55088cc2e06438b362aaf4281a0b7.name: Ice Bolt III
59c55088cc2e06438b362aaf4281a0b7.desc:
Conjures an icy projectile that deals damage in an area and applies a slow debuff.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

1c2e685231638b4db3daca2b58290b2c.name: Stone Stair II
1c2e685231638b4db3daca2b58290b2c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

5c781f8c5cb3884b8828fd1efadab9c9.name: Standing Banner of the Ancients II
5c781f8c5cb3884b8828fd1efadab9c9.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

33de1c549afa8847823de7a9f87e2e89.name: Shivs
33de1c549afa8847823de7a9f87e2e89.desc:
A dagger set that was scavenged from the ruins of the old world. It's dirty and dusty, but still does the trick.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

e656c8a52fae054a833a568e65192f28.name: Ancient Drak Wand
e656c8a52fae054a833a568e65192f28.desc:
A primordial wand that speaks of the previous dominion of the Drak. When the Drak'Dal were pushed back to the archipelago after they attacked humanity, their craft degenerated significantly, thus losing the ability to reproduce designs such as this.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

dcc3da8e67d91242bd729b1b4d308b55.name: Rogue Chestplate
dcc3da8e67d91242bd729b1b4d308b55.desc: A well-balanced chest piece that lets the wearer regenerate their energy faster.

c8428e0aec2a554595f3ac933ce1e991.name: Wildheart Chestplate
c8428e0aec2a554595f3ac933ce1e991.desc: It's a chestplate that has a short, red cape attached to the back. A Flame marks the centre of it, resting where the heart should be. Everything you do, and all you feel, is forever bound to the light of the fire. Let it fill you with pride and warmth.

691aa92a9c63bd4ebee5a4570928c810.name: Fowler Gloves
691aa92a9c63bd4ebee5a4570928c810.desc: Wearing these gloves makes the pulse slow down mysteriously before going in for the kill, thus steadying the hands.

7a4d3fe8c7a2dc43b834d0b780660d16.name: Fowler Helmet
7a4d3fe8c7a2dc43b834d0b780660d16.desc: The metal adornment on this hood faintly resembles the beak of a hawk.

94b7586f8f59d148a44c57e528315606.name: Sunpiercer Gloves
94b7586f8f59d148a44c57e528315606.desc: These gloves offer you sufficient protection when you engage in melee combat.

ab7a4e90f26db64b86848a38a4d4561b.name: Champion's Axe
ab7a4e90f26db64b86848a38a4d4561b.desc: A hefty two-handed axe, usually wielded by champions of the ring! Axes like these are often a status symbol and represent triumph.

674ca6a4bee8644090d88ab15f4fe12d.name: Enshrouded Ice
674ca6a4bee8644090d88ab15f4fe12d.desc:
Frozen, enshrouded liquid that's cold to the touch.

Commonly found in the Shroud of the Albaneve Summits biome.

It's unusable by itself, but can be processed into different materials in crafting.

4c5a76e55345f4469a94dc01e86f97d6.name: Ornate Steel Door
4c5a76e55345f4469a94dc01e86f97d6.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

001b57b6682bde40aa3aa5d15102af73.name: Bamboo Bar Counter
001b57b6682bde40aa3aa5d15102af73.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

d1a513ca7aebfd4aa0b25001860bb99f.name: Hunter Boots
d1a513ca7aebfd4aa0b25001860bb99f.desc: These boots are ideal for stalking prey.

bee0c924d940aa48b6ec0dbb354abf65.name: Eggs
bee0c924d940aa48b6ec0dbb354abf65.desc: A great source of protein that enhances the muscle mass. Best consumed before a good exercise.

f01e1bc2f783794ea1c49f16234d4bb9.name: Purple Hair
f01e1bc2f783794ea1c49f16234d4bb9.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

01951048cd0612468523ba208c8f14a3.name: Jezmina's Apotheosis
01951048cd0612468523ba208c8f14a3.desc: An axe that carves a path through enemies, no matter what. Swinging it fearlessly makes it feel light as a feather.

fee080be9cc07b428397dc9b11dc0265.name: Silent Echo
fee080be9cc07b428397dc9b11dc0265.desc:
Music that illustrates the awe-inspiring first impression that the imposing mountain range leaves behind. All echoes are swallowed by fresh, pure snow. No one will hear you here.

Music Sheet: 
Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

0e257e057fbcf942aaf83ef444da74e3.name: Plaguebringer Gloves
0e257e057fbcf942aaf83ef444da74e3.desc: These traditional archer gloves were made asymmetrical through multiple monstrous tusks and bone shards jutting outwards.

f6e457dc7e61294784265afa74138971.name: Achondrite
f6e457dc7e61294784265afa74138971.desc: Achondrites consist of melted rock. They originate from bigger asteroids or even other planets.

b8682db7dfe92e41a28fb55484321431.name: Madly Maroon
b8682db7dfe92e41a28fb55484321431.desc:
The color of red wine, dried blood, and broken promises.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

d6a72dc99b01644a9c5ba7f6059bd5df.name: Mint Mushroom Meat
d6a72dc99b01644a9c5ba7f6059bd5df.desc: Mint Mushroom Meat that can be used to dye all sorts of fabrics green. The name suggests a minty fresh taste, but consumption is strongly discouraged.

01767700b7ba3e468f2a9a4bed48ae33.name: Stir-Fried Vegetables
01767700b7ba3e468f2a9a4bed48ae33.desc: A healthy mix of vegetables. When eaten with care, it will fill both your stomach and heart.

10deff2c8e8fcf409e41e74164c0f88c.name: Tombstone "Always Loved"
10deff2c8e8fcf409e41e74164c0f88c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ca19b25a3d3ece42bc327badb3a992fb.name: Daggers
ca19b25a3d3ece42bc327badb3a992fb.desc:
A rudimentary set of daggers, the secondary weapon of choice for archers.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

ca197cb92c00c9458e94f53f6d760d4b.name: Scrappy Crate
ca197cb92c00c9458e94f53f6d760d4b.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

00dde6a9650faf41948711c40319e6e5.name: Carved Tropical Wood Fence with Ropes II
00dde6a9650faf41948711c40319e6e5.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

aabe43a30fe19543981dac3e8ca6a785.name: Loraine Crim
aabe43a30fe19543981dac3e8ca6a785.desc: Loraine Crim is an Ancient researcher and adventure enthusiast.

992f81226774c649bf32bbe3ce4b736d.name: Meteorite Showcase (3 Small Slots)
992f81226774c649bf32bbe3ce4b736d.desc: A showcase to display meteorite collection items.

1ed0bf3f75b03545ad78ad4fb9359538.name: Trapdoor Metal 4m
1ed0bf3f75b03545ad78ad4fb9359538.desc: This trap door might open unexpectedly beneath your feet. Watch your step!

2240a97e2789a04e90cf76c63506b4bb.name: Simple Wooden Fence
2240a97e2789a04e90cf76c63506b4bb.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f0e0ae488fba4540959542b0723d67a2.name: Alden Crowley
f0e0ae488fba4540959542b0723d67a2.desc: The Collector, Alden Crowley, can create mystical and dark furniture sets and food items infused with a special, revitalizing energy.

f0e0f41d2a4f864ab61d951f9f04536e.name: Scaffold I
f0e0f41d2a4f864ab61d951f9f04536e.desc: A scaffold that lets you reach higher points while building your base.

482d2c1f227bad448eb159dff3e48b44.name: Efflorescent Hope Chest
482d2c1f227bad448eb159dff3e48b44.desc: This royal chest piece frames a gleaming gem as its heart, reminding the wearer that hope will prevail. Taupe colored sleeves drape at the sides like a chrysalis being shed. The shoulders are accentuated by wing- or petal-like shapes, blossoming outwards.

0c64defd51e5ef46a56d3c0c2f521f71.name: Greater Shroud Survival Flask
0c64defd51e5ef46a56d3c0c2f521f71.desc:
Contains cleansed Shroud Liquid, enhancing the resistance of the user.

Must be taken before entering the Shroud. Extends the Time in the Shroud by 4 minutes. This effect will last for 45 minutes.

2c9741f0f1a2a1448f704fee2f41b263.name: Round Steel Window Frame
2c9741f0f1a2a1448f704fee2f41b263.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

578d9d3a4ee3a94f801003f3a7c0a791.name: Soldier Gloves
578d9d3a4ee3a94f801003f3a7c0a791.desc: Few enemies can withstand even an unarmed blow dealt with these gloves.

076defe047abe74bb2eace38204fdbbc.name: Fireball III
076defe047abe74bb2eace38204fdbbc.desc:
Ignites a fireball projectile that erupts upon impact and deals damage in an area. 

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

bae4561b04381643a4a08f36703e69e7.name: Aurora Bean Seedling
bae4561b04381643a4a08f36703e69e7.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in Basalt Farm Soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

dc28f3eec1a0f344ac64573eaa1a76b6.name: Wooden Crate
dc28f3eec1a0f344ac64573eaa1a76b6.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

63f3897a1213704a98f5e3aa28413948.name: Fire Bolt VIII
63f3897a1213704a98f5e3aa28413948.desc:
Ignites a fire bolt projectile that deals damage to a single target.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

4f89f62985758e43b65df86f663762e8.name: Dragonsbane
4f89f62985758e43b65df86f663762e8.desc:
An axe found atop the skull of a giant dragon skeleton. Legends say it was used to slay the mother dragon, but it wasn't lodged inside her cranium when you found it. 

That's probably for the best. Mothers have enough headaches already.

bd02794f11439740a0bd32260ce6498e.name: Snap Trap
bd02794f11439740a0bd32260ce6498e.desc: If you accidentally get caught in it, it will hurt a little and the shock will stun you for a short time. Better watch your step with these!

60bdba3743ce164fbbb90502b15901b2.name: Wooden Tooth
60bdba3743ce164fbbb90502b15901b2.desc: A traditional and excellently carved wooden hammer made by Vukah craftsmen. Resembles a large tooth and is very good at removing such.

bac5b503b8e1c442b7f707b704330bfd.name: Shroud Wood Block
bac5b503b8e1c442b7f707b704330bfd.desc:
A wood block made from trees that died a long time ago. They are extremely common in areas of the Shroud.

Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

cec0070419a75448ab02bba359b2152e.name: Flame Arcanist Chest
cec0070419a75448ab02bba359b2152e.desc: An admiral blue-colored garment often worn by magic scholars who revere the Mother Flame. The cape attached to the shoulders falls in layers and ends in uneven trim, dancing like little spouts of fire as it moves in the wind.

3fed0be12ae14648a3f431773d157706.name: Guardian Gloves
3fed0be12ae14648a3f431773d157706.desc: Big and bulky gloves, usually worn when wielding large weaponry and shields.

44bb65deb74ed24b89d4073a43fc69ac.name: Supply Sacks I
44bb65deb74ed24b89d4073a43fc69ac.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

8ba2842cce1b704b9c1f76b1c77b6cc9.name: Elite Hollow Helmet
8ba2842cce1b704b9c1f76b1c77b6cc9.desc: An extravagant helmet with red plumes, traditionally worn by high-ranking army commanders.

e2826f68f3fcea478199d0157504f9f0.name: Eternal Ember Arrow II
e2826f68f3fcea478199d0157504f9f0.desc:
An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's blazing hot.

Eternal Arrow: Does not deplete Ammo per use. Equip the Eternal Arrow and use Mana to shoot it with a Bow.

120c1ef5dd18af4e97b1e20468c89a8f.name: Rogue Helmet
120c1ef5dd18af4e97b1e20468c89a8f.desc: A sturdy helmet that protects the wearer from slashes, cuts, and scars.

857a333efba39940b560823a64a5b7d3.name: Nails
857a333efba39940b560823a64a5b7d3.desc: Nails made from Metal Scraps. Sharp objects that can be used as a tool or to improve a weapon.

08d24237ff23aa40b72f0074bcc6798a.name: Water Barrel
08d24237ff23aa40b72f0074bcc6798a.desc: A barrel that will store rainwater.

6ebef5b9a016c348bcff7853b1842bfb.name: Gunther Galeforth
6ebef5b9a016c348bcff7853b1842bfb.desc: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

7a93922c9e244d4c91368b8dcb805637.name: Baby Fae Deer
7a93922c9e244d4c91368b8dcb805637.desc: A baby Fae Deer. They are fragile after birth, but they learn to walk and gallop astonishingly quickly!

55ac5fa9dbd6b843877c05fe389effac.name: Revelwood Stone
55ac5fa9dbd6b843877c05fe389effac.desc: The best stories start small. For example with a stone.

4692c4573f82044296152b27bf91a97b.name: Polished Scrap Brazier
4692c4573f82044296152b27bf91a97b.desc:
A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.

8d75c0a47381a94da5717539dc5a2319.name: White Luminescent Block
8d75c0a47381a94da5717539dc5a2319.desc:
A building block crafted from White Glowing Substance. Its radiance brightens up any space.

Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

1a118504315c534295014012505e96dc.name: Goat Hammer
1a118504315c534295014012505e96dc.desc: A hammer that has been further improved by an added goat horn in the back. Only the finest, most sturdy horns are selected!

f39a85cc3c9ca9438e199967a98b7473.name: Prison Fence
f39a85cc3c9ca9438e199967a98b7473.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

855b4423a65efb418f9c685f6aa6dd3f.name: Huge Chest
855b4423a65efb418f9c685f6aa6dd3f.desc: A big and heavy chest that offers fantastic storage space for countless items.

2d42ff4e8803b4448fb55970401dd05d.name: Herbalist Tunic
2d42ff4e8803b4448fb55970401dd05d.desc: Classic herbalist garb with widened pockets for storing healing tinctures.

e9a077facc629a48a0ffca668b7775a6.name: Leather Bag
e9a077facc629a48a0ffca668b7775a6.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ee344c4092a82f46bd1057b2e967dcab.name: Fell Dragon Youngling Head
ee344c4092a82f46bd1057b2e967dcab.desc:
Its head alone weighs a monstrous amount. The shimmering scales are ice-cold.

Collect multiple Fell Dragon Youngling Heads to craft the Trophy.

a09266b712a5a24a95add5d7fdd19298.name: Frog In The Grass
a09266b712a5a24a95add5d7fdd19298.desc:
Muted shades of green help you blend in, almost invisible as you chase little frogs through the grass.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

d8defe5d10810646b7806ec52a02a5a3.name: Archmage Boots
d8defe5d10810646b7806ec52a02a5a3.desc: These boots were made by the most talented cobblers and are as expensive as they come.

c84a1367f6c327429d56e20d5bb4b1d9.name: Pearlfrost Mentor Hat
c84a1367f6c327429d56e20d5bb4b1d9.desc: When wounded warriors see this hat peak up from the horizon, they know salvation is near. Then they notice that the hat is a little bit cone-shaped. They usually don't say anything about it, though.

c1be9c43c8cb714c851faf38642a4e5d.name: Sand
c1be9c43c8cb714c851faf38642a4e5d.desc:
A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. 

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

61fe69deb99f7340b131aead68e3b7eb.name: Arc Lightning
61fe69deb99f7340b131aead68e3b7eb.desc:
Releases continuous lightning strikes that can jump to multiple other close targets.
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

28cbdfd40a7a4646a6462d8e43a2410e.name: Summer Games Pants
28cbdfd40a7a4646a6462d8e43a2410e.desc: The brown trousers possess a reinforced and padded knee area, visible through the applied scale pattern.

643639cf97caed489bdc972d139cfa8c.name: Scrap Cage
643639cf97caed489bdc972d139cfa8c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e981044b78dcb54eb081c02b0bd5c04c.name: Eternal Heal Cascade I
e981044b78dcb54eb081c02b0bd5c04c.desc:
Releases continuous healing projectiles that automatically seek you and your allies.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

f78f6bcac1c0ff4d99ab35fedfd3c6ff.name: Ectoplasm Shard
f78f6bcac1c0ff4d99ab35fedfd3c6ff.desc: A good amount of crystallized ectoplasm. Inside slumbers the essence of vitality.

bc7e095e04e2114d94bfddbde62ae7c2.name: Blackmire Bark
bc7e095e04e2114d94bfddbde62ae7c2.desc: Bark from the giant trees in the Blackmire. It feels rough but could look quite cozy.

df4e3bab3fb6b44da7ec751141766a5a.name: Archaic Essence I
df4e3bab3fb6b44da7ec751141766a5a.desc:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.

d57f6f1a7fa663449efbf6b8d215b8e4.name: Blood Rose Chestplate
d57f6f1a7fa663449efbf6b8d215b8e4.desc: A laced-up metal bodice that births a crinoline-esque cage. You shan't let these shackles fool you. No band, and no blood can manacle the wrath of the Blood Rose.

f9e8d498192e0c49b772b31ba16597bf.name: Fowler Chest
f9e8d498192e0c49b772b31ba16597bf.desc: The details on this piece of upper body armor were greatly inspired by wing feathers.

b26d839a364e334fa7f75fd350e55153.name: Deadeye Gloves
b26d839a364e334fa7f75fd350e55153.desc: Your shots will always find their mark with these gloves.

5c42e00f154ad547b7c137a0083550ca.name: Club of Defiance
5c42e00f154ad547b7c137a0083550ca.desc: This club can take on hordes of enemies, never wavering.

94a0fee6579933429c84a69c2a25acf4.name: Small Boreal Wood Cupboard
94a0fee6579933429c84a69c2a25acf4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e620437f73da9c4d934fd6fa5d95b688.name: Traitor's Bow
e620437f73da9c4d934fd6fa5d95b688.desc: This bow fires easily against creatures of the Shroud.

167f99f64b2aa54e877298a1d3ad827e.name: Bronze Bars
167f99f64b2aa54e877298a1d3ad827e.desc: A beautiful material known for its warm and bright color. Artisans around the world have turned towards it for centuries, due to its workable characteristics.

c0a32cba2932d843ab35c1aefcb84f5b.name: Skull Stalker Pants
c0a32cba2932d843ab35c1aefcb84f5b.desc: These pants move with you through the underbrush, boosting your stamina as you stalk your prey.

f6eca205cb23f640b42eb0f208b25c4c.name: Efflorescent Hope Flower Crown
f6eca205cb23f640b42eb0f208b25c4c.desc:
A wearable floral wreath. Each sprig, bud, and leaf has been meticulously woven to create a blooming halo.
Whoever hand-crafted this did so with botanical knowledge and love.

f6ecc0175d76eb4bb2f5f9aa2ccb3907.name: Claravinta's Seedling Swinger
f6ecc0175d76eb4bb2f5f9aa2ccb3907.desc:
"This simple mace hides something fantastic inside — a plethora of seeds that will help war-ridden lands recover faster after battle! With this, we'll nurture the flora of the future while defending the present! I've opted for sustainable wheat, nutritious bell peppers, and beautiful cornflowers... in a breathtaking hue of my own design."

- Elder Claravinta

782512f7fc857e48bfebbd194c10dfd7.name: Banana
782512f7fc857e48bfebbd194c10dfd7.desc: A ripe, yellow banana. It can be eaten raw or used in another dish — without the peel, of course.

9614595230aadb4887d4718c2ed7d805.name: Ice Beam Wand
9614595230aadb4887d4718c2ed7d805.desc:
This wand grants power over ice to whoever is brave enough to wield it.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. 

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

27654df54551584da105b8de3086d692.name: Iron Fell Crimson Critter Queen Trophy
27654df54551584da105b8de3086d692.desc:
It's quite unsettling that her intense stare and her burning eyes won't fade. They keep on watching you.

Collect multiple Fell Crimson Critter Queen Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

b19681ab76dbf744ba1ffc3386fe39a0.name: Drak Blood
b19681ab76dbf744ba1ffc3386fe39a0.desc: Violet blood. It runs cold, and the consistency is somewhat syrupy.

e6010038e210f840b6cddd89797daa2b.name: Iron Block
e6010038e210f840b6cddd89797daa2b.desc: Iron Blocks are incredibly reliable and add a decorative edge to any building.

515e1a15136d7342a7a23b419c769bc7.name: Goldlaced Greatsword
515e1a15136d7342a7a23b419c769bc7.desc: An azure gem, curved guard, and gold-patterened edge embellish this sword. All in all, it is both beautiful and deadly.

d54195e4d6072245bba24e2bbaa0db14.name: Anton Godwin
d54195e4d6072245bba24e2bbaa0db14.desc: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

4c24af3757838f4da8b6e75271217d71.name: Crypt Chandelier
4c24af3757838f4da8b6e75271217d71.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

45f97cb05d5f1a4280a12549b8fb1b4a.name: Ginger Tea
45f97cb05d5f1a4280a12549b8fb1b4a.desc: This ginger tea tastes like the paragon of good health.

e8200718a1ac394797f7114de95af1b1.name: Fell Critter Queen Trophy
e8200718a1ac394797f7114de95af1b1.desc: The Fell Critter Queen's antennas are stiff with age, and her curved, fang-like mandibles still frame her mouth. You don't feel terror when looking at them now; they seem almost delicate to your touch.

34e9460c04f96f499efb91cfebe2903a.name: Hollow Wispwyvern Head
34e9460c04f96f499efb91cfebe2903a.desc: It broke your bones with bones. Seemed only fair to take a few of its own. The head's still intact — makes for a decent trophy.

5465c26e415e8544af92922cbb9bd3d5.name: Stone Window Frame
5465c26e415e8544af92922cbb9bd3d5.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4af1b943a601b045a116095c0020c44b.name: Drak Relief VII
4af1b943a601b045a116095c0020c44b.desc:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

The beasts stand victorious, their supremacy uncontested. They are locked in a constant fight for leadership, spilling blood in a desperate attempt to gain the Ancient's favor and become gods in the afterlife.

f0e8f568d074a145b3e087d18d1e46a2.name: Book I
f0e8f568d074a145b3e087d18d1e46a2.desc: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.

84143919720398499388c1a1b7c15074.name: Stormshield
84143919720398499388c1a1b7c15074.desc: A metal plate shield that was twisted and shaped in a Shroudstorm. It seems to be almost indestructible.

69a6abcfd3f0964ca63fb68d772e7aa2.name: Book I
69a6abcfd3f0964ca63fb68d772e7aa2.desc: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.

5a8ae3f20f7a344ab05a3a5bbab71288.name: Noble Dress
5a8ae3f20f7a344ab05a3a5bbab71288.desc: A long, flowing garment. The lower seam effortlessly hovers around the ankles while you walk.

0daa4f7c9ff06045ab4a9406e310b311.name: Eternal Shroud Beam
0daa4f7c9ff06045ab4a9406e310b311.desc:
Releases an aimed ray of disastrous Shroud that continuously deals damage to enemies within. 

Shroud Spell: This spell results in a debuff that reduces your Time in the Shroud.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

64bade768385104788514de476081b0e.name: Spellweaver Chestplate
64bade768385104788514de476081b0e.desc: A lightweight, yet sturdy garnet-colored gambeson. The fire of magic burns inside. It is your duty, Flameborn, to tend to it evermore — for if you perish, the art of sorcery will die with you.

94438333c599b24793b236aa6a2eaa73.name: Glider
94438333c599b24793b236aa6a2eaa73.desc: The possibility to fly has always been a desirable trait. Press %k whilst in the air to open the Glider. Using the wind currents and the height of the starting point, it can be used to travel great distances in an instant.

db7958522e1c1d40b62bab010e8627b0.name: Conifer Tree Seedling
db7958522e1c1d40b62bab010e8627b0.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

cae32ac44f8e634e85ca57e2637b915a.name: Wall Banner of the Ancients III
cae32ac44f8e634e85ca57e2637b915a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

cf4500932fba3c4686a4048f4fd7e86c.name: Ethereal Ward
cf4500932fba3c4686a4048f4fd7e86c.desc: This ward creates an otherworldly light that protects the wielder from incoming damage, akin to a divine blessing.

2e4a7cdbb769234e9c9df719b21fbbc5.name: "Temple Landscape"
2e4a7cdbb769234e9c9df719b21fbbc5.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

535cd324bf4f4f4b81a084a1d6aae3f6.name: Wooden Bowl
535cd324bf4f4f4b81a084a1d6aae3f6.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

57768b5b49c0e545844fc2088e8c5dc2.name: Pillar Of Flames II
57768b5b49c0e545844fc2088e8c5dc2.desc:
Ignites an area with flames that continuously damage enemies within.
It also applies a burn debuff to them.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

4eb7b6bab135d849a8b48c2bfac9ad0e.name: Large Spiral Stone Stairs
4eb7b6bab135d849a8b48c2bfac9ad0e.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

34ab44be3a5ad443a459228c38117478.name: Explosive Arrow III
34ab44be3a5ad443a459228c38117478.desc: A Special Arrow that delivers an explosive surprise. Strikes with greatly improved firepower.

7625895d476cbc42b37ffd1f7d7ac855.name: Mountain's Shadow Boots
7625895d476cbc42b37ffd1f7d7ac855.desc: These boots repeat the same weaving technique from the Mountain's Shadow Gloves. They cover the knees and provide ideal protection when stumbling through dark, icy caves or forgotten fortresses.

db5a836fecdada45a5848f66a6d0a751.name: Coconut Milk
db5a836fecdada45a5848f66a6d0a751.desc: This creamy coconut milk makes for a great refreshment on a sunny day by the shore! It can also be used as an ingredient in cooking.

d2c8de109f81fe42abf21c49c1c05839.name: Yak Feeder
d2c8de109f81fe42abf21c49c1c05839.desc:
A feeding device that holds Yak food.

It will feed your animals when filled with the corresponding food.

63dcddbc184d724cbb3c18a63c9b46fe.name: Drak Relief II
63dcddbc184d724cbb3c18a63c9b46fe.desc:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

The Drak are shown to build temples under a bright sun, resembling the Ancients. They see the Ancients as godlike due to their overwhelming prowess, and aim to gain their favor to ascend to godhood themselves.

b50ca3dbe502c14d9e96711246c9e737.name: Magician Chest
b50ca3dbe502c14d9e96711246c9e737.desc: An ordinary shirt, covered partially by a more sophisticated jacket.

5e2ad21a7f6ed54487a7ef9ce166b05d.name: Bloodfeather Pants
5e2ad21a7f6ed54487a7ef9ce166b05d.desc: Designed for stealth, these neutral pants make sneaking through the thicket effortless.

a42a716c94ee044c89c29578a678e64c.name: Wood Wall I
a42a716c94ee044c89c29578a678e64c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4a7523a4e5649e4f8de0a959a874558d.name: Vorgoth's Soulbound Boots
4a7523a4e5649e4f8de0a959a874558d.desc: Solid metal and forged shut. No gap, no give.

07182383be285842bfb7dcd703d45601.name: Hailcaster Hat
07182383be285842bfb7dcd703d45601.desc: A sophisticated crown that frames the wearer's head with a golden halo and amethyst sparks. It represents the dawning sun, bathing the mountainsides in a long-awaited morning glow.

a95c8c85524408428fb855c3ae14b388.name: Radiant Paladin Helmet
a95c8c85524408428fb855c3ae14b388.desc: A brightly burning visage graces this helmet, setting both the battlefield and hearts alike ablaze.

dd30e422cc6b4948bc3ca374b3bd2bf1.name: Fertile Altered Dirt
dd30e422cc6b4948bc3ca374b3bd2bf1.desc:
A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. 

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

fe2e29218299dd468987b44294d1d126.name: Flag Pole I
fe2e29218299dd468987b44294d1d126.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

42a52c2332080746b827f7c50de1603e.name: Eternal Ember Arrow III
42a52c2332080746b827f7c50de1603e.desc:
An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's blazing hot.

Eternal Arrow: Does not deplete Ammo per use. Equip the Eternal Arrow and use Mana to shoot it with a Bow.

adcbbce8cdbf494abe581f1263466450.name: Bamboo Stairs
adcbbce8cdbf494abe581f1263466450.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f383c183b64e394eab23f268e88b2fab.name: Dusk Garden
f383c183b64e394eab23f268e88b2fab.desc:
Ancient and earthy, cut through with a breath of fresh thyme.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

d07b269e8acbd043bce0795db84ec595.name: Licuala Seedling
d07b269e8acbd043bce0795db84ec595.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.

ffb1bcf6c0896544b8471a11f6d0314e.name: Sand Throne
ffb1bcf6c0896544b8471a11f6d0314e.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

489acbc72a583e42b3623b360f8292fd.name: Fell Sentinel Bow
489acbc72a583e42b3623b360f8292fd.desc: A bow wielded by the army's elite archers. No intruder dares to cross the sights of a Sentinel.

102c8ccde5fee249a70e80aa36a08625.name: Bejeweled Golden Urn
102c8ccde5fee249a70e80aa36a08625.desc: An angular, golden urn. To match the sentimental value of the ashes, the grieving family adorned this vessel with ruby-red jewels. When shaking the urn, an act that is most likely godless and foul, you can hear clanking inside...

2fa16f350f924845a04da1a39326d3fc.name: "Wolf's Choir"
2fa16f350f924845a04da1a39326d3fc.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

09a0d54be690554ab94430262d9ad11c.name: Pearlfrost Mentor Boots
09a0d54be690554ab94430262d9ad11c.desc: Tied dark leather boots with quilted fabric sections. They reach up to the wearer's knees, protecting the shins from deep snow.

f4485199ac335c44b0764845e1c4523b.name: Abyssal Wing Axe
f4485199ac335c44b0764845e1c4523b.desc: The crystal heart, placed between the wings, pulsates with the cold hunger of the abyss.

8b4d5eb9b2f9174489da3560ea3dc72e.name: Iron Fell Sicklescythe Trophy
8b4d5eb9b2f9174489da3560ea3dc72e.desc:
Remains of a wandering specter, doomed to wither on the mortal plane. Its lips are sealed, its eyes are forever shut. The evil has been cast out.

Collect multiple Fell Sicklescythe Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

bf31cd75c34f9d48b2be7686885e708a.name: Talion's Bow
bf31cd75c34f9d48b2be7686885e708a.desc: A bow used by Commanders of the Northern Guard. A powerful energy flows through the user, increasing their pulse and allowing for faster shots.

a91ed092e103d04db710fed398f9aac7.name: Snowflake Splicer
a91ed092e103d04db710fed398f9aac7.desc: This bow is so precise that it can split a faraway snowflake in two.

ae4f247f857af340a7c62082e4d057da.name: Shootable Button
ae4f247f857af340a7c62082e4d057da.desc: This shootable button can only be activated with a ranged weapon by shooting it with an arrow or spell projectile. It switches between ON and OFF every time it is hit.

ab6bdf5e9139cc4a86ccc916683faf53.name: Lantern Garden Gnome
ab6bdf5e9139cc4a86ccc916683faf53.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

65b3df66514546488d20d35b754aff91.name: Yellow Fountain
65b3df66514546488d20d35b754aff91.desc: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

02695ef6d9ff334988268c64f056012a.name: Warlock Boots
02695ef6d9ff334988268c64f056012a.desc: Traditional warlock boots, which protect the feet and allow the wearer to stampede over enemy remains.

eb528e3f0ca550499cd91d4f52279dbc.name: Algae Buds
eb528e3f0ca550499cd91d4f52279dbc.desc: These are the buds of an algae plant. They're inedible when raw, but can be dried.

b3319f61a628c245855e4beb9730f473.name: Sacred Vukah Scroll
b3319f61a628c245855e4beb9730f473.desc: Offers a prayer to the ancient Vukah. If answered, the user will deal more damage against Scavengers and be fortified against their poison.

42677ccb5f3d8e4584d71bbfed5d0dd9.name: Half-Timbered Block
42677ccb5f3d8e4584d71bbfed5d0dd9.desc: Timbering is an ancient building technique that was very popular for its decorative effect.

6f69b5c88ab79c439d5d1259daefc86e.name: Excellent Fishing Rod
6f69b5c88ab79c439d5d1259daefc86e.desc: A fine fishing rod that makes catching fish as easy as possible. You can reel in fish faster and hold out longer if they put up a fight.

6f69d97309b0f34a965fb2439916c291.name: Red Hair
6f69d97309b0f34a965fb2439916c291.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

de66f21b56422a4190be1110d375333a.name: Clay Vase VI
de66f21b56422a4190be1110d375333a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

995e303dcb5b514a9b17f0b6687b5c1e.name: Brazen Bull Boots
995e303dcb5b514a9b17f0b6687b5c1e.desc: No one will get through you whilst you stand your ground in these regal boots.

3c7921e51341014d964ce9b037d2425b.name: Emblem Of The Flameborn
3c7921e51341014d964ce9b037d2425b.desc: A decorative statue or standing crest that represents the Flameborn and their dedication.

6360259c2f7d2d4c8f22632e1ed15796.name: Springlands Miniature Piece
6360259c2f7d2d4c8f22632e1ed15796.desc:
A model of the Springlands, the place where everything began. Green rolling hills, the smell of honey in the air, and clear skies above — but life couldn't stay this peaceful. Not for a Flameborn, anyway.

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.

973bc4714431b24a8ddcac0a62efe235.name: Wildheart Hood
973bc4714431b24a8ddcac0a62efe235.desc: A hood and mask. The latter reminds you of a bird of prey, ready to descend on its enemies at high noon. Your shadow will be the last they'll ever see.

c4a61eb2f4b05e44967a61c488fe2960.name: Draconian Bow
c4a61eb2f4b05e44967a61c488fe2960.desc: Crafted to resemble the wings of the most infamous Kindlewastes dwellers, the Draconian Vulture.

bba89306735b8f419cc6c80641afbb3d.name: Rusty Short Sword
bba89306735b8f419cc6c80641afbb3d.desc: A forgotten sword from long-gone days. Commonly found among the ashes of Embervale.

19aa5703c41b304e9ed7b287c8295bc7.name: Medium Hollow's Eve Pumpkin I
19aa5703c41b304e9ed7b287c8295bc7.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

a2086ca9cd12a549b85eed9f0a045cfb.name: Wizard Boots
a2086ca9cd12a549b85eed9f0a045cfb.desc: Remain steadfast when smiting your foes from afar with these formidable wizard boots.

4248bd92a7e61b4eab6f341204c4fedd.name: Crestflame Chest
4248bd92a7e61b4eab6f341204c4fedd.desc: A belted chest armor piece that's marked by thick, linear grooves and ridges that stretch towards the sun. It is adorned with violet trim that elevates the construction and creates a pleasing color palette reminiscent of the hues of the Mother Flame.

ac11fa0060ceb540a40ae213fe3ae1a7.name: Fire Bolt V
ac11fa0060ceb540a40ae213fe3ae1a7.desc:
Ignites a fire bolt projectile that deals damage to a single target.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

5c0cf98bc58e294abde48526c119cec1.name: Emberguard Gloves
5c0cf98bc58e294abde48526c119cec1.desc: Proud gloves forged from the finest celestium. Two metal ridges protrude from each spine, enabling the warrior wearing them to push their way through hordes of enemies if needed.

e6eabb28bf750742a72e858ddd7bab6e.name: Invisible Barrier Ward
e6eabb28bf750742a72e858ddd7bab6e.desc: With this ward, you can conjure a nearly invisible barrier that can keep you from harm in a time of need.

064e54c5a87d9848a790e5dbcc5aba6b.name: Efflorescent Hope Flower Crown
064e54c5a87d9848a790e5dbcc5aba6b.desc:
A wearable floral wreath. Each sprig, bud, and leaf has been meticulously woven to create a blooming halo.
Whoever hand-crafted this did so with botanical knowledge and love.

da809a6965d6744daba0474afd80459b.name: Flame Arcanist Pants
da809a6965d6744daba0474afd80459b.desc: An assortment of dark layers that protect the wearer's legs from becoming singed, scorched, or incinerated when conjuring fire magic.

56f8548ecc22dc4fba637afeb7ccac31.name: Wolfsbane
56f8548ecc22dc4fba637afeb7ccac31.desc: This plant is notable due to its stunning electrifying colorway, its delicate petals, and its deadly poison.

c06d411214167a41bf329812e916fd63.name: Icefang Blade
c06d411214167a41bf329812e916fd63.desc: A blade that seems to be forged from ice itself.

2e713ead9c652b428e1864a04efcfc08.name: Bamboo Palm Leaf Umbrella
2e713ead9c652b428e1864a04efcfc08.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e2d037d6da74c14ebf976e610b8aa685.name: Room Divider "Fish"
e2d037d6da74c14ebf976e610b8aa685.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

96de1588ef561c43965aa785e02e67dd.name: Lifelock Helmet
96de1588ef561c43965aa785e02e67dd.desc: A robust circlet helmet that sits deep on the forehead and covers the eyes, like a descending one-eyed vulture.

f307e745bc75514a844a22339cee7afd.name: Blackmire Statue I
f307e745bc75514a844a22339cee7afd.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6e0c6c455363654587fb6332ff6da22a.name: Ranger Gloves
6e0c6c455363654587fb6332ff6da22a.desc: Simple gloves made from ethically sourced organic leather.

e780275f2dc48544b9004a7158c64503.name: Fake Wooden Floor Passage
e780275f2dc48544b9004a7158c64503.desc: Fool others looking for hidden passages in your base with this fake secret door.

944bfaf3360e3044848d05fa4db37261.name: Bright Morningstar
944bfaf3360e3044848d05fa4db37261.desc: A club with long, protruding spikes forged from moon-bathed steel. Spilled blood is easily visible on this weapon.

eea14997e77cbe47a4bc40e2974ef9d4.name: Medium Flask
eea14997e77cbe47a4bc40e2974ef9d4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

26664617824dce45b8e5599df5e0fa1a.name: Common Fish Bait
26664617824dce45b8e5599df5e0fa1a.desc: A type of bait used to catch common fish. It smells odd.

caeb1da67abdeb49bcd06b2f1e39cb15.name: Guard Of The North Sword
caeb1da67abdeb49bcd06b2f1e39cb15.desc: Lord Vorgoth's once-trusted blade was discarded before the war and replaced by a weapon more befitting vile acts. It still clings to a semblance of sanity and light, shining brightly in the dark like the North Star.

0924070c0d3a3b42bbfa02facb0f6a96.name: Exclusive Hollow Helmet
0924070c0d3a3b42bbfa02facb0f6a96.desc: Vibrant amethyst-colored plumes adorn this helmet, indicating that the previous wearer might have been a royal commander.

faf2c8c1ddab904abc7836acf87ac933.name: Climbing Rose
faf2c8c1ddab904abc7836acf87ac933.desc: Use the Overgrowth Tool to apply this to structures in your base.

e4d3bb06874c064aaf016e9647853131.name: Keen Games Banner
e4d3bb06874c064aaf016e9647853131.desc: A banner bearing a mark not native to this world.

e04be242818d524ca91747fd7d1c7c61.name: Big Blackmire Statue II
e04be242818d524ca91747fd7d1c7c61.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

5df57040f426444cb4fc8aeb7b13fdf8.name: Noble Pants
5df57040f426444cb4fc8aeb7b13fdf8.desc: These sleek trousers are usually worn underneath more lavish dresses or tunics.

d0e060069d5a394fb7450bd1b1cc9bcc.name: Boreal Wood Chair
d0e060069d5a394fb7450bd1b1cc9bcc.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

55db2270fecbff4b98049a727be0798d.name: Active Mycelium
55db2270fecbff4b98049a727be0798d.desc: The active mycelium of mushrooms absorbs the Shroud's magical properties. Could this be used for alchemical purposes?

ef6b6005bbf5a84ab448af6d74e06fa9.name: Laurel Tree Seedling
ef6b6005bbf5a84ab448af6d74e06fa9.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.

a6dcb0975e0f80479548c470e5367d80.name: Red Flower
a6dcb0975e0f80479548c470e5367d80.desc: A tiny potted plant to beautify your home.

d0c1bd3de798254b9327937444b6ac87.name: Athalan Skree
d0c1bd3de798254b9327937444b6ac87.desc: The Hunter Athalan Skree helps you to build armors and creates equipment for survival.

c690960127ec8e48ab2385445a8aab23.name: Clay Cup
c690960127ec8e48ab2385445a8aab23.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

16ec908b2ec5d248a14e70eee5885df9.name: Baroness Daggers
16ec908b2ec5d248a14e70eee5885df9.desc:
An elegant dual dagger set with extravagant gold detailing. It's slim enough to be smuggled underneath a nightgown unseen into any chamber.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

80294fca3fbd0d48a30996a0aef8db76.name: Golden War Hero Axe
80294fca3fbd0d48a30996a0aef8db76.desc: Many soldiers fall in war. Those who return are heralded and showered in gold and gifts; given weapons befitting a celebrated veteran... but for some, such gifts merely serve as a reminder of their harrowing past.

9ee2a25d912ab7469c49469e40a18e1d.name: Boreal Wood Garden Fence Door
9ee2a25d912ab7469c49469e40a18e1d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6fcef71028f97d45b7ba104fab1fa5fb.name: Ring of the Flame
6fcef71028f97d45b7ba104fab1fa5fb.desc: Filled with the burning Spark of the Flame, it's a valuable asset in the fight against the Shroud. It increases the time you can withstand the Shroud.

49e438ed061dcf4fb69d0b8998db9a61.name: Carved Tropical Wood Fence Pole
49e438ed061dcf4fb69d0b8998db9a61.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c1ed6517646c3e4aa7375ec7f6924a47.name: Adventurer Helmet
c1ed6517646c3e4aa7375ec7f6924a47.desc: A simple but reliable helmet. You might still get a bump or two if you get hit, but that's part of the fun.

c671ab90fd97c642b75313c5f86ba5fa.name: Fenrig's Axe
c671ab90fd97c642b75313c5f86ba5fa.desc: An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.

33f65fb237f71b4ca71903b8f02b80a2.name: Drak Temple Block
33f65fb237f71b4ca71903b8f02b80a2.desc: A building block that's commonly used by the Drak, specifically the Drak'Dal.

0d55cb0baa70d646be9845752fb9adb1.name: Flag Pole VI
0d55cb0baa70d646be9845752fb9adb1.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d36dc9ab662cda4da5e8487dd94bc2ae.name: Wizard Chest
d36dc9ab662cda4da5e8487dd94bc2ae.desc: Protects the wearer from stray sparks, sudden cold flashes, and unplanned fiery explosions.

62856e933d726843b8eac501e725a465.name: Mercenary Shield
62856e933d726843b8eac501e725a465.desc: A shield that will provide safety and aid. For a price.

4c9160c6460e0842aa3f35402a224db2.name: Ancient Temple Bench
4c9160c6460e0842aa3f35402a224db2.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

75d9c5d7369dd04999800c807d671a15.name: Harrow
75d9c5d7369dd04999800c807d671a15.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1f9128c1c6e9a349ad12f36f5b63cbe2.name: Statue of Queen Pikemead
1f9128c1c6e9a349ad12f36f5b63cbe2.desc:
A statue of the late queen Pikemead. An engraving on the bottom reads: 

Gather 'round, we're drinkin'! 
An ode to the Queen, once young! 
3 babes on 'er arm, cup filled to the brim. 
Thinkin' out loud, she'd sung!

e704f12c9c40fd4790a0cd043455b57d.name: Wailing Blade
e704f12c9c40fd4790a0cd043455b57d.desc: An expertly crafted blade, balanced and sharp. Cuts through foes like a wail through the night. It bears the mark of a famous blacksmith from Pikemead's Reach.

c4ec81f5c2d35041afb6fef75b9f9caf.name: Iron Scavenger Artificer Trophy
c4ec81f5c2d35041afb6fef75b9f9caf.desc:
The craftsman in you has created a masterpiece. This iron trophy is a true work of art. Perhaps the Scavenger Artificer would be proud, too, if only he could still speak.

Collect multiple Scavenger Artificer Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

b753030aa2061b4cad13a312c955e772.name: Flame Mosaic Piece VIII
b753030aa2061b4cad13a312c955e772.desc:
A small part of a shattered Flame mosaic. Perhaps you can piece it together if you find all the shards!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. The full collection includes 8 pieces. They can be reassembled into a mosaic inside a Flame Mosaic Frame. The Frame must be placed on the ground.

d73209017d55d54d9960e538ff6e1c9e.name: Explosive Powder Ball
d73209017d55d54d9960e538ff6e1c9e.desc:
An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

e37553bbd2bc2d40b697de43ddcff3da.name: Polished Window Frame
e37553bbd2bc2d40b697de43ddcff3da.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

139a7cca501c02478eeca0a6d7209ab4.name: Ornate Lute
139a7cca501c02478eeca0a6d7209ab4.desc: An expertly crafted lute, originally owned by Chester Loft of The Honeydews — the most daring and lucky of the members. Fans also dubbed him "The Lucky Lute". Despite his adventurous tastes, his good fortune always kept him and his lute out of trouble, so the quality and craftsmanship of the instrument are well preserved.

f36c0d6948a403409556867fa58ddb4d.name: Nightfall
f36c0d6948a403409556867fa58ddb4d.desc:
A dagger set made from darkened steel, reflecting the moonlight on its fractured edges.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

af3e9c433eed434fb1ea8bd39e9dea3e.name: Camera
af3e9c433eed434fb1ea8bd39e9dea3e.desc: You can take screenshots with this item.

f2c7a0f55a52cc4082b12ca5fda9b644.name: Herbalist Boots
f2c7a0f55a52cc4082b12ca5fda9b644.desc: Quickly dash to the rescue in these comfortable and snug boots!

3587030d6d61fc46bc4f18a65d5351b2.name: Prison Fence
3587030d6d61fc46bc4f18a65d5351b2.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
