50fe0b8b0cbfd642b2421485f4cc5488.name: Fertile Veilwater Basin Dirt
50fe0b8b0cbfd642b2421485f4cc5488.desc:
A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. 

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

50fe9d9604f4a444a25af956f3f46fbd.name: Ball Lightning II
50fe9d9604f4a444a25af956f3f46fbd.desc:
Conjures a slow-moving ball of lightning that travels unhindered through enemies and some obstacles.
It continuously releases lightning strikes to nearby enemies that also deal Stamina Damage, which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. 

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

eb5a3186b035694da6830e7e699e30a7.name: Papyrus Seedling
eb5a3186b035694da6830e7e699e30a7.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

c0b3c28700269547a38c34235718e494.name: Pikemead's Peak
c0b3c28700269547a38c34235718e494.desc:
The time for glory is now. Bask in its glow.

Music Sheet: 
Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

46457520a4a7994bb52d30a3d13df066.name: Red Fountain
46457520a4a7994bb52d30a3d13df066.desc: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

2eb72dd604d6724dba0d33e055bcc641.name: Fine Stone Fence
2eb72dd604d6724dba0d33e055bcc641.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

57e34864fd932b4789989953c4ae7d36.name: Toxic Slime
57e34864fd932b4789989953c4ae7d36.desc: Mined from the deadly waste found in the Hollow Halls. Caution is advised!

f9d9f7345b237e488c7f372415a29bef.name: Fool's Errand
f9d9f7345b237e488c7f372415a29bef.desc:
You hear a faint whisper in the back of your head; unified in word, but spoken from a dozen tongues. A ghostly choir pleads with you.

"Descending these dungeons is a fool's errand, can't you see? Turn back while you still can."

6b6c618d5db28a4c831a18f57548deaf.name: High Iron Window Frame II
6b6c618d5db28a4c831a18f57548deaf.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

25ebfb107b83ea4894334fa5c66d4062.name: Epic Fishing Bait II
25ebfb107b83ea4894334fa5c66d4062.desc: This bait tastes so good, so when a fish bites, it will definitely be an epic fish local to Cinder's Cradle.

9bb368b2d09a5541ae75c929898d55b6.name: Butter
9bb368b2d09a5541ae75c929898d55b6.desc: Creamy butter with milky richness — perfect for bringing depth and tenderness to your baked creations.

a15340e9a3ebcb4b90fcf58e498dadff.name: Gold Vorgoth's Eye Trophy
a15340e9a3ebcb4b90fcf58e498dadff.desc:
Gold smooths over the jagged form, giving it an almost sacred appearance. The tendrils resemble ornamental roots rather than organic tissue. This trophy shows you are the greatest Flameborn of all time, because you did not back down from fighting evil more than once. You did it multiple times and were successful.

Collect multiple Vorgoth Eyes to craft the Gold Trophy.

29d77404d49b7548bea00d81ce63f59e.name: Valiant Shield
29d77404d49b7548bea00d81ce63f59e.desc: A formidable shield that can keep you and your allies safe.

f6dde9129ffa9047bf15ab994e44254b.name: Yellow Party Hat
f6dde9129ffa9047bf15ab994e44254b.desc: A fun little hat for fun little parties!

e09153f848358d4699773452666cee3f.name: Fine Hardwood Fence
e09153f848358d4699773452666cee3f.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6e33a02b16b0a445a8e0ca48568aa248.name: Small Prickle Pearl Plant Pot
6e33a02b16b0a445a8e0ca48568aa248.desc: An ancient potted plant. This one can be displayed in the Cultivation Rack.

40a61779e7a6904893319bf48ffa54bb.name: Basket I
40a61779e7a6904893319bf48ffa54bb.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c59e48f81609854580c843c4a17df320.name: Stripetail
c59e48f81609854580c843c4a17df320.desc:
A slender fish, recognizable by its distinctive black stripes running along its body.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

27566e570492554f94c4f800ef1d3077.name: Fell Dragon Youngling Trophy
27566e570492554f94c4f800ef1d3077.desc: A lonely soul, brought low by the Shroud — and set free by your blade.

d7d557a399df9b46aa3982648c571371.name: Quetzal Hunter Chest
d7d557a399df9b46aa3982648c571371.desc: As Quetzals no longer roam Embervale, dyed palm leaves are used in place of their feathers to recreate the look.

f74210b20b64074580a79fe6efe24475.name: Mercenary Gloves
f74210b20b64074580a79fe6efe24475.desc: Mercenary Gloves. They're worth their weight in gold.

f742549d16f35245929b3df47938ce0b.name: Scrap Bowl
f742549d16f35245929b3df47938ce0b.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

05011815d520dd4c8a74bd72792058d0.name: Wooden Palisade III
05011815d520dd4c8a74bd72792058d0.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c075ee572772094488c8197bcc7f1663.name: Castle Block
c075ee572772094488c8197bcc7f1663.desc: Only a prestigious castle can be built from such sturdy stone.

fc923ebd5ea63848a02409f382de2a48.name: Archaic Essence VII
fc923ebd5ea63848a02409f382de2a48.desc:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.

3da0c1d971ddaa4d91fc349fae4b864c.name: Adventurer Trousers
3da0c1d971ddaa4d91fc349fae4b864c.desc: No matter how they may wear and tear, these pants can always be patched up again! That makes them suitable for bold explorers.

9058c865f64177459b48ea7cdbf4d714.name: Wolf's Fang Shield
9058c865f64177459b48ea7cdbf4d714.desc: An oval shield with a regal aura. When your enemies see your eyes peak up from the safety of the shield, they are merely seconds away from taking their last breath.

1cab1f42949a6c41b0c11ecd00ca4563.name: Rough Flintstone Block
1cab1f42949a6c41b0c11ecd00ca4563.desc:
These rough stones shimmer slightly and have a very rustic style. 

Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

0828a8579909a34bad361196583b715f.name: Trampoline (Medium Jump)
0828a8579909a34bad361196583b715f.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

52e685f2888b374b84bf124d75c8e911.name: Shortcrust Pastry Base
52e685f2888b374b84bf124d75c8e911.desc: Perfectly crisp and buttery — a golden foundation for your sweetest baking experiments.

163252758bc68641973d6ba41aa3526a.name: Scavenger Artificer Trophy
163252758bc68641973d6ba41aa3526a.desc: Thinking back at the fight, you can feel the pull of his harpoon, which you cannot escape. Luckily, now when you don't want to be close to him again, you can just leave the room.

f72387c115fc274994068eefd3ebe96e.name: Pinewood Fence Pole
f72387c115fc274994068eefd3ebe96e.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

b3dc7abb65ef114191a67832457516a6.name: Plaguebringer Chest
b3dc7abb65ef114191a67832457516a6.desc:
Countless cankerous growths sprout from this leather armor, thus forging it in a new image.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

e8f2fe8062ff6c41a21d313f2036960e.name: Soothsayer
e8f2fe8062ff6c41a21d313f2036960e.desc: A hammer adorned with an ancient petrified tusk. Tusks and teeth were used by the Vukah for mystical purposes.

d141c413b8969f41bca7fbe1c4664f5d.name: Sunpiercer Pants
d141c413b8969f41bca7fbe1c4664f5d.desc: These pants are just as short as a foe’s lifespan in your presence.

cd17ccb7309a91448d54a18bfbbcf376.name: Yellow Wall Flower
cd17ccb7309a91448d54a18bfbbcf376.desc: A small potted plant to beautify your home.

5cd6333fc6e1d8439ce96718a23bb746.name: Capybara Bait
5cd6333fc6e1d8439ce96718a23bb746.desc:
Food for attracting and taming a Capybara.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.

be7cbc5e286d0b4cbbd902f102b3acd9.name: Gentian Seedling
be7cbc5e286d0b4cbbd902f102b3acd9.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

c2e13a465935d5489e8be284f041d79e.name: Gold Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Trophy
c2e13a465935d5489e8be284f041d79e.desc:
The central eye remains visible, but no longer carries the pressure it once did. It now feels less like a weapon and more like a relic.

Collect multiple Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Eyes to craft the Gold Trophy.

7635712b008bc446875245425e142324.name: Legendary Runes
7635712b008bc446875245425e142324.desc:
Legendary runes are infused with an immense amount of magical energy. These rare and powerful artifacts are required to enhance legendary weapons, shields, armors and rings, unlocking their full potential.

Craftspeople and their assistants can use Runes to imbue said equipment with powerful bonuses and effects.

Once used, legendary runes become an integral part of the imbued equipment and cannot be recovered. Choose wisely, for the power they bestow is both extraordinary and irreplaceable.

9ac60619946cee48b054d02a8356874b.name: Deadeye Boots
9ac60619946cee48b054d02a8356874b.desc: These boots are perfect for keeping a stable stance while aiming, shooting, and killing.

abf7e3bfcea00643acf7af915183f2c7.name: Eternal Fireball II
abf7e3bfcea00643acf7af915183f2c7.desc:
Ignites a fireball projectile that erupts upon impact and deals damage in an area.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

43ce10cd5214d44985b65d7c2796ac15.name: Explorer's Machete
43ce10cd5214d44985b65d7c2796ac15.desc: A sword with a reinforced, pointed edge that can cut through any growth in the thicket. The blade is also useful for hunting wildlife.

0c3ee96a3a120045a9da09f065df7b5a.name: Big Blue Wall Banner I
0c3ee96a3a120045a9da09f065df7b5a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

da4afb06f0906d40a5c061a5358de435.name: Scout Hood
da4afb06f0906d40a5c061a5358de435.desc: The perfect disguise — even in broad daylight.

cad4259892f05146a44723fc29e8a11c.name: Pink Eyes
cad4259892f05146a44723fc29e8a11c.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

d834d87dd805e7468ba045be4d862aa7.name: Fae Deer Food
d834d87dd805e7468ba045be4d862aa7.desc:
Nutritious Fae Deer food for tame animals on your farm.

It must be placed inside the appropriate feeder.

45ac0f96edc8c94c914a0fb4e869d97f.name: Dull Shark Tooth
45ac0f96edc8c94c914a0fb4e869d97f.desc:
A fossilized tooth that has dulled through the ages. While these fossils used to be plentiful, many are now forever buried underneath a dense layer of Shroud-infested water.

This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.

15ddadfd9e4c6a4c82f5f72a47bbf38d.name: "Flower Snake"
15ddadfd9e4c6a4c82f5f72a47bbf38d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

dfa47e9b41f57b44be2a453030e75039.name: Alpine Antler Chest
dfa47e9b41f57b44be2a453030e75039.desc: A blue overcoat with a fluffy, snow-white trim to keep warm. The pelts are lightweight and won't weigh you down when scaling the mountain tops to find vantage points.

9105b44c3990994f953bd0709b46713e.name: Goat Food Bait
9105b44c3990994f953bd0709b46713e.desc:
Food for attracting and taming a goat. It can be given to both Common Goats and Frizzy Goats.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.

d5d5083b56f5b7478a8084d6a668d879.name: Rooibos Seedling
d5d5083b56f5b7478a8084d6a668d879.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

49ec0bdab2bf624fa2718bb657c4b0e8.name: Globe
49ec0bdab2bf624fa2718bb657c4b0e8.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

90fbfc29a7ec3a459f86ff1dbfa1bfea.name: Gem of Skulls
90fbfc29a7ec3a459f86ff1dbfa1bfea.desc: Killing an enemy with a Sneak Attack or Merciless Attack has a %k chance to spawn a level %k companion skull.

4a855bde015b6b4eadd00882fc84d114.name: Bow Of The Serpent
4a855bde015b6b4eadd00882fc84d114.desc: A strong bow that frames each shot between two serpents' maws. Let your arrows strike with the calculated savagery of a viper in waiting!

896f147d1a15a343a045434c8592794c.name: Mercenary Boots
896f147d1a15a343a045434c8592794c.desc: Some scratched up Mercenary Boots. Kick your enemies when they're down!

8012cdaae5b05a439cc45cd046a082c5.name: Tribal Hammer
8012cdaae5b05a439cc45cd046a082c5.desc: A common hammer that may have once been used by ancient Drak'Dal tribe members. Its simple design speaks to its utilitarian nature.

b4c8df7c49d0a4499e22afa76d45f997.name: Fell Crimson Critter Queen Head
b4c8df7c49d0a4499e22afa76d45f997.desc: It looks oddly similar to the Fell Critter Queen, just a different color.

e9b8cc559e10e54182446f9ad95cf07f.name: Warlock Gloves
e9b8cc559e10e54182446f9ad95cf07f.desc: Both spells and smiting blows are easily dealt with these marvelous warlock gloves.

383192b3512fdb449a85c400a342ff7b.name: Valory
383192b3512fdb449a85c400a342ff7b.desc: The adventuring Bard, Valory, carves instruments and shares exciting tales from her travels through Embervale.

50447349831ef24bb86682cec31518e9.name: Skull Summoning Vessel II
50447349831ef24bb86682cec31518e9.desc: Throw this mystical vessel to temporarily summon a skull companion.

aa3bb70de380a245b8ce36470aead35e.name: Ranger Vest
aa3bb70de380a245b8ce36470aead35e.desc: This piece of armor only offers minor protection against incoming arrows, but that hardly matters. The best preventative measure is to aim for the eyes.

c65a2d2546d8a646b5f90371d923e5c0.name: Efflorescent Hope Pants
c65a2d2546d8a646b5f90371d923e5c0.desc: Deep blue pants made from opaque material. With these, warmth will embrace you like a cocoon.

98534ed0b5247d49ac8956b199638d22.name: Commander's Ring
98534ed0b5247d49ac8956b199638d22.desc: A simple and sturdy ring, decorated with three gemstones. The engraving reads: "To Cyrus, my most loyal Commander and friend". It was found inside the maw of the creature that haunts The Pike.

a256a464ed783441b71de915b40ca747.name: Siren Seeker Headband
a256a464ed783441b71de915b40ca747.desc: Fashioned from a piece of fishing net and seaborn trinkets. It keeps the hair out of your face while you dive.

0e641b570dbea449b41da1d31f9edf98.name: Eternal Fireball III
0e641b570dbea449b41da1d31f9edf98.desc:
Ignites a fireball projectile that erupts upon impact and deals damage in an area.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

31865840d24cef4386c955b389bef316.name: Glass
31865840d24cef4386c955b389bef316.desc: A wondrous material. It is transparent and offers many potential applications, especially in building and crafting!

570a0b8dc454384faf45567380c65340.name: Tome of Agony
570a0b8dc454384faf45567380c65340.desc: This dusty old tome emanates a silent hate, restrained by thick iron shackles. Every fortnight, whenever this book is near, a spirited chain rattle fills the midnight air, and the pages inside convulse. It's as if something was trying to leap off the parchment to turn from ink to flesh and blood.

6e799f385befdf4b883f15f515b6033e.name: Flammable Goo
6e799f385befdf4b883f15f515b6033e.desc: A sticky and highly flammable substance. Handle with care!

ed6d3739b7c5c545bfb1e8ef58e5a72b.name: Water
ed6d3739b7c5c545bfb1e8ef58e5a72b.desc: A refreshing bottle of Water that grants more Stamina. Stay hydrated.

b73c41200d54bf43bd384e2745f14d91.name: Voidcaller
b73c41200d54bf43bd384e2745f14d91.desc:
A Shroud-tainted wand which radiates darkness. You feel that using it will widen a hidden void beneath Embervale, slowly growing in obscurity, swallowing all around... but perhaps using it once or twice won't hurt?

Shroud Imbued: 
This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Ethereal Duplication:
The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

d71b65875992c94fa26c86ade6deb2a4.name: Wolf's Hydra
d71b65875992c94fa26c86ade6deb2a4.desc: A heavy club adorned with multiple wolf heads near the handle.

2f92de716da47949bb5cec5df0ce415b.name: Green Vitriol Dust
2f92de716da47949bb5cec5df0ce415b.desc: The end product of chemical experiments, the crystals sparkle like shimmering sea foam.

001c7aac6c190e4cb8b4edca46552701.name: Shroud Spores
001c7aac6c190e4cb8b4edca46552701.desc: A strange kind of energy. It appears unstable for now, but perhaps it can be refined.

5ae0ca9f0816a345b277f915e78c108f.name: Quetzal Hunter Shoes
5ae0ca9f0816a345b277f915e78c108f.desc: In these shoes, you glide through the thicket effortlessly, barely breaking a sweat.

3c898b514777974b9da8da23faf2011d.name: The Hennihilator
3c898b514777974b9da8da23faf2011d.desc: Your eyes do not betray you: This weapon is essentially a chicken on a stick. However, it is incredibly fearsome, and therefore, you'd do well not to draw its ire! Those who anger the Hennihilator do not live to tell the tale!

6e5ad4ddeaa3664a8f7bf2a9af2d13a4.name: Rising Fighter Shield
6e5ad4ddeaa3664a8f7bf2a9af2d13a4.desc:
Even a simple shield such as this can save your life when you get surrounded or surprised. Use it to block or parry incoming attacks!

Parry
You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar.
Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

ed4e7eb1f2373a408f26d2ac1d23d586.name: Bloodfeather Helmet
ed4e7eb1f2373a408f26d2ac1d23d586.desc: This head armor combines a mask, cloth, and horns. For most foes, it will be the last thing they see when you catch them by surprise.

f888bab031ed6e43ad81fc04633499a4.name: Prickle Pearl Tart
f888bab031ed6e43ad81fc04633499a4.desc: A buttery shortcrust pastry tart filled with fresh Prickle Pearls. Delicate and sweet with that unmistakable tickle on the tongue.

a04d3259d2164b49a56e2e45d3cf6b6f.name: Ancient Beacon Block
a04d3259d2164b49a56e2e45d3cf6b6f.desc: A glowing block casting a yellow light that's visible across vast distances. The Ancients are believed to have used it for navigation and signaling — though whatever network it was part of has long since fallen silent.

bf032d11a32330468d42a2f9254f4cec.name: Capybara Feeder
bf032d11a32330468d42a2f9254f4cec.desc:
A feeding device that holds Capybara food.

It will feed your animals when filled with the corresponding food.

cb6b6a4c7ea9cf49a9ee0f79d5104f05.name: Ginger Plant
cb6b6a4c7ea9cf49a9ee0f79d5104f05.desc: A large potted plant to beautify your home.

c93fac7ebfe9db4b9fb1190260078385.name: Shield of Light
c93fac7ebfe9db4b9fb1190260078385.desc: This sacred shield consecrated by the Flame allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.

ec08cf5cda231d4cafc7bb27bf98b131.name: Wand Wall Mount
ec08cf5cda231d4cafc7bb27bf98b131.desc: A display to showcase weapons or shields.

38b5bd5d8cce7341b170958ebd882c25.name: Ancient Ceiling Mobile III
38b5bd5d8cce7341b170958ebd882c25.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

a53368d3fd99a84c85e4abf1ab99b046.name: Refined Wood Block
a53368d3fd99a84c85e4abf1ab99b046.desc: Wood of extremely high quality that was manufactured with an eye for detail.

1f1db9af86f0594fa7adc1cc7912dd72.name: Wig Head
1f1db9af86f0594fa7adc1cc7912dd72.desc: A wig head that unlocks more haircuts once picked up. It can also be placed in your base as decoration.

0dc28691fc4d9b4fa0b0734968f83c1b.name: Greater Health Potion
0dc28691fc4d9b4fa0b0734968f83c1b.desc: After finetuning the Health Potion, the ingredients were adjusted, instantly restoring a great amount of health upon consumption.

d9190aad8566e1429bfce292b1ab5cef.name: Fossil Showcase (3 Small and 2 Medium Slots)
d9190aad8566e1429bfce292b1ab5cef.desc: This is a showcase for Fossil Collection Items usually found in quarries, material veins, or dig sites.

04ae60da3cff304cab608a678d8a914d.name: Healer Boots
04ae60da3cff304cab608a678d8a914d.desc: No need to keep these boots clean and neat. They will get bloody. Your teammates will make sure of that.

43f534971b355f4da61c98d435555d15.name: Granite Window Frame
43f534971b355f4da61c98d435555d15.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

fda27629dadb1a4e945bf50c573cf044.name: Wall Lantern
fda27629dadb1a4e945bf50c573cf044.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

093419c6bb5a0e47b632349150dea333.name: Gem of Burning
093419c6bb5a0e47b632349150dea333.desc: Dealing fire damage applies  burning for %k which deals %k per second. After a successful trigger, it has a cooldown of %k.

e1690de575f9c3469938ad28a96bd039.name: Thornridge
e1690de575f9c3469938ad28a96bd039.desc:
As its distinctive appearance suggests, the Thornridge is an epic fish that only a very skilled fisher can catch.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

8dd3e413c9d5b14ea3acf5665eee469b.name: Draconian Bow
8dd3e413c9d5b14ea3acf5665eee469b.desc: Crafted to resemble the wings of the most infamous Kindlewastes dwellers, the Draconian Vulture.

665df1871462b24f9f3f4ef97b052e35.name: Beginning Of The End
665df1871462b24f9f3f4ef97b052e35.desc:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"Long ago, a wanderer brought an enthralling gift to the people of Embervale."

I so wonder what sort of day it was — I chose to paint the sky as overcast; but whether the air was joyous or heavy, I could not know... - J

6cfbd7b081dd884ba44725fd651e8652.name: Trader Hat
6cfbd7b081dd884ba44725fd651e8652.desc: A merchant's hat that will draw attention in the market square when paired with A LOUD ENOUGH VOICE and good deals!

368ead02902e2b4fb91726c1237ebf3c.name: Wildheart Boots
368ead02902e2b4fb91726c1237ebf3c.desc: A magnificent golden shell for your feet to slip into. With these, you can march with pride — down the streets of your kingdom, through the darkened forest, or into the heart of the Shroud.

89b55ddbae47c74a978615a2c2cd99ff.name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Helmet
89b55ddbae47c74a978615a2c2cd99ff.desc: The radiant golden glow of this helmet recalls the bright spirit of the previous owner. In Embervale, this helmet was reserved for only the brightest thinkers, whose intellect lit the way.

93bf1cd412d5904693d8c184de6b6cc4.name: Kindlewastes Miniature Piece
93bf1cd412d5904693d8c184de6b6cc4.desc:
This model of the Kindlewastes shows sandy dunes and rugged cliffs, but Orindell wasn't always like this. Perhaps this scorching expanse would have looked different if water hadn't stopped flowing through its veins.

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.

a1fe89b9b1c5574e9462d6f9e1e4ec48.name: Scrap Arrow
a1fe89b9b1c5574e9462d6f9e1e4ec48.desc: A slightly enhanced version of the Wooden Arrow, reinforced with a piece of scrap metal at the tip.

3f0d4aa88cf73941850209cbcc0d3ee2.name: Mannequin "Look At Me"
3f0d4aa88cf73941850209cbcc0d3ee2.desc: A mannequin that can be dressed in armor or vanity items.

9e114c917060104eb3e59c3842fa5e0d.name: Sage Plant
9e114c917060104eb3e59c3842fa5e0d.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

7ff619210c75594da990bac0257aa0c1.name: Wolf's Fang Trousers
7ff619210c75594da990bac0257aa0c1.desc: A pair of pants with leather greaves. They don't rustle while moving and muffle every little sound while sneaking around.

3ed0ae7c2aaa954a837337c0ede82aad.name: Capybara
3ed0ae7c2aaa954a837337c0ede82aad.desc: An adorable Capybara. It's entirely unbothered while in your arms. The bristles can be used in crafting.

4eb0cced1d03a44098a3c42eedc92a36.name: Sword Of The Serpent
4eb0cced1d03a44098a3c42eedc92a36.desc: A glistening green blade, perfectly representing the aesthetics of the year of the serpent.

15e53c10285aa048aefcd8402f9760d9.name: Greatsword Gauntlets
15e53c10285aa048aefcd8402f9760d9.desc: Heavy gauntlets that aim to protect your hands in combat. You can swing your blade fearlessly with these.

15e542f393420342913475dc2c983563.name: Dune Armadillo Food
15e542f393420342913475dc2c983563.desc:
Nutritious Dune Armadillo food for tame animals on your farm.

It must be placed inside the appropriate feeder.

b01fb5f778ff304eae4ff0a3eafedecf.name: Small Ancient Ground Lamp
b01fb5f778ff304eae4ff0a3eafedecf.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

074f85a7ba126e49b7e0926f1266cca8.name: Ornate Greatsword
074f85a7ba126e49b7e0926f1266cca8.desc: The embellishments on this sword seem inspired by eastern craftsmanship, but the choice of material betrays the maker's origin. This weapon was most likely forged by a well-traveled blacksmith or commissioned by an aristocrat.

f80c243249ac964799a5bfbca2428efa.name: Ectoplasm Gem
f80c243249ac964799a5bfbca2428efa.desc: Crystallized from evaporated ectoplasm and bonemeal. Used to craft bone keys or decorative furniture.

56ab7988488ee047a5580bdb9f31514d.name: Efflorescent Hope Gloves
56ab7988488ee047a5580bdb9f31514d.desc: Gold veins flow through these gloves like sun-kissed rivers emerging after an icy slumber. The color of the underlying cloth changes from blue to green, symbolizing an awakening — a reach toward the light above the water's surface.

56abc9ed75df9546915b4472dfb86401.name: Scrap Vat I
56abc9ed75df9546915b4472dfb86401.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1a313ff9a7b9d34abcb85057da6f02d6.name: Loom
1a313ff9a7b9d34abcb85057da6f02d6.desc: A complex weaving machine which allows the manufucture of fabric.

3ceeab1c432afa4b904368552c81621b.name: Makeshift Daggers
3ceeab1c432afa4b904368552c81621b.desc:
A long pair of daggers with cloth around the handle.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

e733fa8be6c3d14dba99ceb60a910be1.name: Robert Gibson
e733fa8be6c3d14dba99ceb60a910be1.desc: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

582f964258fa6a458325ee5b9c74aa0d.name: Logo Symbol Projector
582f964258fa6a458325ee5b9c74aa0d.desc: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. It projects the Enshrouded logo.

9f8f2e9e2c4d0b418d4a134a0c565c63.name: Avalanche Starter
9f8f2e9e2c4d0b418d4a134a0c565c63.desc: When placed in competent hands, this horned bow can fire a shot so powerful that it may loosen an avalanche, and bury the valleys in everlasting snow.

09d7c7174ad414428381383fa6d6eb39.name: Paper Lantern I
09d7c7174ad414428381383fa6d6eb39.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

a27d969fdca6f34484954b7ae0e1ecc4.name: Fell Heart
a27d969fdca6f34484954b7ae0e1ecc4.desc:
The faded heart of a Fell Foe. Its potent essence is key in crafting resilient armor and powerful healing spells.

Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

69427027688c6b488f9b713ef847af1a.name: Purified Slime
69427027688c6b488f9b713ef847af1a.desc: A green glowing material that's been cleansed to rid it of its toxic characteristics.

611efa3157e089458a8d0cc49ebba14a.name: Drak Stone Totem II
611efa3157e089458a8d0cc49ebba14a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

02a0c67d30f1d94687c68a1c3bb8b3e1.name: Yellow Confetti Mortar
02a0c67d30f1d94687c68a1c3bb8b3e1.desc: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

e3854f782a668e48b3b27b3f45671e77.name: Large Bamboo Basket
e3854f782a668e48b3b27b3f45671e77.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

2c1c163c305201428565d85a293ccb63.name: Soldier Helmet
2c1c163c305201428565d85a293ccb63.desc: A finely crafted helmet, usually worn by the kingdom's most feared warriors and generals.

e7f57123907cb447b0f81643d4f6d1b4.name: Archaic Essence II
e7f57123907cb447b0f81643d4f6d1b4.desc:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.

ac675dda2f5434479786289c3ae18ec3.name: Shroud Arrow II
ac675dda2f5434479786289c3ae18ec3.desc:
If you can't beat them, join them. 
This Special Arrow uses the power of the Shroud and disperses a cloud of it upon impact.

0bc5cf203927a54099f6689281173862.name: Mountain's Shadow Gloves
0bc5cf203927a54099f6689281173862.desc: Dark leather patterned arm guards wrapped in ashen grey strings. Wool padding peeks out from beneath them when wielding your weapon fiercely.

ae67dbd2cfb77649add07c0d2ea66e8f.name: Gold Fell Thunderbrute Trophy
ae67dbd2cfb77649add07c0d2ea66e8f.desc:
Possessing this golden trophy proves that you dodged every sword blow and defeated your opponent with concentrated force.

Collect multiple Fell Thunderbrute Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

445fe788ec25be43b04fe2c8edfd97ff.name: Banana Plant
445fe788ec25be43b04fe2c8edfd97ff.desc: A large potted plant to beautify your home.

0fab0b4db32709478699d2ff4ec184f1.name: Chain Lightning I
0fab0b4db32709478699d2ff4ec184f1.desc:
Releases a lightning strike at an enemy that can arc to multiple other nearby targets.
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. 

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

d1ae71c64d1b0d4abb5d48d211e4021d.name: White Flower
d1ae71c64d1b0d4abb5d48d211e4021d.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

54a4bdf5d18d0943a060c0e6c5711db3.name: Scholar of the Young Flame Cloak
54a4bdf5d18d0943a060c0e6c5711db3.desc: A resplendent white-and-gold cloak interwoven with iridescent threads. Worn by the "Scholars of the Young Flame", it symbolizes the burning desire to illuminate the unknown.

7b7526b22ebd0f4ea181671f1ffa067b.name: Box 4m
7b7526b22ebd0f4ea181671f1ffa067b.desc: This tool can only be used inside the building area around a Flame Altar. It can help you to quickly build your desired base with pre-defined structures.

c4be39d1e122104cb8ea5f247eab0b6a.name: Aeolipile
c4be39d1e122104cb8ea5f247eab0b6a.desc: A weird demonstration of the expansion force of water vapor. The use-cases are not quite clear... or are they?

5234541069c03e40b0bfd4c6c72e0086.name: Black Coffee
5234541069c03e40b0bfd4c6c72e0086.desc: A freshly brewed cup of coffee. The flavor is strong, bold, and lightly acidic. What better way to start the day?

9bc3ba3cfb091747a560a1444782122d.name: Low Crude Wooden Shelf
9bc3ba3cfb091747a560a1444782122d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

04f41f82f1a3b0409003e2dc1a536cee.name: Large Carved Wooden Cabinet
04f41f82f1a3b0409003e2dc1a536cee.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

307309428b083a4dbaa2e111a4e438ec.name: Ancestral Star
307309428b083a4dbaa2e111a4e438ec.desc: An ancestral weapon from the proud family line of the Galeforths, last held by Virgil Galeforth. He famously said: "If you want this weapon, you'll have to pry it from my cold, dead hands".

1ef8c47b0d9819469a90d9455b70b7fe.name: Magician Boots
1ef8c47b0d9819469a90d9455b70b7fe.desc: Low-cut shoes. Exposing one's ankles is quite enchanting!

25dcbedb60769943803c4d15ee70ed0f.name: Purple Berry Cake
25dcbedb60769943803c4d15ee70ed0f.desc: The sugar rush powers your stamina regeneration for a short amount of time.

6717007e5ab1504cb6868662b14a7b39.name: Archaic Essence III
6717007e5ab1504cb6868662b14a7b39.desc:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.

269de0731cbfea488a02b3ee45c57498.name: Raw Meat and Tomato Skewer
269de0731cbfea488a02b3ee45c57498.desc:
A hunter's favorite ration, crafted for precision. 

After you've grilled it over a fire, it will grant you more maximum health, increase your ranged and dagger damage, and expand your maximum stamina.

8a5418fec6bf954c8bf6d187e57459f3.name: Tidecaller Gloves
8a5418fec6bf954c8bf6d187e57459f3.desc: They don't offer much protection, but enhance your magical abilities. The minimalist design also prevents you from getting sweaty hands.

2dc7c106e8e54f4ea43f5712aed7535b.name: Copperblade Greatsword
2dc7c106e8e54f4ea43f5712aed7535b.desc: This weapon's sheen has been dulled by patina, hiding its once prestigious origin. Only the padded handle still hints at the lost glory.

46f869e0204d634cb0c9c937f79e72a5.name: Pinewood Room Divider II
46f869e0204d634cb0c9c937f79e72a5.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

5875edfd7bc9264dafdb29e05e64a40c.name: Superior Mana Potion +
5875edfd7bc9264dafdb29e05e64a40c.desc: Instantly restores a large amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.

eabc76fe860e95498a3ad5721447bc07.name: Deerstalker Boots
eabc76fe860e95498a3ad5721447bc07.desc: Stalking prey in these boots makes barely any sound. None will hear you coming.

92225d94d55e31428b8fb0855c5ecd0c.name: Electric Initialiser
92225d94d55e31428b8fb0855c5ecd0c.desc:
An electrifying wand that was previously used to start engines and machinery in an instant. The air crackles around it, and it has an odd shape.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

6d4155bf180eb042858573a48e0c3fdf.name: Eternal Voltaic Arrow I
6d4155bf180eb042858573a48e0c3fdf.desc:
An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's charged with electricity.

Eternal Arrow: Does not deplete Ammo per use. Equip the Eternal Arrow and use Mana to shoot it with a Bow.

2b9d5307718e8c42a5ea114afcd64670.name: Graveyard Fence Broken II
2b9d5307718e8c42a5ea114afcd64670.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

86c1e8b5800bf946b099a5e3b3a21c5e.name: Milkmaid Boots
86c1e8b5800bf946b099a5e3b3a21c5e.desc: Simple shoes with flat heels that pair well with dark stockings.

be6d7fd8e773ef4dbc175a37f2e6b0de.name: Scarab
be6d7fd8e773ef4dbc175a37f2e6b0de.desc: A golden jewel scarab beetle. It can be found in the Kindlewastes, and is used as fishing bait, especially useful to catch rare fish.

9534750dede441408b2003e0368fe718.name: Pikemead's Bulwark
9534750dede441408b2003e0368fe718.desc:
Even in death, the Queen unites those who seek protection behind her shield. 

Parry
You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar.
Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

2ae9b134a18d094fabadf51e617fd9eb.name: Calescent Axe
2ae9b134a18d094fabadf51e617fd9eb.desc: It burns the palms when wielded without caution, leaving blisters and pain even as the heat of battle fades.

42e4d9ebd8293a4581bad2bd8153ebb7.name: Deadeye Trousers
42e4d9ebd8293a4581bad2bd8153ebb7.desc: These pants are extremely light and therefore enable quick and flexible movements. Crouch, climb, and run to gain an advantage!

1a3980f676cca64f8a1c822fe39c9b6b.name: Pyreblade
1a3980f676cca64f8a1c822fe39c9b6b.desc: The Pyreblade is capable of unleashing devastating fire strikes while reflecting a portion of the foe’s own fury back upon them.

3d536865e059c74685969dc7a0558006.name: Direwolf Head
3d536865e059c74685969dc7a0558006.desc: The severed head of a ginormous wolf. It must have belonged to some pack leader.

e025656d03426646a6532a522f049ec1.name: Kingsize Bed
e025656d03426646a6532a522f049ec1.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

24969a526c588943b8db000ff8dce07a.name: Wood Wall IV
24969a526c588943b8db000ff8dce07a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

9d1a10832a572744bdb1817811f770fb.name: Granite
9d1a10832a572744bdb1817811f770fb.desc: A magmatic deep rock mostly consisting of feldspar, quartz, and mica.

ef45bb33fec57c4d846b098aeb1e5202.name: Ring of Mana
ef45bb33fec57c4d846b098aeb1e5202.desc: This ring will increase your mana and its replenishment.

ec9431e3c3e239438765f49647eb8fda.name: Bonestorm V
ec9431e3c3e239438765f49647eb8fda.desc:
Conjures a flurry homing bone projectiles that hunt down enemies with crushing force.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

8022fb3b616a1b4abcf723797096006c.name: Wildheart Wall Banner
8022fb3b616a1b4abcf723797096006c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

870784edddc6dd4c863b9448ce380a29.name: Kindlewastes Flower Seedling
870784edddc6dd4c863b9448ce380a29.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

469bea465a44364ebf8420cab7585f48.name: Scrappy Pickaxe
469bea465a44364ebf8420cab7585f48.desc: Forged from old metal rests, it shows signs of improvement in performance but still does not deserve to be called a handy tool.

c872666b6ec77a4cae5fec3ff64effcb.name: Iron Fireplace
c872666b6ec77a4cae5fec3ff64effcb.desc: A sturdy iron stove that warms up your cozy hut in style!

59d6215983803d4099dc3880b979d66d.name: Wolf's Fang Shield
59d6215983803d4099dc3880b979d66d.desc: An oval shield with a regal aura. When your enemies see your eyes peak up from the safety of the shield, they are merely seconds away from taking their last breath.

5db0483cd9a89f47a6a8b4e391d6474f.name: Inscribed Golden Urn
5db0483cd9a89f47a6a8b4e391d6474f.desc: This golden urn has multiple sigils inscribed on it. Their meaning far exceeds modern understanding, but scholars would presume these to be magical wards.

8c5768c998c3f4409dcc7445be4a7217.name: Golden Bulwark Shield
8c5768c998c3f4409dcc7445be4a7217.desc: A massive golden shield engraved with the snarling face of an ancient creature. Its fanged visage is said to ward off evil and strike fear into enemies on the battlefield.

30b90cbf5198594c8cc9afb2470cf127.name: Metal Floor Drain I
30b90cbf5198594c8cc9afb2470cf127.desc: This drain will remove any water above it. Can be placed on the floor.

df7602167ccf8248956c24c47b67d1a8.name: Book I
df7602167ccf8248956c24c47b67d1a8.desc: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.

f468252293a4c5488120fb4abe8e4929.name: Iron Fell Monstrosity Trophy
f468252293a4c5488120fb4abe8e4929.desc:
No longer does it reach for the sorrowful and the damned. The hunger in the dark was razed. Our dreams and minds are safe, for now.

Collect multiple Fell Monstrosity Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

70cd28686508c747a45ae807151a593f.name: Magician Chest
70cd28686508c747a45ae807151a593f.desc: An ordinary shirt, covered partially by a more sophisticated jacket.

319674bd5466db41bffd5dd2871c4f65.name: Spine Of Dalszul
319674bd5466db41bffd5dd2871c4f65.desc: Rectangular flints reach outwards from the blade's core, some as big as your fist. Their peaks and valleys make up the image of a gargantuan spine befitting an apex predator — hence the reference to the drakian god who strove for dominion of the continent.

1f8a8cdc81691346916565721e4c20c6.name: Small Palm Wood Cupboard
1f8a8cdc81691346916565721e4c20c6.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

5300c7a4768a6e40a2b9ef6d2103dc87.name: Limestone Block
5300c7a4768a6e40a2b9ef6d2103dc87.desc: An aged stone that outlasted all else for centuries. Leaves one wondering what kind of things it might have seen.

e886e4486a40c047b972e64ffff5cc2d.name: Gold Dust
e886e4486a40c047b972e64ffff5cc2d.desc: Gold ground to powder. It sparkles even more beautifully than before.

5d91e75cbf7ff349814efcee163325d2.name: Skull Summoning Vessel III
5d91e75cbf7ff349814efcee163325d2.desc: Throw this mystical vessel to temporarily summon a skull companion.

6e89fdb51db5ae42865361ebb6684e92.name: Firefly Chandelier
6e89fdb51db5ae42865361ebb6684e92.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

8941526373743744b3660a0462afa1f9.name: Rough Wood Block
8941526373743744b3660a0462afa1f9.desc:
A basic construction material. Not very pretty, but it gets the job done.

Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

252244f240d8e146bba476f22202ea64.name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Pants
252244f240d8e146bba476f22202ea64.desc: Simple black pants with delicate golden details. Inconspicuous on its own, but in perfect harmony with the other parts of this set. The hems have been rethreaded many times, worn thin by long journeys through Embervale. A quiet statement to the distance once walked by the "Scholars of the Empyrean".

be10e4786c8bd64385c84f7f86531ace.name: Sea Urchin Cluster
be10e4786c8bd64385c84f7f86531ace.desc:
A strange cluster of sea urchins with varying sizes and shapes. Most of these were harmless ocean dwellers — but some carried fatal venom, so it's best to avoid being stung.

This collectible is found in the Springlands.

0d2fb09a78686249bdb834009f717623.name: Wheel Barrow
0d2fb09a78686249bdb834009f717623.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

643f5f9b9a079d48859b6c5e4ab2534b.name: Trapdoor Stone 4m
643f5f9b9a079d48859b6c5e4ab2534b.desc: This trap door might open unexpectedly beneath your feet. Watch your step!

bdae69cda3fdf5498f3cbd464e8c4dc1.name: Poison Sack
bdae69cda3fdf5498f3cbd464e8c4dc1.desc: It's considered to be one of the most dangerous materials in the world! Touching it directly is usually not a good idea.

27ac0183746d4149b083b719936eedb2.name: Eternal Blizzard I
27ac0183746d4149b083b719936eedb2.desc:
Conjures a freezing storm that continuously deals damage to all enemies inside the area and applies a slow debuff to them.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

fe108d9c0b878a4191326f7e8f1f8247.name: Tyger
fe108d9c0b878a4191326f7e8f1f8247.desc: This striped cat is a fearsome hunter, always on the prowl. It's quiet, graceful, independent — and proud to present its spoils of war to you after a successful hunt! After a long day of adventuring though, it loves nothing more than to snuggle and sleep.

c0cbcd15594af54093879e2b3afde1d1.name: Lightforged Axe
c0cbcd15594af54093879e2b3afde1d1.desc: An axe forged in pure light. Few have witnessed its glory, and those who did were blinded in a flash.

815aa43983ed8244bd3074d8b3a36ae5.name: Veilwater Basin Miniature Piece
815aa43983ed8244bd3074d8b3a36ae5.desc:
A model of the Veilwater Basin, complete with glistening lakes, bloodthirsty Drak, and Coconana smoothies. A treacherous paradise — what could you want more from life?

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.

6c685343d9292e47944246f8be25bf1d.name: Heal Beam
6c685343d9292e47944246f8be25bf1d.desc:
Releases an aimed mending ray that continuously heals allies within.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

2b2127b1ca2676449e10bd42d388cdd0.name: Hollow Halls Block
2b2127b1ca2676449e10bd42d388cdd0.desc:
The characteristic building material used inside the Hollow Halls. The originators of this architectural style are unknown and forgotten.

Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

36fb843c5dffa64ba62f79183cb9ff9f.name: Rough Wood Block
36fb843c5dffa64ba62f79183cb9ff9f.desc:
A basic construction material. Not very pretty, but it gets the job done.

Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

9bcb718cfd693d4b854e2d7cddb4c11d.name: Tombstone "In Loving Memory"
9bcb718cfd693d4b854e2d7cddb4c11d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d70ce81bf3aaec4dbace5faef7869f23.name: Silver Candleholder
d70ce81bf3aaec4dbace5faef7869f23.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

68b328ba47947143af8349a442478fb6.name: The Dragons' Map
68b328ba47947143af8349a442478fb6.desc:
A reconstructed map, consisting of 4 former map pieces. It depicts a lake with an island, a river, an obelisk, and parts of a large skeleton. The full writing on the back now reads: 

Mae's Memoir:
The first day of yearwake is unlike the rest
The peaks lay quiet, licking yearfall's wounds
As the sunlight sets in the faraway west
On fields where sleeping buds awoke to blooms 

Ony's' Memoir:
I fly so high, I may never come down
I dance on the sun, whole body ablaze
My cup's always full, I'd drink till I drown
In liquid light and limerence, until I feel dazed

Orpheus' Memoir:
Once born a wanderer, I sought incandescence and bliss
Now I'm frozen in time, my body cast in chains
Accustomed to a sea of shadow, deep in the abyss
My eyes hurt in the brightness, so no light may remain

Polaris' Memoir:
I'm a shining star, drifting high up in the sky
To find your path, you must look to me only
Gazing down at the world, it's hard to deny
Having no one at my side makes my spirit lonely

9199355a35207b48a8d9fc7f41197cfc.name: Large Bamboo Basket
9199355a35207b48a8d9fc7f41197cfc.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1abd05fd1b481841ab010f3026bbb335.name: Mannequin "Here I Come"
1abd05fd1b481841ab010f3026bbb335.desc: A mannequin that can be dressed in armor or vanity items.

4980f1603ab37746a09282fe15ba675f.name: Cup Runneth Over
4980f1603ab37746a09282fe15ba675f.desc:
A music sheet for a song to play by the fireplace while telling adventure stories.

Music Sheet: 
Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

961d878dc082c44cb884eefa3ec95743.name: Vanguard Helmet
961d878dc082c44cb884eefa3ec95743.desc: A rising phoenix thrones above this helmet, protecting your steadfast gaze under its wings. It's a stern reminder of your destiny and the eternity it bears.

155228ca76c66140bf14803cfc14671d.name: Gem of Hopeful Embers
155228ca76c66140bf14803cfc14671d.desc: When the remaining time in the Shroud is below %k, defeated enemies drop time replenishing Orbs.

07bc6092c679a6489b446f46210ea969.name: Eternal Light Burst I
07bc6092c679a6489b446f46210ea969.desc:
Ignites a flash of light, bright enough to push back enemies around the caster.
It also deals Stamina Damage based on your Intelligence attribute to Shroud infested enemies which fills their Stun Bar.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

ccabd43f0c11174a81e39cce72ed1105.name: Gold Hollow Titan Trophy
ccabd43f0c11174a81e39cce72ed1105.desc:
The surface gleams so bright and the plume becomes a radiant crown, turning the helmet into something ceremonial. Fitting for celebrating your multiple defeats.

Collect multiple Hollow Titan Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

daa09a385f40f04fba49daf4381aec43.name: Grandleaf Cabbage
daa09a385f40f04fba49daf4381aec43.desc: The gigantic leaves of this plant are as useful as they are gorgeous. They taste something like cabbage — ideal thinly sliced in a salad, or used as a wrap.

32edef8ea5cce24ba4f2a99bfab04475.name: Reaper's Wand
32edef8ea5cce24ba4f2a99bfab04475.desc:
A twisted wand emitting a faint, blue light. It demands to be wielded!

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

ca2ab18689515a488754dba3a888fe70.name: Portable Water Pump
ca2ab18689515a488754dba3a888fe70.desc:
A tool that allows you to add and remove water in your base. It can also be utilized for irrigation and applying the Wet or Soaked Debuff to enemies. Fill it with water from a well or lake before beginning operation.

Wet 
Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30% for 15 minutes. Warmth reduces the remaining duration.

Soaked 
Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30% for 30 seconds. Also reduces Ice and Shock Resistances by 30% but increases Fire Resistance by 30%.
Soaked can be applied to enemies.
Soaked duration can not be reduced by warmth, and transitions into the Wet debuff once it ends.

a5439c1c8a3a3f438160b2c2f462785f.name: Eternal Shock Wisp I
a5439c1c8a3a3f438160b2c2f462785f.desc:
Conjures a charged wisp that trails you for a short duration. 
It hurls shock projectiles at enemies that also deal Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. 

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

a8dd8863a2994d4dbef6cc56d8640fd6.name: Explosive Arrow II
a8dd8863a2994d4dbef6cc56d8640fd6.desc: A Special Arrow that delivers an explosive surprise. Strikes with improved firepower.

2e913e7e5f148d44a9aa24830162bb5d.name: Chamomile Seedling
2e913e7e5f148d44a9aa24830162bb5d.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

164a690da165ab42bb794dc72bee9db7.name: Penny Bun
164a690da165ab42bb794dc72bee9db7.desc:
A great snack that stimulates the brain.

Increases your magic damage by a small amount.

5148d1249aca204bbf16545f6ec5119b.name: Instrument Stand
5148d1249aca204bbf16545f6ec5119b.desc: An object that allows you to display your instruments.

feb309b9bfb3834ab48b650b30a10b98.name: Steel Fence Pole
feb309b9bfb3834ab48b650b30a10b98.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6700841043f4284a97c4d9a9314b9c03.name: Berry Bush Seedling
6700841043f4284a97c4d9a9314b9c03.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

ca0b94d26efe284da2ea820db774d58c.name: Green Eyes
ca0b94d26efe284da2ea820db774d58c.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

9e40bb38eb5f034ea44e2c1c07f434f9.name: Draconian Bow
9e40bb38eb5f034ea44e2c1c07f434f9.desc: Crafted to resemble the wings of the most infamous Kindlewastes dwellers, the Draconian Vulture.

dc58f9cfbdd9724bbce44db1f527ecc7.name: Wax
dc58f9cfbdd9724bbce44db1f527ecc7.desc: A common ingredient with a smooth consistency. Needed for illumination of all sorts.

e50b488cf8ee564d8244c16a21f5b160.name: Valor Heart Daggers
e50b488cf8ee564d8244c16a21f5b160.desc:
A dagger that can easily be hidden underneath lavish sleeves or dressy skirts. It's quick and easy to unsheath in times of need!

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

6323540d0fb1a8478bd079690c784ef2.name: Drak Wood Totem IV
6323540d0fb1a8478bd079690c784ef2.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e78174813ca45a40a2d0d77c64309341.name: Iron Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Trophy
e78174813ca45a40a2d0d77c64309341.desc:
In its iron covered form the structure becomes heavier and more rigid, its surface darkened and sealed.

Collect multiple Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Eyes to craft the Iron Trophy.

f5d773f7a11c6b48b220d1e5a54ca197.name: Emberguard Shield
f5d773f7a11c6b48b220d1e5a54ca197.desc: An agile shield that feels as though it could be used well offensively. Three small dots adorn its heart, representing humanity, the Ancients, and the Flameborn between.

a10e105623e39445bbc75d1221518a4e.name: Large Ancient Sideboard
a10e105623e39445bbc75d1221518a4e.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

3887c3a40634c5458f71d0ded63865e2.name: Shivering Skeans
3887c3a40634c5458f71d0ded63865e2.desc:
A frosty set of daggers said to be infused with the souls of those who died in the coldest yearfalls.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

d50c2d4b29a0a8478df97c182cd3d50d.name: Skull Trophy I
d50c2d4b29a0a8478df97c182cd3d50d.desc: The Drak decorate their settlements with such trophies. It's impressive that they even washed off the blood — they surely reuse it for other purposes...

420b88293ffeec4ca4910da249c0fa5b.name: Waves Of Valor
420b88293ffeec4ca4910da249c0fa5b.desc:
A vivid palette of bright blue, blazing red, and pure white — crisp, bold, and full of energy, like a banner snapping in the wind. 

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

23b8fad041deaa478651c79161c5583b.name: High Iron Prison Window Frame
23b8fad041deaa478651c79161c5583b.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6cec5a68cd6cc44fb9c69793abfb49b5.name: Dark Red Hair
6cec5a68cd6cc44fb9c69793abfb49b5.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

d13ab689d6e8134d8affdd919db39294.name: Soothsayer
d13ab689d6e8134d8affdd919db39294.desc: A hammer adorned with an ancient petrified tusk. Tusks and teeth were used by the Vukah for mystical purposes.

34b48cabab1b5145bc801a58de266b75.name: Cultivation Rack
34b48cabab1b5145bc801a58de266b75.desc: Up to 3 ancient plant pots can be placed in this decorative cultivation rack.

b02fc56724a28e46b5c362c5046f5938.name: Vertical Banner I
b02fc56724a28e46b5c362c5046f5938.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

cb1eb9e5319b8641ac00ef348d5dcebb.name: Small Magic Chest
cb1eb9e5319b8641ac00ef348d5dcebb.desc:
This magical small chest offers increased storage space for items. 

The items stored here can be used for crafting purposes from anywhere in the base!

cb1ecdba4d14c44cbe416904fd569409.name: Draconian Bow
cb1ecdba4d14c44cbe416904fd569409.desc: Crafted to resemble the wings of the most infamous Kindlewastes dwellers, the Draconian Vulture.

7b018917b2831e4088cc8d25c02bfe13.name: Fell Striker Trophy
7b018917b2831e4088cc8d25c02bfe13.desc: This fight made you stop believing in safe corners. You can be sure that he always closes the gap between you two. Maybe nailed to your walls, he will finally leave you be.

e6adec33a35c7f4b9946b88b2fb78408.name: Ancient Temple Wall Brazier
e6adec33a35c7f4b9946b88b2fb78408.desc:
A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.

a880ef65a6f28b4293bfa29b1a9f036b.name: Tidecaller Pants
a880ef65a6f28b4293bfa29b1a9f036b.desc: Those pants go perfectly with the tunic, creating a fluent transition. They allow enough air circulation to prevent overheating during battle.

d11bef6c2dcd5b4da9768b014f0e091f.name: Greatsword Of Embers
d11bef6c2dcd5b4da9768b014f0e091f.desc: A luminous greatsword that reaches towards the sun above like a rekindled fire. It slashes through the night with vigor, creating light in the dark.

b123f98e8e714043bdfa6529379fb24c.name: Honey
b123f98e8e714043bdfa6529379fb24c.desc: The following sugar rush recharges stamina!

651995718baaaa45a197193b3a70b869.name: Plaguebringer Trousers
651995718baaaa45a197193b3a70b869.desc:
Leather pants with noticeable grain that morphs into fine fungal tendrils.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

802aa4582f771a4ca1c43013311afc3a.name: Sandstorm Swiftblades
802aa4582f771a4ca1c43013311afc3a.desc:
A dagger set of old-timey Eastern craftsmanship. Rogues of that era would swing this short cutlass around during battle, causing nearby sand to swirl up and blind the enemy.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

38499302b8c03b4fa555e6dfb34807a7.name: Siren Seeker Pants
38499302b8c03b4fa555e6dfb34807a7.desc: The cloth of these billowy pants falls in ripples like waves in the cerulean sea.

8b940c89be640045b1a9c4ee76a353d5.name: Piscine Ivory Dust
8b940c89be640045b1a9c4ee76a353d5.desc: Piscine Ivory, often called the ivory of the sea, ground into a bright powder. Renowned for its strength and resilience, it can even serve as a component in metal alloys, lending them exceptional robustness.

e00e77f80ae81c4b87170bd4025bf374.name: Bellows
e00e77f80ae81c4b87170bd4025bf374.desc: These bellows are needed to craft a blast furnace.

a78b7e7095e2354ebe403eeb97a10842.name: Outer Orrery Rings
a78b7e7095e2354ebe403eeb97a10842.desc:
A set of orbital rings. When the inner, middle, and outer rings come together, they can display an entire planetary system.

Find all pieces and combine them on a display pillar!

75f9af272de89e48a4aab265acf9e317.name: Efflorescent Hope Pants
75f9af272de89e48a4aab265acf9e317.desc: Deep blue pants made from opaque material. With these, warmth will embrace you like a cocoon.

d1fc93de0eee9a4baa0cbc0c0170c3b7.name: Mossy Stone
d1fc93de0eee9a4baa0cbc0c0170c3b7.desc:
The dark brown and green give the appearance of an overgrown garden or a mystical clearing.

This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.

9a811ccb73fe5c4eafecfdb505b401f4.name: Blackmire Stone
9a811ccb73fe5c4eafecfdb505b401f4.desc: The best stories start small. For example with a stone.

105479bdbc93ff4795e56a2b72e9a235.name: Blackmire Heartwood
105479bdbc93ff4795e56a2b72e9a235.desc: This century-old wood is found beyond the bark of the giant Blackmire trees.

8f0a66c724cb9f458d8642baaf063ae7.name: Scaffold II
8f0a66c724cb9f458d8642baaf063ae7.desc: A scaffold that lets you reach higher points while building your base.

503db5d6d8266d4e849ef03e831e717a.name: Pikemead's Bulwark
503db5d6d8266d4e849ef03e831e717a.desc:
Even in death, the Queen unites those who seek protection behind her shield. 

Parry
You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar.
Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

d5aff51ac0f5324d81f86de33e59356a.name: Reaper's Wand
d5aff51ac0f5324d81f86de33e59356a.desc:
A twisted wand emitting a faint, blue light. It demands to be wielded!

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

e255b64f34b9c540ae90b94219634681.name: Mage Hat
e255b64f34b9c540ae90b94219634681.desc: No mage armor set is complete without a large, brimmed hat.

84a10e9a0316b54f8febf282d98ed5e0.name: Coffin Lid
84a10e9a0316b54f8febf282d98ed5e0.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e99285834b429a48a6644aa199820822.name: Advanced Rake
e99285834b429a48a6644aa199820822.desc: A Rake enhanced with scrap metal to increase its durability and speed. A decent tool to level hilly ground.

f7a0cc3e4cf70f4fa46d96be06a11bdf.name: Fenrig's Axe
f7a0cc3e4cf70f4fa46d96be06a11bdf.desc: An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.

5560d93c67c41e4e89b8685a86cbf600.name: Fluffy Boots
5560d93c67c41e4e89b8685a86cbf600.desc: These boots are stuffed with extra fluff, thus keeping your feet nice and warm in the snow.

c25efc095dcb43449e342fc25db38cff.name: Golden Bulwark Chestplate
c25efc095dcb43449e342fc25db38cff.desc: A gold-plated chest plate, heavy and imposing — piercing it would be no easy task.

68bb99d54f032041895a64d408c5e7be.name: Date Palm Seedling
68bb99d54f032041895a64d408c5e7be.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested repeatedly.

2a75dad8c44eb54ca2451cd6ec80475c.name: Granite Fireplace
2a75dad8c44eb54ca2451cd6ec80475c.desc: A fireplace that will provide warmth once placed in your home. It's simple, but sufficient for cooking simple meals and gaining the Rested buff.

4b02f36c6c94734fbc9357623e6983f3.name: Veilwater Basin Bone Key
4b02f36c6c94734fbc9357623e6983f3.desc:
Opens doors in the Veilwater Basin Hollow Halls.

Some chests in the Hollow Halls require Ectoplasm to be opened — collect enough on your descent! 
Also make sure to save some Ectoplasm for crafting Bone Keys.

b9a47ebcef74db40b021fc9d7f258913.name: Chamomile Tea
b9a47ebcef74db40b021fc9d7f258913.desc: A very healthy beverage that helps the body recover and prepare for the day to come.

0e3e849135cadc4080ab2b88291bb6ef.name: Blue Fabric
0e3e849135cadc4080ab2b88291bb6ef.desc: Blue dyed fabric used for clothing.

709753bb01cd694dbe46b15c5ba70594.name: Diamond
709753bb01cd694dbe46b15c5ba70594.desc: Born from unimaginable heat and weight, diamond endures what would destroy anything else. Every facet tells a different story.

7262ef1e8f62af4994ba49e68bbfac48.name: Medium Chest
7262ef1e8f62af4994ba49e68bbfac48.desc: An improved storage option with enhanced capacity.

2185fc4a9d7f2e478d75bc534fd15ac2.name: Rock 2m
2185fc4a9d7f2e478d75bc534fd15ac2.desc: This tool can only be used inside the building area around a Flame Altar. It can help you to quickly build your desired base with pre-defined structures.

f9da6a4ff43afa46b26c1727e202f156.name: Ancestral Star
f9da6a4ff43afa46b26c1727e202f156.desc: An ancestral weapon from the proud family line of the Galeforths, last held by Virgil Galeforth. He famously said: "If you want this weapon, you'll have to pry it from my cold, dead hands".

c3e4c73f2a1bbe498da28061f056ede3.name: Obsidian Dust
c3e4c73f2a1bbe498da28061f056ede3.desc: Finely ground obsidian powder. It can more easily be alchemized in this form.

7b66cfd13712fc40be9e8359479274c6.name: Gold Hollow Wispwyvern Trophy
7b66cfd13712fc40be9e8359479274c6.desc:
At this point, you're a professional at not getting crushed by skeletal fury — and this trophy is proof of it.

Collect multiple Hollow Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

4a21f03d6c9ec848a17eebf285139e07.name: Greater Shroud Survival Flask
4a21f03d6c9ec848a17eebf285139e07.desc:
Contains cleansed Shroud Liquid, enhancing the resistance of the user.

Must be taken before entering the Shroud. Extends the Time in the Shroud by 4 minutes. This effect will last for 45 minutes.

ea0a891fca5c2c44bda91ccd7e32e425.name: Forsaken
ea0a891fca5c2c44bda91ccd7e32e425.desc: Lost and forgotten amidst the Shroud, this bow unleashes fury on anyone that crosses its path.

ccb32ddbb94c2a4a84f08884d9f16170.name: Hailscourge
ccb32ddbb94c2a4a84f08884d9f16170.desc: A blade that's cold to the touch. It weighs heavily on the mind.

2df662141d1b0945ba6b1ab52ea7bbff.name: Shroud Meteor
2df662141d1b0945ba6b1ab52ea7bbff.desc:
Calls down a disastrous Shroud Meteor on up to five foes.

Shroud Spell: This spell results in a debuff that reduces your Time in the Shroud.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

a154df784595e54393b0de4b1339cddd.name: Revelation By The Pond
a154df784595e54393b0de4b1339cddd.desc:
Still waters are deep, so they say. These serene blue hues remind us that things aren't always as they seem — for both depths and dewdropped thicket hide fateful encounters.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

dddce676ce59b743bf242de941cff0d1.name: Reed Seedling
dddce676ce59b743bf242de941cff0d1.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

731e56149d0b454298cf62d6bf3bf515.name: Adventurer Trousers
731e56149d0b454298cf62d6bf3bf515.desc: No matter how they may wear and tear, these pants can always be patched up again! That makes them suitable for bold explorers.

a54b71bbbb7c0b48ab6e10d4ab009f30.name: Eternal Fireball I
a54b71bbbb7c0b48ab6e10d4ab009f30.desc:
Ignites a fireball projectile that erupts upon impact and deals damage in an area.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

7f4c1983f6d8da478ba07fa6b2772438.name: Lumberer Coat
7f4c1983f6d8da478ba07fa6b2772438.desc: A heavy tunic with fur lining.

6f53061524746945953c7020db86e2e1.name: Fowler Boots
6f53061524746945953c7020db86e2e1.desc: With these weighted soles, even shaky or uneven ground will not disturb your aim.

9606b370e3c0ca4e94b4df275a797bb2.name: Clay Platter
9606b370e3c0ca4e94b4df275a797bb2.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e7a8a02412d9c74fb37c19487d4d8746.name: Daylily
e7a8a02412d9c74fb37c19487d4d8746.desc: An orange daylily flower. The petals are vibrant enough to be used for dyes.

337b5af3789ea34a97add5ad15f63e70.name: Ashwind Strider Boots
337b5af3789ea34a97add5ad15f63e70.desc: Pale boots that have been adorned by multiple sets of heavy bangles, chaining the wearer to the molten grounds below the flying isles.

0b781044d5792742be50d2a9a5a19782.name: Indigo Plant
0b781044d5792742be50d2a9a5a19782.desc: A plant known for its flowers and the deep blue organic pigment that can be won by processing it.

d9310f910d69f0469d80743a0ef0c659.name: Bronze Barrel
d9310f910d69f0469d80743a0ef0c659.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ae1af636e810214dbc2731342f5f621b.name: Fossilized Bone
ae1af636e810214dbc2731342f5f621b.desc: Over the years, untouched by anyone, the bones of all kind of magical creatures have hardened and turned to stone. A rare material due to its limited availibility and high magical capacity.

febbf03302c4ba458d9d3f452ab44342.name: Spellweaver Gloves
febbf03302c4ba458d9d3f452ab44342.desc: A pair of gloves that enable you to synchronise syllables to spells and weave warding sigils into bulwarks gracefully.

835ae9eb7dc6464eb5b5b913275ee159.name: Lifelock Pants
835ae9eb7dc6464eb5b5b913275ee159.desc: Pants that anchor the wearer firmly on the ground through heavy fabric. While all others fall, you must remain standing... to pick them back up, to force them to continue on fighting.

d217c236228d8147a5d74369f85fba81.name: Ultimate Ring of Health
d217c236228d8147a5d74369f85fba81.desc: This ring will increase your health and healing rate.

3da15e53be36a54facde466c0abf9f9e.name: Clay Vase IV
3da15e53be36a54facde466c0abf9f9e.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6c1371c1bc74ef4a8e649998ba292638.name: Sage Gloves
6c1371c1bc74ef4a8e649998ba292638.desc: In old times these gloves were worn by the wisest scholars of the kingdom, often hiding wrinkled and gray flesh underneath.

e2d9d1ad0b59dd4dabd811843c604863.name: Bird Feeder
e2d9d1ad0b59dd4dabd811843c604863.desc:
A feeding device that holds bird food.

It will feed your animals when filled with the corresponding food.

2bcc8e5ca65e2d43a20d2e1b3775b4ee.name: Wall Tapestry V
2bcc8e5ca65e2d43a20d2e1b3775b4ee.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f3103b5fff55674b9a7c4f250665e7b2.name: Small Ancient Table
f3103b5fff55674b9a7c4f250665e7b2.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

f26b20e2ffdd0e44ae1d1bbdbaabd692.name: Bloodfeather Shoes
f26b20e2ffdd0e44ae1d1bbdbaabd692.desc: With these shoes, maintain your stance and recover before launching your next attack.

f26bb81c5cf70e498c484cc1d62a7cdf.name: Ring Of The Burning Light
f26bb81c5cf70e498c484cc1d62a7cdf.desc: Filled with ancient magic, this ring provides light to you in dark places.

17a0fdaf5ba3bd40acb3fc051cee1388.name: Firebird's Claw
17a0fdaf5ba3bd40acb3fc051cee1388.desc: An axe that has risen from the ashes of a dead world, now soaring high above the ground. Once you sink your claws into a foe with this weapon, they'll soon turn to dust to nourish the Earth anew.

56e22d5c4f37764686d5cebb131748d1.name: Simple Fishing Bait
56e22d5c4f37764686d5cebb131748d1.desc: Very simple fishing bait made out of Critter Parts. Can be used to catch common fish, but not many will like the taste of that one.

0ee1106563f9c440aff9419ba01e69c3.name: Gleam Root Plant
0ee1106563f9c440aff9419ba01e69c3.desc: A large potted plant to beautify your home.

0ee15404f01da544aa6f418ed0400c33.name: Wolf's Hydra
0ee15404f01da544aa6f418ed0400c33.desc: A heavy club adorned with multiple wolf heads near the handle.

59247e089eb74148b82f3222c73d8808.name: Steel Handrail
59247e089eb74148b82f3222c73d8808.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

78d941354d1bae4dae16b6f66cbff128.name: Mannequin "Victory"
78d941354d1bae4dae16b6f66cbff128.desc: A mannequin that can be dressed in armor or vanity items.

96c83652bc8d654f808a936843587865.name: Water Well
96c83652bc8d654f808a936843587865.desc: A near unlimited source of water.

333dda35d190bc408048aae7b66787e4.name: Orange Pendant Light II
333dda35d190bc408048aae7b66787e4.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

da4b5028ea0a9c479c52cd0a61004802.name: Conifer Crate
da4b5028ea0a9c479c52cd0a61004802.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1956886e16dca34899d5f08acaa72243.name: Warrior Trousers
1956886e16dca34899d5f08acaa72243.desc: The pieces that cover the sides of these pants have been carefully forged to defend against flanking attacks.

bcf4c8e429f89d488fbc57987e53b565.name: Rusty Greatsword
bcf4c8e429f89d488fbc57987e53b565.desc: An old greatsword that's begun to decay. The steel's purity has been stripped away by rust.

2c72f5c9a1b3e4408bf90582a459ab6f.name: Capybara Bristles
2c72f5c9a1b3e4408bf90582a459ab6f.desc: These capybara bristles can be woven into your clothing to help you glide through the water more easily and prevent you from cooling down too quickly.

96a9bfe36235214da80efffc31f60ae2.name: Inner Orrery Rings
96a9bfe36235214da80efffc31f60ae2.desc:
A set of orbital rings. When the inner, middle, and outer rings come together, they can display an entire planetary system.

Find all pieces and combine them on a display pillar!

2570ccce87d38244baf30febc36e1e37.name: Warlock Shirt
2570ccce87d38244baf30febc36e1e37.desc: A traditional garment which was historically worn by esteemed battle mages. Now, their ritualistic nature is a faint memory at best.

8a07c3d2ad605b4aa0a7aafaecf2e198.name: Grilled Yellowfin
8a07c3d2ad605b4aa0a7aafaecf2e198.desc: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

d5d6e3c31c7bf84a8e10e0e0fcd591d2.name: Coconut
d5d6e3c31c7bf84a8e10e0e0fcd591d2.desc: A fresh coconut, plucked directly from a palm tree. The water inside can be drunk as is or processed into milk.

2e1da77608e51341abefd49b144ca7d2.name: Seared Fish Filet
2e1da77608e51341abefd49b144ca7d2.desc: Seared on the grill to perfection, enjoy this exquisite piece of fish filet.

21ea58dee0181043acece027028f8e2f.name: Crude Wooden Fence I
21ea58dee0181043acece027028f8e2f.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c34996ca327f594eb33c154c95cee1b7.name: Queen Pikemead Statue Piece
c34996ca327f594eb33c154c95cee1b7.desc:
A broken piece of the Queen Pikemead sculpture.
Find every piece to reassemble a statue.

5f05ee94abf00849b85c8b53e416976c.name: Marksman Hood
5f05ee94abf00849b85c8b53e416976c.desc: A hood worn by ruthless people to hide their intentions. The leather trim provides additional protection and camouflages the wearer between the trees.

2803b3fd8dbf4542848fe3b3d1572fd2.name: Small Silver Brazier
2803b3fd8dbf4542848fe3b3d1572fd2.desc:
A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.

ee4d4ac9166f4740952a2b34ed9934a8.name: Grandleaf Cabbage Seedling
ee4d4ac9166f4740952a2b34ed9934a8.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in Basalt Farm Soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

fb9ada25b2c00d4299c3052345737515.name: Ashwind Strider Boots
fb9ada25b2c00d4299c3052345737515.desc: Pale boots that have been adorned by multiple sets of heavy bangles, chaining the wearer to the molten grounds below the flying isles.

8b7d1632095fd64283906904495d6c10.name: Shiitake Seedling
8b7d1632095fd64283906904495d6c10.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

e59740220dedd2499d2343256a6682b3.name: Torch
e59740220dedd2499d2343256a6682b3.desc: This basic torch provides light for a short amount of time. Watch your step when exploring caves with this!

5fe6ce322df02d4f82ea3bea6f32d79a.name: Wood Banister I
5fe6ce322df02d4f82ea3bea6f32d79a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

13a350fabe286842ae8cca4dec710f6a.name: Flint Arrow
13a350fabe286842ae8cca4dec710f6a.desc: A slightly enhanced version of the Wooden Arrow, reinforced with small pieces of flint at the tip.

447788d36f74f447847062ab4e6b421a.name: Trailblazer Gloves
447788d36f74f447847062ab4e6b421a.desc: Sturdy gloves, dark as the midnight sky. They've been adorned with animal horns that were gathered during the hunt.

56661db407bfe04c8f0acac8b55b328a.name: Eternal Ice Bolt II
56661db407bfe04c8f0acac8b55b328a.desc:
Conjures an icy projectile that deals damage in an area and applies a slow debuff.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

b36167b7adbfc344b768a2d2ac8a5d39.name: Invisible Barrier Ward
b36167b7adbfc344b768a2d2ac8a5d39.desc: With this ward, you can conjure a nearly invisible barrier that can keep you from harm in a time of need.

14a854ab04f87d4ca1a80b179b36f2bc.name: Shroud Vessel's Greatsword
14a854ab04f87d4ca1a80b179b36f2bc.desc: A tainted blade. Fading memories still reverberate from it, but the man who was once haunted by them is long gone. You freed Embervale — and him, too.

e23e5ed63cd63c41afd2613f0fb186c3.name: Mercenary Boots
e23e5ed63cd63c41afd2613f0fb186c3.desc: Some scratched up Mercenary Boots. Kick your enemies when they're down!

21acd823e7b8b84b8106e493b93416e3.name: Blood Rose Boots
21acd823e7b8b84b8106e493b93416e3.desc: Click-clack, click-clack — You hear the sound of her raised heel from a mile away, piercing the ground with unyielding staccato. As her steps quicken, so does your breath. Do not get caught in her path.

3ca9f1795b0d3b43b8f95275cfde67ff.name: Ring of the Heir
3ca9f1795b0d3b43b8f95275cfde67ff.desc: A ring that radiates affluence and tragedy. Was it freed from the ivory finger of a friend, a brother, a child of fortune? Could its fealty have been betrayed, its blood promise broken? Whatever story this ring may tell, its former lords are long gone.

3ca987b3aa2944449092179ecee2c780.name: Black Powder
3ca987b3aa2944449092179ecee2c780.desc: A dangerous alchemical substance used to produce explosives. Better watch out!

ae6021863018b340b64cf36568a8b699.name: Small Bamboo Baordwalk
ae6021863018b340b64cf36568a8b699.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d338f18f378b10429a9da2c3f0f519eb.name: Albaneve Summits Miniature Piece
d338f18f378b10429a9da2c3f0f519eb.desc:
Snow-covered mountains and frozen lakes adorn this model of the summits. A shame the Dragon youngling, or the "winged beast", as soldiers would say, cannot be seen. Perhaps it rests inside Howling Peak, dreaming of frolicking with others of its kind.

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.

9e8ec36e2786004aa2ef5d7402173a74.name: Palm Leaf Basket
9e8ec36e2786004aa2ef5d7402173a74.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

5d63b736c51ff94981e981994de9fd65.name: Ectoplasm Block
5d63b736c51ff94981e981994de9fd65.desc: An ominous, green glowing building block made from ectoplasm. The construction is reminiscent of stained glass windows.

03368aac9ba18841afdd0260ac9d8c6e.name: Ancient Centrifuge
03368aac9ba18841afdd0260ac9d8c6e.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

9a2c328259128b43845487dad679e595.name: Crypt Skull Torch
9a2c328259128b43845487dad679e595.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

e61a82736444444ba9372ea3b1182594.name: Scrap Pot II
e61a82736444444ba9372ea3b1182594.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

9f2bb3722e93224b96d06abc91f7471f.name: Scare Crow
9f2bb3722e93224b96d06abc91f7471f.desc: A straw puppet which is often mistaken for a creature from the Shroud when the sun has set.

38d5a31eb65d2542b17be5a5936142e1.name: Mandible Crusher
38d5a31eb65d2542b17be5a5936142e1.desc:
Striking with staggering force, this hammer obliterates the Hollow by grinding their bones to dust.

Hollow Echo:
The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.

0e271c77b61a1548b132f8fde7ee0856.name: Wooden Arrow
0e271c77b61a1548b132f8fde7ee0856.desc: A Wooden Arrow made of the most basic ingredients.

45129bdbbd9f164d919cf53c6563a3b5.name: Raw Dune Armadillo Meat
45129bdbbd9f164d919cf53c6563a3b5.desc: Fleshy and tough. Better not eat it like this.

960e62c5a8515945a2784f9e41339158.name: Carved Wooden Double Door
960e62c5a8515945a2784f9e41339158.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

240b4b0efe2f2344b55c83ef094788cd.name: Castle Wall Stone Block
240b4b0efe2f2344b55c83ef094788cd.desc: A washed version of the Rough Stone Block. Exposed to the weather, the stones have lost their rough features over time.

b248c5eacceeb44786d4a01ecb3a6cd3.name: Large Round Stone Window Frame
b248c5eacceeb44786d4a01ecb3a6cd3.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d02f163a1a943846a443b967da1bbde3.name: Clay Pot IV
d02f163a1a943846a443b967da1bbde3.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

601c0674b84a5045acf585bad495fc88.name: Orange Pendant Light I
601c0674b84a5045acf585bad495fc88.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

e6fb90a0c9cc22468fa0f858935162e3.name: Red Flower
e6fb90a0c9cc22468fa0f858935162e3.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

e6fbeaf57613ab4bb990ceb0175d9a7b.name: Gem of Cleansing
e6fbeaf57613ab4bb990ceb0175d9a7b.desc: Dealing damage removes the enemy's Shroud Damage Resistance for %k.

35523dfb0d957040aaa971fce6ff5199.name: White Cymbidum Flower
35523dfb0d957040aaa971fce6ff5199.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

1524d87f62dfba4abaa40f929dd6e2ad.name: Mercenary Shield
1524d87f62dfba4abaa40f929dd6e2ad.desc: A shield that will provide safety and aid. For a price.

69bf1f051e199e47a27cb04fe1cca9e8.name: Emberguard Chestplate
69bf1f051e199e47a27cb04fe1cca9e8.desc: A venerated chestplate that reflects the light of the Mother Flame on its polished, angular surface. Anyone who brandishes this armor vows to be the sword of the Flame and the guard of the light.

7d92955ac41cf341b430180d7b33903a.name: Meteorite Showcase (1 Large Slot)
7d92955ac41cf341b430180d7b33903a.desc: A showcase to display meteorite collection items.

1ed2f7d99b05244d8a35bd2a048d020b.name: Bamboo Crate I
1ed2f7d99b05244d8a35bd2a048d020b.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

67f1444953ce93489ed743c070151f5a.name: Celestium Cup
67f1444953ce93489ed743c070151f5a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

2c99f7010ffb2a49aea3a6599bb82605.name: Bronze Cup
2c99f7010ffb2a49aea3a6599bb82605.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

2e6304c816cf7d459878c8fea4ae10fa.name: Polished Wooden Bedside Table
