2e6304c816cf7d459878c8fea4ae10fa.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

6efe09c10d1d5e438512378f75cec492.name: Iron Scavenger Scattershot Trophy
6efe09c10d1d5e438512378f75cec492.desc:
You dreaded the moment he opened his elixir bottle. Without a stomach, it's not going anywhere now.

Collect multiple Scavenger Scattershot Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

b82ca9f40972b549962f96518fc6a7ca.name: Glimmer Gentian Tea
b82ca9f40972b549962f96518fc6a7ca.desc: This is an herbal tea with added glimmer gentian. The blossoms create a smooth texture and extend your Time in the Shroud.

8e30070dcddc884c96b8c32a7ed34442.name: Greater Ectoplasm Soup
8e30070dcddc884c96b8c32a7ed34442.desc: This slimy soup was improved with some salt, slow-cooked broth, and the added aroma of fearing death.

0c473377ec627945b26438002a804194.name: Ornate Hand Drum
0c473377ec627945b26438002a804194.desc:
A fine drum with a patterned leather cover, famously owned by Daniel the Damned, a former member of the Honeydews. Fans speculated that the back of the drum was inscribed with runes that would make Daniel play faster, like a possessed man.

Now that you're holding it, those rumors prove to be false — but his damnation was very real, at least!

fbe0d3cad9511140a568705787e7d089.name: Clay Bowl
fbe0d3cad9511140a568705787e7d089.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

2c7a6a11b1dea647a23718386cb68903.name: Fish Trap
2c7a6a11b1dea647a23718386cb68903.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

0eca60c92ab73c458a739bf6a8961646.name: Fluffy Hood
0eca60c92ab73c458a739bf6a8961646.desc: A nice, cream-colored hood to keep you warm and snug. The droopy little ears are purely fashionable, but aren't they cute?

912d3f7791e413489e7a67ce25e0d8aa.name: Shroud Relic
912d3f7791e413489e7a67ce25e0d8aa.desc: Contains a higher concentration of Shroud compared to Shroud Particles.

b020208dc5729648b131d1ce6b6e015e.name: Spearfisher's Shield
b020208dc5729648b131d1ce6b6e015e.desc: This wooden shield is not nearly intimidating enough for the young Spearfishers — therefore, they adorn their defenses with obsidian shards and glass plucked from the beaches.

2204a1cc0f4e014a916df67412bdac8c.name: Uncommon Fishing Bait
2204a1cc0f4e014a916df67412bdac8c.desc: Any uncommon fish will want to take a bite of this bait.

3326cc91a2eb0341beb2255e579e2801.name: Blunt Arrow
3326cc91a2eb0341beb2255e579e2801.desc: A devastating arrow with a blunt tip. It's bound to unleash a ton of force on impact.

27027ba94d8f0d459de80ba97777989d.name: Thaumaturge Boots
27027ba94d8f0d459de80ba97777989d.desc: A well-fitted pair of boots to round off the Thaumaturge armor set. The purple accents create a balanced overall look.

8a0f2416eb10d0469345cd654aa05e87.name: Celestium Bowl
8a0f2416eb10d0469345cd654aa05e87.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

803a4835e121864c83ce17ee03f10641.name: Arsonist's Bow
803a4835e121864c83ce17ee03f10641.desc: A bow that sparks blazing joy in firebugs and aspiring pyromaniacs.

db541e8c93de8d4a8f0e3dce2196b237.name: Eternal Ball Lightning I
db541e8c93de8d4a8f0e3dce2196b237.desc:
Conjures a slow moving ball of lightning that travels unhindered through enemies and some obstacles.
It continuously releases lightning strikes to nearby enemies that also deal Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. 

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

02df99cabe4060428709e015f471ffe2.name: Large Ancient Plant Pot
02df99cabe4060428709e015f471ffe2.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

193fde79d3e80846aad22a58dfacbf40.name: Thyme Tea
193fde79d3e80846aad22a58dfacbf40.desc: Freshly brewed tea steeped from hand-picked thyme. So simple and aromatic.

e284d54da998f74cbc45a7d269a8852f.name: Blue Goblet
e284d54da998f74cbc45a7d269a8852f.desc:
A dance of cerulean and powder blue.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.

7efc15c13c76254dbb462e033a371031.name: Tombstone "Together Again"
7efc15c13c76254dbb462e033a371031.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

9a911a2817e1b247bdcb4453834e3482.name: Underwater Grappling Hook
9a911a2817e1b247bdcb4453834e3482.desc: A grappling hook that can be used underwater.

bde5f5621658b44d84248b4a3fe793ee.name: Violet Storm
bde5f5621658b44d84248b4a3fe793ee.desc:
Spikes disrupt the smooth surface and jut forward like razor blades. They spring from within a center of calm, from the storm's eye, as devastating violet rain on a thunderous night — after which all weakness will be cleansed, and only the strongest may rise from the submerged lands. According to folklore, this symbolizes the origin of the drakian Broodmother Vesztah.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

9f902f43c945324e9773d4708e927524.name: Conifer Logs
9f902f43c945324e9773d4708e927524.desc: The raw and untreated wood of conifer trees. They fill the air with a fresh smell of pine needles and sweet resin.

51dcfadc05c8af4d8fd07d6b3635818c.name: Deadeye Vest
51dcfadc05c8af4d8fd07d6b3635818c.desc: Duck, dodge, and roll out of harm's way with this lightweight vest.

fba2eb199df1ae40a3d26fa0151f1dd2.name: Sickle Greatsword
fba2eb199df1ae40a3d26fa0151f1dd2.desc:
Once upon a time, Orpheus, a dark dragon, descended from the mountains to wreak havoc on the people's crops. Determined, the farmers laid down their scythes to join in the righteous crusade against the creature, forcing it to retreat with but one blow.
While their names were forgotten, their fabled blades served as inspiration for many blacksmith apprentices.

261a8052eae72d498387442edd81c45a.name: Metal Sheets
261a8052eae72d498387442edd81c45a.desc: Sheets melted out of Metal Scraps to make them more workable and open up options for further processing.

84b1f2f3d548084c8d1a3ce10bf14d89.name: Warden Chestplate
84b1f2f3d548084c8d1a3ce10bf14d89.desc: An incredibly sturdy chest piece, often worn by generals or select members of the royal guard. It inspired fear as much as respect.

d1edcee06608824aa1922415f9846535.name: Decorative Bells I
d1edcee06608824aa1922415f9846535.desc: Decorative bells are especially suitable for the yearfall.

99b5f60fc1a3d143b2ec4505440e16bf.name: Leather Crate
99b5f60fc1a3d143b2ec4505440e16bf.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

5fee9f69f4983447b2613096b500eb13.name: Simple Wood Support
5fee9f69f4983447b2613096b500eb13.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

745045ef71f14243a66e969d65488a84.name: Sunscale
745045ef71f14243a66e969d65488a84.desc:
The Sunscale's name is derived from the distinctive shimmer of its scales, which catch the sunlight.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

437a41154c3aa04697490b1b1679678a.name: Sharpshooter Boots
437a41154c3aa04697490b1b1679678a.desc: Wearing these boots makes each step feel like you're being carried on silver wings.

80fcc1d383d6ee47bf91720efa2e7498.name: Riptide
80fcc1d383d6ee47bf91720efa2e7498.desc: A shield that was washed into a grotto by the river. It must have belonged to a valiant hero.

2aa44b1530372f4c829f44005bcc27fb.name: Darya's Wand
2aa44b1530372f4c829f44005bcc27fb.desc:
A wand that harnesses the power of the eclipse. It functions best when the sun is fully submerged in darkness, and only a faint rim of light shines through.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Ethereal Duplication:
The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

fe2870961477bb43af97b6c0e0e2d4a3.name: Flat ramp 2m
fe2870961477bb43af97b6c0e0e2d4a3.desc: This tool can only be used inside the building area around a Flame Altar. It can help you to quickly build your desired base with pre-defined structures.

bc9fd08fc4a78249aab673853ccf7795.name: Sage Leaves
bc9fd08fc4a78249aab673853ccf7795.desc: A bitter tasting herb that can be found in dry areas. It's said to have enlightening abilities.

c1c08ebeaca3e24291b8790b1b8cfd98.name: Frozen Core Wand
c1c08ebeaca3e24291b8790b1b8cfd98.desc:
This wand hides a rare frozen core inside, enabling its owner to unleash massive ice damage against foes.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

853e5fbc80868d45b11b7547bb794f24.name: Wildwood Shortbow
853e5fbc80868d45b11b7547bb794f24.desc: This sturdy oak wood bow has a high rate of fire and conserves your energy at the expense of damage.

22a7f558df2289499c8ad9231075af28.name: Urn
22a7f558df2289499c8ad9231075af28.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c644a60fc5924143b9d067d841abb1e2.name: Eternal Heal Cascade II
c644a60fc5924143b9d067d841abb1e2.desc:
Releases continuous healing projectiles that automatically seek you and your allies.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

d97f4997455fc947a3097c29d80526c9.name: Hunter Vest
d97f4997455fc947a3097c29d80526c9.desc: Taking down prey, and even other predators is far easier with this finely made hunter's armor.

19e2c283695d2e40b95484eed112e028.name: Explosive Barrel
19e2c283695d2e40b95484eed112e028.desc: A decorative element that creates an explosive atmosphere, indeed.

c82d4cf22f75744882ecde18582c6c59.name: Loraine's Glasses
c82d4cf22f75744882ecde18582c6c59.desc: These glasses have seen countless horizons, failures, and successes. You think you can see some faint scratch marks on them — were they caused by vultures?

53da219750fb274c9b857171f1af3f6b.name: Entangle III
53da219750fb274c9b857171f1af3f6b.desc:
Grows entangling roots in an area that apply a debuff to enemies which prevents them from moving for a short duration.
Rooted enemies are still able to perform attacks and bigger ones are slowed instead of rooted. 

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

5ae90a57dda2354383195aaddc619ebe.name: Constantio's Constructeer, V2.0
5ae90a57dda2354383195aaddc619ebe.desc:
"A new and improved version of the Constructeer V1.0! This model is lighter, faster, more precise, and all-around better! See the delicate lines I've added to the sides? They swing as if bound by gravitational pull — a reminder that time never stands still, and neither should we! Let's move forward into a new era together!"

- Artificer Constantio

95b1ae31dc12024c99198b7d0e9a1ae5.name: Fish Teeth
95b1ae31dc12024c99198b7d0e9a1ae5.desc: The threatening teeth of a fish that is no threat anymore.

758d7da56f65884eb0f62031656bcb87.name: Spellweaver Wall Banner
758d7da56f65884eb0f62031656bcb87.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

cd66af5d95b6c545998cddfc08580693.name: Right Cyclops Arm
cd66af5d95b6c545998cddfc08580693.desc:
The right arm of a Cyclops. It's taller than your whole body when propped up!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.

8500771aed7ad54ca0355633744328d3.name: Bloodfeather Shoes
8500771aed7ad54ca0355633744328d3.desc: With these shoes, maintain your stance and recover before launching your next attack.

25dd99c54d82ab4ca712ab8e549dd9d1.name: Crestflame Shield
25dd99c54d82ab4ca712ab8e549dd9d1.desc: A bulky, circular shield that almost appears to possess a glowing energy core. With this, your defense will be powered up greatly!

ddcd2be12eab084e9b2a861815b58bb2.name: Trap Fireball
ddcd2be12eab084e9b2a861815b58bb2.desc:
A Trap Fireball which can be used as spell ammunition.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

e1915c480cfacb429fcd6262abe06e84.name: Tarpaulin
e1915c480cfacb429fcd6262abe06e84.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

8dfb0ba872edf1449086d5d3fd899ef5.name: Snowpal Child
8dfb0ba872edf1449086d5d3fd899ef5.desc: A friendly figure made from snow.

e40b813eda5a7642a149879ef7a69fc9.name: Crimsonback
e40b813eda5a7642a149879ef7a69fc9.desc:
The Crimsonback, once a common Silverback that survived countless migrations, has scales that burn with a deep red hue. It is said to embody strength and endurance, and it is prized by seasoned anglers for its power and beauty.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

3db11abb2bb87a4dbe86a1ad6cdde587.name: Palm Wood Block
3db11abb2bb87a4dbe86a1ad6cdde587.desc: Perfect to build a provisional house in hot areas. Palm wood is a great alternative to conventional wood, mimicking its charm and durability.

668588a3ea0b9d4a911dcbc039d1a56b.name: Lapislazuli
668588a3ea0b9d4a911dcbc039d1a56b.desc: A rare gem famous for its magical properties as a catalyst. It's great for channeling and shielding!

c798252855607d4dbfaeaa60779f0c51.name: Eternal Arc Lightning II
c798252855607d4dbfaeaa60779f0c51.desc:
Releases continuous lightning strikes that can arc to multiple other close targets.
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

993902b6fd6c154cac5adb2135448753.name: Hero's Shield
993902b6fd6c154cac5adb2135448753.desc: A sturdy shield, graced by the visage of a bird.

3c54817e024f164fafe8a0d0435453d3.name: Creamy Mushroom Spaetzle
3c54817e024f164fafe8a0d0435453d3.desc: A local delicacy with a creamy texture and rich taste. It fills the belly and heals the soul, especially when the north winds are howling outside.

888452f8cee85844929b901898f26264.name: Wildheart Seekers
888452f8cee85844929b901898f26264.desc:
A naturalistic dagger set with winding wooden handles. The blades are slightly curved and are ideal for skinning animals.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

267fdc9fe03a4d4cb6f2aa4291dae7c0.name: Eldermere's Staff
267fdc9fe03a4d4cb6f2aa4291dae7c0.desc:
"A staff of my own design. The dome that encapsulates the tip can contain highly concentrated bolts of energy before releasing them into the spell of my choosing. The quilted leather along the hilt adds a refined touch, I believe."

- Eldermere, Chief Engineer

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

dc51bd8a9e7ee741b44b8c08c5dea290.name: Adventurer Chest
dc51bd8a9e7ee741b44b8c08c5dea290.desc: Warm, light, and agile. This piece of armor is a great fit for adventurers! The red scarf is especially daring.

d86494046cdb044c802da6aec90ce53d.name: Large Crypt Cabinet
d86494046cdb044c802da6aec90ce53d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

493b552bc5efe745a66ac680927fd5a1.name: Corncob
493b552bc5efe745a66ac680927fd5a1.desc: A very versatile crop that can be dried, grilled, or consumed raw, strengthening the consumer for a short duration.

631c203c66346546a17404bd92192d25.name: Warrior Arms
631c203c66346546a17404bd92192d25.desc: The metal parts on these reinforced gloves are bent from one too many reckless swings.

1624c4f83ef2da448b199705cf29b03e.name: Village Oak
1624c4f83ef2da448b199705cf29b03e.desc:
A mix of umber and gray, exhibiting both wisdom and solidity.

This color palette can be made with Springlands materials.

1966186679220f4aa517a5558ba25c4a.name: Flower Soil
1966186679220f4aa517a5558ba25c4a.desc:
The perfect soil for growing beautiful flowers.

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

0ed277fd390c1d4daa7ecdbcf5683529.name: Giant Hollow Halls Banner
0ed277fd390c1d4daa7ecdbcf5683529.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

42047829af0b604cbacbc71426bd49d2.name: Yellow Wall Flower
42047829af0b604cbacbc71426bd49d2.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

c8b11179c1cbd7419904920268845c30.name: Prison Room Divider II
c8b11179c1cbd7419904920268845c30.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

59151fc96d91c449a3194eb279ee1c43.name: Granite Shingle Roof Block
59151fc96d91c449a3194eb279ee1c43.desc: These granite shingles bring a mountain flair to your cozy homestead.

f96ef29958f3d94a91a3c45d7c1427c8.name: Tarred Wood Block
f96ef29958f3d94a91a3c45d7c1427c8.desc:
A Tarred Wood Block. Now only the shingles are missing.

Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

97d8a7e014ec3748add9b861adc7d266.name: Skull Stalker Gloves
97d8a7e014ec3748add9b861adc7d266.desc: These gloves lock your hold on the bow — target the head with steady aim.

c6a916ab3df17f44881291fc4e7220a7.name: Soothsayer
c6a916ab3df17f44881291fc4e7220a7.desc: A hammer adorned with an ancient petrified tusk. Tusks and teeth were used by the Vukah for mystical purposes.

0c302fb88564ed408852c8e62f837957.name: Wall Tapestry II
0c302fb88564ed408852c8e62f837957.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

dfb53f37aff5f449a8afe81ca2498116.name: Baby Frizzy Goat
dfb53f37aff5f449a8afe81ca2498116.desc: An adorable little Frizzy Goat. Its hair gets easily tangled, but it doesn't seem to mind.

6628f7a1c2c8f84ebabf16e2c90f3a21.name: Superior Ring of Health
6628f7a1c2c8f84ebabf16e2c90f3a21.desc: This ring will increase your health and healing rate.

7511f5bdbb83544792a54dcfade31546.name: Large Ancient Temple Shelf
7511f5bdbb83544792a54dcfade31546.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ea7f99d8f060a245ba3410121fcd149b.name: Ancients Night Door
ea7f99d8f060a245ba3410121fcd149b.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

010452f5aaf5cd4199e1609b884cc492.name: Extraordinary Glider
010452f5aaf5cd4199e1609b884cc492.desc: This Glider will allow you to travel extraordinarily long distances.

c5339f613a5a934a8b5119dfe76ec9e2.name: Gabrielle Fairburn
c5339f613a5a934a8b5119dfe76ec9e2.desc: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

48da051881d440418ca6b951e856a1d4.name: Bronze Chandelier
48da051881d440418ca6b951e856a1d4.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

f21ed1ff72d0a24b84f4c66aac9219a6.name: Revelwood Red Leaf Seedling
f21ed1ff72d0a24b84f4c66aac9219a6.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.

19286c77ac612542ab08f07d5737698d.name: Calla Luna
19286c77ac612542ab08f07d5737698d.desc:
A white plant called "Calla Luna". To some, they represent purity and faithfulness, while they're a symbol of sensuality to others. 
However, everybody can agree on their beauty and that their nightly green glow sets them apart from other blossoms in the Nomad Highlands.

faaec385a0841649b2ee75a44293565a.name: Bug Dust
faaec385a0841649b2ee75a44293565a.desc: A protein rich ingredient created from crushed critter shells.

42c683ecb5689e419f669a14d916ffed.name: Licuala Plant
42c683ecb5689e419f669a14d916ffed.desc: A large potted plant to beautify your home.

1faa24eca2611348bbf01a42a1bbd0ad.name: Poisoned Copper Arrow
1faa24eca2611348bbf01a42a1bbd0ad.desc:
A poisoned Special Arrow, potent and dangerous.

Poisoned Arrow: Enemies hit by this arrow are poisoned and additionally receive 8 damage per second for 5 seconds.

c405f244e3335f41a10cb5f37d4b44fb.name: Fluffy Tunic
c405f244e3335f41a10cb5f37d4b44fb.desc: A warm tunic, lined with white wool. The sleeves are long and wide, so it's fun to swing your arms around gleefully!

5e0d27cff3ef1844a6d36e2c06b1d6ae.name: Gold Fell Cyclops Trophy
5e0d27cff3ef1844a6d36e2c06b1d6ae.desc:
There wasn't much substance to begin with, but now only the empty shell remains. Show off your pride with this golden trophy.

Collect multiple Fell Cyclops Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

d28c78a9f9916e428697f328eac88c3a.name: Guard of the North Gloves
d28c78a9f9916e428697f328eac88c3a.desc: Wearing these gloves, the Northern Lord carved his way through the enshrouded valleys of Embervale. The scars he cut into people and soil can be traced from the bleak mountains to today's ruins of Pikemead's Reach.

1afc9e3bb4119643a673968195c745e6.name: Dark Morningstar
1afc9e3bb4119643a673968195c745e6.desc: Children rumored that people killed by this Morningstar would have their souls banished inside the orb. These remnants would echo aimlessly forever in their spherical prison, bouncing between the curved walls and the void.

849ace152c7ac84a9dcafb4ac135204b.name: Cat Pillow
849ace152c7ac84a9dcafb4ac135204b.desc: A soft pillow for your cat.

c31b10d307cae34ea315f30244d19e18.name: Wisteria
c31b10d307cae34ea315f30244d19e18.desc: Use the Overgrowth Tool to apply this to structures in your base.

5a10ad6547b854468c1ab4826b77e25f.name: Dragon's Wing
5a10ad6547b854468c1ab4826b77e25f.desc: Gain the strength of a dragon with this legendary weapon.

977bd870e00ce746970c7ac962d2407a.name: Blood Omen Axe
977bd870e00ce746970c7ac962d2407a.desc: This colossal axe draws strength from those it wounds, stealing their vitality with each strike.

489cbfe0b7d2d44c8b72970fd5c39575.name: Omen Chest
489cbfe0b7d2d44c8b72970fd5c39575.desc:
An ordinary leather coat. A fungal growth overtook the flat grain texture.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

94c96c6baf943b489f2ff85f39a7faaa.name: Scavenger Tyrant Trophy
94c96c6baf943b489f2ff85f39a7faaa.desc: Her whip still haunts you in your dreams so you chose to hang her head instead.

9f5a2a395008334ca267d6ff77b5e3bf.name: Iron Fell Cyclops Trophy
9f5a2a395008334ca267d6ff77b5e3bf.desc:
The prized head of a cyclops, preserved in metal and made accessible to the common person. People can now gaze into its eye unafraid.

Collect multiple Fell Cyclops Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

87ca74dd6b478742ae1253f927c2d226.name: Giant Critter Scales
87ca74dd6b478742ae1253f927c2d226.desc: Massive, hardened scales. Lightweight yet incredibly tough, they are prime materials for crafting durable and flexible armor.

3c9a5c53a1e2fe438884fedbd48565f6.name: Archaic Essence V
3c9a5c53a1e2fe438884fedbd48565f6.desc:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.

7b7e5a68da776a4f9cc8ecedefaf2732.name: Mist of a Fell Sicklescythe
7b7e5a68da776a4f9cc8ecedefaf2732.desc:
A dense, swirling vapor extracted from Fell casters. It is imbued with ethereal Shroud magic, making it invaluable for crafting magical armor and powering devastating spells.

Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

0d11dc71371abe49a46d73104fa69088.name: Elm's Eye Wand
0d11dc71371abe49a46d73104fa69088.desc:
Wildly grown sprigs that coil around a negative space — the eye of the elm, observing its own demise.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

98265708f8f50b4bb4e7721a7e2a9cb0.name: Large Boreal Wood Bed
98265708f8f50b4bb4e7721a7e2a9cb0.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

053949b3a5c91f49a2475d0bc7e38b3a.name: Drak Wood Totem II
053949b3a5c91f49a2475d0bc7e38b3a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

2ce76322d4bba84491521aba8df33bf0.name: Roughly Cut Stone Block
2ce76322d4bba84491521aba8df33bf0.desc:
A block made out of rocks extracted from the ground. Roughly cut to the right size to stack them. Great for building a foundation!

Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

18a80b7117fe68428313072493b3c34a.name: Magician Boots
18a80b7117fe68428313072493b3c34a.desc: Low-cut shoes. Exposing one's ankles is quite enchanting!

bf14369139ea8640a93954abf52723a5.name: Hollow's Eve Boots
bf14369139ea8640a93954abf52723a5.desc: You'll make people shake in their boots when you approach in these spooky shoes!

69ee9ad51c75934a9d75406ac5d47f9f.name: Soothsayer
69ee9ad51c75934a9d75406ac5d47f9f.desc: A hammer adorned with an ancient petrified tusk. Tusks and teeth were used by the Vukah for mystical purposes.

6b6676889367084fa777df5ef83a28d8.name: Dark Red Eyes
6b6676889367084fa777df5ef83a28d8.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

d22fc9fb71450b419beef5ef796cc98f.name: Metal Water Dispenser I
d22fc9fb71450b419beef5ef796cc98f.desc: This item will dispense water endlessly until it is submerged.

d22fc58b70fd2f4d80e317efad1a7c6f.name: Hailscourge
d22fc58b70fd2f4d80e317efad1a7c6f.desc: A blade that's cold to the touch. It weighs heavily on the mind.

d88b20dd6485da43bc8fa48f2023f918.name: Drak Wood Totem III
d88b20dd6485da43bc8fa48f2023f918.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

7f45a9db5364ae4e8a6cf20e1859602a.name: Small Red Marble Arc
7f45a9db5364ae4e8a6cf20e1859602a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

424a07bef1dc9845a6bc375ca66a730f.name: Fell Fashion
424a07bef1dc9845a6bc375ca66a730f.desc:
Look like a Fell foe, but make it fashion. This blue color palette mirrors the hues of the Shroud, with a touch of aquamarine added.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

61ab23d44c91df41b31690c6041df5bc.name: Raw Lean Meat
61ab23d44c91df41b31690c6041df5bc.desc: Inedible, raw meat. Must be cooked over a campfire.

11fd935c3ee4094f9996ad0bed771c1d.name: Eternal Voltaic Arrow II
11fd935c3ee4094f9996ad0bed771c1d.desc:
An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's charged with electricity.

Eternal Arrow: Does not deplete Ammo per use. Equip the Eternal Arrow and use Mana to shoot it with a Bow.

ba150021b34f034ea74de4d8fc40bd81.name: Gilded Contrast
ba150021b34f034ea74de4d8fc40bd81.desc:
White and black in bold opposition, with just a thread of gold to hold it all together. Minimal, but deliberate.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

9c5955ff094af147bee9202cfc70aee8.name: Blackguard Helmet
9c5955ff094af147bee9202cfc70aee8.desc:
A helmet made from petrified insectoid critter legs assembled to grasp at the wearer's face like claws.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

81fec3bf56b684419ef343a91158e4c9.name: Yak Food
81fec3bf56b684419ef343a91158e4c9.desc:
Nutritious Yak food for tame animals on your farm.

It must be placed inside the appropriate feeder.

aab1862f7152d14e80d224b66deff02b.name: Morning Sun
aab1862f7152d14e80d224b66deff02b.desc:
Gaze at the sunlight washing over the mountains, and bathe in the early warmth as you set out on your journey.

Music Sheet: 
Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

cd30fc677cf77345805602acf9b6a39d.name: Gold Hydrak'Dal Trophy
cd30fc677cf77345805602acf9b6a39d.desc:
This trophy proves that you have defeated their leader once again. In their eyes, you must seem like a god. However, they won't worship you, they'll just despise you even more.

Collect multiple Hydrak'Dal Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

6b282a7fecec994699c275d2a37366a4.name: Darya's Staff
6b282a7fecec994699c275d2a37366a4.desc:
A staff that harnesses the power of the eclipsed sun. It functions best when only a crescent of light is left.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

4703f2bfd99fca4e961f555857b41ca8.name: Eternal Chain Heal II
4703f2bfd99fca4e961f555857b41ca8.desc:
Releases a mending ray that automatically seeks nearby allies.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

0edaaaaa56b05049bead71abb4a6d82e.name: Magma Gel
0edaaaaa56b05049bead71abb4a6d82e.desc: A thick gel that sets harder than it looks. Can be applied as a protective coating over most surfaces. Notably, it also generates heat from within.

c7621a63bd37344891b7d4c32f937493.name: Ground Lantern II
c7621a63bd37344891b7d4c32f937493.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

7d64d723e131ed478e9e780f4b1296e0.name: Sunpiercer Shield
7d64d723e131ed478e9e780f4b1296e0.desc: A well-crafted shield marked by a golden sun. Strong, reliable, and radiant — built to hold the line when all else falters.

5431535053dc9648a2beecd32a4ee537.name: Fell Marksman Bow
5431535053dc9648a2beecd32a4ee537.desc: Forged for ruthless efficiency, the Fell Marksman Bow finds its purpose in the skulls of Scavengers who dare cross its path.

89a731a6f1ad6447b8320594a4c403ec.name: Tidecaller Tunic
89a731a6f1ad6447b8320594a4c403ec.desc: A light tunic, as majestic in appearance as the powers it bestows when you spread your arms wide.

d3adcbd3f534374192f103d56c779827.name: Grilled Emberfin
d3adcbd3f534374192f103d56c779827.desc: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

caceaca2ad0f30448167df30e6d22c14.name: Gem of Cold Composure
caceaca2ad0f30448167df30e6d22c14.desc: Blocking or aiming for a short time grants %k physical and %k magical resistance, but slows the movement by %k. Getting hit or attacking while buffed creates an ice explosion that deals %k ice damage and slows enemies, after which the buff gets removed.

911ed8e3ffe11745838db1ce71b19fbb.name: Scholar of the Young Flame Boots
911ed8e3ffe11745838db1ce71b19fbb.desc: These golden boots carried the "Scholars of the Young Flame" across the open roads of Embervale. The soles still carry dust from places you have yet to discover.

d5ee9a8cd2fadd4f8f19e90c530cff6e.name: Eternal Fire Totem II
d5ee9a8cd2fadd4f8f19e90c530cff6e.desc:
Summons a totem that launches fiery projectiles at enemies and explodes when it expires. 
Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

8da6e53186dfe14396080151cb40b651.name: Warden Trousers
8da6e53186dfe14396080151cb40b651.desc: Gray pants which have been refined with expertly crafted metal parts.

72df70dc5eea2f4881dc76af22137435.name: Shroud Weaver
72df70dc5eea2f4881dc76af22137435.desc:
A malicious staff that effortlessly intertwines the strings of fate with the Shroud.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

15d74a8a25ec3a4bae957cf78e6be8d7.name: Elite Hollow Boots
15d74a8a25ec3a4bae957cf78e6be8d7.desc: These boots are enhanced with metal plates, providing more defense to the sensitive shins of the skeletons wearing them.

99e4c56913c1cd4daa16b3f22544e469.name: Decoration Workbench
99e4c56913c1cd4daa16b3f22544e469.desc: Equipped with woodworking and stone masonry tools, this workbench lets you craft beautiful decorative pieces for your home with the Carpenter’s help.

7aa5a8817e0b6a48917d0a93ccdc5653.name: Crude Wooden Gate II
7aa5a8817e0b6a48917d0a93ccdc5653.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

dd5942f825fd91488d685f00eacff75d.name: Efflorescent Hope Boots
dd5942f825fd91488d685f00eacff75d.desc: Cloven, finely segmented boots. Their shape is reminiscent of Fae Deer hooves.

ee65f3341cb6b84da23b566835309e1e.name: Orange Floor Light II
ee65f3341cb6b84da23b566835309e1e.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

8b95d5e05bfbf742954525d85f29f585.name: Hand Spindle
8b95d5e05bfbf742954525d85f29f585.desc: An item used by the Hunter to create better strings.

c342321bc9253a49af07506d77129dee.name: Lifelock Chest
c342321bc9253a49af07506d77129dee.desc: A chestpiece made heavy through dangling chains. The metal plates leave an empty space, a void atop the heart, that's shaped like a keyhole. The once alabaster garments are ingrained with soot.

2045f8fe52a0524ba6cb7af6668e5538.name: Moss
2045f8fe52a0524ba6cb7af6668e5538.desc: A lovely patch of green moss.

038c33111a5ab146bb867ff85da76b5c.name: Midnight Lily
038c33111a5ab146bb867ff85da76b5c.desc: An edible flower used to enhance the effect of certain dishes. It only blooms at night in the Springlands.

a843ec5326f91c4ab23f6abe6f0bab6b.name: Green Rocket
a843ec5326f91c4ab23f6abe6f0bab6b.desc: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

b9e32558b5157d43ac0db01c1bad8308.name: Old Books
b9e32558b5157d43ac0db01c1bad8308.desc: A stack of old parchments, worn and torn by the ravages of time. A wise man could salvage something from the remnants.

3d1e2418c743be4182bd944b41bf6e39.name: Scrap Jug
3d1e2418c743be4182bd944b41bf6e39.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e88faa4438fe3a4188cdd0b04fd7ebff.name: Book I
e88faa4438fe3a4188cdd0b04fd7ebff.desc: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.

aa3538fa8d5dcd4a8c9b4c44d80b989f.name: Deceit
aa3538fa8d5dcd4a8c9b4c44d80b989f.desc:
At first glance, the muted mauve shrouds the wearer in the mundane. Only a keen eye can spot the deceitful, spiteful green lurking underneath.

This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.

7720bbbe187af34ebae2da5c68bc69a3.name: Mystic Hat
7720bbbe187af34ebae2da5c68bc69a3.desc: A Wizard Hat. Most commonly worn during lunar ceremonies and divinations.

7caad8c08a11fa41849774bd41d37bdb.name: Milkmaid Hat
7caad8c08a11fa41849774bd41d37bdb.desc: A milky white headwrap that keeps your hair out of your face while working.

47874f70cb02b74885bb548a69c0946c.name: Crude Wooden Chair
47874f70cb02b74885bb548a69c0946c.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

19f2f26bb7144d49b13c57d6bed2813b.name: Iron Chandelier
19f2f26bb7144d49b13c57d6bed2813b.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

8483ee6d3fad4c4ea7cf2499d34da093.name: Plantain
8483ee6d3fad4c4ea7cf2499d34da093.desc: This plantain, not to be confused with a common banana, cannot be eaten raw. It's high in starch and can be used as a staple in many foods once cooked.

b27fd54e4398a2468a2a75e2e899b1c3.name: Greater Mana Potion
b27fd54e4398a2468a2a75e2e899b1c3.desc: A mana potion with higher concentration, instantly restoring a great amount of mana upon use.

b8a1c5df2214a84da2ecd5bf1926dab2.name: Single Gastropod
b8a1c5df2214a84da2ecd5bf1926dab2.desc:
A lonely gastropod, sitting peacefully on a rock. Descendants of this variant still populated Embervale's shores until recently. Their colorful shells and slippery mucus were crushed into the iridescent pigment used to dye cloth.

This collectible is found in the Revelwood.

befa94b7fc6bcf418fcc8c0e844ab402.name: Golden War Hero Axe
befa94b7fc6bcf418fcc8c0e844ab402.desc: Many soldiers fall in war. Those who return are heralded and showered in gold and gifts; given weapons befitting a celebrated veteran... but for some, such gifts merely serve as a reminder of their harrowing past.

01af73883be75743b0144d3296df67f0.name: Pikemead Statue Showcase
01af73883be75743b0144d3296df67f0.desc: Use this showcase to reassemble the Queen Pikemead statue.

ae59074d7011514bba2eb5ce03e6225a.name: Sacrificial Vukah Dagger
ae59074d7011514bba2eb5ce03e6225a.desc:
A crude dagger, previously used by a Vukah in a bloody ritual.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

d331776b30940844acfd3eaea4b34332.name: Antidote
d331776b30940844acfd3eaea4b34332.desc: An antidote that instantly cures any poison effect.

fefa8fcc239c01429a21878f2d8966af.name: Lucent Axe
fefa8fcc239c01429a21878f2d8966af.desc: The light it bears is a small comfort amidst the sea of sorrow. A lonely star, a guiding light moving frantically against the black skies.

7f6cdb06da35414f8bd75d8fd406f78b.name: Wooden Grate II
7f6cdb06da35414f8bd75d8fd406f78b.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6c52b67cb16357459f955a1e86e5d76e.name: Baby Capybara
6c52b67cb16357459f955a1e86e5d76e.desc: A tiny Capybara. It enjoys headpats, chewing on daylilies, soaking in hot springs, and being held tightly in your warm arms.

9098d0279a1fee4abac89f9ec36d4778.name: Big Blackmire Statue I
9098d0279a1fee4abac89f9ec36d4778.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c6166aebfc5c504489ee63c618fe547b.name: Fertilised Farm Soil
c6166aebfc5c504489ee63c618fe547b.desc:
Healthy, fertilised soil that greatly increases the growing speed of plants.

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

622a85695c7c9f4e8fdaa148793d0bea.name: Trailblazer Hood
622a85695c7c9f4e8fdaa148793d0bea.desc: The metal rim around this hood forms an elegant crown, jagging out from the wearer's skull. The shape of the tips is reminiscent of wings.

432dac3618d41246b9a04819f1aa4679.name: Crude Wooden Double Door
432dac3618d41246b9a04819f1aa4679.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

dddd7b0840a68044bc5959e541d9b27f.name: Metalstar Mace
dddd7b0840a68044bc5959e541d9b27f.desc: A six-edged mace made from heavy metal. The head of this weapon resembles a star.

3f645807b5a07e4b97fb52b426c01849.name: Frog
3f645807b5a07e4b97fb52b426c01849.desc:
A tiny frog. He could be your best friend if you didn't need to use him as fish bait. 

Especially helpful to catch epic fish from the Veilwater Basin.

b6f6d3da5b506745a24a9933a997b858.name: Blessed Club
b6f6d3da5b506745a24a9933a997b858.desc: A club that was bathed in divine waters, thus acquiring a blessing of protection. Turns out blessings are less effective than cold, hard steel when caught in an ambush.

2cd0bdc8602fde439209f11ee274328e.name: Ony's Staff
2cd0bdc8602fde439209f11ee274328e.desc:
A sequence of words is etched along the handle. They feel vaguely familiar to you. 

I fly so high, I may never come down
I dance on the sun, whole body ablaze
My cup's always full, I'd drink till I drown
In liquid light and limerence, until I feel dazed

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

6d90cc382daf0246b0b9d3a27d5a9e5c.name: Large Elevated Crypt Coffin II
6d90cc382daf0246b0b9d3a27d5a9e5c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

a212bd701b455944915bc0ed57e3f3af.name: Pulley
a212bd701b455944915bc0ed57e3f3af.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

8b19ffaa3991f5478e41b1ce0262abc8.name: Steel Pickaxe
8b19ffaa3991f5478e41b1ce0262abc8.desc: This pickaxe can help you dig deeper and further due to the pick having been forged from steel. Heave ho!

aad83ea064989c499f625bf33223637b.name: Gem of Meteoric Impact
aad83ea064989c499f625bf33223637b.desc: Landing after gliding creates an explosion that deals %k fire damage and leaves behind a trail of fire that applies  burning to enemies, dealing %k damage per second for %k. After the initial impact, attacks deal %k additional fire damage for %k.

634ba7f3a2687947a71792cadd9aa8b9.name: Sparkworks Tool
634ba7f3a2687947a71792cadd9aa8b9.desc: An Ancient tool that allows the user to wire up buttons, doors, traps, and more to make them interactable and logically interconnected.

e7a99734c0bd434787471a0d8509a78d.name: Scout Gloves
e7a99734c0bd434787471a0d8509a78d.desc: Excellent tools to scout with — especially due to their grip and padding.

10d9a73a14605e4db9ce237758073216.name: Alchemical Base
10d9a73a14605e4db9ce237758073216.desc: A clear liquid with a sharp smell. Used to enhance alchemical reactions.

5151e7b2de505a4d8c28588febacef29.name: Grilled Shimmerfin
5151e7b2de505a4d8c28588febacef29.desc: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

a52df1cb3ce25145b7c8fe2a1ade8875.name: Large Silver Brazier
a52df1cb3ce25145b7c8fe2a1ade8875.desc:
A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.

78f921bea175894fabfaaef8c9fb9f34.name: Secret Flintstone Door
78f921bea175894fabfaaef8c9fb9f34.desc: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.

b222e64be76bee41ad9211fb272c5fc8.name: Millstones
b222e64be76bee41ad9211fb272c5fc8.desc: Two heavy millstones used to pulverize things. Perfect to grind flour.

03f1e3f50fe2a642946c6ec939b15432.name: Coffee Brewery
03f1e3f50fe2a642946c6ec939b15432.desc: A handy machine that brews hot coffee. There is hope left in this world after all.

cc769a7c1835394688465756d46fafa7.name: Ground Sign
cc769a7c1835394688465756d46fafa7.desc: A standing sign that you can write on.

8f701bdff3e86749845892b8371e15e1.name: Pinky Promise
8f701bdff3e86749845892b8371e15e1.desc:
The chalky white and vibrant pink in this palette form a childlike innocence.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

5132ccd7e92ee341ba5b4e5990fb1c6a.name: Ring of Rapacity
5132ccd7e92ee341ba5b4e5990fb1c6a.desc: A glimmering ring, plucked from the remains of someone who got more than they bargained for.

a0098fecdab31b4ca31d311067001efb.name: Sage Pants
a0098fecdab31b4ca31d311067001efb.desc: Remarkable pants. What makes them remarkable? The wearer, mostly.

cf57facdeb62db4f99e468fe2ab1f3a4.name: Sun Axe
cf57facdeb62db4f99e468fe2ab1f3a4.desc: An axe that shines brightest at dawn, clinging on to hope no matter what.

e76bc3d26ed9a84ba11ead5b1583840d.name: Bamboo Cage II
e76bc3d26ed9a84ba11ead5b1583840d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

61759ae36850b14e912da776fc6557b9.name: Apex Machete
61759ae36850b14e912da776fc6557b9.desc: The weapon brandishes an interlocking pattern of dark and light by partially covering its fuller with a blackened outer shell. The sword's sides are asymmetric, making one ideal for slashing while the other excels in prying or hacking through its pronounced claw-like appendage.

e3dc4741fd276f40993729b478a94046.name: Eternal Hollow Wretch I
e3dc4741fd276f40993729b478a94046.desc:
Summons a Hollow Wretch ally that attacks enemies. 
Maximum amount of summoned Hollow allies is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

e144a9e49d9f0f479bc8ffa8aea9ede3.name: Gem of Lesser Necromancy
e144a9e49d9f0f479bc8ffa8aea9ede3.desc: Killing an enemy has a %k chance to spawn an allied Hollow Wretch at level %k. You can only have 4 active Wretches from this gem at a time. Spawning more will delete the oldest one. Hollow Wretches decay when out of combat for too long.

7ff0c27de68bb14382faded2d6ba07a1.name: Fur Patch
7ff0c27de68bb14382faded2d6ba07a1.desc: A small shred of animal fur.

701c12cc52ad8b43836a48fbc959a6af.name: Golden Bulwark Gloves
701c12cc52ad8b43836a48fbc959a6af.desc: Blocking feels effortless in these gloves, and the crystals catch the sun with every move.

590632927407d047a9be06f81870bace.name: Boreal Wood Banquet Table
590632927407d047a9be06f81870bace.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

08ecfb60ba012c48879ae802d2f4ebc7.name: Gravedigger Hat
08ecfb60ba012c48879ae802d2f4ebc7.desc: People don't make eye contact with gravediggers because it brings bad luck. Therefore, some graveyard keepers wear a cap that covers their eyes to avoid trouble.

d3965dedfcc23b4cbbda2c50c74ebef1.name: Eternal Ice Bolt IV
d3965dedfcc23b4cbbda2c50c74ebef1.desc:
Conjures an icy projectile that deals damage in an area and applies a slow debuff.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

16f6078dc531454292b44ecb3f56f701.name: Crestflame boots
16f6078dc531454292b44ecb3f56f701.desc: Tall boots that are held by leather straps on the inside, and carry a thick layer of additional sheeting towards the outside. They end in kneegards which press upwards further in a radial shape.

327a43c5a5935a45883b72bbde97ae37.name: Frostbite Slasher Trousers
327a43c5a5935a45883b72bbde97ae37.desc: This pair of pants has ample space for carrying exposed blades and hidden toxins.

14e7c144557ea840b54e1ea20fe6dc08.name: Venerable Hollow Pants
14e7c144557ea840b54e1ea20fe6dc08.desc: Pants protected by manifold layers of metal plates. They were forged to hug the cylindrical shape of the leg and further show their creator's craftsmanship through the sparkling, golden rims.

14e7fbcc36412c4797bb2d33e9c68239.name: Secret Wooden Floor Passage
14e7fbcc36412c4797bb2d33e9c68239.desc: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.

2488202d4404eb4386e73e7be37c3e5f.name: Staff Of The Serpent
2488202d4404eb4386e73e7be37c3e5f.desc:
A majestic staff topped with an ouroboros ornament made from green jade. It's perfect for honoring the year of the snake.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

9ecdec31e2c07a4dadb1b52616352494.name: Rotblood
9ecdec31e2c07a4dadb1b52616352494.desc: A mighty hammer, corrupted to the core. The power of the Shroud is channeled in this weapon.

49cf8e0e3b20b542a00adb229335971e.name: Heather Flower
49cf8e0e3b20b542a00adb229335971e.desc: A large potted plant to beautify your home.

1c3145772d0fa34db05518a0ae2fc980.name: Square Plant Pot
1c3145772d0fa34db05518a0ae2fc980.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

ed8ea6074ee69949af762695f46c86b5.name: Blessed Club
ed8ea6074ee69949af762695f46c86b5.desc: A club that was bathed in divine waters, thus acquiring a blessing of protection. Turns out blessings are less effective than cold, hard steel when caught in an ambush.

9dedf8619057c74f8c4e98b1b6ab2fa9.name: Blackguard Chest
9dedf8619057c74f8c4e98b1b6ab2fa9.desc:
A metal cuirass with subtle embossing on it. The pattern is reminiscent of golden tangled vines, now sprouting with delicate mycelium.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

b63c43043b2bcd44b96905d0bde4c465.name: Quetzal Hunter Helmet
b63c43043b2bcd44b96905d0bde4c465.desc: Inspired by the Quetzal, a magnificent bird that once graced the skies of Embervale, this beautiful armor set lets you feel the freedom and precision of flight when you wear it.

ca79924ea936e0488500c90f6fcd4307.name: Mage Gloves
ca79924ea936e0488500c90f6fcd4307.desc: Artificial nails were added to these otherwise simple mage gloves to make them more imposing and fashionable.

2c1667a933ad794e811bc2a6d44128f7.name: Iron Adorned Round Door
2c1667a933ad794e811bc2a6d44128f7.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

a592d52aa805e540a4be05554d0d4356.name: Nightwind Bow
a592d52aa805e540a4be05554d0d4356.desc: A bow that's fueled by the dark shimmer of the Shroud.

4e4d061022022948a25343123de4928f.name: Collection Of Books II
4e4d061022022948a25343123de4928f.desc: What is better than one book?

b0bcd2611b1f5b4d99180dad3c878c9b.name: Kingmaker
b0bcd2611b1f5b4d99180dad3c878c9b.desc:
Life isn't always black and white. Sometimes, power demands sacrifice.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

88da8183e369da4babbbbcd2adb968da.name: Copper Block
88da8183e369da4babbbbcd2adb968da.desc: Copper adds a certain industrial warmth to your home with its characteristic color and shine.

2cf75ff53ba48e4d84ffa77dee62f523.name: Just Enough
2cf75ff53ba48e4d84ffa77dee62f523.desc:
You prefer the clean look with just enough color sprinkled in for your unique style.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

a23993aba1860f4a972a662b8bfe2759.name: Scavenger Bonfire
a23993aba1860f4a972a662b8bfe2759.desc: A big burning pile that's both cozy and archaic.

7f74789eefcb52499cf587dcbb1ecdd7.name: Ancient Pipette
7f74789eefcb52499cf587dcbb1ecdd7.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1cf37044c6f13846a6d86ae8044e2a55.name: Polished Wooden Banquet Table
1cf37044c6f13846a6d86ae8044e2a55.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

1563f3467f6031439389dbb35707ae61.name: Sacrificial Vukah Dagger
1563f3467f6031439389dbb35707ae61.desc:
A crude dagger, previously used by a Vukah in a bloody ritual.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

a3f5131f483f284c9143e0f7f492227d.name: Improved Decay Tool
a3f5131f483f284c9143e0f7f492227d.desc:
A magical tool that allows you to fly while adding and removing broken-looking edges to walls in your base. 

Requires being within the range of a Flame Altar to work.

f76bca502efc7e438392e5c52faa4385.name: Tank Trousers
f76bca502efc7e438392e5c52faa4385.desc: These padded trousers have been hastily stitched at the seams. Despite that, they hold up well.

d41f8508ecd55243ba40141823be8204.name: Eternal Heal Beam II
d41f8508ecd55243ba40141823be8204.desc:
Releases an aimed mending ray that continuously heals allies within.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

7586f3695307104bb4a38ce9bf626129.name: Ragged Shirt
7586f3695307104bb4a38ce9bf626129.desc: Can this even be called a shirt?

128b2706cdcdf64e8b01da2ad249ceda.name: Vanguard Throne
128b2706cdcdf64e8b01da2ad249ceda.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

8618b967341ffb48b48e10f9e1cbbd9c.name: Windy Fields
8618b967341ffb48b48e10f9e1cbbd9c.desc:
Grayish green hues combined with a dusty rose color.

This color palette can be made with Springlands materials.

3c6cee8cdb1a354e8c7f9aed9b3f6530.name: Elder Boots
3c6cee8cdb1a354e8c7f9aed9b3f6530.desc: The design of these boots imitates the skin of wyverns. Their scales were rumored to have the exceptional ability to absorb magical energy from all around!

972e4b296d117d4eb436cf6b4d7b3210.name: Hemotoxin Antidote
972e4b296d117d4eb436cf6b4d7b3210.desc:
Removes the Hemotoxin debuff upon use.

Also applies a buff that prevents the hemotoxin from affecting the user for an hour.

33849843c5c40f4896501b008354f0d3.name: Initiation
33849843c5c40f4896501b008354f0d3.desc:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"Once concealed by the Ancients, its might had been set free."

This one's for you, Brother. I wonder... did the Wanderer speak these same words when he handed you your favorite toy? I imagine you leaning back, almost lounging in that throne like you used to. I miss that side of you. - J

27608da119ce5044b5ceaa29cd930c23.name: Gold Fell Dragon Youngling Trophy
27608da119ce5044b5ceaa29cd930c23.desc:
As you were fighting the Fell Dragon Youngling time and time again, you could observe how its hope got whittled down to despair.

Collect multiple Fell Dragon Youngling Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

134724bed4f93d44818fd54bd52604a3.name: Red Flower
134724bed4f93d44818fd54bd52604a3.desc: A small potted plant to beautify your home.

877d13972671274c8d5dff25b7d2d7b4.name: Soothsayer
877d13972671274c8d5dff25b7d2d7b4.desc: A hammer adorned with an ancient petrified tusk. Tusks and teeth were used by the Vukah for mystical purposes.

1bb0a625b5ce854cb202678fc4c0494e.name: Ancestral Star
1bb0a625b5ce854cb202678fc4c0494e.desc: An ancestral weapon from the proud family line of the Galeforths, last held by Virgil Galeforth. He famously said: "If you want this weapon, you'll have to pry it from my cold, dead hands".

722de1403b9bbc44b4985ccac74d7f1b.name: Head Pounder
722de1403b9bbc44b4985ccac74d7f1b.desc: A gigantic hammer that can only be wielded with both hands. The head was forged from one solid block of steel, requiring advanced crafting techniques.

144cac70345886459c6bea4be992ed44.name: Large Boreal Wood Cupboard
144cac70345886459c6bea4be992ed44.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

b42fa4f902d20c4d863a50bcbc971073.name: Sharktooth Greatsword
b42fa4f902d20c4d863a50bcbc971073.desc: The edges of this blade are indented and therefore resemble cuts made by razor-sharp fins or rows of shark teeth.

0eeaf49fd07aa240b9591ee267db9dd3.name: Shroud Arrow I
0eeaf49fd07aa240b9591ee267db9dd3.desc:
If you can't beat them, join them. 
This Special Arrow uses the power of the Shroud and disperses a cloud of it upon impact.

f6a900ff7efd33499c6b33c36223cd2b.name: Plant Fiber
f6a900ff7efd33499c6b33c36223cd2b.desc: Maybe they can be used as strings? They seem to be pretty robust.

310cb005974f0c43bd5108c9984bebc7.name: Daylilies For Emily
310cb005974f0c43bd5108c9984bebc7.desc:
These warm oranges evoke the smell of daylilies, the warmth of a hearthfire, and the vision of sharing a sunrise with the one you love.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

142dada9d8507444942a1aacd6b1b8d9.name: Carved Wooden Window Frame II
142dada9d8507444942a1aacd6b1b8d9.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

3690d9079c2a0d46b93d03b1d81ae2b8.name: Staff Weapon Rack
3690d9079c2a0d46b93d03b1d81ae2b8.desc: A display to showcase weapons or shields.

284a73a52f2acf46ab06cac4f4624caf.name: Polished Stone
284a73a52f2acf46ab06cac4f4624caf.desc:
The light and dark facets of polished rock. Together, they remind of stone masonry, or more tragically, graveyard sculptures.

This color palette can be made with Springlands materials.

ef7db8a5511994448d1be607d5624094.name: White Flower
ef7db8a5511994448d1be607d5624094.desc: A small potted plant to beautify your home.

943e41846765dd429ffe707a14509b7e.name: Short Sword
943e41846765dd429ffe707a14509b7e.desc: A basic short sword designed for fights in narrow areas. Remarkably agile with a sharp tip.

8db6ed3150aa464cad1e25bc550f3f71.name: Alpine Antler Trousers
8db6ed3150aa464cad1e25bc550f3f71.desc: A simple pair of brown leather pants that connect well to the corresponding undergarments for the torso.

3d6cdc1539487e49a0fc54a5c769be90.name: Fertile Cinder's Cradle Dirt
3d6cdc1539487e49a0fc54a5c769be90.desc:
A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. 

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

5771a55a9e59d045a3dece0f78b00ce6.name: Large Boreal Wood Cabinet
5771a55a9e59d045a3dece0f78b00ce6.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

84f07790a216f24fb8be5a7202137ef0.name: Small Ancient Cupboard
84f07790a216f24fb8be5a7202137ef0.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

bd058a4d37fca54cae1c07d1d7d2763b.name: Frostbite Slasher Hood
bd058a4d37fca54cae1c07d1d7d2763b.desc: The fearsome metal mask is only partially covered by the hood, leaving most of its sharp edges and lines visible to your prey.

7470a1167180774aaf2d87d309be0544.name: Oven
7470a1167180774aaf2d87d309be0544.desc: A safe possibility to expose things to heat without burning them.

0d6713e6e3e5344cbeab9df7dbe9a20f.name: Royal Doublet
0d6713e6e3e5344cbeab9df7dbe9a20f.desc: A comfortable and noble doublet with a little cape attached to it. Every design element was carefully chosen to create an honorable look.

9400dd5b27c0d1409c3466bf47d85409.name: Secret Stair Passage
9400dd5b27c0d1409c3466bf47d85409.desc: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.

2d64f32aa3f111438c8e7e9a1dc97499.name: Iron Arrow
2d64f32aa3f111438c8e7e9a1dc97499.desc: A deadly arrow tipped with an iron arrowhead, spreading fear among enemies.

3fd1834a0833a247acb76f5e4b7ff25e.name: Rogue Boots
3fd1834a0833a247acb76f5e4b7ff25e.desc: Adventurers who wear these fearsome boots should not be messed with.

37e478f99b152b43b4775c5b2f02786c.name: Riptide
37e478f99b152b43b4775c5b2f02786c.desc: A shield that was washed into a grotto by the river. It must have belonged to a valiant hero.

22c76f8730317a499df25bb3072545df.name: "Flower Vase"
22c76f8730317a499df25bb3072545df.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

a957ac78067c3b4e8fd4458514cbc4f1.name: Spectral Ward
a957ac78067c3b4e8fd4458514cbc4f1.desc:
This magic shield allows you to block and parry against physical attacks. 

Parry
You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar.
Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

bb00d15b06c12548a9f1d8b9440cb2d5.name: Astrodome Shield
bb00d15b06c12548a9f1d8b9440cb2d5.desc: A convex shield, held by a bold yet delicate golden frame. Its design appears to be derived from the visual language and construction of telescopic lenses or compasses. Beneath the frame lies a faint constellation whose name and origin are unknown.

ce85b8f0e9d7ba44aa37bc119ca6f60c.name: Cryptic Wand
ce85b8f0e9d7ba44aa37bc119ca6f60c.desc:
A strange wand that was covered by ashes. Its body bends and twists, but never breaks.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

2fbbcae0ddf814419b7539a0f15f251a.name: Warlock Pants
2fbbcae0ddf814419b7539a0f15f251a.desc: Historic pants, formerly the centerpiece of ceremonial warlock clothing.

d5a12760fb0c234ab4474741fbe040b3.name: Small Salon Mirror
d5a12760fb0c234ab4474741fbe040b3.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

18dfb3ff6fa1994c847fb831f7eda917.name: Big Red Wall Banner
18dfb3ff6fa1994c847fb831f7eda917.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

cbb371985dd7dc43ae93e735c9c4b248.name: Resin Torch
cbb371985dd7dc43ae93e735c9c4b248.desc: An advanced torch that provides light for a longer period. Use this to explore deeper into the abyss!

3cb2af002a939b43b192a622d2143277.name: Iron Cyclops Trophy
3cb2af002a939b43b192a622d2143277.desc:
Large, in charge, and ready to barge in while you are busy scavenging caves.

Collect multiple Cyclops Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

7df800cd897e414b9d00bf234fad0020.name: Iron Grate
7df800cd897e414b9d00bf234fad0020.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e7f7c51ca56c0341904c276db4b9f1e0.name: Summer Games Cropped Top
e7f7c51ca56c0341904c276db4b9f1e0.desc: An athletic-looking top made from vibrant fabric, held together by leather straps. The cropped cut lets you show off your physique!

7a58a5025cfdbe4f954b65c5158daf1f.name: Strawberry Seedling
7a58a5025cfdbe4f954b65c5158daf1f.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

f04806ac53b4104a903dcd71e2c3464c.name: Bonebreaker
f04806ac53b4104a903dcd71e2c3464c.desc: A primitive, but well-crafted brutal weapon to splinter the bones of the enemy.

0415bb275fb84549b2f4a1412c89cb29.name: Red Confetti Mortar
0415bb275fb84549b2f4a1412c89cb29.desc: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

734ea07193f8e649828a195f1570bdae.name: Sword Garden Gnome
734ea07193f8e649828a195f1570bdae.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

3094b484ebb7224fa78ec763dc068253.name: Trailblazer Trousers
3094b484ebb7224fa78ec763dc068253.desc: Pants made from deep blue cloth and patched leather. The layers on the inside provide good insulation against the bitter cold.

37a69cddea710044814486dd417c4b1c.name: Manathor's Greatsword
37a69cddea710044814486dd417c4b1c.desc:
"Embervale is nothing but a speck of dust; a single point in time from which we will propel ourselves forward. We'll leap from here, into the future — towards the stars above. Towards home. No matter where we land... we will make our mark. They will remember us. They will remember me."

- Manathor

6f8356393b3f764792bc65df39a6f7f2.name: Mountain's Shadow Boots
6f8356393b3f764792bc65df39a6f7f2.desc: These boots repeat the same weaving technique from the Mountain's Shadow Gloves. They cover the knees and provide ideal protection when stumbling through dark, icy caves or forgotten fortresses.

e56278ee282d51439bcb46a69664b5d3.name: Wheat Seedling
e56278ee282d51439bcb46a69664b5d3.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

0026c38c886f7f46a956a462170d4654.name: Smelter
0026c38c886f7f46a956a462170d4654.desc: Used by a smith to melt and alloy metals.

07d53a8a589f784391aae3b8baaccea9.name: Iron Fell Wispwyvern Trophy
07d53a8a589f784391aae3b8baaccea9.desc:
Good omens fell to ash. Lights turned to lies, not promises. What was once a sign of good fortune has been snuffed out by a brush with fate. Pikemead's glory is restored.

Collect multiple Fell Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.

f2ba2d87a381894686e03e00b8bfc278.name: Wool
f2ba2d87a381894686e03e00b8bfc278.desc: Refined wool. It can be used for weaving garments and warm padding.

30757b2fcfeee24eacb2a021de697da2.name: Drak Stone Totem I
30757b2fcfeee24eacb2a021de697da2.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6738ff846c11ec48aef9c8a6ba33a199.name: Deerstalker Hood
6738ff846c11ec48aef9c8a6ba33a199.desc: The cloth straps attached to this mask glide softly in the breeze, helping to discern wind direction and speed.

097ceaee661a074c8a3a3cf83c2de899.name: Pure Amethyst
097ceaee661a074c8a3a3cf83c2de899.desc:
This electrifying purple palette has the same vibrancy as an untainted amethyst crystal.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

fcc37b0d888278489dd5f9ac0d095ce5.name: Swimfins
fcc37b0d888278489dd5f9ac0d095ce5.desc: Allow for faster swim sprints while submerged in water.

ad88fcc911ea1c499cd6427a28feeb0d.name: Wooden Door
ad88fcc911ea1c499cd6427a28feeb0d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f3407d41ea29bc439f1df4c069077780.name: Fish Tacos
f3407d41ea29bc439f1df4c069077780.desc: Crispy fish tacos filled with a hearty plantain rice.

ed397cdfdd1e1e4db245d6a36f3c4692.name: Ragged Boots
ed397cdfdd1e1e4db245d6a36f3c4692.desc: They can barely be called boots.

9d987adc6b9fab459beb88913591ed14.name: Bronze Fell Striker Trophy
9d987adc6b9fab459beb88913591ed14.desc:
Standing far away didn't save you in the fight. Now you don't have to worry about the distance between you; you can admire the bronze-glazed head from up close.

Collect multiple Fell Striker Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

0181455a6072f4458dc56816bc9aedf4.name: Collection Of Books III
0181455a6072f4458dc56816bc9aedf4.desc: What is better than one book?

f754fe59bfd99140ba47a5ad6d15a7d5.name: Fossil Showcase (2 Medium Slots)
f754fe59bfd99140ba47a5ad6d15a7d5.desc: This is a showcase for Fossil Collection Items usually found in quarries, material veins, or dig sites.

134f05e935b85344b12afd6a7b7ba9b8.name: Dragon Sword
134f05e935b85344b12afd6a7b7ba9b8.desc: A mythical blade from long gone days. Legends say that it was passed on to Embervale by a wise spirit who descended from the stars in the year of the dragon.

8b0a5ee78fb7554bb3b6c6cb6f22c915.name: Poisoned Celestium Arrow
8b0a5ee78fb7554bb3b6c6cb6f22c915.desc:
A Celestium Special Arrow dipped in poison.

Poisoned Arrow: Enemies hit by this arrow are poisoned and additionally receive 30 damage per second for 5 seconds.

127493a137f0e34b966cd0707c7053d3.name: Bonescourge Mace
127493a137f0e34b966cd0707c7053d3.desc:
This mace is the bane and banisher of all undead creatures.

Hollow Echo:
The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.

353cd233e2f2c9438a3778374d21c072.name: Flightless Redtail
353cd233e2f2c9438a3778374d21c072.desc: A Flightless Redtail with colorful feathers and a strong, regal beak. You can keep it in captivity indefinitely for eggs, and it can't even fly away.

13307841e3197d45890ab87d663b4cbe.name: Ranger Gloves
13307841e3197d45890ab87d663b4cbe.desc: Simple gloves made from ethically sourced organic leather.

d865575c1711d7458e690063241c08e3.name: Guillotine
d865575c1711d7458e690063241c08e3.desc: Heads plummet to the ground, eyes shut in terror. Victims prefer darkness rather than to face the Guillotine.

3a90dad0293a404f8d81ecfec4b1e01f.name: Corrupted Boar Tusk
3a90dad0293a404f8d81ecfec4b1e01f.desc:
A jagged tusk that's been tainted by the Shroud. Pulsing with faint traces of toxic energy.

Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

e77ba9ac7f97e64c898210737b973ca2.name: Veilwater Basin Rubble
e77ba9ac7f97e64c898210737b973ca2.desc: A mix of different biome-specific materials, mainly stone and dirt.

7adc64e21756d549b4d43355c64cf2cd.name: Small Hollow's Eve Pumpkin II
7adc64e21756d549b4d43355c64cf2cd.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

3f176126178f49489423e05048c43790.desc: This icebox will keep your ice cold indefinitely.

e908efa38df0274fa250e42a46d0f8e4.name: Eternal Voltaic Arrow III
e908efa38df0274fa250e42a46d0f8e4.desc:
An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's charged with electricity.

Eternal Arrow: Does not deplete Ammo per use. Equip the Eternal Arrow and use Mana to shoot it with a Bow.

0c503f88c6fd604bb0872557759b9510.name: Flame Arcanist Pants
0c503f88c6fd604bb0872557759b9510.desc: An assortment of dark layers that protect the wearer's legs from becoming singed, scorched, or incinerated when conjuring fire magic.

179255dc8243e144b13287f13c48a03a.name: Tidecaller Shoes
179255dc8243e144b13287f13c48a03a.desc: Stride forth in these shoes, as swiftly as your mana regenerates.

372ad65415407541a4cfda8ac2ba2028.name: Pillar Of Flames I
372ad65415407541a4cfda8ac2ba2028.desc:
Ignites an area with flames that continuously damage enemies within.
It also applies a burn debuff to them.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

542a730a6fa0ec49a8fd129b1e14017c.name: Captain Whiskers
542a730a6fa0ec49a8fd129b1e14017c.desc:
This cat is as dark as the midnight sky and its charming demands for attention never go unanswered. It purrs loudly whenever you are near! 

The Scavengers that kept this cat were unsure whether to call it "Captain" or "Whiskers".

8a189a3a4d86504784fa5d40778aff69.name: Ice Bolt I
8a189a3a4d86504784fa5d40778aff69.desc:
Conjures an icy projectile that deals damage to a single target and applies a slow debuff to it.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

510426bbac748247919d5e59dedbe1b0.name: Exclusive Hollow Helmet
510426bbac748247919d5e59dedbe1b0.desc: Vibrant amethyst-colored plumes adorn this helmet, indicating that the previous wearer might have been a royal commander.

fe6f5224c345f746a549d9507b599986.name: Ranger Hood
fe6f5224c345f746a549d9507b599986.desc: A hood that provides additional protection from the sun, allowing you to focus your gaze undisturbed.

416e539d8b57f947a09f633742e3ca0e.name: Dagger Wall Mount
416e539d8b57f947a09f633742e3ca0e.desc: A display to showcase weapons or shields.

31d660e92febc04face2a6183175f617.name: Pearls
31d660e92febc04face2a6183175f617.desc: Small orbs that grow inside shellfish, valued for their raw beauty.

31d6f2cc695e924ca88c65929e1634f2.name: Sun Hammer
31d6f2cc695e924ca88c65929e1634f2.desc: The sun won't drown in the darkness of night. It will rise again.

aa6c6ca278ce934f9f37e5b5da7b65af.name: Light Blonde Hair
aa6c6ca278ce934f9f37e5b5da7b65af.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

f3c4b8e19023c0448da0e5205e3da00a.name: Vukah Brawler Head
f3c4b8e19023c0448da0e5205e3da00a.desc: The tusks remain dangerous since they don't dull after death. Never stumble!

af961fc185d06b41b0a9711428419b52.name: The Horde Unleashed
af961fc185d06b41b0a9711428419b52.desc:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"The Shroud, a ruinous fog which sought only to spread and devour."

It's a terrifying sight... but packed tightly against the light of the morning sun. I wanted to show that there is still hope... somewhere out there. - J

938bbb9959994f478d9c64c10cb1973d.name: Sulfur
938bbb9959994f478d9c64c10cb1973d.desc:
An important material and basic chemical ingredient found in nature. It can be used to make bright orange and red dyes.

Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

e3aea10cfd11114a9abde61603aa25ad.name: Fake Stair Passage
e3aea10cfd11114a9abde61603aa25ad.desc: Fool others looking for hidden passages in your base with this fake secret door.

35df9078d764cd41aa4479379e4c7727.name: Stone Shingle Roof Block
35df9078d764cd41aa4479379e4c7727.desc:
A natural way to decorate a roof.

Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

d368055c8b21e9488392ab52d5e04582.name: Radiant Paladin Gloves
d368055c8b21e9488392ab52d5e04582.desc: These gloves radiate warmth and safety as if they were forged in pure liquid light.

59b9fe9431d0504bbced51ebb2726c40.name: Mirage
59b9fe9431d0504bbced51ebb2726c40.desc:
All hope is fickle, a mirage on the horizon. This staff makes its bearer reject all convictions to walk into the abyss.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

201f9108b6839e49add4a0019056d975.name: Ripped Alchemist's Wall Hanging
201f9108b6839e49add4a0019056d975.desc: A ripped piece of fabric, detailing alchemical wisdom. Someone might be able to decipher it if you had the other half!

2524181e9fa8934ebb17489b11ff9d29.name: Mother-Of-Pearl
2524181e9fa8934ebb17489b11ff9d29.desc: The natural iridescent material that pearls are made of, it can be found lining the inside of certain shells and valued for its luminous shimmer.

94ca572b20a78644862134de0458e67e.name: Throne Room Wall Lamp
94ca572b20a78644862134de0458e67e.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

09a3f0cd84df0b449d3f26ea0425c550.name: Iron Crypt Wall Torch
09a3f0cd84df0b449d3f26ea0425c550.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

a583b2c169cd9042b3ef55e253f18bbc.name: Large Iron Window Frame
a583b2c169cd9042b3ef55e253f18bbc.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

91baa4ca06cf434ebfa94fe511aa5c16.name: Large Round Wooden Window Frame
91baa4ca06cf434ebfa94fe511aa5c16.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c8368c779e190f489bbce2b33fb3d01e.name: Cat Food Bait
c8368c779e190f489bbce2b33fb3d01e.desc:
Food for attracting and taming a Cat.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.

149a8c94d404084e934de4b0c960d802.name: Sharpshooter Gloves
149a8c94d404084e934de4b0c960d802.desc: These improved archery gloves make it easier to shoot birds straight out of the sky! There are hardly any birds these days, though.

243b41ca2fe26d40869a6b50513ba3a7.name: Fell Defender Shield
243b41ca2fe26d40869a6b50513ba3a7.desc:
A battered metal shield that allows you to block and parry physical attacks. Young squires tend to place all their hope in these... until the metal starts to bend and give.

Parry
You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar.
Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

e62b61cc8bc48040aee8bce462d6257c.name: Small Crypt Table
e62b61cc8bc48040aee8bce462d6257c.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

ba542dffc4a7cc4aa700afce50e6d84d.name: Saffron Plant
ba542dffc4a7cc4aa700afce50e6d84d.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

e351ee978c480b479374fe3940731f3e.name: Large Magic Chest
e351ee978c480b479374fe3940731f3e.desc:
A larger storage opportunity for bulk items.

The items stored here can be used for crafting purposes from anywhere in the base!

38e6b264e65f1f478fc97cb939ccb876.name: Shadowbloom Wrap
38e6b264e65f1f478fc97cb939ccb876.desc: This wrap is a good alternative to the more commonly seen meat wrap. It still increases your health, and additionally, the shadowbloom stocks are very filling and extend your Time in the Shroud.

f42c3bfc87f3454399afb44890d8255e.name: Vukah Nesting Material
f42c3bfc87f3454399afb44890d8255e.desc: A complicated and interwoven nesting material, used for building extravagant tree houses.

1f4ec6cf203ff647a09f830bc8a03ead.name: Flat Bread
1f4ec6cf203ff647a09f830bc8a03ead.desc: A simple meal, granting a lasting Melee Damage boost upon consumption. It tastes better in combination with other things, though.

e84ae6c99cc8dc40842ecba3182c7343.name: Prison Fence Pole
e84ae6c99cc8dc40842ecba3182c7343.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

69efe13b58430f4ea13effe3f829d09f.name: Trap Fireball
69efe13b58430f4ea13effe3f829d09f.desc:
A Trap Fireball which can be used as spell ammunition.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

9baebc0440c4c54f854e8f2335cd0bdc.name: Giant Bone Arrow II
9baebc0440c4c54f854e8f2335cd0bdc.desc:
An arrow made from bone.

The force of this arrow allows it to pierce hit targets to harm multiple foes.

3394348070bb36419efa2ba2eb1eb3b8.name: Rogue Shield
3394348070bb36419efa2ba2eb1eb3b8.desc: A light shield that effortlessly allows the wearer to stay nimble whilst under fire.

959b8dc2b2fef648897d966600e6cae0.name: Ceiling Lantern
959b8dc2b2fef648897d966600e6cae0.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

09653c8312d7674aa4a597ac7f3c9037.name: Trapdoor Stone 2m
09653c8312d7674aa4a597ac7f3c9037.desc: This trap door might open unexpectedly beneath your feet. Watch your step!

2e931ae880331041b5ea71f6dc5ff798.name: Small Backpack
2e931ae880331041b5ea71f6dc5ff798.desc:
An extension to your backpack that enlarges your inventory by one row. 

Outdated
This item is of an old design. Visit your craftsmen to find an improved version of the backpack with an additional row.

aad1ccd558ef2944a06c5281653c0870.name: Simple Wood Support
aad1ccd558ef2944a06c5281653c0870.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

99427252a7670b45aa8a0442534cd511.name: Large Bamboo Crate
99427252a7670b45aa8a0442534cd511.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

7da352394ae8e34591ebaa51dd090e07.name: Book I
7da352394ae8e34591ebaa51dd090e07.desc: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.

b574aea652bb964cbeaecd40c8b01d8b.name: Crestflame boots
b574aea652bb964cbeaecd40c8b01d8b.desc: Tall boots that are held by leather straps on the inside, and carry a thick layer of additional sheeting towards the outside. They end in kneegards which press upwards further in a radial shape.

b85c65fd6fba50419c6886a9e4fdbe85.name: Dragonsbane
b85c65fd6fba50419c6886a9e4fdbe85.desc:
An axe found atop the skull of a giant dragon skeleton. Legends say it was used to slay the mother dragon, but it wasn't lodged inside her cranium when you found it. 

That's probably for the best. Mothers have enough headaches already.

766e5bda50a2dc4fb82ea6fb556a2ca6.name: Fae Deer Farmer Shirt
766e5bda50a2dc4fb82ea6fb556a2ca6.desc: A short-sleeved linen shirt that's topped with an orange fur cape. The cape flows down the wearer's back and ends in pieces that wave in the wind like a tail.

d92b621d7081b141822ed3984b386d95.name: Bronze Sword
d92b621d7081b141822ed3984b386d95.desc: A light and swift sword of beautiful color. It dulls quickly, though.

b6d0b21808ac1c478a8f763c49b71e40.name: Quetzal Hunter Chest
b6d0b21808ac1c478a8f763c49b71e40.desc: As Quetzals no longer roam Embervale, dyed palm leaves are used in place of their feathers to recreate the look.

56fb23c796b20044ba657c95d110eefa.name: Snakespine Wand
56fb23c796b20044ba657c95d110eefa.desc:
A mythical wand formed around a winding vertebrae core. It strikes with deadly precision.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

285a87e73889634e93349180364c625e.name: Flame Mosaic Piece III
285a87e73889634e93349180364c625e.desc:
A small part of a shattered Flame mosaic. Perhaps you can piece it together if you find all the shards!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. The full collection includes 8 pieces. They can be reassembled into a mosaic inside a Flame Mosaic Frame. The Frame must be placed on the ground.

74be73eb3507d74bb7a5b16579eb5fb0.name: Spiced Tea
74be73eb3507d74bb7a5b16579eb5fb0.desc: Hot and spicy! Surprisingly refreshing and cooling even in the heat.

74be9bf405432c47be9da1b51cf77e89.name: Jezmina's Apotheosis
74be9bf405432c47be9da1b51cf77e89.desc: An axe that carves a path through enemies, no matter what. Swinging it fearlessly makes it feel light as a feather.

c6d191c2e5ecfe4ca52bea6459056be6.name: Guardian Shield
c6d191c2e5ecfe4ca52bea6459056be6.desc: It's more than a shield — it's a bulwark of faith, a final sanctuary in the fray.

64c5d046c7819b40a5021bb0cc0f3965.name: Phoenix Bow
64c5d046c7819b40a5021bb0cc0f3965.desc: An asymmetrical bow that's headed by a golden phoenix. The drawstring is reinforced with yellow diamonds that reflect the light with every little movement.

7c2716d6484c1147a2c41afb53dbaf2a.name: Stone Sink
7c2716d6484c1147a2c41afb53dbaf2a.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

f71e8de881fb9d4b9587bcccd663c5cc.name: Brazen Bull Trousers
f71e8de881fb9d4b9587bcccd663c5cc.desc: These leg guards protect the wearer's sides from incoming strikes.

b6b181bd984047459db3d7ccc23ec79d.name: Spearfisher Bow
b6b181bd984047459db3d7ccc23ec79d.desc: Whether used to shoot birds from the sky or fish in the water, this bow is precise and vicious. It's definitely more stylish than a fishing rod, though it's less effective for the same purpose... perhaps its venom would be better used on other wildlife instead.

fbf1580fe4830f45ba726712c00445a4.name: Robotic Arm
fbf1580fe4830f45ba726712c00445a4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ebf8b581ff1e634e80ccd546c24149b5.name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Gloves
ebf8b581ff1e634e80ccd546c24149b5.desc: These black and gold gloves once carried the knowledge and secrets of the humans. Don't be intimidated by the power they literally once held.

00b2f51a37e6da4b8720fc2eb4c5a603.name: Hophare Food
00b2f51a37e6da4b8720fc2eb4c5a603.desc:
Nutritious Hophare food for tame animals on your farm.

It must be placed inside the appropriate feeder.

4063bd356550334bacf9a1fba905ce4b.name: Trapdoor Wood 4m
4063bd356550334bacf9a1fba905ce4b.desc: This trap door might open unexpectedly beneath your feet. Watch your step!

160e33ccf2f6634eafa861400fc377dc.name: Hand Drum
160e33ccf2f6634eafa861400fc377dc.desc: A simple percussion instrument used to play music. The little chimes add a nice flair to any song.

79d7ee155e950742b974a2825ab8e469.name: Standing Banner of the Ancients I
79d7ee155e950742b974a2825ab8e469.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d4b33e6bfc49b14a8ab32fe5851292e3.name: Pearl
d4b33e6bfc49b14a8ab32fe5851292e3.desc: A gorgeous pearl. The magnetic pull of its lustrious shine is only enhanced by its rarity.

cacfd5d23e0f3148b4204a5db13e71b0.name: Mystic Boots
cacfd5d23e0f3148b4204a5db13e71b0.desc: Elegant boots with blue accents. They exude glamour and grace.

cacf1f270d921e4581ddadb5d07479b0.name: Ectoplasm Fragment
cacf1f270d921e4581ddadb5d07479b0.desc: A small amount of frozen or crystallized ectoplasm. It contains a tiny bit of life energy.

fad63ca32f402e41b16891b291965dd5.name: Jezmina's Apotheosis
