fad63ca32f402e41b16891b291965dd5.desc: An axe that carves a path through enemies, no matter what. Swinging it fearlessly makes it feel light as a feather.

66314b2e6049b148ad1ff3bb9d0d981a.name: Iron Pickaxe
66314b2e6049b148ad1ff3bb9d0d981a.desc: A highly performant pickaxe made out of iron, useful in every environment. A truly handy tool to have.

121f695aa769534dafc0ac2cff44043b.name: Fluffy Mittens
121f695aa769534dafc0ac2cff44043b.desc: These gloves were patched together with two different fabrics. They re-create the look of "hooves".

206564137de5e942ae2f65d3eea2e38e.name: Omen Gloves
206564137de5e942ae2f65d3eea2e38e.desc: Gloves made from rotting, undead matter. They claw at their wearer's upper arms as if to grow upwards.

62a7e64d0bb8564695e45683c068ffd9.name: Chanterelle
62a7e64d0bb8564695e45683c068ffd9.desc: It tastes incredibly bitter when raw, but develops a zesty aroma while cooked.

dd5a030ca9c352488e7bfddd28bf7578.name: Steep ramp 2m
dd5a030ca9c352488e7bfddd28bf7578.desc: This tool can only be used inside the building area around a Flame Altar. It can help you to quickly build your desired base with pre-defined structures.

bccf5c500d44634da3d6d689d3d55e78.name: Oswald Anders
bccf5c500d44634da3d6d689d3d55e78.desc: The Blacksmith Oswald Anders crafts and upgrades armors and weapons.

ee665cc56f29324dbcc237d6b81a4099.desc:
An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

d8109b3e4528524698fdacee7ca85891.name: Spiked Greatsword
d8109b3e4528524698fdacee7ca85891.desc: Every rose has thorns — and sometimes, nature can serve as inspiration for weaponry and design!

b5f8cb9e01c89a47adda5c49ccbf8630.name: Wolf's Fang Trousers
b5f8cb9e01c89a47adda5c49ccbf8630.desc: A pair of pants with leather greaves. They don't rustle while moving and muffle every little sound while sneaking around.

cc12476240f5c2468100fa7bb9cb351f.name: Skull Stalker Chest
cc12476240f5c2468100fa7bb9cb351f.desc: You feel calm and guarded in this upper body armor — consider your next move carefully.

4b428b3711a9414484ced46fec6b5b97.name: Ice-Coated Daggers
4b428b3711a9414484ced46fec6b5b97.desc:
The tip of these daggers has become permanently frosted after piercing the ice-cold heart of a Cyclops. Either that or someone tried their hand at spearfishing and left their blades in the freezing waters too long.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

6dee4ecdefe2e84ab2efaa67cc98cb98.name: Decay Tool
6dee4ecdefe2e84ab2efaa67cc98cb98.desc:
A magical tool capable of adding and removing signs of decay to walls in your base. 

It can only be used within Flame Altar range.

1d87a0adc594be448c1d988ae2aef219.name: Dried Fur
1d87a0adc594be448c1d988ae2aef219.desc: After drying the Animal Fur on the Drying Rack, it becomes sturdier and more durable for a longer period of time.

29379de3281223499b37893873d3106f.name: Explosive Arrow I
29379de3281223499b37893873d3106f.desc: A Special Arrow that delivers an explosive surprise.

4569977a46036142a95732fc94b5cf54.name: Grapple Plant Flower
4569977a46036142a95732fc94b5cf54.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

66f3daa0adb899419a8f0ff91b86d863.name: Deadeye Gloves
66f3daa0adb899419a8f0ff91b86d863.desc: Your shots will always find their mark with these gloves.

e890ada2ca474d4593bc97988093d539.name: Rustic Side Table
e890ada2ca474d4593bc97988093d539.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

3459dfa1cd161f43a27280a93c55a026.name: Steel Standing Lamp
3459dfa1cd161f43a27280a93c55a026.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

22b84e57a493c74aae1e0406f3011e58.name: Sword Of The Serpent
22b84e57a493c74aae1e0406f3011e58.desc: A glistening green blade, perfectly representing the aesthetics of the year of the serpent.

6bada60df5fa0248984c255ff92be275.name: Forked Tongue
6bada60df5fa0248984c255ff92be275.desc:
A heavy blade that's split alongside the central ridge. Caution is advised, as some believe it to be a forked-tongued omen that taints the wielder's heart with lies.
Yet, their caution spells weakness, and their words drip with envy... They would wield it if they could. Why shouldn't you?

Shroud Imbued: 
This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.

744245c72933004f97d73ab518d8fa21.name: Pinewood Room Divider III
744245c72933004f97d73ab518d8fa21.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

8fedf467152e4e44afc2a3b0cd276c5a.name: Tank Chestplate
8fedf467152e4e44afc2a3b0cd276c5a.desc: The improved copper coating of this Tank Chestplate can withstand many more blows at the frontlines of battle.

51af2df27f5b7949bdff8a499adc6445.name: Winterly Hat
51af2df27f5b7949bdff8a499adc6445.desc: A hat that looks like it protects your precious ears from the cold. It's just cosmetic, though.

2c0f63b34f5c904abc93d9aea8dd1399.name: Waveborne Ritualist Pants
2c0f63b34f5c904abc93d9aea8dd1399.desc: With their simplicity, these pants bring balance to the outfit and allow the wearer’s presence to shine.

1b06eaa8b67a654086873ca3af2fdbb8.name: Wax Torch
1b06eaa8b67a654086873ca3af2fdbb8.desc: A very durable and long-lasting source of light made from wax. Equip this before starting your expeditions into the unknown!

c83e874a551dcb4aa40c4dab3a80d345.name: Drak Temple Vase I
c83e874a551dcb4aa40c4dab3a80d345.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

7283f61227cbc0479fe5cbe15b9e8569.name: Draped In Envy
7283f61227cbc0479fe5cbe15b9e8569.desc:
The muted gray and silvery sheen cannot hide the underlying seething emerald-green envy.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.

864f2d51293b0041afad6bf2c684f7fc.name: Small Hollow's Eve Pumpkin III
864f2d51293b0041afad6bf2c684f7fc.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

3605f29183444946942e5248a81e7e8c.name: Tanning Station
3605f29183444946942e5248a81e7e8c.desc: This workplace will enable the Hunter to mass produce leather.

b8a2b05ee6b00b4bb7c98c4642bf6f67.name: Ancient Road Block
b8a2b05ee6b00b4bb7c98c4642bf6f67.desc: A unique building block for roads. It creates paths with harmonious circle patterns.

5fc12af85538fa4aaa96e57b65d0f22a.name: Bronze Vorgoth's Eye Trophy
5fc12af85538fa4aaa96e57b65d0f22a.desc:
Bronze seeps into the newly formed flesh, binding eyelid and tendrils into a unified shell.

Collect multiple Vorgoth Eyes to craft the Bronze Trophy.

ce572230f617ab40a182e86f2c35beac.name: Tricorn
ce572230f617ab40a182e86f2c35beac.desc: A distinguished hat with a folded-up brim. The front has been embellished with a small metal detail.

19d4e2b59b3e3347a1b0898dbb719978.name: Golden Vase Of The Ancients II
19d4e2b59b3e3347a1b0898dbb719978.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4c56e1df3fb87c4e93453f38f50fb1e6.name: Obsidian Arrow
4c56e1df3fb87c4e93453f38f50fb1e6.desc: An arrow tipped with a sharp shard of Obsidian.

6c533bddc35cc44ca3703191b1952c7a.name: Palm Wood Chair
6c533bddc35cc44ca3703191b1952c7a.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

8630f87f4f1cb14b8d7d9c0e426fbd6b.name: Hannah Reed
8630f87f4f1cb14b8d7d9c0e426fbd6b.desc: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

ac3b67f38b65df4db3ea0ae190a252ca.name: Pikemead's Bulwark
ac3b67f38b65df4db3ea0ae190a252ca.desc:
Even in death, the Queen unites those who seek protection behind her shield. 

Parry
You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar.
Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

8a8535194f06de499b4d81e4a0981208.name: Gleam Root
8a8535194f06de499b4d81e4a0981208.desc:
An underwater plant that only grows where the moonlight coats the sea floor. It has an enticing glow that spells demise for any diver willing to forget themselves in their pursuit of the light in the deep.

It can be found beneath the water in the Veilwater Basin.

5eb97172fb657f42b173f2e9dbc2600f.name: Assassin Boots
5eb97172fb657f42b173f2e9dbc2600f.desc: Your steps will be quick and quiet, and your strikes will be deadly.

9272c5fffc978247b688ce21548ce07e.name: Seared Fish Cutlet
9272c5fffc978247b688ce21548ce07e.desc: A seared fish cutlet that can only be prepared so well in a fish grilling cage. It is very flavorful.

fcb47a87298a8c4184f9d535442a0fe8.name: Low Elegant Armchair
fcb47a87298a8c4184f9d535442a0fe8.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d182b1c8cad53640a16c16563842db8c.name: Transcendental Ward
d182b1c8cad53640a16c16563842db8c.desc: A bright magic shield that conjures protection from the aether when used.

77c406ce4f1ce14d8fb29e19c3c94c0d.name: Plaguebringer Hood
77c406ce4f1ce14d8fb29e19c3c94c0d.desc:
Putrescence laps against the side of this brown hood, like a wave of pestilence crashing to shore.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

084a502c9321cd4f8ce0b37f8a70ccdc.name: Specklefin
084a502c9321cd4f8ce0b37f8a70ccdc.desc:
Its spotted skin secretes a numbing poison. The pattern is a warning, not a decoration.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

b2425a7c8a19d44aa77da30f626ad179.name: Mesosiderite
b2425a7c8a19d44aa77da30f626ad179.desc: The mesosiderite consists of a rough mix of metal and stone. They likely resulted from a crash between two asteroids.

8e6896594c702b4bb95d9cf728080f16.name: Large Crypt Cupboard
8e6896594c702b4bb95d9cf728080f16.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c5a1d96ab7bd77498766cb870f9d9852.name: Ranger Boots
c5a1d96ab7bd77498766cb870f9d9852.desc: These boots were made for those wishing to lurk quietly through the thicket.

ce194e61d05b414199a6ab11e91d3524.name: Greatsword Of Rivalry
ce194e61d05b414199a6ab11e91d3524.desc: Face your enemy, one on one, and prove your domination once and for all.

80919c25732e9940a3ebae7fe2b0dece.name: Decorative Bells III
80919c25732e9940a3ebae7fe2b0dece.desc: Decorative bells are especially suitable for the yearfall.

fa1cba532c6db444b4468c78fcf323c8.name: Half-timbered Shell Limestone Block
fa1cba532c6db444b4468c78fcf323c8.desc: The exposed wooden beams create a beautiful contrast to the rough surface, creating a feeling of warmth.

86f211980cf0a645bbdc71dd2d9fa169.name: Artificer's Boots
86f211980cf0a645bbdc71dd2d9fa169.desc: A pair of heavy-duty, gilded boots. Even sharp machinery pieces or rotating gears could not scrape them.

24e67ed9d697ef40b2125bf6c46ef89c.name: Mace of Wrath
24e67ed9d697ef40b2125bf6c46ef89c.desc: In the bygone days, young men would carry maces like these to thrash and toil amongst one another like a dark, thundering storm. It helped to release anger and weed out the weak.

52e9f040db225045b30d4abf1a8488c4.name: Fell Cyclops Trophy
52e9f040db225045b30d4abf1a8488c4.desc: A giant trophy, weighing countless pounds. Mounting this on the wall is no easy task.

dda0b40e48a9234f97ecb25649669d3f.name: Sage Tunic
dda0b40e48a9234f97ecb25649669d3f.desc: An illustrious garb that almost shines brighter than the wearer's spirit.

0c6007b46924c24d9ad0380a1f345b47.name: Magnificent Granite Stone Chair
0c6007b46924c24d9ad0380a1f345b47.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f97f2b8cb352034b8e33df22d3e40c90.name: Twigs
f97f2b8cb352034b8e33df22d3e40c90.desc: A twig, as insignificant as it might seem, has a lot of potential. Everything starts somewhere...

7151dca78aa33b41bd00967f25d6482d.name: White Hair
7151dca78aa33b41bd00967f25d6482d.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

6841472382403844b1b1c49916731a0e.name: Granite Stone Shower
6841472382403844b1b1c49916731a0e.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

cedbabcc1b22ed4b9a011247157e7271.name: Collection Of Books I
cedbabcc1b22ed4b9a011247157e7271.desc: What is better than one book?

b69ab336ca71e74a95aca63d91d0685a.name: Artificer's Gloves
b69ab336ca71e74a95aca63d91d0685a.desc: Refined gloves that offer both protection and maneuverability for the fingers. Wearing them makes one feel as though they can work with utmost precision and concentration.

fd7e19b038bcb44f839cc5931380b2b8.name: Decorative Butter Churn
fd7e19b038bcb44f839cc5931380b2b8.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

a5f065771be2144387350a3edcd66c2f.name: Cyclops Head
a5f065771be2144387350a3edcd66c2f.desc:
The severed head of a fearsome cyclops. It looks down on you with disdain.

Collect multiple Cyclops Heads to craft the Trophy.

72e82e05cce8ec4886afd46c823eb7cd.name: Large Bloomheart Fruit Plant Pot I
72e82e05cce8ec4886afd46c823eb7cd.desc: An ancient potted plant. This one can be displayed in the Cultivation Rack.

7becfc405bc53d45b5b6cefd042ddf77.name: Blue Luminescent Block
7becfc405bc53d45b5b6cefd042ddf77.desc:
A block crafted from Luminous Growth material that glows in the dark.

Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.

8e0b09fc4bf8c747ac16056b1b5c93b4.name: Glimmer Gentian Plant
8e0b09fc4bf8c747ac16056b1b5c93b4.desc: A large potted plant to beautify your home.

0d7f9acc98d39c44bacaddc4574504ac.name: Vorgoth's Soulbound Chest
0d7f9acc98d39c44bacaddc4574504ac.desc: Squint and you might see a heart etched into the plate. More heart than Vorgoth himself has shown in years. His real one drowned in Elixir.

fe60a5f0f22b8b47a2b6e8afe46f27eb.name: Blackmire Temple Door
fe60a5f0f22b8b47a2b6e8afe46f27eb.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c01bf68fecaa3f48b60cf7a6530845bb.name: Farmer Garb
c01bf68fecaa3f48b60cf7a6530845bb.desc: Faintly smells of grain, sweet summer days, and honey.

81aa98e00a1ccb43b16ba467906b9edf.name: Fell Monstrosity Head
81aa98e00a1ccb43b16ba467906b9edf.desc: Despair, hatred, loneliness... it grasps at anything to fill the void and leaves nothing but dust.

3bb9db2bcb17674e949ea52adab8744f.name: Sandstone Fence
3bb9db2bcb17674e949ea52adab8744f.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

5331dc2261a9304d937504d4ebd7bd60.name: Wolf's Hydra
5331dc2261a9304d937504d4ebd7bd60.desc: A heavy club adorned with multiple wolf heads near the handle.

adfd226a367c754baae2fdafc04d5028.name: Bonestorm IV
adfd226a367c754baae2fdafc04d5028.desc:
Conjures a flurry homing bone projectiles that hunt down enemies with crushing force.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

007cb4aeb5906a41904b97ae803342b6.name: Rogue Helmet
007cb4aeb5906a41904b97ae803342b6.desc: A sturdy helmet that protects the wearer from slashes, cuts, and scars.

5bd043a81b23164495f79474b23ec2de.name: Tank Helmet
5bd043a81b23164495f79474b23ec2de.desc: A copper helmet that keeps your skull from harm while you protect your allies.

364b7112c751f04897017919b86b299c.name: Shell Limestone Block
364b7112c751f04897017919b86b299c.desc: This stone block is commonly used in Veilwater Basin.

aca0057ebb8c5b4991191d54473f7726.name: Blue Wall Banner I
aca0057ebb8c5b4991191d54473f7726.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

5c9b5430c1a1db4283558153667635fb.name: Trailblazer Chest
5c9b5430c1a1db4283558153667635fb.desc: This armor piece was made from a combination of soft materials and hard, scale-like plating to ensure the ultimate flow of movement and protection. It has small hunting trophies attached to various spaces.

582a7e9e9942e844a346c454c241270e.name: Hunter's Bow
582a7e9e9942e844a346c454c241270e.desc: A finely handcrafted bow, used by seasoned woodland hunters.

5e1ee0091d76bd40bf37e099c88a47de.name: Big Elegant Sofa
5e1ee0091d76bd40bf37e099c88a47de.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

dd43497a094969429aba33b79375fcf7.name: Supply Sacks V
dd43497a094969429aba33b79375fcf7.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

3fca3796c6208044950168142fb4837d.name: Greater Golden Twinflame Sword
3fca3796c6208044950168142fb4837d.desc: An elaborate sword, decorated in gold filigree. It came from the skies as a shooting star years ago, and fell into the gaping maw of a cave.

2abdff384bd1be4ea8ff82bbe084dfaf.name: Gravedigger Pants
2abdff384bd1be4ea8ff82bbe084dfaf.desc: There's some extra space in the pockets perfect for storing crypt keys, "borrowed" rings, and lost fingerbones.

6e9bbd82ef300848aff6078117f1fc95.name: Ancient Health Potion +
6e9bbd82ef300848aff6078117f1fc95.desc: Instantly restores health massively, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.

7d10969869e62b4ba0bf48f942633acc.name: Tidecaller Gloves
7d10969869e62b4ba0bf48f942633acc.desc: They don't offer much protection, but enhance your magical abilities. The minimalist design also prevents you from getting sweaty hands.

e70fb1b447232c44a4910da151ef81ff.name: Dune Armadillo Feeder
e70fb1b447232c44a4910da151ef81ff.desc:
A feeding device that holds Dune Armadillo food.

It will feed your animals when filled with the corresponding food.

e70f11dea0f53d41b582959ac71c2adc.name: Fern
e70f11dea0f53d41b582959ac71c2adc.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

978c6707aae1db49bca37b3edc38ef1a.name: Vanguard Trousers
978c6707aae1db49bca37b3edc38ef1a.desc: Comfortable pants fashioned from crimson cloth. Being both durable and imposing, they can be worn for parades as well as war.

ccfbd2e7de9cc24a984ad9fd69f556dd.name: Wailing Blade
ccfbd2e7de9cc24a984ad9fd69f556dd.desc: An expertly crafted blade, balanced and sharp. Cuts through foes like a wail through the night. It bears the mark of a famous blacksmith from Pikemead's Reach.

6271e1971fbafb47a2e8618a97d4c21d.name: Twin Soul Mace
6271e1971fbafb47a2e8618a97d4c21d.desc: A perfectly balanced mace, where each front mirrors the opposite side.

e0da31ca411c4946aaf9b3214d987e0b.name: Greater Golden Twinflame Sword
e0da31ca411c4946aaf9b3214d987e0b.desc: An elaborate sword, decorated in gold filigree. It came from the skies as a shooting star years ago, and fell into the gaping maw of a cave.

3a054369c1321847ae22e61427ddf54d.name: Wooden Chest
3a054369c1321847ae22e61427ddf54d.desc: This small chest offers increased storage space for items.

cbaca957908bc0459538afd8cf36f7ff.name: Sunpiercer Shield
cbaca957908bc0459538afd8cf36f7ff.desc: A well-crafted shield marked by a golden sun. Strong, reliable, and radiant — built to hold the line when all else falters.

ea33013da791664f8fc387ec03d6b807.name: Fine Copperblade Greatsword
ea33013da791664f8fc387ec03d6b807.desc: A blade forged from the pure, reflective copper commonly found in the Revelwood. While you can spy a hint of patina across its body, there's no noticeable discoloration.

069f69714242c042a5b7cb22e54667af.name: Bonemeal
069f69714242c042a5b7cb22e54667af.desc: Useful for alchemical and magical purposes.

054a3ac4c3f5eb498e8f6cf2b991f917.name: Rough Sandstone Block
054a3ac4c3f5eb498e8f6cf2b991f917.desc: A rougher version of the Refined Sandstone Block, mainly produced for quantity. Due to its outer appearance it was mainly used for foundations.

26d6a2eb745b6e46b198ab6308e304a4.name: Spellbreaker Gloves
26d6a2eb745b6e46b198ab6308e304a4.desc: With these gloves, all the magic of the world can easily flow into the tips of your fingers to guide your sword arm properly.

eb650b84a683764391ffc549f403f981.name: Hailcaster Gloves
eb650b84a683764391ffc549f403f981.desc: Simple layered gloves that allow for optimal versatility and swiftness when spellcasting.

57ee369991b29e4f88a1bf79db24f155.name: Homage To Drak Slurp
57ee369991b29e4f88a1bf79db24f155.desc:
A bright green color palette, reminiscent of algae, shrubbery, and Drak cuisine.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

c5c8c1832344ac41b6b24a0284489379.name: Health Potion +
c5c8c1832344ac41b6b24a0284489379.desc: Instantly restores a small amount of health, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.

8fb7cb6aa57edc46b7febd5057198808.name: High Paling Fence III
8fb7cb6aa57edc46b7febd5057198808.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

425b181dc6a7944f86b828f03fd5158b.name: Large Ancient Prayer Beacon
425b181dc6a7944f86b828f03fd5158b.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

49737efedc651f4a917587f0e783e98e.name: Ramone Jones
49737efedc651f4a917587f0e783e98e.desc: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

07af5f62dbb3c24480b71059b4cb7eaf.name: Stonewrought Sword
07af5f62dbb3c24480b71059b4cb7eaf.desc: A once pristine weapon. Now decayed but still just as deadly.

c22a332f1800184995e9875d4cdd8e05.name: Mercenary Helmet
c22a332f1800184995e9875d4cdd8e05.desc: This sturdy Mercenary Helmet protects your eyes and hides your expression, making you appear fearless and intimidating.

947dda53c8087646980d9f02a7405866.name: Beet Seedling
947dda53c8087646980d9f02a7405866.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

f86cda067c953e4597275b519146b4b3.name: Wayfarer Pants
f86cda067c953e4597275b519146b4b3.desc: A sturdy pair of pants that will take you wherever your heart desires.

2de1f84056ca334c9deaf3b2a5672d76.name: Deerstalker Trousers
2de1f84056ca334c9deaf3b2a5672d76.desc: Warm and padded hunting pants that will retain your body heat during cold, starless nights.

e323224f30819b41911787f3cc822da5.name: Honey Beehive
e323224f30819b41911787f3cc822da5.desc: Anything can be domesticated with enough patience. Used to produce honey and wax.

b9703dd2f270ed4f978125ff11cd27de.name: Warlock Pants
b9703dd2f270ed4f978125ff11cd27de.desc: Historic pants, formerly the centerpiece of ceremonial warlock clothing.

3b1e2eec492b20418fb3a8b5ac1340bf.name: Sword Of The Serpent
3b1e2eec492b20418fb3a8b5ac1340bf.desc: A glistening green blade, perfectly representing the aesthetics of the year of the serpent.

5b3506961dbecf41a778fc286847f93b.name: Prismatic Ward
5b3506961dbecf41a778fc286847f93b.desc: A ward that refracts all incoming light. Some say it creates a colorful prismatic effect when the conditions are right.

c15d345324b95c469d4cf9c80674babd.name: Runes
c15d345324b95c469d4cf9c80674babd.desc:
Runes are mystical artifacts that attract and store magical energy from the environment. 

Craftspeople and their assistants can use runes to enhance your weapons, shields, armors and rings, which provides powerful bonuses and effects.

Salvage weapons, shields, armors and rings to recover runes, allowing you to reuse them and customize your arsenal.

a9d4fff64d2cce45b7389101153adfdf.name: Reaper's Wand
a9d4fff64d2cce45b7389101153adfdf.desc:
A twisted wand emitting a faint, blue light. It demands to be wielded!

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

bea67de36f623242846c80be26a5adfb.name: Nomad Highlands Dirt
bea67de36f623242846c80be26a5adfb.desc:
A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. 

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

6569b9c217ac6043b740a651e2006506.name: Sunpiercer Chestplate
6569b9c217ac6043b740a651e2006506.desc: The gleaming gold and vibrant green crystals adorning the chestplate make it a shield and a statement of enduring strength. Watch out for the spiked shoulder pads!

86db8f3c22758147a5b5169a24bf8688.name: Scrap Shield
86db8f3c22758147a5b5169a24bf8688.desc:
A crude shield made from the leftover metal scraps of the old world.

Parry
You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar.
Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

b82ea9d61be50a4688c083fe76145384.name: Ring of the Ether
b82ea9d61be50a4688c083fe76145384.desc: A strange ring that seems to hold an entire, nebulous world in the stone that adorns it.

d66d9b3325c4364899de3e1376d726e6.name: Rune Master's Sword
d66d9b3325c4364899de3e1376d726e6.desc: The inscription carved into this sword cannot be deciphered, since the archaic knowledge of rune matching has been lost to time. Whatever the writing entails, it makes the blade overflow with energy.

7ad5bc4d6fd15d448259291ede28f314.name: Venerable Hollow Gloves
7ad5bc4d6fd15d448259291ede28f314.desc: Heavy plated metal gloves, once worn by valiant soldiers.

a9b5402fa394b147967d6f86c51e3000.name: Grilled Silverback
a9b5402fa394b147967d6f86c51e3000.desc: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

0b448b99e252174896d796ca10b94ccb.name: Flame Mosaic Piece IV
0b448b99e252174896d796ca10b94ccb.desc:
A small part of a shattered Flame mosaic. Perhaps you can piece it together if you find all the shards!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. The full collection includes 8 pieces. They can be reassembled into a mosaic inside a Flame Mosaic Frame. The Frame must be placed on the ground.

f5caaa85be8c5440bff07c9f741402a5.name: Cooked Rice
f5caaa85be8c5440bff07c9f741402a5.desc: This cooked rice is delicious and vaguely aromatic. It will make for a good side dish.

dfce85bce80e8a44b4f8ce2c176fa715.name: Boreal Wood Garden Fence II
dfce85bce80e8a44b4f8ce2c176fa715.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

87405ef994149d4e8df4667c81eb2082.name: Raw Wool
87405ef994149d4e8df4667c81eb2082.desc: Raw wool. It's fluffy, easily knotted, and smells vaguely earthy. It needs to be processed further to be used for garments and armor.

f4c0d29a20993a41ac1b4fd731fdc5c4.name: Small Ancient Sideboard
f4c0d29a20993a41ac1b4fd731fdc5c4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

140f1d2ab741db43962a2b5186b2ffc1.name: Maritime Sink
140f1d2ab741db43962a2b5186b2ffc1.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

6cdf79230d78c140920e7f34772f37f0.name: Vegetable Soup
6cdf79230d78c140920e7f34772f37f0.desc: A warm soup made from various vegetables. Full of vitamins and energy.

5de9203f96a5ef4eb7931387a2b26ca8.name: Stormbound Staff
5de9203f96a5ef4eb7931387a2b26ca8.desc:
The staff's material is engraved with countless labyrinthine lines reminiscent of the chaotic flow of battle. However, a metal halo encircles the negative space within, preserving a sense of calm, as if one were inside the eye of a storm.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

8e13047160afc14a872385df35948178.name: Broken Hollow Halls Banner
8e13047160afc14a872385df35948178.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c2cde9da461dbb44acc33f0c88ba015f.name: Goalpost
c2cde9da461dbb44acc33f0c88ba015f.desc: A goalpost that can be activated via the Sparkworks system.

649724d4e1441d4983e6bbdb7e4f0f22.name: Simple Wooden Handrail
649724d4e1441d4983e6bbdb7e4f0f22.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

652bf36ced827d4cbc97a66e9c9706cf.name: Small Throne Room Brazier
652bf36ced827d4cbc97a66e9c9706cf.desc:
A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.

385baf4f850c104d84203fbd652d372c.name: Dragon Sword
385baf4f850c104d84203fbd652d372c.desc: A mythical blade from long gone days. Legends say that it was passed on to Embervale by a wise spirit who descended from the stars in the year of the dragon.

6a1ad61173e31144a8206cbc3485a866.name: Sugar Cane
6a1ad61173e31144a8206cbc3485a866.desc: A sweet candy alternative made from plant fiber. The sugar rush is known to regenerate stamina for a short amount of time.

84d285915bc6244286a311d81bb7f7cb.name: Cursed Mocking Shield
84d285915bc6244286a311d81bb7f7cb.desc: This shield is adorned with a skull that spouts bloodcurdling mockery and jeers at your foes whenever you block their attacks. However, should you lose the upper hand in battle, its ridicule may fall upon you, too.

e7367d329ac340428f04aa5208fe8ac4.name: Big Hollow's Eve Pumpkin III
e7367d329ac340428f04aa5208fe8ac4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

711b1d43b79896478c05993afa59fa6d.name: Baby Flightless Redtail
711b1d43b79896478c05993afa59fa6d.desc: A small, round Flightless Redtail baby. Even at this age, their beak can cause some damage. Don't get pecked!

7602556256169c45a489b18c1019e9c7.name: Kindlewastes Bone Key
7602556256169c45a489b18c1019e9c7.desc:
Opens doors in the Kindlewastes Hollow Halls.

Some chests in the Hollow Halls require Ectoplasm to be opened — collect enough on your descent! 
Also make sure to save some Ectoplasm for crafting Bone Keys.

16e044114006124481e67092c5db23eb.name: Siren Seeker Gloves
16e044114006124481e67092c5db23eb.desc: Small wonders hide amidst the seagrass of the shores, begging to be freed by nimble hands. What will you find betwixt the reeds today? A sharp edge made dull, a fallen star in the sand, a bottled siren's wish? The waves have a way of changing everything they claim, so be careful on your search!

a426ce2e66e2644e87cffbcdf60afe29.name: Drak Temple Vase VI
a426ce2e66e2644e87cffbcdf60afe29.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

9ed6967b742fbc42acdf34b1097aee97.name: Tomb Raider's Bow
9ed6967b742fbc42acdf34b1097aee97.desc:
A standard, carved bow that reminds you of forgotten temples and overgrown tombs. Makes you want to go exploring for hidden riches!

Grave robbing is bad, and you shouldn't do it while anyone is looking.

3e95c7378817884cb45a5c4ccc7406ee.name: Alchemist Apprentice Boots
3e95c7378817884cb45a5c4ccc7406ee.desc: Simple leather boots — a perfect fit.

bf6b5a53ad32bc49b99f2608634e4ff4.name: Sage Headwrap
bf6b5a53ad32bc49b99f2608634e4ff4.desc: You can't read sacred scrolls if you can't see, but true understanding comes from within, anyway.

08b7d1d1aa7dc64fa999e3894927f5c5.name: Fell Black Knight Greatsword
08b7d1d1aa7dc64fa999e3894927f5c5.desc: The weapon of choice for Lord Vorgoth's personal guard. Blue lines follow the blade's body, carving around its peaks and valleys like the north winds.

5a29e3b063868447b5c9f230322b6597.name: Jezmina's War Banner II
5a29e3b063868447b5c9f230322b6597.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

99b776e3b5698f40a475ed976cc28d7b.name: Almanac of Plants and Seedlings
99b776e3b5698f40a475ed976cc28d7b.desc: Explains how to grow all sorts of seedlings.

4f4f9cc840befb428407e20c91697ee3.name: Gem of Armoring
4f4f9cc840befb428407e20c91697ee3.desc: Killing an enemy spawns an orb at the enemy's location. Collecting the orb allows you to resist all damage for %k.

33ea87d4d5d97b4abadd1ee41eb2b80b.name: Hero's Shield
33ea87d4d5d97b4abadd1ee41eb2b80b.desc: A sturdy shield, graced by the visage of a bird.

01dfa54f27ae464690e4897cb6f08f52.name: Ranger Boots
01dfa54f27ae464690e4897cb6f08f52.desc: These boots were made for those wishing to lurk quietly through the thicket.

7cbbe9a1f54e584495be03bfd297273c.name: Vat Of The Ancients II
7cbbe9a1f54e584495be03bfd297273c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

dd2c77bf6fc65e4cb262551a4e815dc6.name: Meat Wrap
dd2c77bf6fc65e4cb262551a4e815dc6.desc: Filled with the power of life, this wrap will increase the Health of the consumer.

381dc161fc678241a0c027222659ff9d.name: Awning III
381dc161fc678241a0c027222659ff9d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

df710608f2ff7041979b2f5aef66db82.name: Round Wooden Door Frame
df710608f2ff7041979b2f5aef66db82.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

a835dafcf2a4844ea271d1fee050bb4a.name: Fell Thunderbrute Trophy
a835dafcf2a4844ea271d1fee050bb4a.desc:
Mount it inside your halls to honor the Flame!

Collect multiple Fell Thunderbrute Heads to craft the Trophy.

6fa3087020533e428a71a21016090627.name: Pumpkin Seedling
6fa3087020533e428a71a21016090627.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

f90b1e1b768cde4fbc145c26c441de5f.name: Plaited Block
f90b1e1b768cde4fbc145c26c441de5f.desc: A building block made from tightly woven twigs. It's used inside Vukah buildings.

692616be2447ec45bd9dd7edcfb13456.name: Shroud Sack
692616be2447ec45bd9dd7edcfb13456.desc:
An organic bag containing highly concentrated Shroud spores.

Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

a692b043c7f4454fbb18fe66edd3f90a.name: Aerostriker
a692b043c7f4454fbb18fe66edd3f90a.desc: A heavy hammer that strikes true, like a bird of prey.

9dd781394b96104baee6258f161d98f4.name: Ranger Trousers
9dd781394b96104baee6258f161d98f4.desc: Pants which shield the legs from brambles and thorns while hunting down prey.

40f70200a7866447ad8e06423588a054.name: Stapelia Starflower
40f70200a7866447ad8e06423588a054.desc:
A flower with star-shaped petals. It fills the moonlit valleys of the Albaneve Summits with the smell of death.

Its deep, dark color can be used to make pitch-black pigments.

f2da83cc5da64b4ab25ef8c2503253e4.name: Fruit Bowl
f2da83cc5da64b4ab25ef8c2503253e4.desc:
A refreshing bowl of fruits with positive health benefits.

Boosts health and stamina upon consumption.

e369e5675f4d0343b6cb117a83cd7e3b.name: White Wall Flower
e369e5675f4d0343b6cb117a83cd7e3b.desc: A small potted plant to beautify your home.

e1d1be1d8c2a8446b7f71acd6c1d8f64.name: Room Divider "Snake"
e1d1be1d8c2a8446b7f71acd6c1d8f64.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

9bc6d1095845dc4da5de25035c134cc0.name: Emberguard Pants
9bc6d1095845dc4da5de25035c134cc0.desc: A pattern ripples across the fabric, creating subtle peaks and valleys as fingers draw across it.

a91a1d5e2e7c7b4ea91ae85a5865abe7.name: Proto Matter-Bender
a91a1d5e2e7c7b4ea91ae85a5865abe7.desc:
A traditional Ancient tool used to adjust the subject's physical matter or shell after arrival. It can also be used to unleash the full wonder of blunt force trauma.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

efe3233327a4be4f89af44c80e2fd537.name: Drak Relief III
efe3233327a4be4f89af44c80e2fd537.desc:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

This relief portrays two images. The top shows a human-made Night Sanctum, and people bringing books and scrolls as a tribute to the Ancients.

The bottom sees the Drak enraged. They refuse to let humanity gain the favor of the Ancients, and attack.

04f74a89ab77eb4eab8139c5baca20f1.name: Blackguard Boots
04f74a89ab77eb4eab8139c5baca20f1.desc:
A warrior's boots that used to brandish a golden sheen. They've dulled due to the fungal overgrowth.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

2f7e8ff09c58b74391ada49b89c5a287.name: Wooden Banquet Table
2f7e8ff09c58b74391ada49b89c5a287.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

8d1c1df97c9e424c93ba91e105020b63.name: Bamboo Room Divider I
8d1c1df97c9e424c93ba91e105020b63.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

01826aaf8170784180974c24ad976769.name: Bones
01826aaf8170784180974c24ad976769.desc: Possessing magical properties, bones of the dead are often used in alchemy.

c94a58e90b816941a2741db0980b39ac.name: Alchemy Station
c94a58e90b816941a2741db0980b39ac.desc: An Alchemy Station offering all needed tools to craft better alchemical products.

10eaccbf2a31a34997066ca1dab57c31.name: Garden Gnome
10eaccbf2a31a34997066ca1dab57c31.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

26a009b5ec5a82499fc1842dbb28f57e.name: Hollow Cyclops Trophy
26a009b5ec5a82499fc1842dbb28f57e.desc: The frozen horns made from ectoplasm don't melt near the hearth fire. They must be magical!

7f3f1623afa3024e8086edb677546ea5.name: Ashes Of Pikemead's Reach
7f3f1623afa3024e8086edb677546ea5.desc:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"Elixir and blood, a drop for a drop."

You did not hear me when last we spoke. Maybe imagery will reach you, Manny. Sorry. I know you hate it when I call you that. - J

1edc08f757474a45af9769e51960ea62.name: Coffee Beans
1edc08f757474a45af9769e51960ea62.desc: These raw coffee beans must be roasted and ground before unfolding the depths of their flavor!

471c6ce2acbdf1438a1472101f2ba56b.name: Shimmerfin
471c6ce2acbdf1438a1472101f2ba56b.desc:
Despite wearing black bands over their eyes like bandits, they are relatively easy to catch.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

fb099ee3e10d014fa381660175552c4b.name: Gleam Root Dust
fb099ee3e10d014fa381660175552c4b.desc: This powder was derived from the Gleam Root plant, which only grows at night in the Veilwater Basin.

d154eff393d1e34d83f0a09ca5d428e2.name: Gem of Agility
d154eff393d1e34d83f0a09ca5d428e2.desc:
After performing an evade action, the next hit deals %k additional cutting damage and replenishes 
%k stamina on the next hit.

aaab370deeee41438eb500f2e3228a03.name: Fake Stone Door
aaab370deeee41438eb500f2e3228a03.desc: Fool others looking for hidden passages in your base with this fake secret door.

74b72db597a45a459c1717d8301b6f03.name: Lump of Clay
74b72db597a45a459c1717d8301b6f03.desc: A malleable material that is especially useful for construction purposes.

0dae7d53ce9e6c48a09c15c84d5c1cdf.name: Flame Pact Gloves
0dae7d53ce9e6c48a09c15c84d5c1cdf.desc: Gloves adorned with glowing, green gems. No matter what you're rebuilding or tearing down — you'll always look fashionable with these!

d3c6e35eab71574391e7b50d584dee85.name: Large Golden Room Divider
d3c6e35eab71574391e7b50d584dee85.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

cae72cbc2ba2c649bd61a6244a65b97a.name: Meat and Mushroom Skewer
cae72cbc2ba2c649bd61a6244a65b97a.desc: It’s a simple combination — a mushroom and some meat on a skewer — but the flavor and the effects go a long way.

a500f4f497dc6848a6d19a1e65078795.name: Carved Limestone Vase II
a500f4f497dc6848a6d19a1e65078795.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d2ebef42b19d404bb62b887bedae211b.name: Exploding Arrow IV
d2ebef42b19d404bb62b887bedae211b.desc: A Special Arrow that delivers an explosive surprise. Strikes with immense firepower.

2ba0d4bcc11ac840914e50cb17c84dd9.name: Cryptic Wand
2ba0d4bcc11ac840914e50cb17c84dd9.desc:
A strange wand that was covered by ashes. Its body bends and twists, but never breaks.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

24b8ca738c133e4ba67e1e6e3f2b0037.name: Hollow Wretch II
24b8ca738c133e4ba67e1e6e3f2b0037.desc:
Summons a Hollow Wretch ally that attacks enemies. 
Maximum amount of summoned Hollow allies is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

5f367bbd4096eb408b64a80fdea9fa88.name: Hollow Cyclops Head
5f367bbd4096eb408b64a80fdea9fa88.desc: Its only eye still aimlessly rolled around in its socket before the beheading. Eventually, though, it spilled out.

d656998b1024074bb7b8d7126dda1b19.name: Cleaned Bandage
d656998b1024074bb7b8d7126dda1b19.desc:
A bandage combined with antiseptics.

This item provides improved healing if applied to a wound.

0d8fe204e7076e4db48f65dec9d47f5c.name: Stone Side Table
0d8fe204e7076e4db48f65dec9d47f5c.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

cecc28174d55344fba16cf0c0a41fd29.name: Drak Claws
cecc28174d55344fba16cf0c0a41fd29.desc: Meant to hold and rip prey, these claws are still sharp as ever.

060cfb79d474fe409bce940a86bbecd3.name: Giant Bone Arrow IV
060cfb79d474fe409bce940a86bbecd3.desc:
An arrow made from bone.

The force of this arrow allows it to pierce hit targets to harm multiple foes.

0c32a1a55d8dc24983d024a067923d63.name: Shroud Sludge
0c32a1a55d8dc24983d024a067923d63.desc:
Excessive experimentation proved that mixing slime and jelly creates sludge.
All of these substances are entirely different and deserving of their own characterization due to their varied viscosity.

6fe9addb3d00b5449e7a96f824d1ec99.name: Fell Curse Cleansing Tonic
6fe9addb3d00b5449e7a96f824d1ec99.desc:
Removes the Fell Curse upon use.

Also applies a buff that prevents the curse from affecting the user for an hour.

2e2f37c60e581d41894c8ed27f827171.name: Greater Golden Twinflame Sword
2e2f37c60e581d41894c8ed27f827171.desc: An elaborate sword, decorated in gold filigree. It came from the skies as a shooting star years ago, and fell into the gaping maw of a cave.

31d7a598b62bd6478b0792e9eb867d3d.name: Ancient Bench
31d7a598b62bd6478b0792e9eb867d3d.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

6cc8814924279f45be54cc81af2fc861.name: Light Brown Eyes
6cc8814924279f45be54cc81af2fc861.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

575be69b99c4904d9d24409d7855ff98.name: Rising Fighter Gloves
575be69b99c4904d9d24409d7855ff98.desc: Gloves made for beginner fighters. Robust, but agile. They will mainly protect you from blisters when swinging your sword.

f220d390fb6fe34bab1fa622139052a9.name: Stone Column
f220d390fb6fe34bab1fa622139052a9.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

16e85f83f80bb84ea5c001d22d1c2bb4.name: Wolf's Fang Hood
16e85f83f80bb84ea5c001d22d1c2bb4.desc: A hood fashioned from the scalp of a white wolf. The fangs at the front are still attached.

43a3d3d46a4cd54a8dfb066715c3e40d.name: Wooden Shield
43a3d3d46a4cd54a8dfb066715c3e40d.desc:
This makeshift wooden shield allows you to block and parry physical attacks. 

Parry
You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar.
Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.

e9cba34e62cf5e41a57c2658116a3731.name: Medium Castle Table
e9cba34e62cf5e41a57c2658116a3731.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

5bc190ee70f421429f7b227645a85caa.name: Grass
5bc190ee70f421429f7b227645a85caa.desc: A small potted plant to beautify your home.

071ca55117eb4b42b08a43b82d310a32.name: Baby Round-Billed Sailer
071ca55117eb4b42b08a43b82d310a32.desc: A young Round-Billed Sailer, unable to fly yet due to its overly round shape and tiny wings.

9b0cc139c7f94141b267a778993ff1f3.name: Rising Fighter Trousers
9b0cc139c7f94141b267a778993ff1f3.desc: Polstered trousers to dampen your fall in fighting practice.

76eb0826c0efdf45b377610c098e0054.name: Valor Heart Daggers
76eb0826c0efdf45b377610c098e0054.desc:
A dagger that can easily be hidden underneath lavish sleeves or dressy skirts. It's quick and easy to unsheath in times of need!

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

79920239c0f6a341b377ae28f773fc3e.name: Well Block
79920239c0f6a341b377ae28f773fc3e.desc: Bathed in waterproofing liquids, this stone block is mostly used for Elixir Wells.

47a09d660cd1f147845ce94f7559d260.name: Brazen Bull Helmet
47a09d660cd1f147845ce94f7559d260.desc: A heavy helmet, adorned with the imposing horns of a bull and a tall, far-reaching crest. The faceplate only leaves room for the eyes, letting the wearer's red-hot anger radiate outwards.

95f9050554630a4c8992e3ce228c1b4f.name: Pyreheart Blade
95f9050554630a4c8992e3ce228c1b4f.desc: The blade near the handle is segmented into three shapes, which form an upside-down heart when viewed as a whole. It carries a vermilion gemstone inside that burns bright as a pyre.

d46e501fc193db458bf759f1acf59d5f.name: Long Wall Banner
d46e501fc193db458bf759f1acf59d5f.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

13b5a47a62c9624b8779646e5a71df33.name: Emberfin
13b5a47a62c9624b8779646e5a71df33.desc:
This striking red fish is marked with black stripes. Its shimmering scales resemble cooling embers, earning it the name "Emberfin".

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

e1f882b11927cc4db6cb66709de173c5.name: Bronze Platter
e1f882b11927cc4db6cb66709de173c5.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

eb94809ae128fd479c04d149b8ab55e2.name: Headscarf
eb94809ae128fd479c04d149b8ab55e2.desc: A simple headscarf that will keep your scalp safe from the burning heat of the overhead sun.

e47299e7f5c7a848b683eeb03a61a49f.name: Blackguard Trousers
e47299e7f5c7a848b683eeb03a61a49f.desc:
A pair of rotting pants, held together by stabilizing chitin shells.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

0a7148c5b18a514290a97c0d4838dbfe.name: Round Stone Window Frame
0a7148c5b18a514290a97c0d4838dbfe.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ac725f4d4e286e439fa45537ad6f405c.name: Wooden Palisade I
ac725f4d4e286e439fa45537ad6f405c.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d9893cd6cba2e948834f97c083512bff.name: Secret Stone Door
d9893cd6cba2e948834f97c083512bff.desc: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.

e3718ece5b25b34188a90497e10bf6a2.name: Improved Bandage
e3718ece5b25b34188a90497e10bf6a2.desc:
A bandage that was made more absorbent by moss. The added silver dust and wound ointment will cure poison.

This item heals 70% health over 10 seconds if applied to a wound. 

Receiving any damage interrupts the healing effect.

fa7299857875a8438e6f1184b3383a53.name: Empty Farmbed
fa7299857875a8438e6f1184b3383a53.desc: This Farmbed can be filled with dirt, sand, or soil to grow plants.

d26fa984996dba49b8299ba0bc604044.name: Ivy
d26fa984996dba49b8299ba0bc604044.desc: Use the Overgrowth Tool to apply this to structures in your base.

e4538a1c1bd1a144960b0d357628db53.name: Fake Castle Door
e4538a1c1bd1a144960b0d357628db53.desc: Fool others looking for hidden passages in your base with this fake secret door.

aa1044fe6f3d2343b16fde1461ab2ca1.name: Cutthroat Boots
aa1044fe6f3d2343b16fde1461ab2ca1.desc: The reinforced soles allow the wearer to skulk through the overgrowth undisturbed, and to reach vantage points quickly. Perfect for an ambush!

7de25db2936a72408c37f44a9546344d.name: Fell Critter Queen Head
7de25db2936a72408c37f44a9546344d.desc: The Fell Critter Queen Head looks strangely small without the bulk that had once followed behind it.

bef4a9daa7d8fc4a9b46cc06770aee69.name: Falk Fall Daggers
bef4a9daa7d8fc4a9b46cc06770aee69.desc:
The edge of these daggers is shaped like the beak of a soaring eagle, willing to strike down toward its enemies.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

65b7e5f01281ff4bac5a6b49e6159e2a.name: Megalodon Greatsword
65b7e5f01281ff4bac5a6b49e6159e2a.desc: You see it before your inner eyes: A giant, submerged in the deep ocean blue, controlling the tides with each laboring, drawn-out exhale. The depths are calling. Will you answer?

444bceacf339184d8bcb13fcacf02f58.name: Minstrel Hat
444bceacf339184d8bcb13fcacf02f58.desc: A colorful and flashy hat, often worn by poets, minstrels, or traders of luxurious goods.

e0ac15857f6b2445a4fc780ef19a6a6b.name: Hunter Gloves
e0ac15857f6b2445a4fc780ef19a6a6b.desc: These leather gloves have been adorned with metal to protect the wearer's knuckles.

18aaef93fa7fe54885288f2de3577cdd.name: Large Grandleaf Cabbage Plant Pot
18aaef93fa7fe54885288f2de3577cdd.desc: An ancient potted plant. This one can be displayed in the Cultivation Rack.

36df76069676c444bd81e8bc0ad0192a.name: Mysterious Mauve
36df76069676c444bd81e8bc0ad0192a.desc:
A color palette that makes you feel like a scholar, wandering through wisteria-laden archways to take samples of the flora.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

6e4e6a657be53146ae482f7ba637b72f.name: Alchemist's Ring
6e4e6a657be53146ae482f7ba637b72f.desc:
A ring with glowing engravings that read: 

"May the Shroud never tear you down — Balthazar"

6e4e24e6b5d1514ebc75f40fcb581a02.name: Shellbreaker Daggers
6e4e24e6b5d1514ebc75f40fcb581a02.desc:
Sometimes a Drak hatchling proves too weak to break its shell. In such cases, the Broodwardens use this poison-tipped blade to cut the egg open. The young bear a mark from that day onward — a symbol of frailty that brands them for life, forever beneath those who hatched unaided.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

9bafabf90c060d47a8c3c7c567ebaa1e.name: Rake
9bafabf90c060d47a8c3c7c567ebaa1e.desc: A rake made of the simplest materials. A basic tool used to flatten the ground for upcoming construction works.

58be29c2ccd0ba41a6c52ad896c782b2.name: Nightshade
58be29c2ccd0ba41a6c52ad896c782b2.desc:
A dagger's point coated in poison is often more effective than diplomacy.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

ccae73fbb4bb9546a828349b23fcaf15.name: Gold Fell Striker Trophy
ccae73fbb4bb9546a828349b23fcaf15.desc:
The severed, golden head, forever frozen in time, invites you to look within. To reach this moment, you had to perfect your fighting strategy. Well done.

Collect multiple Fell Striker Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

a14f6f34d7e2bb4aabbcafa5fa71d363.name: Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Trophy
a14f6f34d7e2bb4aabbcafa5fa71d363.desc: You don't need to worry about a sudden flash of light tearing through the air anymore. That era is gone.

43274b5791b5144fa1b8219775989182.name: Large Stone Arc
43274b5791b5144fa1b8219775989182.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

dbc303fa4b0b95439d547eeb5cdddf0e.name: Miner Helmet
dbc303fa4b0b95439d547eeb5cdddf0e.desc: A miner's helmet with an attached light.

7319eac1cd69a04e9f4def54cc07bdc7.name: Big Furry Straw Mat
7319eac1cd69a04e9f4def54cc07bdc7.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

2f67e3d7e6c1dc49b465044c1589ecd2.name: Flax Plant
2f67e3d7e6c1dc49b465044c1589ecd2.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

1358edca27b3d040814d10d8f4f0a2a4.name: Ornamented Vase V
1358edca27b3d040814d10d8f4f0a2a4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

17d9ddc1524f704c8e9ca90e231a468e.name: Standing Wooden Barrel
17d9ddc1524f704c8e9ca90e231a468e.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6f4e208b80acb54b9a8276a9bd2f28ed.name: Archaic Essence VI
6f4e208b80acb54b9a8276a9bd2f28ed.desc:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.

ad72b7dfdd80aa4ba866edd07672249f.name: Eternal Protective Barrier
ad72b7dfdd80aa4ba866edd07672249f.desc:
Conjures a magical shield that blocks and absorbs incoming projectiles until its health is depleted.
You and your allies also gain 25% increased Physical Resistance within the barrier. 

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

843fe911e692004d9821feb8a487f2c0.name: Drak Stone Totem I
843fe911e692004d9821feb8a487f2c0.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e7a34eb623212142b63dc56538d18905.name: Snowball
e7a34eb623212142b63dc56538d18905.desc: A lumpy ball of snow. It's harmless enough as long as you don't put any rocks inside!

1f113749094b1e478c13f07ef397f9a2.name: Venom Stinger
1f113749094b1e478c13f07ef397f9a2.desc: A sharp, organic stinger. Don't get pricked, or you'll have venom rushing through your veins!

5d1812c78f381441ae1c8dd983bc71c9.name: Crypt Brazier
5d1812c78f381441ae1c8dd983bc71c9.desc:
A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.

86ebf364060633419dff191da0a98155.name: Spinning Wheel
86ebf364060633419dff191da0a98155.desc: A workstation that weaves Flax into Linen in a much more effective way.

632627bf5233134087c62c70284949f2.name: Pink Flower
632627bf5233134087c62c70284949f2.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

7d85844415045e429da159089a6aa0a2.name: Winterly Pants
7d85844415045e429da159089a6aa0a2.desc: A pair of pants with fleece on the inside.

5452c8e6d71df942a5f093bea074a5c6.name: Gormander's War Banner I
5452c8e6d71df942a5f093bea074a5c6.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

078195a9a4a02942aee8d36cb274bedf.name: Emberguard Boots
078195a9a4a02942aee8d36cb274bedf.desc: Imposing boots that leave a deep imprint wherever they step. They possess additional plating towards the outer sides, protecting the wearer from low blows.

9b71739858d06141b8da05cb9ae0f24b.name: Violet Grove
9b71739858d06141b8da05cb9ae0f24b.desc:
The Flora of Cinder's Cradle: Fruits that ripen into every shade of violet imaginable. Dark as a bruise or soft as dusk. 

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

a4747aab0a54334f9de86b2da534e747.name: Snow Lantern
a4747aab0a54334f9de86b2da534e747.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

886f026979cb22468bb456ccceaf173f.name: Masterful Mace
886f026979cb22468bb456ccceaf173f.desc: This mace is unstoppable once in motion.

509d43a139f30d40825460983a42e84c.name: Large Chest
509d43a139f30d40825460983a42e84c.desc: A larger storage opportunity for bulk items.

4cf2e76c263007409bdccd8e5141becb.name: Mother's Eye
4cf2e76c263007409bdccd8e5141becb.desc: Silvery like the sea glass on long-forgotten shores. Something within this ring inspires hope.

2e56612f36070441ac7922ef4196a8fd.name: Sky Specter Pants
2e56612f36070441ac7922ef4196a8fd.desc: A pair of pants that is fit to hide under midnight gloom.

5df93c8c9262834a8be98ed7d4bbbd3f.name: White Glowing Substance
5df93c8c9262834a8be98ed7d4bbbd3f.desc: This material glows in a warm white light. It's an alchemical miracle!

258acd24419a2c46b8151a5ccd9be84b.name: Astral Daggers
258acd24419a2c46b8151a5ccd9be84b.desc:
A quick set of daggers that reflects the light of the stars above. The handle is topped by an elliptical guard that appears to be floating. It reminds one of planetary rings.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

4f9d66c238e18648bb3155593d5acd67.name: Flag Pole II
4f9d66c238e18648bb3155593d5acd67.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

cc518276d6218541aba12e9ea7393784.name: Ornamented Vase VI
cc518276d6218541aba12e9ea7393784.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

7c09765f5ccb5643b2e7bb1d5998fc8b.name: Cattail Seedling
7c09765f5ccb5643b2e7bb1d5998fc8b.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

988d6760a0c04c4c8ece606024c6cf62.name: Scrappy Sword
988d6760a0c04c4c8ece606024c6cf62.desc: A blunt sword, designed to open up ways. Especially through lines of enemies.

bcd04139036b844eabc7664134483bea.name: Blast Furnace
bcd04139036b844eabc7664134483bea.desc: This advanced furnace can create incredible heat! It's used to smelt higher quality materials.

7fcb56c22b79d9498614567adf09aef2.name: Violet Fabric
7fcb56c22b79d9498614567adf09aef2.desc: A luscious, dyed fabric, usually reserved for creating the finest garments.

237d817632fcf14f8de0545fdd3e65cc.name: Marksman Trousers
237d817632fcf14f8de0545fdd3e65cc.desc: The coloring of these pants allows the wearer to seamlessly blend into the foliage.

b0f45d4a4e4d27499258433b3414a8b7.name: Queen Pikemead Statue Piece
b0f45d4a4e4d27499258433b3414a8b7.desc:
A broken piece of the Queen Pikemead sculpture.
Find every piece to reassemble a statue.

55a196ca2fd73945bd48c4da9c588350.name: Alpine Antler Chest
55a196ca2fd73945bd48c4da9c588350.desc: A blue overcoat with a fluffy, snow-white trim to keep warm. The pelts are lightweight and won't weigh you down when scaling the mountain tops to find vantage points.

9a8467a82880ee42b4ad3730a4cb484b.name: Stone Bedside Table
9a8467a82880ee42b4ad3730a4cb484b.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

a34cc63cbc388d4f8d5db7b080b64523.name: Fell Wispwyvern Head
a34cc63cbc388d4f8d5db7b080b64523.desc: When its luminous brood skipped over the waves near Pikemead's Reach, it was seen as a good omen. Unfortunately, no being, no matter how small, escapes the corrupting grasp of the Shroud.

e672e73ccc647f419729c9e8c68570d4.name: Blizzard II
e672e73ccc647f419729c9e8c68570d4.desc:
Conjures a freezing storm that continuously deals damage to all enemies inside the area and applies a slow debuff to them.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

9cdf523ab391494a96ea21e302c80525.name: Palm Leaf Basket
9cdf523ab391494a96ea21e302c80525.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4d577bc5fc2304478d9ea25c6866b85e.name: Orrery
4d577bc5fc2304478d9ea25c6866b85e.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

cff4b3dda4685f4d90ba679822544c59.name: Copper Cup
cff4b3dda4685f4d90ba679822544c59.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

fa990b14390cd34dab0038ab47d17c55.name: Bamboo Stairs
fa990b14390cd34dab0038ab47d17c55.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d5b26a89f7581147a313a0b975a9a5a2.name: Granite Block
d5b26a89f7581147a313a0b975a9a5a2.desc: A stone building block made with granite. The many minerals inside give it a special, speckled look.

818499eadbf81444b2fa6f42425e39c2.name: Aerated Banshee Gel
818499eadbf81444b2fa6f42425e39c2.desc:
A lightweight, protective gel. Has properties of Fell magic.

Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

7ed07b886d98234e92963a12defef470.name: Grilled Wolf Meat
7ed07b886d98234e92963a12defef470.desc: Roasted ribs were a delicacy back in the day, providing a substantial amount of health to the consumer.

e653ceac79aeee49b090880f20f041e7.name: Greater Health Potion +
e653ceac79aeee49b090880f20f041e7.desc: Instantly restores a medium amount of health, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.

0426e4eec1ac6b458ba141c5c7281b31.name: Mana Drain VII
0426e4eec1ac6b458ba141c5c7281b31.desc:
Releases a continuous magical beam that leeches Mana from enemies without dealing damage to them.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

566129aa198bd5469b12341f39c9f544.name: Dog Bowl
566129aa198bd5469b12341f39c9f544.desc:
A little feeding bowl for your Dog.

It will feed your animals when filled with the corresponding food.

91c3185adc58724e86adea21b61627a5.name: Summer Games Bangles
91c3185adc58724e86adea21b61627a5.desc: Asymmetrical bangles that aid viewers in visually differentiating your arm movements as you dash past them towards the finish line.

fcf39b1537249443a89e287d16befc55.name: Recent Drak Wand
fcf39b1537249443a89e287d16befc55.desc:
A simplified wand, shaped by the resurgence of the Drak. Weapons such as these would've held great power in the past, but the primal knowledge surrounding their creation was lost. Recently crafted wands are therefore more primitive, and mere imitations of the once undeniable power and dominion of the beasts.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

2eda765353899f4f84ce989162fe8d3b.name: Explosive Powder Ball Net
2eda765353899f4f84ce989162fe8d3b.desc:
An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

14a3fc7acac18144a777a69a0195c1cf.name: Deadeye Vest
14a3fc7acac18144a777a69a0195c1cf.desc: Duck, dodge, and roll out of harm's way with this lightweight vest.

57069cfd8395164099e0a36c2870518f.name: Salon Sign
57069cfd8395164099e0a36c2870518f.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

964778960c57f44baf9a6d42efa304b9.name: Flame Arcanist Boots

Polaris' Memoir:
I'm a shining star, drifting high up in the sky
To find your path, you must look to me only
Gazing down at the world, it's hard to deny
