79c9987b0dae6448a42d81e2b106af50.name: Herbalist Gloves
79c9987b0dae6448a42d81e2b106af50.desc: These fingerless gloves allow the wearer to feel each leaf and root before picking, allowing a proper assessment.

e3c7ef3aa7e4ba4bb80d591065ea1661.name: Horn Daggers
e3c7ef3aa7e4ba4bb80d591065ea1661.desc:
The many layers of smelted metal in these daggers make them appear similar to an animal's tiered horn, tapering off at the edges.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

fac8068653bb6a4ca44cae72741a45cd.name: Latte
fac8068653bb6a4ca44cae72741a45cd.desc: Coffee that's been refined with a splash of milk. The mild aroma makes it easy to sip!

f4a292ec48187a44aa18f5f4297095eb.name: Water Trough
f4a292ec48187a44aa18f5f4297095eb.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

857ff8874f355247a55008354795458f.name: Golden Recruit Axe
857ff8874f355247a55008354795458f.desc: The most successful, newly decorated recruits are sometimes gifted weapons dipped in gold. They aren't any sharper than their less impressive counterparts, but serve as a status symbol among the group.

5a4979c0681f9645889da7acf38afbb3.name: Camp Bed
5a4979c0681f9645889da7acf38afbb3.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

b78630770a91c74e87f7e39ea4e79113.name: Hollow Halls Showcase (3 Small Slots)
b78630770a91c74e87f7e39ea4e79113.desc: This is a showcase for Hollow Artifact Collection Items usually found in the Hollow Halls.

c005ab372621ec4f978842ad623d6cf0.name: Polished Wooden Bench
c005ab372621ec4f978842ad623d6cf0.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

59d2c471852bb6429a87734c3a452d5e.name: Bronze Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Trophy
59d2c471852bb6429a87734c3a452d5e.desc:
The waves of projectiles raining down on you are still a vivid memory. But this eye won't hurt you no more.

Collect multiple Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Eyes to craft the Bronze Trophy.

c717cbade369fb4da038a9b93f656b08.name: Herbal Mountain Tea
c717cbade369fb4da038a9b93f656b08.desc: A strong, herbal tea. It increases your mana and stamina.

5bbacade4b4f524f9154cd555b1bb9ec.name: Purple Pendant Light I
5bbacade4b4f524f9154cd555b1bb9ec.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

1800dba9e25dca4d84dfaa270a89b6b8.name: Healer Gloves
1800dba9e25dca4d84dfaa270a89b6b8.desc: These gloves allow nimble fingers to patch up wounds when in a pinch.

2473aa4bd79c7546adcc86ea76de076a.name: Great Mace
2473aa4bd79c7546adcc86ea76de076a.desc: Easy to use and quite deadly. The sharp blades on the side allow for easier penetration of armor.

16c21a093c745245bdf317d370d19a19.name: Fur Hood
16c21a093c745245bdf317d370d19a19.desc: Simplistic head protection. It won't guard against much, but it's better than nothing.

06c7de0f2440fb4fb08d7b96619bed60.name: Enhanced Spiked Club
06c7de0f2440fb4fb08d7b96619bed60.desc: The most basic weaponry, enhanced to be more effective and durable.

bca225991a454741b28a98c114eda76d.name: Tank Helmet
bca225991a454741b28a98c114eda76d.desc: A copper helmet that keeps your skull from harm while you protect your allies.

4c867d0a9066aa45a7b61eac33b5aedc.name: Ancient Colum Base I
4c867d0a9066aa45a7b61eac33b5aedc.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

729469f4992d2a49989d0b7a00a9138e.name: Frostbite Slasher Gloves
729469f4992d2a49989d0b7a00a9138e.desc: Padded gloves made from thick white cloth and deep blue leather arm guards. A small buckle and cyan string hold them together. The fingertips are left bare, so you can still feel the pulse of the hunt.

00475a61fa4d194dafa88dd32a1a3e00.name: Mage Chest
00475a61fa4d194dafa88dd32a1a3e00.desc: This garment is held together by oakwood buttons, a woven belt, and magic itself! The buttons are doing most of the work, though.

cbb5275cea5c5441897ae6a8427b1b6a.name: Ornamented Vase III
cbb5275cea5c5441897ae6a8427b1b6a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

0899b7113c80c14e918bff30cbc99a15.name: Jester Hat
0899b7113c80c14e918bff30cbc99a15.desc: A gleeful and jingly hat. The little bells make frolicking around more joyous.

639bb1ea62d3624ebc6ce9d044b43e7f.name: Wolf's Hydra
639bb1ea62d3624ebc6ce9d044b43e7f.desc: A heavy club adorned with multiple wolf heads near the handle.

9347265f5b4f4842975c11274e6e960f.name: Aurora Sword
9347265f5b4f4842975c11274e6e960f.desc: All incoming light fractures on the surface of this elegant blade, creating a dancing ensemble of floating colors. It is practically dripping with excellence.

07f69756ab076647b1152763f84ad043.name: Coalescent Wand
07f69756ab076647b1152763f84ad043.desc:
The wielder's energy melts inside the wand's empty husk and reforms to shoot forth a boundless stream of elemental energy.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

ec5280a55eb09542891eea687e20dfe8.name: Chicken Soup
ec5280a55eb09542891eea687e20dfe8.desc: A very healthy soup made by boiling chicken for a period of time. An old house maiden's dish to help protect the body from illness.

4e388c90397a4241a19c22bcd99be2c0.name: Baby Dune Armadillo
4e388c90397a4241a19c22bcd99be2c0.desc: This baby Dune Armadillo is already starting to form its horn, later used for digging tunnels — never when you're looking, though. It's strange how that works.

36f7fffeaea76548b83abf4c99992160.name: Shell Limestone
36f7fffeaea76548b83abf4c99992160.desc: A type of limestone derived from seashells.

ff8f59e4f31fb2488c196516f170bff2.name: Wizard Pants
ff8f59e4f31fb2488c196516f170bff2.desc: Dark pants for dark magic wielders.

beedcbe7e6da7e448bc56ba795d92d71.name: Astronomy Desk II
beedcbe7e6da7e448bc56ba795d92d71.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

f02b536a452f5a4782a8d4db8bb0d32f.name: Trap Fireball
f02b536a452f5a4782a8d4db8bb0d32f.desc:
A Trap Fireball which can be used as spell ammunition.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

ce491e01c854ea42b483f4c28e685783.name: Blackmire Statue IV
ce491e01c854ea42b483f4c28e685783.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

0e32b4abe26dbb4e8b6ad2e84d66e900.name: Algae Seedling
0e32b4abe26dbb4e8b6ad2e84d66e900.desc:
A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. 

This plant needs to be placed in water and submerged completely.

87a6ff5fa3aabf44949f0853994835d4.name: Wall Mounted Candleholder
87a6ff5fa3aabf44949f0853994835d4.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

d56569d32f4e6947859fb10fe3155914.name: Bell Pepper
d56569d32f4e6947859fb10fe3155914.desc: A crisp, vibrant red bell pepper with a sweet, juicy flavor and a glossy skin.

8d1dbe138b34724f913f924517c9cf6a.name: Pink Mushroom Meat
8d1dbe138b34724f913f924517c9cf6a.desc: A rose-colored piece of fresh mushroom meat. It has various applications.

82e70ca6cd2f0f428aa3b33a00205caf.name: Mountain's Shadow Shield
82e70ca6cd2f0f428aa3b33a00205caf.desc: A shield with a central amethyst. The metal frame around the sides makes it more durable.

553528c6e36e534e91ac280c316968a5.name: Obsidian
553528c6e36e534e91ac280c316968a5.desc: Volcanic, pitch-black glass formed centuries ago. It leaves sharp edges when fractured, making it interesting for smithing and crafting.

cca7b3e8a75a1548998bc036a6268867.name: Fell Monstrosity Trophy
cca7b3e8a75a1548998bc036a6268867.desc:
Inside, you can see nothingness. The absence of matter — of sanity and sanctum.

Collect multiple Fell Monstrosity Heads to craft the Trophy.

7687db26caa918498f087db55c5da03b.name: Eternal Blizzard II
7687db26caa918498f087db55c5da03b.desc:
Conjures a freezing storm that continuously deals damage to all enemies inside the area and applies a slow debuff to them.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

bd6cb2404293c74ba327e5da7616c2e7.name: Blue Confetti Mortar
bd6cb2404293c74ba327e5da7616c2e7.desc: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

04d9e8687622e14cb50d68e4e84807bf.name: Radiant Paladin Trousers
04d9e8687622e14cb50d68e4e84807bf.desc: This pair of trousers looks plain at first glance, but the craftsmanship allows the wearer to produce and retain more warmth from within.

ca26e2b64de90745b0552d460e3a339d.name: Watering Can
ca26e2b64de90745b0552d460e3a339d.desc: A useful item for watering thirsty flowers and plants.

a8d923ade318ca4991f6ec9654ae0f80.name: Resource  Bundle I
a8d923ade318ca4991f6ec9654ae0f80.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

b30fca3b4e46c742800e305df5e46601.name: Magmatic Axe
b30fca3b4e46c742800e305df5e46601.desc: An axe that's hot to the touch, as it was forged inside an active volcano. It's ready to unleash fiery chaos with every swing.

1a9a5d7717c0534b97695ecb0112192a.name: Staff Of The Serpent
1a9a5d7717c0534b97695ecb0112192a.desc:
A majestic staff topped with an ouroboros ornament made from green jade. It's perfect for honoring the year of the snake.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

780b12a1650d87488c1f168b5e12e7e1.name: Yellow Fabric
780b12a1650d87488c1f168b5e12e7e1.desc: Yellow dyed fabric used for clothing.

127655a01ab2d74c896c9276eb068023.name: Water Reptile Hide
127655a01ab2d74c896c9276eb068023.desc: This hide is sleek and water-resistant. It's commonly procured from amphibians that prefer wet or water-filled environments.

aacbe58f08935c47b985edd75a6e37c0.name: Lantern
aacbe58f08935c47b985edd75a6e37c0.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

8e5a4210943f8b458a8a4348904d7662.name: Ancient Greenery
8e5a4210943f8b458a8a4348904d7662.desc:
Cabbage, thyme, and moonstone — greens that run deep, blues that carry something ancient.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

8a5856c8fc3a4544a7b90e6bafe46616.name: Carved Wooden Shelf
8a5856c8fc3a4544a7b90e6bafe46616.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

440604e58166b64c8f0fe4f877aea2b2.name: Large Red Marble Arc
440604e58166b64c8f0fe4f877aea2b2.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d20b220a4712de489223d141b89efa6b.name: Lupa's Scalper
d20b220a4712de489223d141b89efa6b.desc: "Shadow Over Umber Hollow — Lupa" is etched on the side.

493e9876b564a743ba512b12faaade70.name: Grilled Specklefin
493e9876b564a743ba512b12faaade70.desc: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

9d5c8c61b6cc02478909af811ec4acf6.name: Sparkling Dust
9d5c8c61b6cc02478909af811ec4acf6.desc:
Diamond pulled from deep below. Moonstone fallen from somewhere far above. Mother-Of-Pearl drawn from the ocean floor. 
Three materials that would have never met, ground together into something that catches light from every direction at once, warm and cold, and shifting all at the same time.

664a23a22070ca429ff5fd7bb364cae4.name: Greatsword Of The Old Order
664a23a22070ca429ff5fd7bb364cae4.desc: Before the fall, many guards and knights of Embervale would brandish swords such as these. Perhaps their spirit lives on through your righteous strikes.

7e269726327ec94fb66ef146bacc55f9.name: Fell Scout Bow
7e269726327ec94fb66ef146bacc55f9.desc: Pierce Enemies in the back with arrows shot from this precise Fell Scout Bow, perfect for those who prefer their enemies dealt with from a comfortable distance.

85a6e6e539087442a80d17ad5aaab21a.name: Blessed Club
85a6e6e539087442a80d17ad5aaab21a.desc: A club that was bathed in divine waters, thus acquiring a blessing of protection. Turns out blessings are less effective than cold, hard steel when caught in an ambush.

2583e78fd37acf469e6515286ce85e8a.name: Cinder's Cradle Dirt
2583e78fd37acf469e6515286ce85e8a.desc:
A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. 

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

4b7a0c544c874f428617fe3761bc3558.name: Stone Banquet Table
4b7a0c544c874f428617fe3761bc3558.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

9119cec8fab4b24ab29aabe390ccb572.name: Scrap Pot V
9119cec8fab4b24ab29aabe390ccb572.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

59f98a380446a5498d664ef8597c1bdd.name: Hailcaster Chest
59f98a380446a5498d664ef8597c1bdd.desc: A carefully layered tunic, tied over the chest with gold string. The cloth is thick, but flowy. It will enable quick magical dashes while protecting you from the bitter cold.

c1094307d2c99d43b5ae83631eaac1f0.name: Blue Pendant Light II
c1094307d2c99d43b5ae83631eaac1f0.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

747a2ebb63da1341bc0619dee6cddace.name: Astronomy Ceiling Lamp
747a2ebb63da1341bc0619dee6cddace.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

d9c8ab177e71fb4b9ebe1115c5c34717.name: Flame Arcanist Chest
d9c8ab177e71fb4b9ebe1115c5c34717.desc: An admiral blue-colored garment often worn by magic scholars who revere the Mother Flame. The cape attached to the shoulders falls in layers and ends in uneven trim, dancing like little spouts of fire as it moves in the wind.

106fdb4678db604f8bddd7380e0adde2.name: Fae Deer Farmer Gloves
106fdb4678db604f8bddd7380e0adde2.desc: Two-toned leather gloves with light stitching. Their pattern gives them an almost whimsical feel.

62a1e365aa3f4246809bdd5e5b044cea.name: "Boar At Home"
62a1e365aa3f4246809bdd5e5b044cea.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

16e94c98786a4c4eaff4395cdeafef4b.name: "Slick Fade" Wig Head
16e94c98786a4c4eaff4395cdeafef4b.desc: A wig head that unlocks more haircuts once picked up. It can also be placed in your base as decoration.

bab3e6aeebad6442b11725f974a08cb8.name: Gilded Pickaxe
bab3e6aeebad6442b11725f974a08cb8.desc: This steel pickaxe has been further refined through the addition of gold ornaments.

4b5bb9b4fca7014a9cbd9927beb66e49.name: Warrior Helmet
4b5bb9b4fca7014a9cbd9927beb66e49.desc: Dive headfirst into battle with this Warrior Helmet!

1fadd58c70d29f4c9454d44ea728ce7d.name: Vat Of The Ancients IV
1fadd58c70d29f4c9454d44ea728ce7d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

3cdb2de66f9cc74c86db2ba78065912d.name: Salt
3cdb2de66f9cc74c86db2ba78065912d.desc: Crystalline powder, which can be found in enshrouded valleys. The taste of food can be improved drastically when sprinkled with salt.

e7208acdf3c0704e9da5973509fbd2fb.name: Fireplace
e7208acdf3c0704e9da5973509fbd2fb.desc: A fireplace that will provide warmth once placed in your home. It's simple, but sufficient for cooking simple meals and gaining the Rested buff.

9f7c4c34df89db4eb9fa08287a9b501b.name: Warden Boots
9f7c4c34df89db4eb9fa08287a9b501b.desc: No one can tread past you when you're wearing these steadfast boots.

ca8b6e18a20141429fc75e3559e39e64.name: Venerable Hollow Chestplate
ca8b6e18a20141429fc75e3559e39e64.desc: A weighty armor piece, adorned with diamond- and star-shaped studs in brushed gold. A crimson cape trails behind, withered like the wearer's spirit.

29315a7c24bdd0488d10012403dd9175.name: Tall Ancient Ground Lamp
29315a7c24bdd0488d10012403dd9175.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

90d1a61d8be94f4b84bb95b6360cd92d.name: High Ornamented Stone Window Frame
90d1a61d8be94f4b84bb95b6360cd92d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

70b28b4f2bea434aa667ecfe1133c01b.name: Lever
70b28b4f2bea434aa667ecfe1133c01b.desc: Flipping the lever switches the state between ON and OFF.

66ceaaee196f8d4b812db9a771e6e477.name: Bloomheart Fruit Seedling
66ceaaee196f8d4b812db9a771e6e477.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in Basalt Farm Soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

b5b4942fe2547e4994a658aa3766b212.name: Flaming Gauntlets
b5b4942fe2547e4994a658aa3766b212.desc: Gauntlets that burn with pure, magical fire. Use them to set your foes aflame!

22938ab1fa4991449367131ef73bc840.name: Jezmina's War Banner I
22938ab1fa4991449367131ef73bc840.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d6db179bca24154cab244de9b59e227a.name: Orange Fabric
d6db179bca24154cab244de9b59e227a.desc: Orange dyed fabric used for clothing.

ff973a72937da045848428bf622ec49a.name: Red Marble Column Block
ff973a72937da045848428bf622ec49a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

040077f088a458478f01beb4e75263ed.name: Crucible
040077f088a458478f01beb4e75263ed.desc: Used in a Smelter to melt ores and create alloys.

a061425035f51046a1afc5639adbbfad.name: Lupa's Scalper
a061425035f51046a1afc5639adbbfad.desc: "Shadow Over Umber Hollow — Lupa" is etched on the side.

78329ed946bd164e862a23ebea3649f7.name: Scout Chest
78329ed946bd164e862a23ebea3649f7.desc: A simple, light chest piece to complement the rest of the armor.

c7c2766be6ec8944bb9744182273491d.name: Cyclops Skull
c7c2766be6ec8944bb9744182273491d.desc:
A gruesome, skeletal Cyclops head. You can fit your entire fist through the giant eyehole!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.

82efed0463df6d4aa87b93889069a6b3.name: Radiant Paladin Boots
82efed0463df6d4aa87b93889069a6b3.desc: Expertly crafted boots. They've been embellished with flame-spouting shields, a roaring inferno only kept at bay through vigilance.

40c26acc1f97f042937ece51f31d3a53.name: Bloodfeather Gloves
40c26acc1f97f042937ece51f31d3a53.desc: Adorned with a crystal and gold trim, these gloves give you a firm grip on your daggers — ideal for strikes from behind.

d30d1e32fc8e72449310b5ea98b1e85a.name: Transcendental Ward
d30d1e32fc8e72449310b5ea98b1e85a.desc: A bright magic shield that conjures protection from the aether when used.

9c7bef94da3f314ca679f09d012fc7f4.name: Passionflower
9c7bef94da3f314ca679f09d012fc7f4.desc: Take a moment to appreciate this fascinating flower and its beautiful pink color.

ddd885ccf1faac48ac5718f0e91f95d0.name: Green Fabric
ddd885ccf1faac48ac5718f0e91f95d0.desc: The color of life — a wonderful color for clothes.

6a88cc849d2820469f937c7bdd6dc618.name: Standing Lantern
6a88cc849d2820469f937c7bdd6dc618.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

4c31bd3c0819d2408f87023a92e27c04.name: Guardian Chestplate
4c31bd3c0819d2408f87023a92e27c04.desc: Prodigious tin armor. The glistening sheen inspires hope.

1ee51ac635f841459c5f65b2b1cd0766.name: Flame Mosaic Piece VI
1ee51ac635f841459c5f65b2b1cd0766.desc:
A small part of a shattered Flame mosaic. Perhaps you can piece it together if you find all the shards!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. The full collection includes 8 pieces. They can be reassembled into a mosaic inside a Flame Mosaic Frame. The Frame must be placed on the ground.

d69dddbfc342064ab83cecca66c7c6be.name: Blood Rose Chestplate
d69dddbfc342064ab83cecca66c7c6be.desc: A laced-up metal bodice that births a crinoline-esque cage. You shan't let these shackles fool you. No band, and no blood can manacle the wrath of the Blood Rose.

ff59a49ddc188c4bab51900be74654a4.name: Empty Fern Pot
ff59a49ddc188c4bab51900be74654a4.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

62063afdea3cef46a8efba5c4272ea13.name: Clay Fireplace
62063afdea3cef46a8efba5c4272ea13.desc: A fireplace that will provide ample warmth. Warmth is needed to acquire the Rested buff.

2a331ba7153dc8499f967f84de59a731.name: Shrub Seedling
2a331ba7153dc8499f967f84de59a731.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

f6bb1ace1b81ca4db2308cd456b8ca3f.name: Moon Rock Greatsword
f6bb1ace1b81ca4db2308cd456b8ca3f.desc: An enchanted-looking blade of unknown origins. It coats the skies and mind with pitch-black gloom — but inside the dark, there's a hint of blue moonlight.

5d19ff9a85411c44809aa834664dbb11.name: Scrap Pot VI
5d19ff9a85411c44809aa834664dbb11.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

d15dcf5a587e394b843c534f9085fa96.name: Deadeye Boots
d15dcf5a587e394b843c534f9085fa96.desc: These boots are perfect for keeping a stable stance while aiming, shooting, and killing.

52e3b3970b09014dabe25287f72041ce.name: Metal Wall Drain II
52e3b3970b09014dabe25287f72041ce.desc: This drain will remove any water above it. Can be placed on the wall.

c2fdb779b301444297a6f6f224fde196.name: Red Carpet Block
c2fdb779b301444297a6f6f224fde196.desc: Roll out the red carpet whenever you wish, and make your entrance in style.

f72083be514fca4ca6ba27547f377ad8.name: Right Cyclops Leg
f72083be514fca4ca6ba27547f377ad8.desc:
The right leg of a wild Cyclops. The skeletal remains are intact.

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.

d51073c12fa20f46b60a222c461b0639.name: Pink Lily Flower
d51073c12fa20f46b60a222c461b0639.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

299608baa068614fb4af065c47085042.name: Aureolin Flower Seedling
299608baa068614fb4af065c47085042.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

3bf1e0081931fb45a40f146f821d86b2.name: Tarred Bow
3bf1e0081931fb45a40f146f821d86b2.desc: This bow's natural resistance to fire makes it perfect for firing volleys of flaming arrows.

184eb754fc053f4ab45d82c062f7cdd0.name: Bloodfeather Chest
184eb754fc053f4ab45d82c062f7cdd0.desc: With this chest piece, you can cut through the woods with ease, remaining undetected as you prepare your next strike.

a9a74c99189a29438fdca1b0f665e9a6.name: Bamboo Boardwalk I
a9a74c99189a29438fdca1b0f665e9a6.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

7632abc037ebea4880bbb70d12a0ea8f.name: Banana Seedling
7632abc037ebea4880bbb70d12a0ea8f.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested repeatedly.

5e569bd2ead9ad4d9e025234f34f8826.name: Misfortune Mace
5e569bd2ead9ad4d9e025234f34f8826.desc: A frightening mace that brings misfortune to any that oppose it.

0484bee4f6a0d449a68b94468feafe96.name: Vorgoth's Soulbound Gloves
0484bee4f6a0d449a68b94468feafe96.desc: Overlapping scales of metal sheathe each finger. Flexible enough for a firm grip, heavy enough to crush.

920f37ddd495ed4db44aadd4c8041b1a.name: Pumpkin Soup
920f37ddd495ed4db44aadd4c8041b1a.desc: A tasty pumpkin soup. It's creamy and rich in flavor. It will also keep you warm. What's not to love?

f701dc3885e0464498ff5133c90db7b6.name: A Spiral Down, Down, Down
f701dc3885e0464498ff5133c90db7b6.desc:
A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home.

There are words written on the back:
"But from the depths of the Wells an unforeseen curse swept into Embervale."

A horrible nightmare of mine. I could not rest until I had put it to canvas... but now, I can't stand to look at it. -J

1a45f7b2f937fc48ab4493817ed09d8f.name: Darya's Wand
1a45f7b2f937fc48ab4493817ed09d8f.desc:
A wand that harnesses the power of the eclipse. It functions best when the sun is fully submerged in darkness, and only a faint rim of light shines through.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Ethereal Duplication:
The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

e5d17574cbc27f44950bf542dc24cdf8.name: Beastmaster Shaman Staff
e5d17574cbc27f44950bf542dc24cdf8.desc:
A wooden staff from which bioluminescent mushrooms sprout. In the hands of the Vukah, it holds the power to command beasts.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

182f943a54ef884c84a0882e1c477da7.name: Metal Water Dispenser II
182f943a54ef884c84a0882e1c477da7.desc: This item will dispense water endlessly until it is submerged.

5cb4220d190c6b49a7f140e9e38810b8.name: Bitter Harvest
5cb4220d190c6b49a7f140e9e38810b8.desc:
An unlikely trio — sulfur, thyme, and grandleaf cabbage creating something bold.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

fffcce175a56eb4883c652e92ed27a38.name: Cube 4m
fffcce175a56eb4883c652e92ed27a38.desc: This tool can only be used inside the building area around a Flame Altar. It can help you to quickly build your desired base with pre-defined structures.

c2bf2be9b717e64fb587cd1fbb975b0e.name: Bone Arrow
c2bf2be9b717e64fb587cd1fbb975b0e.desc:
An arrow made from bone.

The force of this arrow allows it to pierce hit targets to harm multiple foes.

62a9800c70be9047bb152d32915463a2.name: Trapdoor Wood 2m
62a9800c70be9047bb152d32915463a2.desc: This trap door might open unexpectedly beneath your feet. Watch your step!

4cb5ac4226476644b0651f6305d2e8cc.name: Rare Fishing Bait
4cb5ac4226476644b0651f6305d2e8cc.desc: This special mix drives rare fish wild and makes it easy for you to catch them.

a78fc2139ed32c42b5838946e5072627.name: One-Handed Melee Weapon Rack
a78fc2139ed32c42b5838946e5072627.desc: A display to showcase weapons or shields.

e2784b5b1bf0ba45887155693542236b.name: Brisk Bow
e2784b5b1bf0ba45887155693542236b.desc: Every true shot makes the blood pump faster.

21e6dbb3501c6643865333796d76599d.name: Herbalist Tunic
21e6dbb3501c6643865333796d76599d.desc: Classic herbalist garb with widened pockets for storing healing tinctures.

e5b2fc5ca25fdb4db29a4c52efb5d637.name: Small Flask
e5b2fc5ca25fdb4db29a4c52efb5d637.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1c4b36a038ede943ba2a706a32ea96d1.name: Grilled Shadowtail
1c4b36a038ede943ba2a706a32ea96d1.desc: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

118478d05f535849a60ce7b12a9de5bc.name: Large Water Wheel
118478d05f535849a60ce7b12a9de5bc.desc:
A large water wheel. It can be placed in water to generate force for a mill.

Must be placed near the mill.

27d7bb567b54734a8ab28b07624327d2.name: Metal Floor Drain II
27d7bb567b54734a8ab28b07624327d2.desc: This drain will remove any water above it. Can be placed on the floor.

0446ec6ba4281f448197633c372d107f.name: Gold Cyclops Trophy
0446ec6ba4281f448197633c372d107f.desc:
Possessing this trophy shows everyone that you are not on the Cyclops' menu — it's the other way around!

Collect multiple Cyclops Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

32562cb1880a3345ace5a112e08859f8.name: Eternal Heal Beam I
32562cb1880a3345ace5a112e08859f8.desc:
Releases an aimed mending ray that continuously heals allies within.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

2939b36b541ab54889a9e5ba1b1ebe91.name: Trap Fireball
2939b36b541ab54889a9e5ba1b1ebe91.desc:
A Trap Fireball which can be used as spell ammunition.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

0a7a807fedc40c4aa81807774286a069.name: Fae Deer Farmer Hood
0a7a807fedc40c4aa81807774286a069.desc: A fanciful hood with expressive animal ears and a draping cape. It's made from layers of faintly dotted fur and is well-suited for walking among the Fae Deer as a trusted friend and companion.

deb14612af297d4f8cbb7efac629f799.name: Crypt Bench
deb14612af297d4f8cbb7efac629f799.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

159cc3dea9048148972672ee8332f219.name: Vase Of The Ancients IV
159cc3dea9048148972672ee8332f219.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

51b1213ee268bc49afcb61786d41bb72.name: Raw Meat and Hazelnut Skewer
51b1213ee268bc49afcb61786d41bb72.desc:
A hearty feast that fortifies your body. 

Grilled over a fire, this skewer will increase your melee damage, boost your maximum health, and accelerate your health regeneration.

df63e0324c493f499d7412a8e204f774.name: Ring of Thundersnow
df63e0324c493f499d7412a8e204f774.desc:
Sometimes, when the tropical winds of the Veilwater Basin roll towards the cold air of the mountains, a thundersnow is born. 
The snowfall softens its roars, but it leaves traces in the freshly cracked surfaces of frozen ponds.

21a89f777047f84ba46eada4b6052c06.name: Boreal Wood Table
21a89f777047f84ba46eada4b6052c06.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4e48e6ee063d9e468d95ad2ccd68e5ae.name: Nova
4e48e6ee063d9e468d95ad2ccd68e5ae.desc: This sword, bright and blinding, erupts on the battlefield to unleash the original brilliance of the Flame.

c1b41c3f5ddcbb4ab4b6ef0634ba10dd.name: Vat II
c1b41c3f5ddcbb4ab4b6ef0634ba10dd.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4a44f329606e854190a9a367e3afb988.name: Loraine's Top
4a44f329606e854190a9a367e3afb988.desc: Loraine always liked to safekeep the bones she found on excavations personally, as they were too precious to entrust to anyone else.

4f22ad3de8bdc548b293ff47ef3980e0.name: Broken Guard Of The North Crown
4f22ad3de8bdc548b293ff47ef3980e0.desc:
The broken crown from a once-venerated Lord. It's in shambles, just like his sanity and legacy. 

It can be used to upgrade the Flame.

9f4625ba85916e45869eed58bba26481.name: Small Wall Mounted Silver Lamp
9f4625ba85916e45869eed58bba26481.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

ba5e424c6e2cd14da82e60ab12f4845f.name: Chain Lightning II
ba5e424c6e2cd14da82e60ab12f4845f.desc:
Releases a lightning strike at an enemy that can arc to multiple other nearby targets.
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. 

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

b487c906eab6c943a6264ab43286a559.name: Wall Sign
b487c906eab6c943a6264ab43286a559.desc: A wall sign that you can write on.

95c4f5f940e87b468bc4d0309bcd75c9.name: Ranger Hood
95c4f5f940e87b468bc4d0309bcd75c9.desc: A hood that provides additional protection from the sun, allowing you to focus your gaze undisturbed.

1380aaf23b85d04795b04a08baef918f.name: Mining Sieve
1380aaf23b85d04795b04a08baef918f.desc: A hand scraper and sieve that can be used to mine gold and other materials underwater.

c0b8d97591e94c4d88f0876635b8b245.name: Herbalist Gloves
c0b8d97591e94c4d88f0876635b8b245.desc: These fingerless gloves allow the wearer to feel each leaf and root before picking, allowing a proper assessment.

c3e8afcd4a3586408982c74f9cfabef7.name: Royal Crown
c3e8afcd4a3586408982c74f9cfabef7.desc: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.

c7ca6b0cdb044245a3991c8c66bb9421.name: Wooden Lavatory
c7ca6b0cdb044245a3991c8c66bb9421.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

851326caa69aa44f94c5cd28f0565669.name: Revelwood Dirt
851326caa69aa44f94c5cd28f0565669.desc:
A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. 

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

5fa44152793cba43a37a00dafc4189aa.name: Scorching Wand
5fa44152793cba43a37a00dafc4189aa.desc:
This wand practically vibrates with warmth and destructive energy. It becomes restless and twitchy when dormant for too long.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

bedef2e28be7f644804673d738905f64.name: Enshrouded Vulture Talon
bedef2e28be7f644804673d738905f64.desc:
A massive, razor-sharp talon.

Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.

0dfdd6a44872df4a822deea3acfdd21e.name: Summer Games Boots
0dfdd6a44872df4a822deea3acfdd21e.desc: A bandage wrap that lets your takeoff foot achieve maximum jump power. These light coverings make it easier to protect your soles from harm as you prepare to propel yourself through the air!

04e9c47970b94e4daa7b19d38d11a74d.name: Copper Fence
04e9c47970b94e4daa7b19d38d11a74d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4330ef90c48e6d49873755b2329baef3.name: Steep ramp 4m
4330ef90c48e6d49873755b2329baef3.desc: This tool can only be used inside the building area around a Flame Altar. It can help you to quickly build your desired base with pre-defined structures.

80b28d439c69754ab765031c60da9113.name: Ornate Handpan
80b28d439c69754ab765031c60da9113.desc: This handpan is a true rarity, ornamented with striking red tones.

b31fb816edba9842877fa45e4ec485ba.name: Curse Bringer Axe
b31fb816edba9842877fa45e4ec485ba.desc: Its maw is cradling a gem that glows as the curse is spoken, leaving foes weaker as it feeds itself.

a713342bd0edcb4ea847951476822f42.name: Quick Stack Station
a713342bd0edcb4ea847951476822f42.desc: Used to transfer items from your backpack to matching magic chest stacks nearby. Magic chests must be placed within a 16 m radius of this station.

7247bc626200ce4d92574e6503559125.name: Chondrite
7247bc626200ce4d92574e6503559125.desc: Chondrites are the most common kind of starfall. They look grainy and unremarkable, but they are older than the sun.

6698bf4f397d7344b3f1b9d03a55ca83.name: Metal Scraps
6698bf4f397d7344b3f1b9d03a55ca83.desc: Remains of metal, which was present to witness humanity's downfall. They might turn out to be useful.

57c9683ca2f0ec4eb3b403283f89acd1.name: Wildheart Gloves
57c9683ca2f0ec4eb3b403283f89acd1.desc: Find the foe's weakness, then aim, breathe, and shoot. Nothing can escape your arrows when the Flame lights their path.

bf001d520d9b084da98b54ab9e1c04e3.name: Meat and Corncob Skewer
bf001d520d9b084da98b54ab9e1c04e3.desc: With just some meat, a corncob, and a small fire, you can make this nutritious skewer anywhere and at any time.

b244f4092e2b1546b0d340120ab34629.name: Blood In The Snow
b244f4092e2b1546b0d340120ab34629.desc:
A song inspired by the unforgiving beauty of the North. Whenever fresh blood is spilled, snowflakes dance downwards from the skies to wash away the sanguine stain.

Music Sheet: 
Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

6b524716caefe747a67528aff8177f32.name: Scrap Pot III
6b524716caefe747a67528aff8177f32.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

9b9930411db80d49a3085af10f823d5f.name: Rooibos
9b9930411db80d49a3085af10f823d5f.desc: An interesting plant, stimulating every persons taste buds. The use in tea has established itself as a custom.

0ddeaf4f7003c946a6f56b7e202246e7.name: Cryptic Wand
0ddeaf4f7003c946a6f56b7e202246e7.desc:
A strange wand that was covered by ashes. Its body bends and twists, but never breaks.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

febfd403bdd923459be6f5e74b016309.name: Grilled Sunscale
febfd403bdd923459be6f5e74b016309.desc: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

f1d8e9f0f19a26448cdb5bbf1453fb32.name: Nameless One
f1d8e9f0f19a26448cdb5bbf1453fb32.desc: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.

6f38713d8b91834ea848b35e5c5b52e1.name: Jewelry Box
6f38713d8b91834ea848b35e5c5b52e1.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

84292cbc9e86ce40a6f9b8e611442832.name: Archaic Shards
84292cbc9e86ce40a6f9b8e611442832.desc: Jagged fragments of dense metal. Too irregular to smelt cleanly, too valuable to discard.

db8e61595cb7c94686ebb185433f108f.name: Fenrig's Axe
db8e61595cb7c94686ebb185433f108f.desc: An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.

3f2913ed3ae00d468edd646c25f8486a.name: Fell Striker Head
3f2913ed3ae00d468edd646c25f8486a.desc: The head of a Fell Striker. The eyes have been fully absorbed into fungal growth... so they're blinded by more than rage.

833ff8d30e35f143ab879744d09ac39b.name: Ancient Stool
833ff8d30e35f143ab879744d09ac39b.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

990e1b0323433249b586cdbaa2bdd8cf.name: High Ancient Temple Window Frame
990e1b0323433249b586cdbaa2bdd8cf.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

89b24dacf138dc46b8fbb88644dce443.name: Rogue Shield
89b24dacf138dc46b8fbb88644dce443.desc: A light shield that effortlessly allows the wearer to stay nimble whilst under fire.

6178b1be3e3c114293adca190305fe2b.name: Refined Stone Block
6178b1be3e3c114293adca190305fe2b.desc: A Refined Stone Block, that plastered countless aristocratic buildings back in the day.

62d080cf98e9684e8ee6e250d70f1031.name: Hailcaster Chest
62d080cf98e9684e8ee6e250d70f1031.desc: A carefully layered tunic, tied over the chest with gold string. The cloth is thick, but flowy. It will enable quick magical dashes while protecting you from the bitter cold.

6843abee23e5244bad89cd7e97a3c3f4.name: Bamboo Fence Pole
6843abee23e5244bad89cd7e97a3c3f4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

a2b8defcc9d7d5439d31cf955e19fdcc.name: Fish Fossil
a2b8defcc9d7d5439d31cf955e19fdcc.desc:
The fossilized remains of a lobe-finned fish. Descendants of this nocturnal drift-hunter were considered a delicacy and used to populate brooks and springs. However, consumption became impossible during the reign of the Shroud, as some fish developed new rows of rotting teeth and bit back.

This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.

56c7d8aa35b6b54d826f146cd5709fbd.name: Dragon Sword
56c7d8aa35b6b54d826f146cd5709fbd.desc: A mythical blade from long gone days. Legends say that it was passed on to Embervale by a wise spirit who descended from the stars in the year of the dragon.

d127b8b835256e47b02b3cf4502e7e20.name: Orange Floor Light I
d127b8b835256e47b02b3cf4502e7e20.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

cdfd9bfe5368d54db99211a8a610c99e.name: Crystal Jug
cdfd9bfe5368d54db99211a8a610c99e.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c69db05ea1727045b0477f8f43db0b7c.name: Candlelight Wand
c69db05ea1727045b0477f8f43db0b7c.desc:
It burns softly, just enough to brighten the dark hallways of forgotten archives. Riddles with lost answers, poems with rhymes that flutter and flee, and stories of unwritten ends reveal themselves before you. Keep their memory alive.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

aec138b4158dc44cbefc64ae40f13f7d.name: Pastel Yearwake
aec138b4158dc44cbefc64ae40f13f7d.desc:
Life still blooms everywhere around.

This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.

b12ff025d3999e459efd27e5f5f6d938.name: Rattlesnake Bow
b12ff025d3999e459efd27e5f5f6d938.desc: The bow curves into a zig-zag shape on both sides, capturing a vision of a rattlesnake's tail in motion.

8a0b9f673aa2c548a384926fa3dae3a7.name: A Distant Star
8a0b9f673aa2c548a384926fa3dae3a7.desc:
Surrounded by black sand and basalt stone, the darkness closes in — but it never wins. Sometimes it's a distant star on a starry night, other times it's a friendly face. There is always something. There is always light.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.

4b6b9f1c4630174da58362276407a0fc.name: Fine Wooden Fence
4b6b9f1c4630174da58362276407a0fc.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

14ead6ee61b92f45ab669dd5f5606e09.name: Bronze Scavenger Scattershot Trophy
14ead6ee61b92f45ab669dd5f5606e09.desc:
Looking at his teeth up close, you're almost grateful he stuck to throwing scrap.

Collect multiple Scavenger Scattershot Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

3bbb27b5cabd594bb4363358e4bef588.name: Tank Gloves
3bbb27b5cabd594bb4363358e4bef588.desc: Copper-plated gloves that protect the wearer's tender hands during a brawl.

21ee2092668c3f41ac6a047bafb229e1.name: Saturated Pink Hair
21ee2092668c3f41ac6a047bafb229e1.desc:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

120afdf988150c4e9c50ba01247818d7.name: Wooden Palisade VI
120afdf988150c4e9c50ba01247818d7.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

bde1f0d25e983b4bb6f41f0ba300a0fa.name: Wolf's Hydra
bde1f0d25e983b4bb6f41f0ba300a0fa.desc: A heavy club adorned with multiple wolf heads near the handle.

bb1a641e28971245a17ddcd6d57f0068.name: Polished Wooden Side Table
bb1a641e28971245a17ddcd6d57f0068.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

23671a4cf492ff4f99a6f838d3170c89.name: Strawberry
23671a4cf492ff4f99a6f838d3170c89.desc: A delicious aggregate-accessory fruit, predominantly found in the Revelwood.

34636605ffeb6e4ea7a6c5dc284904aa.name: Lightforged Daggers
34636605ffeb6e4ea7a6c5dc284904aa.desc:
Daggers that were bathed in sunlight during forging. Their spiked edge can cause a lot of damage!

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

246c0c357fdc0645803da912847b9348.name: Trilobites
246c0c357fdc0645803da912847b9348.desc:
Multiple ancient trilobites, perfectly still and preserved in a petrified coat of sediment.

This collectible is found in the Revelwood.

ffc6372a5e95a34ead35d953e28691fe.name: Reptile Hide
ffc6372a5e95a34ead35d953e28691fe.desc: The tough and scaly skin of a reptile.

b76053f3153ddf4388c8fd696e2593be.name: Sugar
b76053f3153ddf4388c8fd696e2593be.desc: The sugar rush powers your stamina regeneration for a short amount of time.

3fadee02c320504f88bd8cea3dc9ff15.name: Wall Tapestry III
3fadee02c320504f88bd8cea3dc9ff15.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

1728d93018fc9d4f9da01b0af6f1f243.name: Polymath's Wand
1728d93018fc9d4f9da01b0af6f1f243.desc:
A wand that especially talented scholars of the arcane forces favor. It's versatile and reflects the wielder's brilliance.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

58eedb1af7530b4cadf2b0e5479f1b8f.name: Bow Of The Serpent
58eedb1af7530b4cadf2b0e5479f1b8f.desc: A strong bow that frames each shot between two serpents' maws. Let your arrows strike with the calculated savagery of a viper in waiting!

054c40940a25144b8c16283c85391d16.name: Deerstalker Chest
054c40940a25144b8c16283c85391d16.desc: Every movement is softened and muted whilst clad in this upper body armor.

b346faaa5cec5442b9ef3d2af3afd7a8.name: Talion's Bow
b346faaa5cec5442b9ef3d2af3afd7a8.desc: A bow used by Commanders of the Northern Guard. A powerful energy flows through the user, increasing their pulse and allowing for faster shots.

1003590f05e4484894f050e06255883e.name: Lupa's Scalper
1003590f05e4484894f050e06255883e.desc: "Shadow Over Umber Hollow — Lupa" is etched on the side.

80ba6298dffc4243907a758ea6f30d74.name: Aurora Bean Rice
80ba6298dffc4243907a758ea6f30d74.desc: A colorful dish of rice, beans, and fresh vegetables. As nourishing as it is beautiful.

bc5d6dfc5dfdc34394202d0595e1d6e2.name: Small Stone Arc
bc5d6dfc5dfdc34394202d0595e1d6e2.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

e344a1fa9b924e488ce578065e2c0ef3.name: Large Crypt Door
e344a1fa9b924e488ce578065e2c0ef3.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

a21d5184cd8626439402e41f7a9945e6.name: Mystic Chest
a21d5184cd8626439402e41f7a9945e6.desc: An exquisite mystical coat made of fine, dyed material. The metal clasps alone are highly valuable.

cfa09cd09ee22b408164b1b690e90bf8.name: Rogue Trousers
cfa09cd09ee22b408164b1b690e90bf8.desc: The metal plates provide added protection against jagged or poisoned arrows.

724f45be8f7ddf49bc17eabcb06c1e63.name: Soldier Trousers
724f45be8f7ddf49bc17eabcb06c1e63.desc: Thick and reliable pants. Not very breathable, unfortunately.

e53eaf4e91c67b48adb90bd92f9284a6.name: Small Palm Wood Cabinet
e53eaf4e91c67b48adb90bd92f9284a6.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6356df6c63bebb4b8c418bf3987449a8.name: Iron Bench
6356df6c63bebb4b8c418bf3987449a8.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

a64e73fb5eb1654abaceb486e3aa7fa0.name: Harvest Festival
a64e73fb5eb1654abaceb486e3aa7fa0.desc:
A collection of bright oranges that exhibit a warm and inviting glow.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

b586728b575cd444a9ee4c7ec96aebf6.name: Soothsayer
b586728b575cd444a9ee4c7ec96aebf6.desc: A hammer adorned with an ancient petrified tusk. Tusks and teeth were used by the Vukah for mystical purposes.

64f685823941b741b6b52545aa783582.name: Bird Food Bait
64f685823941b741b6b52545aa783582.desc:
Food for attracting and taming a Flightless Redtail or a Round-Billed Sailer.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.

e6ff7a115cd85749b75a8fe62defdc2e.name: Wooden Side Table
e6ff7a115cd85749b75a8fe62defdc2e.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

da950b4bbe967642be706dcee302f71f.name: Underwater Mud
da950b4bbe967642be706dcee302f71f.desc: Soft, water-soaked mud, hauled up from the bottom of a lake or silent stream.

df0e00f445e8684691714aa5eb49d97e.name: Crude Wooden Fence III
df0e00f445e8684691714aa5eb49d97e.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c3b2663208d6d74297c80318cfa38b4a.name: Cooked Fae Deer Milk
c3b2663208d6d74297c80318cfa38b4a.desc: A delicious jug of Fae Deer milk. Drinking it will grant you endurance and recharge your stamina faster!

0b6572ddf9fe13428a8c012e29e8d128.name: Crypt Chair
0b6572ddf9fe13428a8c012e29e8d128.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

41a785d946a79e49b1972c14270c7250.name: Guardian Chestplate
41a785d946a79e49b1972c14270c7250.desc: Prodigious tin armor. The glistening sheen inspires hope.

05ef70e5d2580b40a72d999290ce2c9d.name: Milkmaid Garb
05ef70e5d2580b40a72d999290ce2c9d.desc: A grassy green dress for housekeeping or working on the farm.

eb0aaee23b40b64aacde6035bad52926.name: Shroud Weaver
eb0aaee23b40b64aacde6035bad52926.desc:
A malicious staff that effortlessly intertwines the strings of fate with the Shroud.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

91505e485b84324d95706ee059bfbe95.name: Medium Backpack
91505e485b84324d95706ee059bfbe95.desc: An extension to your backpack that enlarges your inventory by three rows.

8cb135e86be68f458deb7098c29342c4.name: Big Stone Statue "Sword"
8cb135e86be68f458deb7098c29342c4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

7e3eae811e1d6e47b0db7f4500c8ba64.name: Sword Of The Serpent
7e3eae811e1d6e47b0db7f4500c8ba64.desc: A glistening green blade, perfectly representing the aesthetics of the year of the serpent.

52d442bc37495d4cb3591fe8e69e0316.name: Adorned Drakling Daggers
52d442bc37495d4cb3591fe8e69e0316.desc:
Only Draklings skilled enough earn the right to wield these adorned daggers. They often remain a trusted weapon for a lifetime.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

55f07f764acd564297d7f1397fcac0ea.name: Dragonsbane
55f07f764acd564297d7f1397fcac0ea.desc:
An axe found atop the skull of a giant dragon skeleton. Legends say it was used to slay the mother dragon, but it wasn't lodged inside her cranium when you found it. 

That's probably for the best. Mothers have enough headaches already.

3f1271f11408c940ac4100c4b89dbcf2.name: Clay Vase III
3f1271f11408c940ac4100c4b89dbcf2.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

0202fb8336760a44be0af0c34b62104c.name: Gold Scavenger Scattershot Trophy
0202fb8336760a44be0af0c34b62104c.desc:
He spun, he threw his scrap balls, and drank his way through every fight he had. But in the end, none of it was enough. This trophy is proof of your victory.

Collect multiple Scavenger Scattershot Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

fd8888323f1f4c47a0e6c681f6f14333.name: Fertile Kindlewastes Sand
fd8888323f1f4c47a0e6c681f6f14333.desc:
A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. 

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

6a3b4f057dc4a646afce7fc141e53b87.name: Emerald Forest
6a3b4f057dc4a646afce7fc141e53b87.desc:
Lush and lively like the Nomad Highlands flora before the drought.

This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.

3be24ffc146661438fe533d702d4880d.name: Fossilized Bone Arrow
3be24ffc146661438fe533d702d4880d.desc: An arrow enhanced with pieces of Fossilized Bone. Strikingly beautiful and deadly.

84f35a4e4bebe445b5858fd5a740060a.name: Shroud Meteor Scroll
84f35a4e4bebe445b5858fd5a740060a.desc:
This scroll is enchanted with the power of the Shroud Meteor. 
It calls down a disastrous Shroud Meteor on up to five foes. 

Shroud Spell: This spell results in a debuff that reduces your Time in the Shroud.

332a280f05722240ba3bdfc37ec659ac.name: Green-Winged Orchid
332a280f05722240ba3bdfc37ec659ac.desc:
This color palette's combination of light green and vibrant purple takes inspiration from extinct orchids.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

f183097663efab46b251e218fa8a9eb4.name: Mana Drain I
f183097663efab46b251e218fa8a9eb4.desc:
Releases a continuous magical beam that leeches Mana from enemies without dealing damage to them.

Channel Spell:
Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.

cf24fe9a2b803141a2e5f5c25ff6f1d4.name: Blazing Wand
cf24fe9a2b803141a2e5f5c25ff6f1d4.desc:
A wand that deals significant fire damage, eradicating anything in its path.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

1b562a112d8c2041ac8e54aacb2183bd.name: Warrior Chest
1b562a112d8c2041ac8e54aacb2183bd.desc: Risky but agile upper body armor. At least your shoulders will be safe from harm with these impressive spaulders!

e4aa74d7f91f584c8e0793e4e98ffe8a.name: Blizzard I
e4aa74d7f91f584c8e0793e4e98ffe8a.desc:
Conjures a freezing storm that continuously deals damage to all enemies inside the area and applies a slow debuff to them.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

280f7cdccf380a4795b94de7d144659b.name: Graveyard Fence Pole
280f7cdccf380a4795b94de7d144659b.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c686ca018f8582409417a4f418988d71.name: Gleaming Staff
c686ca018f8582409417a4f418988d71.desc:
A magical staff that gleams with hope, able to unleash powerful magical attacks.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

c2b0f05cbf06b747b233638de933abc0.name: Assassin Boots
c2b0f05cbf06b747b233638de933abc0.desc: Your steps will be quick and quiet, and your strikes will be deadly.

a35d3b0b2b301d4d951ce634ccf069f8.name: Guardian Shield
a35d3b0b2b301d4d951ce634ccf069f8.desc: It's more than a shield — it's a bulwark of faith, a final sanctuary in the fray.

987f25aec5d6284bb36b2d6f24511e48.name: Shroud Infused Farm Soil
987f25aec5d6284bb36b2d6f24511e48.desc:
Shroud infused soil seems dangerous at first glance. However, when used in a controlled environment, it can create a potent bioactive environment that encourages rapid growth.

Drainage
This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.

679895c056faef40be31b25c63b3af19.name: Ancient Microscope I
679895c056faef40be31b25c63b3af19.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

5bbb71c539be594db994dce2113bb228.name: Dirt Road Block
5bbb71c539be594db994dce2113bb228.desc: A simple dirt road material that allows you to decorate your base with natural-looking paths.

bf6d90830bbee64b80f0052c6d59fa55.name: Trap Fireball
bf6d90830bbee64b80f0052c6d59fa55.desc:
A Trap Fireball which can be used as spell ammunition.

Spell Charges:
Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

f3a0db59b881c54a88d7ba97f4d2928c.name: Pickaxe
f3a0db59b881c54a88d7ba97f4d2928c.desc: A basic mining tool, made of the simplest of materials. It's not very durable or efficient, but it does what it's supposed to.

c291753d12b9644dadca587f31706b82.name: Veilwater Basin Sand
c291753d12b9644dadca587f31706b82.desc: A bright, silvery white sand that mostly consists of crushed seashells.

bb0326a183b2984788eb2015cb5b4a45.name: Fish Drying Rack
bb0326a183b2984788eb2015cb5b4a45.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

83cbce39f0e10f4c922725f171f32716.name: Scrap Pot I
83cbce39f0e10f4c922725f171f32716.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

46792f6e5ced5f4599df432d6de4b916.name: Warden Chestplate
46792f6e5ced5f4599df432d6de4b916.desc: An incredibly sturdy chest piece, often worn by generals or select members of the royal guard. It inspired fear as much as respect.

455cc078fa22694db2d8165ece741627.name: Guard of the North Pants
455cc078fa22694db2d8165ece741627.desc: Pants that were formerly worn by soldiers of Lord Vorgoth, oldest son to Queen Pikemead. Legends say he was consumed by the Shroud after the Ancients pushed him off Howling Peak's summit.

bf4edb0bc6df5f4fbec802b143186224.name: Exceptional Ring of Health
bf4edb0bc6df5f4fbec802b143186224.desc: This ring will increase your health and healing rate.

28d17db0f827dd4b8549e6683f2a7892.name: Wooden Window Frame
28d17db0f827dd4b8549e6683f2a7892.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

07f700288d8a664bbfac447c800983a6.name: Paper Reed
07f700288d8a664bbfac447c800983a6.desc: These paper reed fibers can be used in many crafting recipes just like other plant fibers.

88e5c1d53dd8e2408c864514bbd7f751.name: Cinder's Cradle Rubble
88e5c1d53dd8e2408c864514bbd7f751.desc: A mix of different biome-specific materials, mainly stone and dirt.

59959776eff8be4cbe9132cd2f105f92.name: Healer Pants
59959776eff8be4cbe9132cd2f105f92.desc: Woven pants which keep the wearer from scraping their knees.

57f805f58182874a9971f83585879424.name: Rust And Rose
57f805f58182874a9971f83585879424.desc:
This color palette blends muted orange, soft mauve, and earthy brown into a palette that feels both weathered and graceful — like warmth preserved in fading light. 

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

4e399330b389b349ad3f42c43276c0ec.name: Enshrouded Oil
4e399330b389b349ad3f42c43276c0ec.desc: Its uses are unknown even to the creator itself, but it definitely didn't help the skin of the Fell!

aa0a0b3077ccd3408c68b5ad9b230ee2.name: Skull Summoning Vessel I
aa0a0b3077ccd3408c68b5ad9b230ee2.desc: Throw this mystical vessel to temporarily summon a skull companion.

c1a5f78b3e19f44fa33a03c4663a101c.name: Royal Gloves
c1a5f78b3e19f44fa33a03c4663a101c.desc: These gloves are a bit stiff and barely functional. The most important thing is that they look impressive to peasants. You won't need to do manual labor, anyway.

637ddbd61cccc8418b48ec7df82cca93.name: Bamboo Ladder
637ddbd61cccc8418b48ec7df82cca93.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

100bdad0adc7a941a4bfd534599b5a0c.name: Red Marble Block
100bdad0adc7a941a4bfd534599b5a0c.desc: This block, made from polished red marble fragments, has a mysterious yet graceful look.

357df583c190994eb6cf1ba73b150fc7.name: Large Ancient Arc
357df583c190994eb6cf1ba73b150fc7.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

7257ead3868c9440bcd557198b0ad5b3.name: Emberguard Shield
7257ead3868c9440bcd557198b0ad5b3.desc: An agile shield that feels as though it could be used well offensively. Three small dots adorn its heart, representing humanity, the Ancients, and the Flameborn between.

58b8962a2d8d6445bc8593ea79851c0e.name: Eternal Ember Arrow I
58b8962a2d8d6445bc8593ea79851c0e.desc:
An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's blazing hot.

Eternal Arrow: Does not deplete Ammo per use. Equip the Eternal Arrow and use Mana to shoot it with a Bow.

473d6dded3da1b4bbe03afd9e382c261.name: Goo
473d6dded3da1b4bbe03afd9e382c261.desc: A sticky paste used to bind chemical substances.

8788c9992d93ea46a3cb76ef1bfc292a.name: Medium Crypt Table
8788c9992d93ea46a3cb76ef1bfc292a.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

9177b2cdaa4f734c93be56dbd6e790f1.name: Brazen Bull Gloves
9177b2cdaa4f734c93be56dbd6e790f1.desc: Catching a backhand from these spiked gloves will bring even the most vigilant attacker to their knees.

d5470962da2cc9469aacbd2d46f5a35e.name: Hophare Pillow
d5470962da2cc9469aacbd2d46f5a35e.desc: A cosy pillow with a Hophare design on it. The animal looks so lively that you think it may leap from the fabric at any moment!

3b28056f3da76f418ff51c6cf6a70bf6.name: Corrosive Daggers
3b28056f3da76f418ff51c6cf6a70bf6.desc:
These blades were corroded by being submerged in poison for too long.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

5517a0e570010247887f6d9fc4dd1d16.name: Eternal Giant Bone Arrow II
5517a0e570010247887f6d9fc4dd1d16.desc:
An eternal bone arrow that's overgrown with green crystals.

Eternal Arrow: Does not deplete Ammo per use. Equip the Eternal Arrow and use Mana to shoot it with a Bow.

5899b9aeda380940a50230fb564c0947.name: Wooden Palisade II
5899b9aeda380940a50230fb564c0947.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

5899d3af64e7e54290c37ad161008508.name: Frost Wand
5899d3af64e7e54290c37ad161008508.desc:
A wand that focuses the wielder's power through a frozen crystal. Magical energy is refracted inside and amplified with every reflection.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

65730ac90cc85f489e55fa5c531ac015.name: Oven
65730ac90cc85f489e55fa5c531ac015.desc: This significant upgrade to the Cooking Station offers new food options that can be cooked passively.

88882abd6bfee24aa6dcbe160baf62e1.name: Large Round Polished Window Frame
88882abd6bfee24aa6dcbe160baf62e1.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4c0bc0b1c43074418d023da46bc2a075.name: Undergrowth Staff
4c0bc0b1c43074418d023da46bc2a075.desc:
A staff that absorbs energy from the soil. It's brimming with potential.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

7219f05d6ea4fa44b705591323738ce3.name: Mothling Hood
7219f05d6ea4fa44b705591323738ce3.desc: A hood with a striking pair of plumose antennae. It keeps you warm and safe while wandering at night, and perhaps the antennae will help you find what you desire — or what you really need.

1438fdf04c509e41bdccb26553e13f1d.name: Red Marble Fragment
1438fdf04c509e41bdccb26553e13f1d.desc: This simple fragment can be processed into a stunning Red Marble Block.

5b20fef7f20d1e4f9be5e94758ee24a2.name: Big Coffin
5b20fef7f20d1e4f9be5e94758ee24a2.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

afd74a95d9152943b3e1eba8fc6f6336.name: Staff Of Reeds
afd74a95d9152943b3e1eba8fc6f6336.desc:
The mandibles of the staff open towards the skies like a snapjaw's maw, looking to drag prey down to the depths of the moor... Powerful magic cast through this weapon can damn anyone to darkness.

Spellcasting: 
Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

b838a055d7f0a94b93c750d204f385f8.name: Veilwater Basin Boardwalk I
b838a055d7f0a94b93c750d204f385f8.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

acf0eb218bd2f248b0d0a5413ed20251.name: Blood Rose Boots
acf0eb218bd2f248b0d0a5413ed20251.desc: Click-clack, click-clack — You hear the sound of her raised heel from a mile away, piercing the ground with unyielding staccato. As her steps quicken, so does your breath. Do not get caught in her path.

4fb6ae87896c2f4682161bd13c76731a.name: Clay Vase II
4fb6ae87896c2f4682161bd13c76731a.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

9d5dd70b917c3f4f8f0f0e2bbc3189ee.name: Medium Hollow's Eve Pumpkin III
9d5dd70b917c3f4f8f0f0e2bbc3189ee.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

4daebdae8854564bbbbd10504aecda1e.name: Astrodome Shield
4daebdae8854564bbbbd10504aecda1e.desc: A convex shield, held by a bold yet delicate golden frame. Its design appears to be derived from the visual language and construction of telescopic lenses or compasses. Beneath the frame lies a faint constellation whose name and origin are unknown.

fd900b53b217de468a8bd8e241663e3a.name: Herbalist Pants
fd900b53b217de468a8bd8e241663e3a.desc: Some plain herbalist pants. They smell like rosemary and thyme.

34b1f6e8df73414dbb0dbe60a1bbfef9.name: Carved Limestone Vase III
34b1f6e8df73414dbb0dbe60a1bbfef9.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

b2f7c65438cb5c4ba0ba8fc1d6f3598e.name: Dog Food
b2f7c65438cb5c4ba0ba8fc1d6f3598e.desc:
Nutritious Dog food for tame pets.

It must be placed inside the appropriate feeder.

c2d70060fd95cc4e84752b67cb2197dd.name: Large Quick Stack Station
c2d70060fd95cc4e84752b67cb2197dd.desc: Used to transfer items from your backpack to matching magic chest stacks nearby. Magic chests must be placed within a 24 m radius of this station.

02eb1cc3a2d28b4da71528800654ea3e.name: Protector Greatsword
02eb1cc3a2d28b4da71528800654ea3e.desc: Girdles and cloth wrap tightly around the hilt, proposing the story of an unlikely protector having to adjust the grip on the weapon spontaneously.

2c672a2bc1455544863e27756a45a3ad.name: Crackling Wand
2c672a2bc1455544863e27756a45a3ad.desc:
Fire proves to be an excellent weapon against creatures of the Shroud. 

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

1a3eb78fce875c41959344b9d6791417.name: Greater Antidote
1a3eb78fce875c41959344b9d6791417.desc:
An improved antidote that will cure poisoning upon use.

Also applies a buff that prevents the player from poisoning.

4e9ead14a0d03043b7ad23173bb3fcac.name: By The Riverside
4e9ead14a0d03043b7ad23173bb3fcac.desc:
A music sheet for a song that bestows a minor boost in morale.

Music Sheet: 
Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.

b2d8d1de3c09cb4eab525dd781469270.name: Hunter Hood
b2d8d1de3c09cb4eab525dd781469270.desc: Remain unseen and strike from the shadows with this formidable archer's hood.

35e215fc4e65214e84048298badc8508.name: Cactus Seedling
35e215fc4e65214e84048298badc8508.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.

e493c0dcba0fca4c9d18466ac38ee48f.name: Spider Web I
e493c0dcba0fca4c9d18466ac38ee48f.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

7890be5338062a408d1c8cbb4355ee59.name: Pillbug
7890be5338062a408d1c8cbb4355ee59.desc: A little pillbug, also called a roly-poly. It can be found in the Albaneve Summits and used as fishing bait, especially popular among rare fish.

3a36a478f89e694bbcda4b723d5099f7.name: Chamomile Plant
3a36a478f89e694bbcda4b723d5099f7.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

eda1c7354663a3409f2de7220f8427cf.name: Sigil Ring of the Elder Guard
eda1c7354663a3409f2de7220f8427cf.desc: "Captain Arkwright" is engraved in the metal. Given to the most loyal commanders.

ae93403fed755d4ebd0b784ba83b88f5.name: Wood Logs
ae93403fed755d4ebd0b784ba83b88f5.desc: The byproducts of felling a tree. Just be careful that it doesn't fall on your head!

9f7d9157fce16c4fb0ca261d539e7e62.name: Grilled Whiskerfin
9f7d9157fce16c4fb0ca261d539e7e62.desc: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

95fbc14e5ad560498498c569021745f8.name: Bow Of The Serpent
