ac1f35239e7d4742815b30157144b580.desc: With the farmer’s guidance, you can prepare refined meals at this kitchen station.

8e6b87248ef87540b4236c2f0ed2a187.name: Rogue Boots
8e6b87248ef87540b4236c2f0ed2a187.desc: Adventurers who wear these fearsome boots should not be messed with.

f0fe477f8e6cbe47943e09c5571945a0.name: Fake Basement Door
f0fe477f8e6cbe47943e09c5571945a0.desc: Fool others looking for hidden passages in your base with this fake secret door.

04cb7c034d71934eb9150565a11579ac.name: Tome of the First Flameborn
04cb7c034d71934eb9150565a11579ac.desc:
A gilded tome, emblazoned with a large "E". It tells the story of the original Flameborn and how they shaped Embervale as we know it.

Every river or peak, ruin and castle, fight and fable was crafted with their support, and in their honor. Our world would not exist without them.

The last words on the final page simply read "Thank you for everything."

ba21f555f8f5d249a54066c0274b4e5e.name: Ground Coffee Beans
ba21f555f8f5d249a54066c0274b4e5e.desc: Ground coffee beans, ready to be brewed into an energizing cup of coffee!

f7488c98397ec74ba08669b3d0d34f7b.name: Charcoal Kiln
f7488c98397ec74ba08669b3d0d34f7b.desc: A tool to create various coal related items from wood.

1343cd3e7d1fc5438386dac6c486ab67.name: Round Sea Urchin
1343cd3e7d1fc5438386dac6c486ab67.desc:
Globular and small, this sea urchin looks unassuming. A keen eye, however, will notice the fivefold symmetry.

This collectible is found in the Springlands.

9e4d299195b2334285cbda06dba89969.name: White Wolf Sword
9e4d299195b2334285cbda06dba89969.desc: This sword slices through the air like a sharp howl at midnight.

f6c4686adb375d4c937957b1caa2d718.name: Rising Fighter Boots
f6c4686adb375d4c937957b1caa2d718.desc: Footwork is the most important skill of swordsmanship. These boots should make learning the first steps easier.

23e42b958435354a996602f8dc0c7c51.name: Wooden Palisade VIII
23e42b958435354a996602f8dc0c7c51.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

8cc95ee60427874f92d0c5de3070fb5b.name: Ezramin's Courage
8cc95ee60427874f92d0c5de3070fb5b.desc:
"It's not right to leave humanity behind. Their world is ours. I feel, no, I know that this is my home. Stars be damned — Let's fight for Embervale!"

- Ezramin

77a8dad3c261864ab9ab673a5d6d31f8.name: Cyclops Trophy
77a8dad3c261864ab9ab673a5d6d31f8.desc: A severed Cyclops Head, still wearing a helmet, although that's hardly needed now.

11ea359732ba92409c6f4ebc1f123be5.name: Plantain Curry
11ea359732ba92409c6f4ebc1f123be5.desc: A creamy curry made from plantain, rice, coconut milk, and vegetables. It's tart, earthy, and quite filling.

f7294d3e07f4ff41a28cd93659882ee1.name: Bronze Hollow Titan Trophy
f7294d3e07f4ff41a28cd93659882ee1.desc:
The Bronze Hollow Titan Head carries a warm, dull sheen into your home.

Collect multiple Hollow Titan Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

bc1823a6c1e39f4197fa5ad105bbb2fe.name: Sparkworks Workbench
bc1823a6c1e39f4197fa5ad105bbb2fe.desc: The Sparkworks Workbench allows you to craft multiple logic tools like levers or light switches that can be edited with the Sparkworks Tool.

e167aa0d684fdd46aa27eb65ac19d862.name: Calla Luna Plant
e167aa0d684fdd46aa27eb65ac19d862.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

bfc34b6a10569d4fa2dc872b9de035ac.name: Yellow Glow Soup
bfc34b6a10569d4fa2dc872b9de035ac.desc: It tastes a bit bitter, but is known to increase mana, mana regeneration and magic damage. What a magical soup!

be82d6f5779f0740971a4ebdd8c0583a.name: Soldier Chestplate
be82d6f5779f0740971a4ebdd8c0583a.desc: This regal soldier's armor symbolizes chivalry, glory, and valor.

bd2028ffd38a584086cedd166a53b9d8.name: Grilled Waveleaper
bd2028ffd38a584086cedd166a53b9d8.desc: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

3511355b743b1040a53bfe9e948a10d1.name: Dune Armadillo
3511355b743b1040a53bfe9e948a10d1.desc: This species constantly regenerates its outer shell, allowing for the collection of scales.

46cf267c980fa74e8072666a6bb3e318.name: Axe Of Deimos
46cf267c980fa74e8072666a6bb3e318.desc: An axe named after a small moon that orbits a red planet, tirelessly drifting through the void... somewhere far, far away from the valleys you call home.

7ff4c4c01f1ebf49ad025198e6434c46.name: Siren Seeker Headband
7ff4c4c01f1ebf49ad025198e6434c46.desc: Fashioned from a piece of fishing net and seaborn trinkets. It keeps the hair out of your face while you dive.

6a349341c54ce346a2da81b959a75531.name: Draconian Bow
6a349341c54ce346a2da81b959a75531.desc: Crafted to resemble the wings of the most infamous Kindlewastes dwellers, the Draconian Vulture.

08f0a1513000dd4e95e5f4cb8ef5b789.name: Verily Verdant
08f0a1513000dd4e95e5f4cb8ef5b789.desc:
Abundant like clover fields, yet mysterious like wild ivy scaling a wizard's tower. 

This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.

1e91a9b6697bd84f9d7de8a0106c819f.name: Hawk Gloves
1e91a9b6697bd84f9d7de8a0106c819f.desc: Reliable gloves which shield the wearer's arms from claws.

2575475efcdf9547bf357d1bcc0ac9c0.name: Scrappy Axe
2575475efcdf9547bf357d1bcc0ac9c0.desc: An axe made out of scrap metal with improved durability and efficiency compared to the Axe.

03b731d47c7d6e419d30f5c914857b69.name: Cutthroat Helmet
03b731d47c7d6e419d30f5c914857b69.desc: A darkened hood which lets you blend into the woodland scenery more easily. A piece of red cloth covers the mouth, making you feel like a bandit.

9d2f27182100494197764cfcdf2394a9.name: Hardwood
9d2f27182100494197764cfcdf2394a9.desc: This especially tough wood could cause much damage if it hits your head while you fell trees.

1080fa9a4d39ab4288501b80723703d7.name: Eternal Ice Bolt I
1080fa9a4d39ab4288501b80723703d7.desc:
Conjures an icy projectile that deals damage in an area and applies a slow debuff.

Eternal Spell: 
Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

2387cc0f6811924c89c155787f3e9512.name: Skull Stalker Helmet
2387cc0f6811924c89c155787f3e9512.desc: Pierce your foes through the heart — using your horns isn’t necessary.

b0fe32ac917b9341a2e0de7fe628fb47.name: Heart's Desire
b0fe32ac917b9341a2e0de7fe628fb47.desc:
Burning reds, crimson as a passionate kiss — or the blood of a weeping heart, pierced by a lance.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

af8a335eaa96434ca1c82c3dfd7e8edb.name: Scavenger Matron Helmet
af8a335eaa96434ca1c82c3dfd7e8edb.desc: She is less fearsome without her helmet. The acidic scent lingers, however.

f082c331da66ea4a85f02fbcefd580d0.name: Gloom Monarch Boots
f082c331da66ea4a85f02fbcefd580d0.desc: These boots seemingly once belonged to a ruler whose name has been lost to time. It faded into oblivion, leaving only a title and a lingering curse.

9ce9278fdbb3b340bf73c8dde9ec6efc.name: "Cowlick" Wig Head
9ce9278fdbb3b340bf73c8dde9ec6efc.desc: A wig head that unlocks more haircuts once picked up. It can also be placed in your base as decoration.

da12f757d35a314bb7000f5761472b5e.name: Cinder's Cradle Sand
da12f757d35a314bb7000f5761472b5e.desc: Fine, dark sand found along volcanic shorelines.

7bb1252b9963cb4eb6ec2e2b2618e221.name: Waggon
7bb1252b9963cb4eb6ec2e2b2618e221.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

0d44ff1a902e0445ab86ef86bb8b1c15.name: Revelwood Miniature Piece
0d44ff1a902e0445ab86ef86bb8b1c15.desc:
A miniature piece that shows the Revelwood, part of Meldore. It used to be a vibrant area where the rivers flowed with wine, and the trees would shade the weary. Eventually, though, abuse of the Elixir spread, and the roots that once brought life to the Kingdom began to rot.

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.

51babb6f143c004686ccbb2d2b40bb36.name: Large Salon Mirror
51babb6f143c004686ccbb2d2b40bb36.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

13a8577416717f46b37c4e3a8b3a322c.name: Wood Planks
13a8577416717f46b37c4e3a8b3a322c.desc: Planks created by cutting Wood Logs into shape. Very useful for building.

1d737d75066d654e8e13fd9a39d11f37.name: Polished Wooden Throne
1d737d75066d654e8e13fd9a39d11f37.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

d8dde8b9a1656b45bb91c3d605be2c6f.name: Fireblood
d8dde8b9a1656b45bb91c3d605be2c6f.desc: Red-hot fire runs through its veins, illuminating the hammer from within.

b0c08295e5f615429e0838df4a61f4c7.name: Fish Cutlet
b0c08295e5f615429e0838df4a61f4c7.desc: Fish cut into thick slices, be aware of the bones, but you can still enjoy it.

b7423595473b6e458ac3005061d9aed0.name: Skull Splitter Axe
b7423595473b6e458ac3005061d9aed0.desc: The Skull Splitter gets its name from its merciless nature — cleaving skulls with every swing.

2f989815089e3349ac447bf7a7aff100.name: Standing Torch
2f989815089e3349ac447bf7a7aff100.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

a072a51aec74534fb168e4020724c1ee.name: Firefly Lamp
a072a51aec74534fb168e4020724c1ee.desc:
An illumination  item that can be placed in your home.

Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.

445d80901e54a749ba8239253ca51953.name: Fossil Showcase (2 Small Slots)
445d80901e54a749ba8239253ca51953.desc: This is a showcase for Fossil Collection Items usually found in quarries, material veins, or dig sites.

a577a03b2bc44e4dbb7cf5d54b8e9a6e.name: Breaching Bow
a577a03b2bc44e4dbb7cf5d54b8e9a6e.desc: A bow that breaches all — flesh, scales, borders. Nothing can withstand its might.

6e6046daa36c524eb747b65cbc8b78f4.name: Large Chondrite
6e6046daa36c524eb747b65cbc8b78f4.desc: Chondrites are the most common kind of starfall. They look grainy and unremarkable, but they are older than the sun.

ed5464f7ab02e74b815329ab8de91456.name: Small Bamboo Window II
ed5464f7ab02e74b815329ab8de91456.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

58d01f7306fe34458c81e270db406fae.name: Nomad Highlands Bone Key
58d01f7306fe34458c81e270db406fae.desc:
Opens doors in the Nomad Highlands Hollow Halls.

Some chests in the Hollow Halls require Ectoplasm to be opened — collect enough on your descent! 
Also make sure to save some Ectoplasm for crafting Bone Keys.

320233a979456d49b4dd0a0187ee0211.name: Plough
320233a979456d49b4dd0a0187ee0211.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

c17fe05719a9ff4ab30fe1b5e31e7951.name: Hailscourge
c17fe05719a9ff4ab30fe1b5e31e7951.desc: A blade that's cold to the touch. It weighs heavily on the mind.

9ba2d4969d00aa4e971dfd207fb02079.name: One-Handed Melee Weapon Wall Mount
9ba2d4969d00aa4e971dfd207fb02079.desc: A display to showcase weapons or shields.

b70433090420dd41897161aeb3f15cc9.name: Big Coffin Lid
b70433090420dd41897161aeb3f15cc9.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

6217cde55ef6694ebff07bc05ddb58c9.name: Daggers Of Liquid Light
6217cde55ef6694ebff07bc05ddb58c9.desc:
The blades thicken and slim periodically in subtle waves, as if they were forged from pure, liquid light. Be careful not to blind yourself when wielding these in battle!

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

050f2bf60a87af47bf90babe3fb7cd14.name: Flag Pole III
050f2bf60a87af47bf90babe3fb7cd14.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

ad653ee4d6241e4f8c760270ef5ab0c6.name: Large Backpack
ad653ee4d6241e4f8c760270ef5ab0c6.desc: An extension to your backpack that enlarges your inventory by four rows.

ff4b7cdd6723d740bce1d7a023440b0e.name: Glass Shards
ff4b7cdd6723d740bce1d7a023440b0e.desc: Glass broken into pieces offers many sharp edges used to enhance weapons.

5d0bf1bc267cd740894d37b45f47c5d8.name: Thaumaturge Pants
5d0bf1bc267cd740894d37b45f47c5d8.desc: This pair of pants has significant padding on the inside, allowing you to travel for longer periods in frost-ridden lands. Traditionally, hides from the wearer's spirit animal are used to create the padding, but wool will do in a pinch.

1eb8f9890e5f1242819983927efcb89b.name: Straw Roof Block
1eb8f9890e5f1242819983927efcb89b.desc: Used to build thatched roofs. A basic and reliable solution to protect yourself from the elements.

4fafe253746dd546a027ece3e6e28d06.name: Flute
4fafe253746dd546a027ece3e6e28d06.desc: A flute carved from bone. You can use it to make music.

cee6b5858a4a8441af6e2ec5adffa62b.name: Twisting Wand
cee6b5858a4a8441af6e2ec5adffa62b.desc:
Fires a projectile that deals Shroud damage.

Ethereal Duplication:
The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

7e209211ef145c4bb3b1e9fda67435df.name: Crude Wooden Table
7e209211ef145c4bb3b1e9fda67435df.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

3c13e35f7c104b48ae38c446a33e3753.name: Winterly Boots
3c13e35f7c104b48ae38c446a33e3753.desc: A pair of comfortable boots perfect for snow days.

4f90c9241ec3ca48a8d5d52303012397.name: Artificer's Gloves
4f90c9241ec3ca48a8d5d52303012397.desc: Refined gloves that offer both protection and maneuverability for the fingers. Wearing them makes one feel as though they can work with utmost precision and concentration.

39b788bbf6af9c439939dbce3ac1ce73.name: Fish Poison Gland
39b788bbf6af9c439939dbce3ac1ce73.desc: Potent in small doses. A staple ingredient for poison-based concoctions.

682db414063f8447a0670c75b3e4dcd8.name: Chanterelle Seedling
682db414063f8447a0670c75b3e4dcd8.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

79cb7424f742bc449344eb791d20a6d8.name: Sacrificial Vukah Dagger
79cb7424f742bc449344eb791d20a6d8.desc:
A crude dagger, previously used by a Vukah in a bloody ritual.

Riposte Kick:
Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. 
It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

9201739455177d4a898f027863ed2b9e.name: Elder Hat
9201739455177d4a898f027863ed2b9e.desc: The past, present, and future all unfold in front of your eyes like blooming aureolins when observed through this helmet.

4b74251cd274794f92114ef2b30dfe7a.name: Veil Of Blues
4b74251cd274794f92114ef2b30dfe7a.desc:
The Veilwater Basin is rich in vibrant colors. The blue sky reflecting in the clear waters — and at night, the waters glow faintly, as if holding onto the memory of the day’s colors.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

72d4655a86fe1841af817de868abd43c.name: Granite Throne
72d4655a86fe1841af817de868abd43c.desc:
A decorative item that can be placed in any building.
Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

14f368ee3253784caaefb5f1067f668d.name: Sandstone Fence Pole
14f368ee3253784caaefb5f1067f668d.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

7e012d9f95c5934383bbf7ba02636f4f.name: Pikemead Statue Showcase
7e012d9f95c5934383bbf7ba02636f4f.desc: Use this showcase to reassemble the Queen Pikemead statue.

2059d8993d11674ebf1c0a6e552b3e49.name: Prismatic Ward
2059d8993d11674ebf1c0a6e552b3e49.desc: A ward that refracts all incoming light. Some say it creates a colorful prismatic effect when the conditions are right.

5297f9616059d24ab775835137ce80ce.name: Taro Plant
5297f9616059d24ab775835137ce80ce.desc: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.

330c36a32af9f64089026c910f722469.name: Big Ammonite
330c36a32af9f64089026c910f722469.desc:
An impressively big ammonite fossil. The remains of this marine cephalopod once housed a large, tentacled, sea-bound creature. In Embervale superstition, every identifiable rim extending from the spiral's core is said to bestow a day of good luck.

This collectible is found in the Springlands.

b1196b081818a942a432b289a57c6264.name: Warlock Gloves
b1196b081818a942a432b289a57c6264.desc: Both spells and smiting blows are easily dealt with these marvelous warlock gloves.

c9c9c94bf1397b4baaef0d096a90ce39.name: Collection Of Books I
c9c9c94bf1397b4baaef0d096a90ce39.desc: What is better than one book?

a1c6a91ca83cfa46ad9a8377722bd916.name: Flax Seedling
a1c6a91ca83cfa46ad9a8377722bd916.desc: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

dd4e19ed9a48854ca2a1fcfb856a7412.name: Blackmire Miniature Piece
dd4e19ed9a48854ca2a1fcfb856a7412.desc:
A piece of the Blackmire, the long-forgotten woods. While there are no human settlements here, it is absolutely teeming with life... and mystery.

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.

0c0eb684806c7b409789cce2331fa066.name: Fell Sicklescythe Head
0c0eb684806c7b409789cce2331fa066.desc: There's still a faint glow behind its eyes. Hopefully, they won't follow your every move.

6fc5481860f4204fba89656b979372b3.name: Two-Handed Melee Weapon Rack
6fc5481860f4204fba89656b979372b3.desc: A display to showcase weapons or shields.

1802078ae930c54b86c0359adcb38fb6.name: Clay Vase I
1802078ae930c54b86c0359adcb38fb6.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

af73c72280d24442ba3ab229bdb00213.name: Pearlbloom Nectar
af73c72280d24442ba3ab229bdb00213.desc: A refined nectar pressed from Prickle Pearl and Bloomheart Fruit. It tingles on the tongue before settling into a smooth, soothing sweetness.

4f521b82bfb65548a61d25fc21c2f782.name: Red Flower
4f521b82bfb65548a61d25fc21c2f782.desc: A potted plant to beautify your home.

5c872f2c54e0f543afe68d3e8d517fc9.name: Bird Food
5c872f2c54e0f543afe68d3e8d517fc9.desc:
Nutritious bird food for tame animals on your farm. It can be fed to both Flightless Redtails and Round-Billed Sailers.

It must be placed inside the appropriate feeder.

ef24c1cc07f0fe4c9e0d9696b4e6d141.name: Shroud Vapor
ef24c1cc07f0fe4c9e0d9696b4e6d141.desc: A potent base for crafting potions of various kinds.

7cbea4611c6a3d4a951fb7a8b4eb311f.name: Yellow Flower
7cbea4611c6a3d4a951fb7a8b4eb311f.desc: A tiny potted plant to beautify your home.

dafb9438a76a834daffad78685355713.name: Ashwind Strider Pants
dafb9438a76a834daffad78685355713.desc: Airy, slightly billowing pants that allow the wearer to feel the heat of the wind.

b9d8f650075b5b4fb35cd54bd2a315d2.name: Tomato
b9d8f650075b5b4fb35cd54bd2a315d2.desc: A red and juicy Tomato! If handled with care, it can have enhancing effects.

0e7228365ac34a4b8064ba3abaafd294.name: Poison Gland
0e7228365ac34a4b8064ba3abaafd294.desc: The source of the dangerous Poison.

e46dd762ed92ac45a3380133f9e7e252.name: Medium Backpack
e46dd762ed92ac45a3380133f9e7e252.desc:
An extension to your backpack that enlarges your inventory by two rows. 

Outdated
This item is of an old design. Visit your craftsmen to find an improved version of the backpack with an additional row.

66e74c1677423d42b36bd07a4aee4bdc.name: Alpine Antler Gloves
66e74c1677423d42b36bd07a4aee4bdc.desc: A pair of thick gloves, stuffed with warm, white fur. The area around the back of the wrist is shielded with a small metal plate.

49bc0414e96ff040bee5330d0408e870.desc:
An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

5b9d85d748717740a13d55c345b6ec9b.name: Frostbite Slasher Boots
5b9d85d748717740a13d55c345b6ec9b.desc: Heavy boots with metal caps, perfect for kicking down doors or crushing skulls under your heel.

158e313ff9bc534098cc0baf1a288bd4.name: Clay Vase V
158e313ff9bc534098cc0baf1a288bd4.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

9a58e13188a40843b449595d27db12c0.name: Darya's Wand
9a58e13188a40843b449595d27db12c0.desc:
A wand that harnesses the power of the eclipse. It functions best when the sun is fully submerged in darkness, and only a faint rim of light shines through.

Overcharge:
This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

Ethereal Duplication:
The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile.

Multishot: 
Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

92a42db8c1aa88439c672c1d8abf7997.name: Bamboo Fence With Ropes II
92a42db8c1aa88439c672c1d8abf7997.desc: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

skills.name: Well Rested
desc:
The base duration for the Rested buff is increased by **2** minutes.

**Rested**
The Rested buff increases your Stamina Maximum and Regeneration significantly.

It requires **shelter, sitting or sleeping,** as well as **warmth** from a heat source.

The buff can be refreshed **anywhere.**

Surrounding comfort items further increase its duration.

The base duration for the Rested buff is increased by **4** minutes.

**Rested**
The Rested buff increases your Stamina Maximum and Regeneration significantly.

It requires **shelter, sitting or sleeping,** as well as **warmth** from a heat source.
